Benefit: You gain temporary hit points equal to half of the hit point damage dealt by a draining spell, plus half of the ability damage dealt by the draining spell. If the draining spell deals damage to multiple victims (such as a draining fireball), calculate the temporary hit points gained based on the victim that suffered the most damage. These temporary hit points do not stack with themselves and last for up to 1 hour. A draining spell uses up a spell slot 1 level higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-fang-and-fury-combat:
You combine savagery and martial training.

Prerequisites: base attack bonus +6, able to initiate 3rd level or higher maneuvers, bite natural attack

Benefit: Once per round you may make a bite attack as an additional part of initiating a strike. This bite attack must be made against one of the targets of your strike. It does not gain any of the benefits of the strike (though it might benefit from other effects, such as boosts or stances).
feat-graves-embrace-heritage:
You enhance your deathly nature, granting you some measure of control.

Prerequisites: Mixed Blood (undead) and/or graveblood subtype

Benefit: You may choose to count as undead only if it would be advantageous to you when resolving the effects of spells and abilities (you still do not gain undead immunities unless you are actually undead). Once per day you may drain your own life force to gain power; as a swift action you suffer a -4 penalty to your Constitution and gain a +4 untyped bonus to another ability score of your choice. Both bonus and penalty last for up to 1 minute.

Normal: Graveblood creatures count as undead for the purpose of resolving spells and abilities (they still do not gain undead immunities unless they are actually undead).
feat-improved-channel-resistance-general:
You are harder to influence with channeled energy.

Prerequisite(s): Undead type

Benefit: Your channel resistance increases by +4 (even if you didn't have channel resistance).

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-imitate-corpse-combat:
You can use your undead nature to pull a classic ruse.

Prerequisites: Undead type

Benefit: When you use the Bluff or Knowledge (religion) skills to appear fully dead (as opposed to undead), you may do so as an immediate action. Add a +4 circumstance bonus to this check if you activated this ability in response to suffering damage. As usual, you fall prone and observing creatures must succeed at a Knowledge (religion) or Perception check with a DC equal to your check's result to realize that you are not fully dead.

Normal: It takes a move action for an undead creature to appear fully dead using the Bluff or Knowledge (religion) skills.
feat-positive-energy-resistance-general:
You have adapted to become resilient to positive energy damage.

Prerequisites: Undead type

Benefit: You gain positive energy resistance equal to 5 + your Hit Dice.

Special: This feat may be retrained at no cost if you cease being undead. It still takes time to retrain.
feat-psychomachy-metapsionic:
You are adept at assaulting the minds of your victims.

Prerequisites: One or more metapsionic feats

Benefit: If a power you manifest deals damage to a mental ability score (such as ego whip's damage to Charisma), you may expend your psionic focus as part of manifesting that power. If you do, it instead deals damage to the mental ability score of your choice.
feat-feral-vitality:
Prerequisite(s): Shapechanger subtype, Toughness

Benefit: You gain fast healing 2.
feat-undead-companion-general:
Your companion or familiar becomes undead.

Prerequisites: animal companion, dark messenger, or familiar

Benefit: Your animal companion, dark messenger, or familiar gains the undead type (if you have more than one of these features, choose one upon gaining this feat). Do not recalculate its base attack bonus, hit points, saving throws, or skill points. If the creature's Charisma score was less than its Constitution score before becoming undead, its Charisma score becomes equal to its former Constitution. Additionally, it gains channel resistance +4. If another ability you possess would permanently alter the affected creature's type (such as the sorrow's shadow class feature), instead improve its positive energy resistance by +5 and its channel resistance by +2.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, choose another animal companion, dark messenger, or familiar that you possess to be affected.
feat-dogpile-combat:
Prerequisites: Dirty Fighting

Benefit: Whenever you make a melee attack against a prone target, you can forego the normal +4 on your attack roll. If you do and hit, they become sickened for 1 round. Multiple hits stack, increasing the duration of the sicken.
feat-pack-howl-psionic:
Letting loose a blood curdling howl, you and your beasts see their enemies driven in fear before them.

Prerequisites: Hunting pack class feature.

Benefit: You can expend your psionic focus as a standard action to let loose a psionically-empowered howl. When you do, all creatures within 60 feet of you or one of your beasts must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier) or become frightened for one round, then shaken for one minute after that. This feat cannot be used to increase existing fear effects. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Special: If you have a collective, you may choose for specific members of your collective to not be affected by this feat.
feat-rabid-bite-combat: Benefit: When you hit with your bite attack, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + ½ your HD + Con modifier) or become fatigued after the end of its next turn (if the target is already fatigued this has no effect). This is a disease effect.
feat-superior-rabid-bite-combat:
Prerequisite(s): Bite attack, Rabid Bite, BAB +6

Benefit: The disease latent in your bite has advanced, causing a violent lashing out in addition to exhausting your foe. Now, when you hit with your bite attack, the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + ½ your HD + Con modifier) or spend its next turn attacking the nearest creature. If there are multiple creatures the same distance from it, then the target is chosen at random from among the closest targets. Regardless of if the save is made or not, the target is fatigued after the end of its next turn (if the target is already fatigued this has no effect). This replaces the effects of Rabid Bite.
feat-style-shift:
Prerequisites: One Style feat, one Shifting feat

Benefits: Whenever you adopt a Style, you may activate your Shift in the same action.

Special: If you possess the Fuse Styles feat, you may also adopt a martial stance with the same action
feat-feats:
Many of the feats presented here are heritage feats—feats that represent unlocking the latent potential in your mixed blood, or even differences, deliberate mutations, or divine gifts within creatures of pure blood. These capabilities might appear over time, as the result of exposure to magic that awakens the blood (even on accident) or deliberately, as the creature trains their capabilities. Heritage feats usually require a creature to have one or more creature types or subtypes in order to gain their benefits.

Your wings have strengthened to the point of allowing flight.

Prerequisite: Vestigial Wings, 7th level of higher

Benefit: Your wings strength; you gain a fly speed equal to double your base land speed with good maneuverability

Your unusual nature affects your vitality, bolstering you in ways different from other mortals.

Prerequisite: Aberration, fey, ooze, plant, or undead type.

Benefit: Choose Wisdom or Charisma. You calculate your bonus hit points per Hit Die based on the chosen ability score instead of your constitution

You can tap into your ancestor's elemental energy to breath that same energy upon your enemies

Prerequisite: Aberration, dragon, magical beast, ooze, or undead type, and/or cold or fire subtype

Benefit: Choose acid, cold, fire, electricity, negative energy, or sonic, then 30-ft. cone or 60-ft. line. You gain a breath weapon usable once every 2 rounds that deals 1d6/level damage of the chosen type. A successful reflex save (DC 10+ 1/2 your Hit Die + your Constitution modifier) halves this damage

With the aid of subtle blood magics, you inspire your fellows more easily.

Prerequisite: Bardic Performance, Harmonic Spell

Benefit: You gain an allotment of special bloodsong performance rounds equal to half your daily allotment of bardic performance rounds. When you regain your daily allotment of bardic performance rounds, you regain your bloodsong performance rounds as well. You may start or maintain a bardic performance with bloodsong performance rounds, but such performances only affect creatures that share a type or subtype with you until you resume spending only bardic performance rounds. You may not start or maintain a performance with both bardic performance and bloodsong performance rounds.

Your nature enhances spells for which you have an affinity.

Benefit: Spells you cast with a descriptor that matches one of your subtypes (such as a spell with the good descriptor cast by a creature with the good subtype) have their caster level and save DCs increased by 1.

The deaths of your enemies impel you to ever-greater acts of violence.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +6, and chaotic, dwarf, evil, fire, goblinoid, orc, or reptilian subtype and/or dragon, monstrous humanoid, or undead type.

Benefit: You gain a cumulative +1 racial bonus to attack and damage rolls whenever a hostile creature (with 2 or more Hit Dice) within 60-ft. of you is reduced to 0 or less hit points, which lasts for up to 1 minute or until the end of the encounter, whichever is shorter. You must be able to perceive the creature being reduced to 0 or less hit points to gain the bonus from it.

You bolster those who share beliefs similar to your nature.

Prerequisites: Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful subtype.

Benefit: Allies (other than you) within 30-ft. who share an alignment component with one of your subtypes gain a +1 morale bonus to armor class, saving throws, and skill checks.

You were born with—or developed—claws or fangs that you can use in battle.

Prerequisites: Aberration, dragon, fey, magical beast monstrous humanoid, or undead type and/or reptilian subtype.

Benefit: Choose bite or 2 claws. You gain the natural weapon(s) chosen, as normal for a creature of your size. You may not gain a natural weapon of a type you already possess in this fashion.

Special: You may select this feat up to twice.

You have honed the magic of your heritage to its peak.

Prerequisites: Improved Sanguine Sorcery, 13th level or higher.

Benefit: Choose confusion, dimension door, or shadow conjuration. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 15th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.

Your divine blood reaches its peak of concentration and power.

Prerequisites: Improved Spark of Divinity, 13th level or higher.

Benefit: Choose death ward, divine power, or flame strike. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 15th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.

You pull your prey in and don't let go.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +4, and bite or tentacle natural weapon.

Benefit: You gain the grab special attack with your bite and/ or tentacle attacks.

Your blood-born sorcery intensifies, offering greater capabilities.

Prerequisites: Sanguine Sorcery, 7th level or higher.

Benefit: Choose dispel magic, haste, or invisibility. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 10th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.

You hone your divine connection further, gaining additional capabilities.

Prerequisites: Spark of Divinity, 7th level or higher.

Benefit: Choose hold person, magic circle against alignment or resist energy. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 10th level, and every 5 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.

Your instincts are to grab an enemy and crush and tear at them while they struggle against you.

Prerequisites: Improved Grapple, and aberration, dragon, magical beast, or ooze type.

Benefit: You gain the constrict special attack, dealing 1d4+Strength modifier damage (the damage value given is for Medium creatures). If you already have a constrict special attack its damage increases by one die step.

You have a talent for harming those like yourself.

Benefit: You gain a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls made against creatures that share a type or subtype with you. Those creatures suffer a -1 penalty on saving throws made against your abilities, maneuvers, powers, and spells.

You are extraordinarily strong for your size.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +4, and dwarf, giant, or orc subtype and/or dragon, magical beast, or monstrous humanoid type.

Benefit: You gain the powerful build special quality, which lets you function in many ways as if you were one size category larger. Whenever you are subject to a size modifier or special size modifier for a Combat Maneuver Bonus or Combat Maneuver Defense (such as during grapple checks, bull rush attempts, and trip attempts), you are treated as one size larger if doing so is advantageous to you. You are also considered to be one size larger when determining whether a creature's special attacks based on size (such as grab or swallow whole) can affect you. You may use weapons designed for a creature one size larger without penalty. However, your space and reach remain those of a creature your actual size. The benefits of this ability stack with the effects of abilities, powers, and spells that change the subject's size category.

You have developed unusual amounts of life force in your body.

Prerequisites: Toughness, and aberration, fey, ooze, or plant type.

Benefit: You gain fast healing 2.

You know how to defend against those like yourself.

Benefit: You gain a +1 competence bonus to armor class and saving throws against creatures that share a type or subtype with you.

Your magical heritage has bestowed limited magical power upon you.

Prerequisites: Aberration or fey type.

Benefit: Choose charm person, mage armor, or magic missile. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.

You know how to climb exceptionally well.

Prerequisites: Climb 4 ranks, and claw natural attack and/or aberration, fey, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, ooze, or undead type and/or earth, giant, or reptilian subtype.

Benefit: You gain a climb speed equal to 1/2 your land speed. If you already have a climb speed, it instead improves by 10 ft.

Unusually small and nimble for your race, you can squeeze into tight places.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +3, and elf, gnome, goblinoid, halfling or reptilian subtype and/or aberration, fey, or ooze type.

Benefit: You gain the flexible frame special quality, which allows you to function in many ways as though you were one size smaller. If you would be subject to a size modifier or a special size modifier for an opposed check (such as Stealth), you are treated as being one size smaller if it is advantageous to you. You are considered to be one size smaller when "squeezing through" restrictive spaces, and may use weapons designed for creatures one size smaller without penalty. Your space and reach remain that of a creature your actual size. The effects of this ability stack with those of abilities, powers, and spells that change the subject's size.

Your ancestral connection to divine energies permits you to cast certain spells.

Prerequisites: Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful subtype and/or outsider type.

Benefit: Choose bless, command, or shield of faith. You may use the chosen spell as a spell-like ability once per day, at a caster level equal to your character level. At 4th level, and every 4 levels thereafter, you gain an additional use per day of the chosen spell.

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time, you choose a different spell from the above list.

Your unnatural nature infuses your body, letting you resist assaults against it in unusual ways.

Prerequisites: Aberration, fey, ooze, outsider or undead type.

Benefit: Choose Intelligence or Charisma. You use the chosen ability score in place of Constitution as a modifier to your Fortitude saves.

You were either born with or developed a pair of weak wings.

Prerequisites: Dragon, fey, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, or outsider type and/or air subtype.

Benefit: You have developed small wings; when you fall you can slow your descent by making a DC 15 Fly check to fall safely without taking falling damage, albeit at a rate of 20 feet a round. When falling safely, you can make another DC 15 Fly check to glide, moving 5 feet laterally every round. You may take ranks in the Fly skill. Fly becomes a class skill for you.

Your enemies recoil in disgust when they strike you.

Prerequisites: Aberration, ooze, or undead type and/or evil or reptilian subtype.

Benefit: When you take damage, you exude a horrible stench. Anyone within 10 feet of you must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Die + your Constitution modifier) or be sickened for 1 minute. This is a poison effect.

+++
feat-greater-unarmed-strike-combat:
Prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, character level 3rd.

Benefit: Your unarmed strikes have their base damage increased to 1d8 (for a Medium-size creature). At character level 10th, this increases to 1d10 base damage.

If you are a monk, brawler, or other class that gains increased unarmed damage based on your level, you instead add 4 to your effective class level to determine your unarmed strike damage dice.
feat-terror-of-the-hunt-psionic:
When you howl, the terror seeps into foes far and wide.

Prerequisites: Pack Howl, hunting pack class feature.

Benefit: When you use your Pack Howl feat, all creatures within one mile of you and your beasts who are not within the range of the Pack Howl itself must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier) or become shaken for one minute. This feat cannot create a stronger fear effect than shaken. A creature gains a +1 bonus on their save for every 500 feet between them and the nearest source of your Pack Howl.

Special: If you have a collective, you may choose for specific members of your collective to not be affected by this feat.
feat-mixed-blood-heritage:
You come from a family with diverse heritage.

Choose: One of the following creature types or subtypes:

Aberration, air, chaotic, cold, dragon, dwarf, earth, elf, evil, fey, fire, giant, gnome, goblinoid, good, halfling, lawful, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, orc, ooze, outsider, plant, reptilian, undead, or water.

Benefit(s): You gain the benefits associated with the chosen type or subtype from Table: Creature Subtypes. You may choose a subtype that is not appropriate for your creature type (such as a monstrous humanoid gaining the dwarf subtype through this feat). Do not recalculate your base attack bonus, saving throws, skill points, or Hit Dice.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you choose a different type and/or subtype from the above list. You may not select a type or subtype you already possess or gain both the cold and fire subtypes through this feat. Unlike other creatures with the air subtype, a creature who gains the air subtype with this feat does not gain or improve a fly speed.

Table: Creature Subtypes

Base Creature Type Benefits

Aberration You gain the aberrant subtype. Additionally, you gain darkvision 60 ft. or your existing darkvision improves by 30 ft.

Air You gain the air subtype, and you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC vs. ranged attacks as well as immunity to inhaled poisons.

Chaotic You gain the chaotic subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against effects with the lawful descriptor.

Cold You gain cold resistance equal to 5 + your level. At 7 Hit Dice, you gain the cold subtype.

Dragon You gain the drakeblood subtype, and you gain the scent special quality.

Dwarf You gain the dwarf subtype, and you gain a +2 competence bonus to your CMD when resisting a bull rush or trip attempt while standing on the ground.

Earth You gain the earth subtype, and your natural armor bonus increases by 1.

Elf You gain the elf subtype, and you gain a +1 racial bonus on Perception checks and ranged attack rolls involving a bow, crossbow, or firearm.

Evil You gain the evil subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against effects with the good descriptor.

Fey You gain the feyblood subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against compulsions.

Fire You gain fire fire resistance equal to 5 + your level. At 7 Hit Dice, you gain the fire subtype.

Giant You gain the giant subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate checks and a +1 competence bonus on CMB and CMD.

Gnome You gain the gnome subtype, and you gain a +1 racial bonus to Craft and Perception checks.

Goblinoid You gain the goblinoid subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks.

Good You gain the good subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against effects with the evil descriptor.

Halfling You gain the halfling subtype, and you gain a +1 racial bonus on Acrobatics checks and attacks made with thrown weapons.

Lawful You gain the lawful subtype, and you gain a +2 racial bonus on saves against effects with the chaotic descriptor.

Monstrous humanoid You gain the crossblood subtype, and your natural armor bonus increases by 1.

Orc You gain the orc subtype, and you gain a +1 racial bonus on melee attack and damage rolls.

Ooze You gain the slimeblood subtype, and you gain acid resistance 5.

Outsider Your type changes to outsider (native), and you gain a +2 racial bonus to Knowledge (planes) checks.

Reptilian You gain the reptilian subtype, and you gain a 15 ft. climb speed.

feat-fox-elusion-combat-style:
You are able to effortlessly dodge your opponent's strikes against you by distracting it with disruptive feints.

Prerequisites: Int 13, Combat Expertise, Fox Style, Improved Feint; base attack bonus +9 or Bluff 9 ranks.

Benefit: While using this stance, increase the duration of the concealment that you gain from Fox Style by a number of rounds equal to your Charisma bonus (minimum 0).
feat-improved-remedial-shapechange:
When you use remedial shapechanging to repair your body, you recover additional wounds.

Prerequisites: Con 13, shapechanger.

Benefit: When you successfully use remedial shapechanging, the next time you heal hit point damage during the next 24 hours you heal 2 hit points of damage per Hit Die you possess plus 1d4 points of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution damage. You may divide this healing up between multiple ability scores.

Additionally, you can use remedial shapechanging in new ways by increasing the Constitution check DC. First, you can add +5 to the DC in order to perform remedial shapechanging in 1d4 rounds instead of 1 minute. Second, you can add +5 to the DC in order to immediately heal this hit point and ability damage without needing to receive healing from another source. You may choose to apply one, both, or neither of these modifications to your Constitution check.

Normal: A successful use of remedial shapechanging causes your remedial shapechanging to heal 1 hit point of damage per Hit Die you possess and 1 point of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution damage.

Remedial Shapechange

When examining a shapechanger, some are surprised to realize that shapechangers do not seem to heal their wounds between their forms. While not entirely impossible, it is extremely difficult for such a creature to heal its wounds because it can only guide its body from one form into the next; reknitting their own flesh and bone together is not only a painful prospective, but it is downright impossible without some sort of healing agent, be it time or magic, to solidify the process. The practice of using one's shapechanging abilities for self healing is called remedial shapeshifting, and all shapechangers can perform this special action.

Once per day, a creature with the shapechanger subtype can spend 1 minute using its change shape ability to close minor wounds and set broken bones by slowly changing from one form to another. After this minute, the shapechanger makes a DC 15 Constitution check. If successful, the next time it heals hit point damage during the next 24 hours it heals 1 additional point of damage per Hit Die as well as 1 point of Strength, Dexteirty, or Constitution damage. Additionally, any wounds that the shapechanger possessed from caltrops or similar effects are healed as if the shapechanger had rested for 24 hours. Whether or not the shapechanger succeeds, it cannot use this ability again for 24 hours. Creatures that are unable to control their shapeshifting (such as afflicted lycanthropes) or who are unable to change shape cannot make use of this ability.
feat-spell-feint:
You foil an opponent's attempts to counterspell your magic by surprising them with an unexpected spell.

Prerequisites: Spell Bluff.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on Sense Motive checks to determine if an opponent is has readied an action to attempt to counterspell your spells. If you determine that your opponent has readied an action to attempt to counterspell your spells, you can attempt a Bluff check opposed by the opponent's Sense Motive as a standard action to fool them into wasting their counterspell. If your check succeeds, your opponent wastes his readied action, expending one 1st-level spell slot in the process. For every 5 by which your Bluff exceeds your opponent's Sense Motive, increase the level of the wasted spell slot by 1, up to the maximum level of spell that your target can cast.
feat-flexible-font:
You draw your magical power from more than one source.

Prerequisite: Font class feature, 3rd level.

Benefit: Select a font focus (from any font) that you do not have and add that font's focus spells to your list of known spells.

Normal: You only gain bonus known spells from one font.
feat-second-spirit-totem:
You can bond with two spirit totems.

Prerequisite: Spirit totem class feature, 7th level.

Benefit: Select a second spirit totem.

Whenever you gain a totem bonus feat or totemic aspect in your class progression, you can choose options from either of your spirit totems.

Normal: You only gain one spirit totem.
feat-affix-balloon-combat:
You can use your balloons defensively.

Prerequisite(s): Haan, Int 13, Combat Expertise, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): You gain the haan's balloon special ability, allowing you to affix a balloon to an opponent as a combat maneuver that does not provoke attacks of opportunity (see above). The DC for the Reflex save or Strength check to escape from this balloon is equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier.
feat-amplified-glitch-combat:
You can create sudden distractions with technological devices.

Prerequisite(s): Disable Device 3 ranks, Intimidate 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can wirelessly introduce a fast-acting virus or disruptive frequency into all nearby technological devices to briefly cause them to malfunction in loud, surprising ways. You can use this ability on one target creature per character level, no two of which can be more than 30 feet apart. Each target must either be carrying technological devices or be within sight and hearing of such devices. (The locations of such devices are up to the GM, although most public spaces in technologically developed areas contain enough technology for this feat to function.)

Your glitch causes alarms to go off, automated devices to spin and flail, readouts to flash brightly, and so on. With a successful Disable Device check (DC 10 + the highest Hit Dice of all creatures targeted + the highest Wisdom bonus of all creatures targeted + 1 per creature targeted beyond the first), all targets are shaken for 1 round, plus 1 additional round for every 5 by which your result exceeds the DC.

Once you have targeted a creature with this feat, that foe is immune to this ability for 24 hours.
feat-barricade-combat:
You are adept at creating quick, temporary cover.

Prerequisite: Knowledge (engineering) 1 rank.

Benefit: As a move action, you can stack and reinforce objects that are too small or too fragile to provide cover into a single square of adjacent cover. The GM has discretion over whether enough such objects are nearby to allow you to use this ability, but most urban and wilderness settings not specifically described as empty or barren have enough such material to allow at least one such temporary barricade to be built. The barricade grants partial cover against attacks with line of effect that pass through it. If the barricade is in a square that already granted partial cover, it instead grants normal cover.

The barricade is temporary and not particularly durable. It has hardness equal to 5 + 1/2 your number of ranks in Knowledge (engineering), and three times that many hit points. Additionally, once it or a creature adjacent to it is hit by an attack, the barricade collapses at the beginning of your turn in 1d4 rounds (unless the barricade is destroyed completely by the attack). There isn't normally enough material for you to build a second barricade in exactly the same space unless you are in a particularly crowded area (as determined by the GM).
feat-conditioned-response-combat:
You are skilled at turning your defensive conditioning into offensive opportunities.

Prerequisite(s): commando conditioning class feature*.

Benefit(s): When you successfully make a saving throw using a bonus you gain from your commando conditioning class feature, you can apply that same bonus to the first attack roll and damage roll you make against the creature that triggered that saving throw, as long as that attack is made before the end of your next turn.
feat-constrict:
You can use your serpentine lower body to crush foes that you grapple.

Prerequisite(s): Legless species trait, venomborn.

Benefit(s): You can grapple foes with your lower body, leaving your hands free. When you do so, you also inflict bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 plus 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier, as per the construct universal monster ability.
feat-exposure-training:
You have learned how to make the most out of any situation, even ones you're not specifically trained for.

Prerequisite(s): commando conditioning class feature*, evasion class feature.

Benefit(s): Once per day as an immediate action when you attempt a saving throw that your conditioning bonus doesn't apply to, you can apply your highest conditioning bonus to that saving throw.
feat-extra-favored-enemy:
You have honed your skills against more favored enemies than most rangers.

Prerequisite(s): favored enemy class feature, ranger level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You designate one additional creature type or subtype as a favored enemy. Your bonus against this favored enemy begins at +2. Like your other favored enemy bonuses, this bonus may be selected to be increased at any level that you normally gain a new favored enemy (5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th).

Special: You can take this feat more than once, but no more than one additional time for every 4 ranger class levels you possess beyond 3rd.
feat-extra-favored-terrain:
You are a master of more terrains than most rangers.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain class feature, ranger level 5th.

Benefit(s): You designate one additional type of terrain as a favored terrain, as defined on page 65 of the Pathfinder Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook. Your bonus in this favored terrain begins at +2. Like your other favored terrain bonuses, this bonus may be selected to be increased at any level that you normally gain a new favored terrain (8th, 13th, and 18th).

Special: You can take this feat more than once, but no more than one additional time for every 4 ranger class levels you possess beyond 5th.
feat-extra-instant-talent:
You are an expert in working with your symbiote to adapt to the conditions you face.

Prerequisite(s): instant talent class feature*.

Benefit(s): You can use your instant talent ability 1 additional time per day without incurring influence from your symbiote.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-extra-venomborn-mutation:
Whether it appeared immediately or only later over time, the venomborn mutagen has given you more mutations than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Mutation species trait, venomborn.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional mutation, chosen from those listed for the mutation species trait.

Special: You can take this feat one additional time for every 6 levels you gain beyond 1st (7th, 13th, and 19th).
feat-fragmented-burst:
You can use your fragmented step ability without moving.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, shattersoul, fragmented step species trait, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You can use your fragmented step ability one additional time per day. As a full-round action, you can expend one use of fragmented step to send out shards of your body at every creature within a 30-foot radius, dealing damage as per your fragmented step ability. If you have the fragmented charge ability, you can instead choose to affect every creature in a 60-foot radius.
feat-fragmented-charge:
You gain additional options with your fragmented step.

Prerequisite(s): shattersoul, fragmented step species trait, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): You can use your fragmented step ability one additional time per day. When you use fragmented step, you can choose to use it as a full-round action to move up 60 feet instead of the normal 30 feet. If you end your movement adjacent to an opponent, you can choose to apply your fragmented step damage to that opponent as well, even if you did not move through that opponent's square.
feat-greater-affix-balloon-combat:
You can make free attacks on foes that you send floating away with your balloons.

Prerequisite(s): Haan, Int 13, Affix Balloon or balloon special ability, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus on checks made to affix a balloon to a foe. Whenever you successfully move an opponent with a balloon, that forced movement provokes attacks of opportunity.
feat-improved-firespray:
Your firespray is particularly potent.

Prerequisite(s): haan, firespray ability.

Benefit(s): You roll d8s for the damage of your firespray instead of d6s. If you normally add 1/2 your level to the damage, also increase the number of dice that you roll by 1.
feat-improved-lunge-combat:
You can quickly recover from your lunges, helping you to avoid counterattacks.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 1 rank, Lunge.

Benefit(s): When you use the Lunge feat to increase the reach of your melee attacks by 5 feet until the end of your turn, you do not suffer a penalty to your AC. You cannot use this feat if you carry a medium or heavy load.

Normal: You take a –2 penalty to your AC until your next turn when making a lunge attack.
feat-improved-primal-defense:
You can wear minimal armor as a second skin, undaunted and unhindered as always.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, Primal Defense, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): You can gain the benefits of the Primal Defense feat even when wearing light armor.
feat-improved-sake-affinity:
Your affinity for alcohol unlocks additional abilities.

Prerequisites: tanuki, sake affinity species trait, sufficiently high level (see table).

Benefit: Choose one spell from the table below; by taking a swig of alcohol, you can expend one daily use of your expeditious retreat ability to gain the benefits of this spell. The duration of the effect is always 1 minute, regardless of its usual duration.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you select it, you may select another spell from the table. To select a spell, you must meet the minimum character level for its listing in the table.

Spell Min. Level

Divine favor 3rd

False life 5th

Rage 7th
feat-improved-tanuki-magic:
You gain greater spell-like abilities.

Prerequisites: tanuki, tanuki magic species trait.

Benefit: You may use your detect poison and purify food and drink spell-like abilities at will, and you add create food and water, disguise self, and shrink item to the spell-like abilities that you may use once each per day.
feat-mariner:
You are equally at home above or below the water.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain (water) class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to Profession (sailor) and Swim checks. You can always take 10 on Swim checks, you never need to make concentration or Acrobatics checks due to rough waters, and you add your character level when determining the number of rounds you can hold your breath.
feat-on-second-thought:
You are able to partition your mind, relying on your two separate identities to provide you with added mental defenses.

Prerequisite(s): dual identity class feature, quick change social talent, vigilante level 7th.

Benefit(s): When you fail a saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, you can change your mental state to your other identity (from social to vigilante, or vice versa) for a brief moment as an ? immediate action; this does not involve any kind of physical transformation. Your other identity makes the same saving throw against the effect, and you take whichever result is most favorable. You remain in the identity you started in, and you are staggered on your next turn. If you also have the immediate change social talent, you are not staggered.
feat-powerful-stench:
You have greater control over your odor glands than most taers.

Prerequisite(s): Stench trait, taer.

Benefit(s): The range of your stench aura extends to 15 feet. In addition, you can use that ability an additional number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1), although you must wait 1d4 rounds between uses.
feat-primal-defense:
Your instincts and sheer determination are all you need to ward off attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When unarmored, you add your Constitution bonus to your AC and your CMD. This does not stack with class features that allow you to add your Wisdom bonus or any other ability score other than Dexterity to your AC. If you are proficient with shields, you can use a shield to further improve your AC while using this feat.
feat-primitive-weapon-expert-combat:
You are an expert at wielding weapons made from fragile materials.

Benefit(s): Any weapon made from primitive materials (such as bone, obsidian, stone, or wood) loses the fragile quality while you wield it.
feat-sidekick-variant-leadership:
You recruit a follower who, like you, has a masked persona.

Prerequisite(s): character level 4th, dual identity class feature or masked persona.

Benefit(s): This feat is similar to the Leadership feat, with several exceptions. You can attract only a 1st-level cohort (referred to hereafter as a sidekick) with this feat, and can't recruit followers. You determine your Leadership score according to the rules presented in the Leadership feat, but your sidekick is always at least 3 levels lower than yourself.

A sidekick can take levels in only fighter, rogue, or vigilante. They cannot multiclass, though they can take any archetype for which they qualify.

Your sidekick gains a masked persona and gains all of the benefits of your own dual identity or masked persona feature. If your sidekick is accompanying you, changing identities for them requires the same amount of time that it takes for you, regardless of how much time it would normally take them. Your sidekick can never be coerced to reveal your true identity.

If a sidekick gains enough XP to bring them to 2 levels lower than your level, they don't gain the new level until you gain your next level; until you advance, their XP total remains 1 less than the amount needed to attain the next level.

If you release your sidekick from service or otherwise lose your sidekick, you can recruit a new one. At 7th level, you can swap this feat for the Leadership feat.
feat-spelunker:
You're trained in the skills needed to explore and survive underground.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain (underground) class feature.

Benefit(s): While in underground terrain, you gain a +2 bonus on Climb checks and on Acrobatics checks to cross narrow surfaces and uneven ground. Additionally, you get a +2 bonus to Perception checks against creatures that gain a species bonus to Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.

Finally, you gain a +4 bonus on Fortitude saves against disease and poison effects caused by molds, fungus, and creatures of the ooze or plant type.
feat-temporary-enemy:
You briefly treat a creature as your nemesis.

Prerequisite(s): favored enemy class feature, ranger level 5th.

Benefit(s): Once per day as a swift action, you can designate one creature you can see as your favored enemy for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Make a Knowledge check to identify the creature. If you succeed, you use your highest favored enemy bonus against them; otherwise, your bonus is +2.
feat-three-dimensional-tactics-combat:
Being accustomed to life underwater, many kalo warriors are trained to fight in three dimensions.

Prerequisite(s): kalo, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are fighting underwater, in a zero-gravity environment, while flying, or in other situations where you are not restricted to a single plane of movement, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls in any round in which you have moved, even if it's just a 5-foot step.
feat-two-places-at-once:
When in doubt, you can offer definitive proof that your social and vigilante identities are separate individuals.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 11, dual identity class feature or masked persona.

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can create an illusion of your social identity (if you are in your vigilante identity) or your vigilante identity (if you are in your social identity).

This functions as silent image, but is a supernatural ability. If you're at least 4th level, it functions instead as minor image. If you're at least 7th level, it functions instead as major image. If you're at least 10th level, it can function instead as persistent image. If you're at least 13th level, it can function instead as programmed image. As long as the image does not directly interact with a viewer, add any Disguise bonus you receive from your seamless guise class feature to the save DC to detect the illusion.
feat-urbanite:
You are an expert at surviving even the deadliest urban jungle.

Prerequisite(s): favored terrain (urban) class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Appraise, Diplomacy, and Knowledge (local) checks. In addition, your movement is not impeded by crowds or difficult terrain within urban areas.
feat-whalesong-blast:
You can weaponize your powerful vocalizations against your opponents.

Prerequisites: whalefolk, echolocation species trait.

Benefit: Once per hour, you can emit a 15-foot cone of sonic energy as a standard action. Each creature in the area of effect takes 2d4 damage. A successful Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 +1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier) halves the damage, but a creature that fails this saving throw by 5 or more is also staggered for 1 round. The damage increases by 1d4 at 6th level and every 5 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 5d4 damage at 16th level.
feat-astrology:
You have come to understand that the workings of the universe and even the capricious machinations of the gods can all be divined from the motions of the heavens.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (geography) 3 ranks and Sense Motive 3 ranks, or the ability to manifest at least 1 constellation and Sense Motive 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): You can perform the prognostication occult skill unlock even if you can't use psychic magic, though you must employ this occult skill unlock via horoscopy.

With a DC 10 + creature's hit die prognostication task you can determine the astrological conditions at the time of a creature's birth. This can allow you to ascertain information about a creature that is based on those astrological conditions such as a creature's date of birth or the benefits they would receive from the Auspicious Birth feat. This task follows the normal rules for the prognostication occult skill unlock.

If you can cast psychic spells or have the Psychic Sensitivity feat, you can use prognostication one additional time per day.

Spending 1 minute consulting a star chart or cosmogram that is accurate for the world or plane you are currently on, prior to attempting a Sense Motive check, grants you a +2 insight bonus on the check.

Special: A zodiac, or a path of the mage vizier, can expend uses of their stargazing or personal astrarium ability to use prognostication an additional time per day.
feat-auroral-armaments:
Sometimes destruction requires more than just stellar power.

Prerequisite(s): Zodiac with the aurora orbit, BAB +4

Benefit(s): While you are wielding the weapon form of a constellation you may take a swift action to add your aurora torch damage to a single attack with that constellation.
feat-extra-secret-of-the-pale:
Your delve into the secrets of life and death are unceasing, constantly expanding your abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Pale theologian, secrets of the pale class feature

Benefit(s): You gain an additional secret of the pale.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, allowing you to select a different secret of the pale each time it is selected.
feat-extra-theology-points:
The arts of pale theology come naturally to you.

Prerequisite(s): Theology points class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an extra 2 theology points each day.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, granting you an additional 2 theology points for each selection.
feat-fly-in-formation-teamwork:
You are skilled at flying together with your companions.

Prerequisite(s): Fly speed

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Fly checks and you improve the maneuverability of your fly speed by one step while adjacent to a flying ally with this feat. If an adjacent ally with this feat would fall, and you have a free hand or other grasping appendage, you can catch them as an immediate action. If you are flying with a heavy load, or your ally's additional weight would put you at a heavy load, you both begin to fall slowly towards the ground at a rate of 60 feet per round and take no damage upon landing.
feat-grant-control:
Control over your undead is easily granted to others, binding the energy to their soul rather than yours.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to create and control mindless undead.

Benefit(s): As a standard action you can touch a creature and transfer control over any number of mindless undead you control to that creature. These undead count against that creature's limit of undead they can control using animate dead (or similar abilities, such as the Death sphere's reanimate ability), and you cannot transfer control to a creature if the transferred undead would put them above this cap. You cannot transfer control of an undead whose total Hit Dice is more than twice the recipient's caster level with their ability to create and control undead. If the touched creature does not have the ability to create and control mindless undead themselves, they may only control a maximum of four Hit Dice of undead, none of which can have more than 2 Hit Dice. If the creature has caster levels in a class with animate dead on their spell list but does not know the spell, they use their caster level when determining the number of undead they can control (as normal for animate dead).

Transferred undead follow the new creature's commands, not yours, and no longer count against the number of Hit Dice of undead you can control.
feat-manipulate-deathly-intellect:
You can manipulate the intellect of the undead you create, allowing you to render an intelligent undead you create feral and wild and imbue mindless undead with a measure of thought.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to create undead creatures, character level 5

Benefit(s): Whenever you create a mindless undead creature, you can choose to give it a measure of Intellect. It gains an Intelligence score of 1, can understand (but not speak) one language you know, and gains 1 skill rank per Hit Die. An undead creature's class skills are Climb, Disguise, Fly, Intimidate, Knowledge (arcane), Knowledge (religion), Perception, Sense Motive, Spellcraft, and Stealth. At character level 11, you can choose to increase its Intelligence score to 2.

You still treat these undead as mindless undead when determining if you can control them with your magic.

Alternatively, when you create an intelligent undead creature you can choose to cripple its intellect, reducing its Intelligence score to 3. It loses skill ranks as normal for having lower Intelligence, and loses the ability to speak (but not understand) its languages. At 11th level, and again at 17th level, you can choose to reduce their Intelligence score by an additional 1.
feat-master-undead-trainer:
Your mastery over handling unaligned undead has greeted you greater insight into training them to perform basic tasks.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Undead 11 ranks.

Benefit(s): You can train mindless unaligned undead to perform 2 tricks, rather than only 1. Undead you train retain this ability until they are trained by another character, in such a case they lose their knowledge of this additional trick.
feat-unaligned-undead:
You have learned to quell the evil energies of mindless undead you create.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to create mindless undead, character level 9

Benefit(s): When you create a mindless undead creature, you can choose to create them with an alignment of true neutral.

If these undead are released from your command they have a starting attitude of Indifferent to all creatures, but defend themselves if attacked. Unaligned undead still give off an aura of evil and are detected as such by the detect evil spell and other abilities that detect evil-aligned creatures.

Unaligned mindless undead often seek out the professions and family members they left behind in life. Though their skills remain non-existent, if they are managed properly they can be used as assistants in many tasks. Unaligned undead are often used as laborers or soldiers in societies where their creation is common.
feat-cypherspeaker:
Prerequisite(s) Words of Foundation class feature, Perform (oratory) 1 rank Cypherspeakers have studied how the higher powers hid the truth of the Words beneath layers of obfuscation and seek to emulate this for their own needs.

Benefit(s): You can conceal the activity of speaking a Word by masking it in your speech. As a swift action, you may combine your speaking of a Word with a Perform (oratory) check. Observers must make a Perception or Sense Motive check opposed by your Perform (oratory) check to realize you are also speaking a Word.

Special: This feat counts as Cypher Magic for the purposes of qualifying for the prestige class Cyphermage. You may also ignore the requirement for arcane casting and treat the increases to arcane caster level granted by Cyphermage as increases to Speaker level for Identifying Words and Words of Foundation.
feat-death-spiral-combat:
You can spin or hurl a grappled opponent across an icy or snowy surface.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 6 ranks, Improved Grapple.

Benefit(s): While you have an opponent up to one size category larger than you grappled, you can attempt the move grapple action if you and your opponent are standing upon a surface covered in ice, snow, or at the GM's discretion, another appropriate slippery medium.

If you succeed, instead of moving both yourself and your target up to half your speed, you continuously rotate around an axis in the center of the square(s) you currently occupy while moving your opponent through each square adjacent to you, provoking attacks of opportunity from creatures threatening the squares your opponent passes through when applicable. After you have done so, you can use a move action each round to continue the death spiral without needing to attempt an additional combat maneuver check. You cannot move while maintaining the death spiral.

If you release the grapple, your target falls prone in a square of your choosing adjacent to you. Alternatively, when releasing the grapple, you may attempt to hurl your opponent across the slick surface by making a grapple combat maneuver. If your check succeeds, you hurl your target 5 feet away from you in a direction of your choosing. For every 5 by which your check exceeds your opponent's CMD, you hurl the target an additional 5 feet. On a failed check, you and your opponent fall prone in a randomly determined square adjacent to your last position.

You cannot use this feat if you are grappling more than one target. If you are wearing ice skates while performing this maneuver on an icy surface, you gain a +4 bonus on your combat maneuver check to begin the death spiral, but you must also succeed on a DC 10 Acrobatics check each round to spin around an axis without falling and thus ending the death spiral.
feat-decipher-cipher:
Prerequisite(s) Words of Foundation class feature, Linguistics 1 rank

Benefit(s): You may attempt a Linguistics check to create a cipher that has a DC equal to the result rolled (or a lower number if you desire). When creating this cipher, you gain +1 to the Linguistics check for every language you know. This takes one hour.

You can attempt a Linguistics check to decipher a single page of text as a full-round action instead of taking 1 minute as normal. In addition, when you attempt a Use Magic Device check to cast a spell from a scroll, you are treated as though you have the minimum score in the appropriate ability score to cast that spell. Finally, you may choose to add your Intelligence modifier to your Use Magic Device skill checks instead of your Charisma modifier.
feat-double-cork-charge-combat:
Your aerial tricks on ice skates and skis confound your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Acrobatics), Snow Bum.

Benefit(s): When you succeed on an Acrobatics check to charge an opponent while ice skating or skiing, you deny your target his Dexterity bonus to AC and ignore the –2 penalty to AC imposed by charging if your Acrobatics check equals or exceeds your target's CMD.
feat-experimental-speaker:
Prerequisite(s) no levels of a class that grants the Words of Foundation class feature, ability to cast spells, Linguistics 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Select one class that grants you the ability to cast spells. You can now use your highest level spell slots from that class to speak a limited number of Words, treating your level in that class as your Speaker level. Learn the following Identifying Words: All, Ally, Enemy, and Self. In addition, learn one Word of Foundation that you meet the prerequisites for. The Word and Identifying Word must be prepared if you are a prepared spellcaster.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each additional time you select this feat, learn an additional Word of Foundation that you meet the prerequisites for.
feat-extra-modifying-word:
Prerequisite(s) Modifying Word class feature

Benefit(s): You gain one additional modifying word. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this modifying word.

Special: You can gain Extra Modifying Word multiple times, but at most once per 5 Speaker levels.
feat-fiery-spellcaster:
You are an expert at identifying, dispelling, and countering cold-based spells and effects.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 4 ranks.

Benefit(s): You gain a +4 bonus on the following checks: Spellcraft checks made to identify a spell with the cold descriptor as it is being cast, and dispel checks made to dispel a cold-based spell or effect. In addition, when you select an opponent as the target of your counterspell, and the designated opponent casts a spell with the cold descriptor, you may counter that spell by casting a spell with the fire descriptor. This spell can be no more than one level lower than the spell you are countering. It may also be of equal or greater level than the spell you are countering.
feat-frostbitten-touch:
Your frigid touch destroys living tissue.

Prerequisite(s): ability to cast 5th-level arcane spells.

Benefit(s): When you hit a target with a melee touch attack dealing cold damage, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your caster level + your Intelligence or Charisma modifier [your choice]) or become fatigued for 1 round. This cannot cause the target to become exhausted, even if the target is already fatigued. However, if you confirm a critical hit with the melee touch attack, the target instead becomes exhausted for 1 round. Undead, constructs, and creatures immune to cold damage are also immune to this effect.
feat-frozen-fury:
While raging, you imbue your attacks with winter's fury.

Prerequisite(s): Rage class feature, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): While raging you can spend one or more rounds of rage as a swift action to deal additional cold damage on melee attacks you make on your turn. Your melee attacks deal 1 point of cold damage for each round of rage you spend, up to a maximum of one-half your current rounds of rage.
feat-greater-word-focus:
Prerequisite(s) Word Focus Choose an Identifying Word to which you have already applied the Word Focus feat. Any Words you speak using that Identifying Word are very difficult to resist.

Benefit(s): Add +1 to the Difficulty Class for all saving throws against Words using the Identifying Word you select. This bonus stacks with the bonus from Word Focus.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new Identifying Word to which you have already applied the Word Focus feat.
feat-ice-runner:
You maintain your balance and grip when moving across icy or snowy surfaces.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 3 ranks, Climb 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): You ignore up to –5 in penalties due to slippery surfaces on Acrobatics checks and Climb checks, allowing you to move across icy terrain or climb icy surfaces with greater ease than most. When you fail an Acrobatics check while walking across ice or snow, your movement, if any, is halted, but you do not fall prone.
feat-ice-vision:
Your eyes are trained to spot icy hazards.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 3 ranks, Survival 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): You gain a +4 bonus on the following checks: Survival checks made to avoid or detect the potential for natural hazards in a specific area, such as crevasses, thin ice, and glacial lake outburst floods including Jökulhlaups; Perception checks made to spot encroaching avalanches, icebergs, and glacial lake outburst floods including Jökulhlaups; and Perception checks made to potentially notice unusual ice structures such as traps and hidden doors located in a pane or block of ice or snow. You receive a check to notice such features whenever you pass within 10 feet of them, whether or not you are actively looking.
feat-icy-spellcaster:
You are an expert at identifying, dispelling, and countering fire-based spells and effects.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 4 ranks.

Benefit(s): You gain a +4 bonus on the following checks: Spellcraft checks made to identify a spell with the fire descriptor as it is being cast, and dispel checks made to dispel a fire-based spell or effect. In addition, when you select an opponent as the target of your counterspell, and the designated opponent casts a spell with the fire descriptor, you may counter that spell by casting a spell with the cold descriptor. This spell can be no more than one level lower than the spell you are countering. It may also be of equal or greater level than the spell you are countering.
feat-inner-fire:
Your core body temperature increases when you are subject to cold-based spells and effects.

Prerequisite(s): Endurance, Great Fortitude.

Benefit(s): Whenever you succeed on a saving throw against a spell with the [cold descriptor], you gain resistance to cold equal to the level of the spell. You may immediately apply the resistance to any cold damage dealt by the spell responsible for triggering this feat, and the resistance to cold lasts for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).

In order to gain resistance to cold, the saving throw must be made in response to an enemy's actions.

Saving throws caused by your actions or those of your allies never grant resistance to cold.
feat-master-linguist:
Prerequisite(s) Linguistics 5 ranks, Perform (oratory) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): From this point forward, whenever you put a rank into Perform (oratory), you learn to speak and read a new language. You do not learn any languages for ranks put into Perform (oratory) before gaining this feat.
feat-namer:
Prerequisite(s) Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): When you would learn a Word, you may instead learn the Word for a type of creature that would be summonable via a Summon Monster spell with spell level equal to half your Speaker level (minimum 1). Speaking the Word for a creature summons a copy of the creature within 30 feet of you that lasts for 1 minute per Speaker level and expends a use of the Ally Identifying Word. This is not the True Name of a specific creature, but instead the Word of Foundation for that type of creature.

This feat counts as having the ability to cast summon monster.
feat-orca-pod-combat-teamwork:
You emulate orca tactics while underwater.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Grapple, swim speed, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When you and at least one ally who also has this feat threaten the same creature while underwater, you gain the grab special attack. You are treated as if you were one size category larger than your actual size for each ally threatening the same creature. Therefore, if you and two allies threaten the same opponent, you are treated as if you were two size categories larger than your true size. In addition, while underwater you can verbally communicate with allies who also have this feat, though you are limited to exchanging basic information such as move, stay, go, attack, defend, and the like.
feat-polar-bear:
You are accustomed to immersion in cold water.

Prerequisite(s): Endurance, Swim 1 rank.

Benefit(s): When immersed in cold water, you treat the water's temperature as if it were 20° Fahrenheit (11° Celsius) warmer than its true temperature (see "Cold Dangers" for details regarding immersion in very cold water). You gain a +4 bonus on Swim checks made when swimming in water with a temperature of 60° Fahrenheit (15° Celsius) or less. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws against spells with both the cold and water descriptors as well as spells with the cold descriptor belonging either to the Water domain or the Elemental school of water.
feat-polar-vision:
Your eyes grow accustomed to prolonged twilight.

Benefit(s): While outdoors in terrain covered by ice or snow, you gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, you gain darkvision out to a range of 30 feet instead. If you already have darkvision, the range of your darkvision increases by 30 feet.
feat-practiced-paddler-racial:
Prerequisite(s): Paddler Shoony

Benefit(s): You're skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony. You gain a swim speed of 20 feet and the +8 racial bonus on Swim checks that a swim speed normally grants.
feat-reindeer-herder:
You domesticate and train reindeer.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 3 ranks, Ride 3 ranks, either the animal companion, divine bond (mount), or mount class feature.

Benefit(s): This feat affects only reindeer. In temperatures of 40° Fahrenheit (4° Celsius) or less, you and your reindeer animal companion or mount gain the benefits of endure elements whenever you are adjacent to each other. In addition, when you ride your reindeer animal companion or mount, the reindeer can move across snow and icy surfaces without penalty.
feat-resolute-soul:
Prerequisite(s) Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): Negative levels do not apply a penalty to your Will saving throws.
feat-shivering-fist:
Your unarmed strike chills your target to the bone.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): You must declare you are using this feat before you make your attack roll (thus, a failed attack roll ruins the attempt). Shivering Fist forces a foe damaged by your unarmed attack to succeed at a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wis modifier), in addition to dealing damage normally. A defender who fails this saving throw uncontrollably shivers for 1 round. A shivering creature can take no actions, becomes vulnerable to cold, and loses his Dex bonus to AC, if any. Creatures immune to cold are immune to the shivering effect but still take damage normally. You may attempt a shivering attack once per day for every four levels you have attained (but see Special), and no more than once per round.

Special: A monk of the katabonic chill receives Shivering Fist as a bonus feat at 1st level, even if he does not meet the prerequisites. A monk may attempt a Shivering Fist attack a number of times per day equal to his monk level, plus one more time per day for every four levels he has in classes other than monk.
feat-slippery-character:
You quickly react to spells with the [cold descriptor].

Prerequisite(s): Improved Lightning Reflexes, Lightning Reflexes.

Benefit(s): Whenever you succeed on a Reflex saving throw against a spell or spell-like ability with the [cold descriptor], you may as an immediate action move a number of squares across a surface covered by ice or snow up to the level of the spell. You cannot move a distance greater than your base speed regardless of the spell's level. You must walk across the surface to gain the preceding benefit. Furthermore, the saving throw must be made in response to an enemy's actions.

Saving throws caused by your actions or those of your allies grant you no ability to move.
feat-small-but-vicious-racial:
Prerequisite(s): Shoony

Benefit(s): Unlike most Shoony, you tend towards more aggressive behavior against those you are unfamiliar with. You gain a natural bite attack that deals 1d3 bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
feat-snow-angel:
You are equally comfortable standing upright or lying prone while on ice and snow.

Benefit(s): While prone on ice or snow, you make melee attack rolls without penalty.

Normal: You suffer a –4 penalty to melee attack rolls while prone.
feat-snow-bum:
You are an expert ice skater and skier.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 4 ranks.

Benefits: You gain a +4 bonus on all Acrobatics checks made to ice skate and ski. Whenever you succeed on an Acrobatics check to increase your speed while ice skating and skiing, your speed doubles instead. The penalty you take while using a ranged weapon while moving on skates or skis is halved from –4 to –2.
feat-sodbuster-racial:
Prerequisite(s): Shoony; 5th level

Benefit(s): Years toiling in soil have made you an expert digger. You gain a burrow speed of 10 feet.
feat-spontaneous-chill:
Instead of casting a cure spell, you can instead cast a spell with the [cold descriptor].

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks, ability to spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells, Arctic domain or Ice subdomain.

Benefit(s): You can "lose" a prepared spell to cast a spell with the cold descriptor at least one level lower, instead of casting a cure spell or an inflict spell as you normally would. The spontaneously cast spell must appear on your class's spell list.
feat-tobogganing:
You emulate the penguin's ability to escape danger.

Benefit(s): When you drop to a prone position on ice or snow, you take a –2 penalty to AC against melee attacks and can move at half speed across such a surface. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal. You can take a 5-foot step while prone. This benefit does not stack with the rogue fast crawl talent. If you fall prone while ice skating or skiing, any falling damage is reduced by half, but damage sustained from a collision with an object or creature while sliding on ice or snow is dealt normally.

Normal: You can crawl 5 feet as a move action. You cannot take a 5-foot step while crawling. While prone, you take a –4 penalty to AC against melee attacks.
feat-true-namer:
Prerequisite(s) 11th level Speaker, Namer, Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): You gain the Wizard arcane discovery True Name, treating your Speaker level as your Wizard level for all purposes.

Special: You can gain True Namer multiple times, but you must select a different, specific outsider each time.
feat-unconscious-speaker:
Prerequisite(s) 11th level Speaker, Words of Foundation class feature

Benefit(s): Once per day when you are reduced below 0 hit points, you may speak a single Word as an immediate action. If this Word regains you enough hit points to regain consciousness, you do not fall prone or unconscious.
feat-whisperer:
Prerequisite(s) know at least 3 Modifying Words, Words of Foundation class feature Through extreme mastery of Foundation, you have discovered the secret to sharing your knowledge temporarily.

Benefit(s): Once per day as a full-round action you may whisper a Word of Foundation and Identifying Word into an ally's ear. Doing this expends a use of the Identifying Word and the Word itself, as well as requiring you to gain any penalties associated with speaking the Word.

That ally may use that Word and Identifying Word once as a standard action using your level and DC for the ability at the time that the Word was whispered to them. They lose this ability the next time you meditate to regain Words.
feat-wielder-of-flame:
Creatures vulnerable to fire cower in your presence.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Intimidate 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully hit an enemy vulnerable to fire with a melee attack dealing fire damage, the struck creature must also succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier) or become shaken for 1 round.

This is a mind-affecting, fear effect. A creature that successfully saves is not subject to the same effect for 24 hours.
feat-wielder-of-frost:
Creatures vulnerable to cold cower in your presence.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Intimidate 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully hit an enemy vulnerable to cold with a melee attack dealing cold damage, the struck creature must also succeed at a Will saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Charisma modifier) or become shaken for 1 round.

This is a mind-affecting, fear effect. A creature that successfully saves is not subject to the same effect for 24 hours.
feat-wolf-pack-combat-teamwork:
You and your allies emulate the hunting tactics of wolves.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): When you and at least one ally who also has this feat threaten the same creature, you gain the benefit of any combat feat your ally used during his last turn with the exception of combat feats granting a bonus to any die roll or your AC. For instance, if your ally attacks an enemy with a weapon affected by the Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization feats, you cannot gain the benefits of these feats because they grant a bonus to his attack roll and weapon damage roll respectively. You must otherwise meet the feat's requirements.
feat-word-focus:
Prerequisite(s) Words of Foundation class feature Choose an Identifying Word. Any Words you speak using that Identifying Word are more difficult to resist.

Benefit(s): Add +1 to the Difficulty Class for all saving throws against Words using the Identifying Word you select.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new Identifying Word.
feat-aggressive-power-attack-combat:
You sacrifice defense for offensive power.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When using Power Attack, you can choose to take a penalty to your armor class instead of your attack bonus.

Normal: You take penalties to all melee attacks and combat maneuvers in exchange for causing more damage.
feat-backdown-combat:
The threat of being hit again causes your enemy to flinch.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +4, Intimidate 5 ranks.

Benefit: After a successful Power Attack against a melee target, they must make a Will Save DC 10 + 1/2 of your character level + Strength modifier. If they fail the saving throw, they are flat-footed for 1 round. Back down is a mind-affecting fear effect.
feat-careful-power-attack-combat:
Just because your attacks are powerful doesn't mean you throw caution to the wind.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When using Power Attack, you gain a +1 Dodge bonus to armor class for each -1 attack penalty in addition to the bonus damage.

Normal: The attack penalties from Combat Expertise and Power Attack stack.
feat-deafening-bull-rush-combat:
As you slam into your enemy, they are deafened by the attack.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Improved Bull Rush

Benefit: When making a successful Bull Rush, you deafen the target creature for 1d4 rounds.
feat-divine-justification-combat:
Your faith grants healing to your allies and harms your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Selective Channel, Channel Energy Class Feature

Benefit: If you use Power Attack, and Selective Channel, during the same round you heal allies and harm enemies at the same time.

Special: Healing is equal to the damage before the Will saving throw is made to determine if the damage is halved.

Normal: When Channeling Energy you must choose to heal or harm.
feat-falling-power-attack-combat:
You use the momentum of your fall to cause devastating damage to your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When falling as part of an attack, you may use Power Attack to reduce the damage you suffer by 2d6 and increase the damage of your attack by 2d6.
feat-knock-out-combat:
The weak fall from the fury of your fists.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Power Attack

Benefit: When making a successful unarmed Power Attack against an enemy that is 4 levels lower than you, they must make a Fortitude saving throw DC 10 + 1/2 hit dice + Strength modifier. On a failed saving throw, the enemy is stunned for 1d4 rounds. On a successful saving throw, the enemy is staggered for 1d4 rounds.
feat-mighty-throw-combat:
You demonstrate the tremendous strength you wield when attacking an enemy with a thrown weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Deadly Aim, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: You may apply Deadly Aim and Power Attack when using a thrown weapon. The penalties to attack and the bonus damage stack.

Normal: Power Attack can only be used as part of a melee attack.
feat-militant-spellcaster-combat:
Your enemies underestimate your strength until you enhance your strikes with magic.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Spellcasting Class Feature

Benefit: When making a Melee Power Attack as a swift action, you can sacrifice one spell per caster level to enhance the physical damage of one attack by 1d4 per level of the spell sacrificed. Special: The damage enhancement is not expended until you make a successful Power Attack, make a normal attack, or combat ends.
feat-powerful-onslaught-combat:
Every attack is more brutal than the last.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When using Power Attack, each successive hit in a single round increases the amount of damage by +2.
feat-powerful-sneak-attack-combat:
From the shadows or among friends, your powerful attacks are more deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Sneak Attack Class Feature

Benefit: When using Power Attack and Sneak Attack for each -1 penalty to melee attack rolls instead of gaining a +2 bonus damage, you can choose to maximize one sneak attack die.

Normal: When using Power Attack, you can choose to suffer a -1 attack penalty to melee attacks and CMB checks to gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls.
feat-precision-power-attack-combat:
A swing, and a miss, or so your thought.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When using Power Attack, if you fail to hit the creature's armor class, but would have hit the creature if it was flat-footed, they suffer damage equal to the Power Attack bonus damage.

Normal: On a missed attack the creature takes no damage.
feat-premeditated-ambush-combat:
Observe the enemy before you strike.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack

Benefit: If you voluntarily act last in the round looking for enemy weaknesses, your next Power Attack deals extra damage equal to your strength modifier.
feat-smite-the-hidden-evil-combat:
Your martial training helps you find the hidden evil of your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Smite Evil Class Feature, base attack bonus +10

Benefit: When using Power Attack and the Smite Evil, choose one non-humanoid creature type. Treat any creature of that type as Evil Outsiders for the purpose of additional damage. Special: The damage from Power Attack stacks with the damage from Smite Evil.

This feat can be taken more than once. Each time choose another non-humanoid creature type.
feat-staggering-attack-combat:
Your unconventional tactics may stagger your enemy.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Aggressive Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When making a successful Aggressive Power Attack, you force the target of your attack to make a Fortitude saving throw DC 10 + 1/2 hit dice + Strength modifier or be staggered for 1d4 round.
feat-strike-of-silence-combat:
Your opponents talk to much. Use a shield to render them speechless.

Prerequisites: Power Attack, shield proficiency, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When making a successful Power Attack with a shield, the target is silenced for 1 round.

Special: The silence effect from multiple attacks does not stack.

Normal: A spellcaster is unable to cast a spell with a verbal component while silenced.
feat-strike-the-hand-combat:
You use the immense power of your strike to disable your opponent's hand.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +6
