Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend an additional daily use of your wild shape class feature to add the draconic LC creature template to your animal form. You can select a different draconic variety every time you use this ability.
feat-draconic-wild-shape-mythic:
You transform into a draconic humanoid with your wild shape.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic Wild Shape.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend two additional daily uses of your wild shape class feature and 2 points of mythic power to add the half—dragon creature template to your animal form. You can select a different dragon variety every time you use this ability.
feat-draconic-wing-buffet-combat-mythic:
Your dragon wings gain more strength in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic Wing Buffet.

Benefit(s): Your wing buffet attacks deal damage as if you were one size larger. If your claw attacks deal energy damage, your wing buffets deal 1d4 additional points of energy damage too. This stacks with the mythic dragon wings power for dragon disciples.
feat-draconic-wing-buffet-combat:
Your draconic wings can be used as weapons in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrager or sorcerer with the draconic bloodline, base attack bonus +7, wings or draconic wings class feature, Draconic Manifestation, Draconic Tail.

Benefit(s): Whenever you manifest your wings and are wearing no armor or light armor, you also gain two wing buffet attacks. These are secondary attacks that deal 1d4 damage (1d3 if you are Small), plus ½ your Strength modifier. You cannot use your wing attacks while flying.
feat-dragon-crawl:
Your claws have adapted to more than one task.

Prerequisite(s): Claw attack, Climb 3 ranks.

Benefit: You gain a climb speed equal to your base land speed. You also gain 1 skill rank per level which must be invested into the Climb skill. This benefit applies retroactively, and you are allowed to retrain any skill ranks you had previously invested into Climb upon taking this feat.
feat-dragons-breath-spell-metamagic:
Your energy spells erupt as bursts from your mouth.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic Heritage (chromatic, metallic, or primal).

Benefit(s): Only an energy spell that has a line or burst area of effect can be cast as a dragon's breath spell. The selected spell's area of effect changes into a 30—foot cone that emanates from your mouth as a breath weapon. A dragon's breath spell takes up a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal.
feat-dragons-breath-spell-metamagic-myth:
Your breath spell lingers, inflicting continued damage to enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Dragon's Breath Spell.

Benefit(s): A target damaged by a dragon's breath spell you cast suffers the same damage in the following round unless they succeed at a second saving throw.
feat-dragonblessed:
Despite not being a wyrmtouched, you share a fragment of their power.

Prerequisite(s): Non-wyrmtouched race.

Benefit: You gain the dragonkin subtype.

Special: You must select this feat at 1st level.
feat-dragonblood-dwarf:
You can use your draconic breath more often.

Prerequisite(s): dwarf, breath weapon racial trait

Benefit(s): You gain two additional uses of your breath weapon per day.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you select it, you gain two additional uses of your breath weapon.
feat-dragonblood-dwarf-mythic:
Your draconic nature is exalted by your mythic power.

Prerequisite(s): Dragonblood dwarf.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to your breath weapon's number of daily uses. This is in addition to the bonus uses of the breath weapon ability granted by the Dragonblood Dwarf feat. Your breath weapon also deals 1d4 points of damage + 1d4 for every 2 levels you possess beyond 1st, without limits.
feat-drake-ally:
You understand the basics of forming a partnership with a drake.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to Perception checks and a +2 bonus to Diplomacy checks made against dragon type creatures (this bonus increases to +5 when made against a drake who recognizes you as its charge). In addition, you learn the draconic language (if you already knew this language, you may learn another language of your choice) and dragon type creatures will recognize you as a friend and ally (causing them to have a starting attitude of unfriendly or better towards you unless they have reason to be hostile towards you).
feat-drake-bond:
You have formed a weak connection with a drake.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Ally, animal companion, or mount class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a legendary drake companion (if you possess an animal companion or mount, the legendary drake companion replaces it even if you have the Drake Ally feat), although the drake cannot possess more than 5 hit dice, regardless of its charge's level. As such, it does not gain as any other benefits it would normally get from gaining hit dice, such as additional drake powers, size increases, or ability adjustments.
feat-drake-bounce:
You can maneuver around the battlefield in the blink of an eye.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Dive, Acrobatics 3 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you use your Drake Style feat, if an object or creature would be in your path and you have not moved your full base land speed, you can choose to kick off of it to continue your movement, making an additional Acrobatics check to further increase your height. You can continue to kick off of different creatures until you have traveled your entire base land speed, but you cannot kick off of the same creature more than once. If you have the Drake Talons feat, you can deal damage to each creature you kick off of with this feat. This does not increase the amount of times you can attack a creature with the Drake Style feat.
feat-drake-dive:
Your ability to dive into opponents is greatly enhanced.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Style, Acrobatics 3 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you use your Drake Style feat, you can substitute a living creature in place of a solid object, although it must be at least one size smaller than you.

While you can jump off of a willing creature without issue, if you wish to jump off of a hostile creature, your Acrobatics check must exceed the creature's AC. If it does not, the creature is allowed to make an attack of opportunity against you and your movement speed using Drake Style is halved. In addition, you can make an attack against any creature in your path and you can choose to double the result of your Acrobatics check for the purpose of how high you can jump.

Normal: Drake Style only allows you to attack a single creature.
feat-drake-flurry:
The only thing quicker than how you fly through the air is how easily you can attack while doing so.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Style, Acrobatics 7 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you use your Drake Style feat, you can make a second attack with your unarmed strike against a creature with a -5 penalty. When you have 15 or more ranks in Acrobatics, you can make a third attack with a -10 penalty.

Special: If you have the Drake Meteor feat, these additional attacks do not count as an attack action, nor may you use your breath weapon in place of these attacks.
feat-drake-friend:
Your bond with your drake has grown stronger.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Bond, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Your legendary drake companion may possess up to 10 hit dice.
feat-drake-master:
You and your drake are as one.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Friend, character level 13th.

Benefit(s): Your legendary drake companion may possess up to 15 hit dice.
feat-drake-meteor:
Your aerial prowess is beyond compare.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Dive, Drake Style, Acrobatics 7 ranks.

Benefit: When using your Drake Style feat, your base land speed is doubled and you can choose to triple the result of your Acrobatics check for the purpose of how high you can jump. You can also treat this attack as an attack action for the purpose of what can be applied to it (such as the Vital Strike feat). In addition, if you possess a breath weapon, you can use it in place of the attack granted by the Drake Style feat.
feat-drake-style-style:
You possess the ability to attack from the air, just as a drake.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Acrobatics rank 1.

Benefit: As a full round action, whenever you are adjacent to a solid object that is one size smaller than you or larger, you can make a DC 10 Acrobatics check. If this is successful, you can jump up to your land or flight speed above the ground (use your Acrobatics check to determine the height of your jump), although this movement must be in a straight line and you do not take any falling damage while falling using this feat. During this movement, you can move through other creature's spaces and make an attack against one creature in your path with your unarmed strike; this attack is treated as being made with two hands for the purpose of the Power Attack feat. If your Acrobatics check exceeds a creature's AC, that creature cannot make an attack of opportunity against you during this movement.
feat-drake-talons:
Your agility allows you to deal damage at all times.

Prerequisite(s): Drake Dive, Acrobatics 5 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you use your Drake Style feat to kick off of an unwilling creature successfully, you also deal damage to that creature equal to your unarmed strike's damage. In addition, if you end your turn adjacent to an object of creature which you could kick off of, you can choose to cling to them until the beginning of your next round (to cling to a hostile creature, you must make an Acrobatics check with a DC of the creature's armor class), sharing that creature or object's space. At the beginning of your next turn, you can choose to drop off (this movement does not provoke an attack of opportunity) of that creature or kick off of them to use your Drake Style feat once again, but you cannot choose to continue to cling to them.
feat-draw-on-madness:
No matter the burden on your psyche, how far your mind has to bend, you will get the upper hand.

Prerequisite(s): Madness focus, mesmerist level 7

Benefit(s): A number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier, you can cast spells of the focus you last used as if they were on your list of spells known.
feat-dreadforger-combat:
Prerequisite(s): Craft (any) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When creating a non-magical trap, poison, or other item which is not gained from a class ability, feat or sphere, you may increase the saving throw DC of the item to up to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Intelligence modifier. For every point by which you increase the saving throw DC, the Craft DC increases by 2. Using this feat does not increase the cost of your creation.
feat-dream-sovereign-psionic:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to manifest dream message or induce nightmare.

Benefit(s): When you manifest either dream message or induce nightmare, you gain the ability to augment them in the following ways:

• Augment (dream message): For every additional power point you spend, you may target one additional creature with this power. You may send a different message to each target. If you spend 2 additional power points, you may hold a conversation with any number of creatures you have contacted with this power. Each creature (manifester and any targets) is capable of sending a number of messages equal to the manifester level of this power, but only between themself and the manifester. If you spend 2 additional power points, then the creatures may deliver messages that can be heard by all entities affected by this power. If you spend 6 additional power points, you may manifest a single power on the targets of the dream message. The power affects however many creatures it normally would, and targets are allowed a saving throw as normal.

• Augment (induce nightmare): For every additional power point you spend, you may target one additional creature with this power. If you spend 2 additional power points, you may ensnare a creature in a nightmare dreamscape rather than allowing them a saving throw. For every 2 power points you spend augmenting this power, you may choose 1 additional feature to be added to a nightmare dreamscape you create using this power.
feat-druidic-bond:
The bond between you and your animal companion has been greatly empowered.

Prerequisite(s): Animal companion or mount class feature.

Benefit: You are able to choose any animal as your animal companion or mount that a druid of your level would be able to choose (for example, a ranger with this feat could select an allosaurus as their animal companion). In addition, you treat your effective druid level as though it was 2 higher than it normally is.
feat-dual-weapon-charge:
You can strike a foe with two weapons at the end of your charge.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, Base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): When making a charge attack you may attack with a weapon in each hand, when doing so you do not gain an attack bonus from charging, and you take an additional -2 penalty to AC.
feat-eagle-eyed-awareness:
Your vision and reaction time is comparable to the most prolific of avian predators.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Perception)

Benefit(s): You may roll a perception check with a -5 penalty to determine your initiative. Any non-Dexterity bonus you have to initiative checks applies to this Perception check.
feat-easy-mark-combat:
Your bluster, bravado, and bladework leave your foes open to your attacks, and those of your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Feint, distracting attack rogue talent, sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When you hit a target in melee with a light weapon, you can make a Bluff check as a swift action to feint that target. If your target is already flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus, you sacrifice only one-half of your sneak attack damage rather than all of it when using your distracting attack.

Special: If you have the Greater Feint feat and successfully feint a target using this feat, your target is denied its Dexterity bonus against you and all allies adjacent to you until the end of your next turn.
feat-ecstatic-euphoria:
The throes of sexual passion bring you to a place of sublime focus and excited connection with your cultic patron.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 1 rank

Benefit(s): After spending one hour obtaining sexual release, either by yourself or in concert with others, you gain a +1 morale bonus for a number of hours equal to the ranks you have in Knowledge (religion). You may apply this bonus to one of the following categories: attack rolls; caster level checks and concentration checks; saving throws; or skill checks. You cannot use this feat while you are fatigued or exhausted.

If you engage in your sexual congress with an aberration, fey, or outsider that serves your cultic patron, your morale bonus for using this feat is +2.

Special: At the GM's option you may substitute ranks in Knowledge (dungeoneering) if your cultic patron is a mythos entity, Knowledge (planes) if it is a fiendish or celestial being, or Knowledge (nature) if your cult focuses upon the fey realms or spirits of nature or fertility.
feat-effortless-spell-combat:
Casting and combat is a natural process for you.

Prerequisite(s): Spell combat class feature

Benefit(s): You no longer need a free hand to use the spell combat class feature.
feat-ego-limiter:
Your symbiote is more subservient to you than normal.

Prerequisite: Symbiosis class feature

Benefit(s): Reduce the ego of your symbiote by 1. At 5th level and every 4 levels thereafter, reduce your symbiote's ego by an additional 1.

Special: A symbiotic slayer can choose to gain this feat in place of their 1st level social talent.
feat-eldritch-animation: Benefit(s): Undead creatures you create gain channel resistance +4 or increase their existing channel resistance by +2 (whichever provides a higher bonus) against all effects from a source other than you.
feat-elemental-claws-mythic:
Your natural attacks throb with sheer elemental power.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Claws.

Benefits: The extra energy damage dealt by Elemental Claws increases to 1d8 points, and you gain additional uses of Elemental Claws per day equal to your tier. You can expend one use of mythic power as an immediate action to add the extra damage from your Elemental Claws to all of the natural attacks you make until the beginning of your next turn. This counts as only one use of Elemental Claws, regardless of the number of attacks that you make in this fashion.
feat-elemental-commixture-mythic:
You and your allies can create an irresistible magic vortex of elements.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Commixture.

Benefits: You and your allies can combine up to three elemental spells together. The bonuses for the commixtures stack, and up to two different secondary effects can be produced at the same time by the combination of the primary spell with each of the secondary spells. For example, if the primary spell is an earth spell and the secondary ones use air and fire, both the dust and lava secondary effects can be produced (but not the smoke effect, since secondary spells don't combine with each other).

By expending one use of mythic power, you can reduce the casting time of one combined spell by 1 step (a standard action becomes a move action, a move action becomes a swift action, and a swift action becomes an immediate action). This stacks with Quicken Spell and other effects that allow to reduce a spell's casting time.
feat-elemental-conjurer:
Benefit(s): You may spontaneously convert any spell with the acid, cold, electricity, or fire descriptors into a summon monster spell of equal level. However, the only creatures that can be summoned are elementals whose type matches the descriptor as seen in Table: Elemental Conjurer.

Table: Elemental Conjurer

Descriptor Elemental Summoned

Acid Earth elemental

Cold Water elemental

Electricity Air elemental

Fire Fire elemental

For example, a wizard could convert a fireball into a summon monster III spell used to summon 1d3 Small fire elementals.
feat-elemental-conversion-mythic:
Elemental spells you cast are infused with raw chaos.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Conversion.

Benefits: You add 1/2 your mythic tier (minimum 1) to the number of times per day or per hour you can use Elemental Conversion. If the affected spell has not an instantaneous duration, you can expend one use of mythic power as an immediate action to randomly change its elemental energy every round.
feat-elemental-endurance-combat:
Benefit(s): Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. You gain energy resistance to the chosen energy type equal to your damage reduction.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different energy type.
feat-elemental-expertise:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental Focus, elemental attunement class feature or one Elemental Flux maneuver known.

Benefit(s): In addition to the normal energy types listed with Elemental Focus, you may select force, sonic, and untyped damage with the feat. The DC increase applies to any effect which either deals damage of the chosen type or is made as a result of an attack which deals damage of the chosen type (so Elemental Focus (fire) would increase the DC of plasma grenades).
feat-elemental-hands:
Rather than positive or negative energy only, you can channel elemental energy through your touch.

Prerequisites: Fervor or lay on hands class feature, non-neutral alignment on the good-evil axis, worshiper of a deity granting the Air, Earth, Fire, Water or Weather domain.

Benefit: Select an energy type matching a domain granted by your deity. You can use your fervor or lay on hands ability to deal the same amount of energy damage, instead of positive or negative energy damage. If your ability uses positive energy, you inflict elemental damage to evil creatures; if it uses negative energy, you inflict elemental damage to good creatures.

Creatures who are neutral on the good-evil axis take half damage.

Special: Paladins can select this feat in place of a mercy.
feat-elemental-hands-mythic:
Your targets suffer a lingering effect from your divine elemental energy.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Hands.

Benefit: A creature that suffers elemental damage from your fervor or lay on hands ability modified by the Elemental Hands feat acquires vulnerability to that type of elemental energy for a number of rounds equal to your mythic tier.
feat-elemental-healing-metamagic-mythic:
The goodness in your element lingers and pervades everything.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Healing.

Benefits: You may choose to treat neutral targets either as good or evil when casting a spell modified with Elemental Healing. For creatures it damages, the spell is treated as a persistent spell. Creatures that are cured by the spell are granted any excess hit points as temporary hit points that last until they are lost.
feat-elemental-healing-metamagic:
You can use energy from elemental spells to cure good beings, or positive energy to damage evil creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Spell, good alignment, worshiper of a deity granting the Air, Earth, Fire, or Water domain.

Benefits: You can empower an elemental spell (a spell with the acid, cold, electricity, fire, or water descriptor) with healing power, or a healing spell with elemental energy. Both options have the same effect. The selected spell cures good creatures and damages evil creatures for the same amount listed in its description. It has no effect on neutral creatures. The damage inflicted to evil creatures has the same descriptor of the original spell in case of an elemental spell (unless it was modified with Elemental Spell or a similar ability), or a descriptor matching a domain granted by your deity in case of a healing spell; the modified spell gains both the healing descriptor and the appropriate energy descriptor. An elemental healing uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-elemental-healing-spell-like-abilit:
You become a master of elemental life force.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Healing Spell-like Ability, 3rd mythic rank or tier.

Benefit: If the spell-like ability you have chosen to modify with Elemental Healing Spell-Like Ability can be used more than three times per day, you can use this feat an additional number of times per day equal to one-third your mythic rank (minimum 1). When you have expended your daily uses of this feat, you may choose to spend two uses of your mythic power as a free action to gain an additional use of the feat.

In addition, by expending two daily uses of this feat, you may apply Elemental Healing Spell-Like Ability to a different spell-like ability you possess. This spell-like ability must be one whose spell level does not exceed one-half your caster level (round down) -3. If you cannot use an elemental healing spell-like ability at least twice per day, you cannot use this ability.

You can use an elemental spell-like ability to cure living beings, or a cure spell-like ability to damage evil creatures.

Prerequisites: Spell-like ability at caster level 6th or higher.

Benefit: Choose one of your spell-like abilities that either is a cure effect or inflicts acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, subject to the restrictions described in this feat. Three times per day, you may empower that spell-like ability so that it cures good creatures and deals energy damage to evil creatures for the same amount listed in its description. If you possess an elemental subtype, you must select the energy type matching your subtype. A spell-like ability modified this way has no effect on neutral creatures.

The damage inflicted to evil creatures has the same descriptor of the original spell in case of an elemental spell, or an elemental descriptor matching the selected energy type in case of a healing spell-like ability; the modified spell-like ability gains both the healing descriptor and the appropriate energy descriptor.

You can only select a spell-like ability duplicating a spell with a level less than or equal to ½ your caster level (round down) –1. For a summary, see the following table.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time it is taken, you can apply it to a different spell-like ability.

Spell Level Caster Level

0 2nd

1st 4th

2nd 6th

3rd 8th

4th 10th

5th 12th

6th 14th

7th 16th

8th 18th

9th 20th
feat-elemental-ki-mythic:
Your ki attacks become more powerful.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Ki.

Benefits: Each point of burn you accept counts as 3 ki points for the purpose of activating ki powers and abilities.

At 7th level, your unarmed attacks are also treated as cold iron and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 10th level, your unarmed attacks are also treated as lawful weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 16th level, your unarmed attacks are treated as adamantine weapons for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction and bypassing hardness.
feat-elemental-knowledge-mythic:
Your instinctive knowledge of the elemental world grows.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Knowledge.

Benefit: You gain all the skill unlocks for the skills related to your expanded elements, as per the Signature Skill feat.
feat-elemental-marksman-combat:
Prerequisite(s): One Elemental Flux maneuver known.

Benefit(s): When you hit a foe with a maneuver using a weapon that deals the same type of damage as your active energy type (such as with a laser pistol while your active energy type is fire), the creature must succeed at two saving throws against the maneuver instead of one.
feat-elemental-overload-mythic:
You command your element as if they were the substance of your body itself.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Overload.

Benefit: The additional chance to ignore the effects of a critical hit or sneak attack you gain from Elemental Overload is doubled, and can exceed 100% in total.
feat-elemental-protection-mythic:
Your channeled element thoroughly protects your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Protection.

Benefit(s): When you channel energy using the Elemental Protection feat, the ability functions now as mythic healing warmth.
feat-elemental-strike-combat-mythic:
Your elemental blood invigorates your weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Strike.

Benefit: Whenever you use Elemental Strike to enhance your weapons, the effect lasts for 1 minute instead of 1 round. If you expend one use of mythic power when using Elemental Strike, you can also add any one magic weapon special ability with a base price modifier of +1 from the following list to your weapons (the total base price modifier increases to +2 at 4th tier, +3 at 7th tier, and +4 at 10th tier):

burning, catalytic, corrosive, corrosive burst, cyclonic, flaming, flaming burst, frost, grounding, icy burst, igniting, quenching, rusting, shock, shocking burst, tailwind, thawing, thundering, underwater.

You can only add a special ability to a weapon if you belong to a corresponding half-elemental race.
feat-elemental-trial-mythic:
The elemental judgment dealt by your deity is absolute.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Trial.

Benefit(s): When you channel energy using the Elemental Trial feat, the ability functions now as mythic trial by fire (see above).
feat-elemental-vigor-mythic:
Your life force is strictly tied to the power of the elements.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Vigor.

Benefit: The temporary hit points and +10 foot speed bonus granted by Elemental Vigor persist for 1 round per mythic tier you possess after you dismiss your elemental form.
feat-elevated-arcana-monster:
Prerequisites(s): At least one racial Hit Die, spell-like or psi-like abilities from racial Hit Dice.

Benefit(s): Add your Hit Dice from class levels to the caster or manifester levels of any spell-like or psi-like abilities you possess as a result of your racial Hit Dice.
feat-elevated-might-monster:
Prerequisite(s): At least one racial Hit Die.

Benefit(s): Add your Hit Dice from class levels to any racial Hit Dice you possess for the purpose of determining the DCs of any abilities based on racial Hit Dice (such as breath weapons, frightful presence, etc.) and the DCs of abilities based on class level (such as channel energy).
feat-elevated-repertoire-monster:
Prerequisites(s): At least one racial Hit Die, spell-like ability from race.

Benefit(s): Choose up to three spell-like abilities you possess. You gain a total of 3 additional uses of these spell-like abilities divided as you choose (for example, a hezrou with this feat could grant 2 additional uses per day to its blasphemy spell-like ability and 1 additional uses per day to its summon spell-like ability).
feat-elevated-resistance-monster:
Prerequisites(s): At least one racial Hit Die, spell resistance from race.

Benefit(s): Add your number of Hit Dice from class levels to your spell resistance for the purpose of calculating your spell resistance.
feat-energized-spell-metamagic:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to channel positive or negative energy.

Benefit(s): When you cast an energized spell, you may expend one use of your channel energy ability to have the spell deal positive energy damage (which heals living creatures and harms undead) or negative energy damage (which heals undead creatures and harms living ones), corresponding to a type of energy you are capable of channeling. An energized spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-energy-soldier-combat:
Benefit(s): Any ability that would enable you ignore any amount damage reduction also enables you to ignore the same amount of energy resistance under the same circumstances (for example, you may use the Clustered

Shots feat to total the damage from all attacks made with a laser rifle or +1 flaming longbow before applying fire resistance).
feat-energy-transmutation-akashic:
Prerequisite(s): Elemental Essence.

Benefit(s): You may use the Elemental Essence feat on veils which lack the acid, cold, electricity, or fire descriptor. The veil gains the chosen descriptor and any damage of the original type dealt by that veil is changed to the new type. If you invest a second point of essence into a veil with the Elemental Essence feat, you may select a second energy type, causing the veil to deal half of its damage as the first damage type and the other half as the second damage type.

You gain 1 point of essence.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you must choose a different energy type.
feat-enhanced-protection-monster:
Prerequisite(s): Energy resistance racial trait.

Benefit(s): Two types of energy resistance you possess from your race increases by 5 for every 5 Hit Dice you possess, to a maximum of 30.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time applying it to two different types of energy resistance.
feat-enigmatic-origins:
Your draconic heritage is far more complex than others.

Prerequisite(s): Wyrmtouched.

Benefit: You may add the following options to those you can select for your draconic breath weapon racial trait, allowing it to deal the listed type of damage:

• Bludgeoning

• Piercing

• Slashing

• Negative Energy (this breath weapon cannot be used to heal undead)

• Sonic

In addition, you can choose for your draconic resistance to instead grant negative energy resist 5, sonic resist 5, DR 3/bludgeoning, DR 3/piercing, or DR 3/slashing.

Special: You must select this feat at 1st level.

Special: Whenever you choose to deal sonic damage with your breath weapon, your breath weapon's damage die is reduced by 1 step.
feat-eternal-mind-monster:
Prerequisites(s): Int 21, Iron Will.

Benefit(s): Any creature that attempts to interact directly with your thoughts (such as via detect thoughts or telepathy) must succeed at a Will save or become confused for 1 minute. If you have at least 20 Hit Dice, the target is instead driven permanently insane as the insanity spell (if using the strain rules, you may instead have a target take a number of points of strain damage equal to your Intelligence score on a failed saving throw). The save DC is equal to 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + the higher of your Intelligence or Charisma modifier. Using your own telepathy to communicate does not activate this ability unless you spend a standard action to focus your mind on one opponent. A creature targeted by this ability is immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.
feat-exotic-arcana:
Your sorcerous abilities run deep in your blood.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 14, Eldritch Heritage, character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You gain the bloodline arcana of the bloodline you selected with the Eldritch Heritage feat. For purposes of using that power, treat your sorcerer level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in sorcerer. You do not gain any of the other bloodline abilities.

Special: If you later take the Mythic Eldritch Heritage mythic feat, you treat your sorcerer level as equal to your character level for this feat's purpose too.
feat-expanded-breath-weapon-breath:
Tapping into your inner dragon, you learn how to better harness your elemental power.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait, character level 3rd.

Benefit: You can increase the area of your breath weapon to a 30 foot cone or 60 foot line.
feat-explosive-bolts:
Your mystic bolts strike with explosive force.

Prerequisite: Warlock 5th.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use your mystic bolts as a ranged attack, if you successfully hit a foe with a mystic bolt, you can choose for it to deal splash damage to all adjacent squares to the target (equal to the minimum damage of the mystic bolt), allowing a Reflex saving throw (10 + ½ your vigilante level + your Charisma modifier) to halve the damage. You can select 1 square while dealing splash damage; that square is not subjected to splash damage.

Special: If you have the Genius Vigilante or Wise Vigilante feats, you instead use your Intelligence or Wisdom modifier to determine the saving throw for this feat.
feat-extended-bite:
Your fangs can travel a surprisingly long distance.

Prerequisite(s): Wyrmtouched, bite attack, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): The reach of your bite attack increases by 5 feet during your turn.
feat-extra-assassin-talent:
With devoted practice, you have increased your death?dealing ability.

Prerequisite(s): Assassin talent class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional assassin talent. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this assassin talent.

Special: You can gain Extra Assassin Talent multiple times.
feat-extra-commanders-aura:
You manage to maintain your commander's aura for longer than others.

Prerequisite(s): Commander's aura class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use your commander's aura for an additional 6 rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Commander's Aura multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-extra-deed:
You have honed your deadly skills and gained more deeds to your name.

Prerequisite: Wanderer 1st level

Benefit: You gain one additional wanderer deed. You must meet all the prerequisites for this deed.

Special: You can gain Extra Deed multiple times.
feat-extra-drake-power:
Your power and that of your charge flows through you more easily than most.

Prerequisite(s): Drake, must have a charge.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional drake power.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times.
feat-extra-enhanced-familiar:
Your connection to your familiar grants it greater power.

Prerequisite(s): Enhanced Familiar class feature

Benefit(s): You gain an additional enhanced familiar option.

Special: This feat may be selected more than once, but no more than once for every five caster levels you possess.
feat-extra-gestalt-talent:
Prerequisite: Gestalt talent* class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional gestalt talent. You must meet the prerequisites for this gestalt talent.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times.
feat-extra-hypercharge:
Prerequisite: At least one helmsman hypercharge*.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional Helmsman hypercharge for which you meet the prerequisites

Special: You may select this feat multiple times.
feat-extra-implantation:
You can implant more cybertech in your body.

Prerequisite(s): Con 16 or Wis 16.

Benefit(s): One of your implantation slots (your choice) can accommodate one more piece of cybertech than normal.

Special: You can select Extra Implantation multiple times (but not more than once for each slot you possess).
feat-extra-implantation-points:
You can go beyond your implantation limits.

Benefit(s): You gain two additional implantation points.

You can allocate these points between your Intelligence and Constitution scores as you choose.

Special: You can select Extra Implantation Points multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-extra-inspired-trance:
Your trance lasts longer than usual.

Prerequisite(s): Inspired trance class feature

Benefit(s): Your inspired trance lasts for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Inspired Trance multiple times.

Its effects stack.
feat-extra-mech-enhancement:
Prerequisite(s): Bonded mech* class feature; or Mech Piloting*, Psi-Core Upgrade*, Psicrystal Affinity, Technologist*, manifester level 3rd.

Benefit(s): Choose one Mech Enhancement. Any mech that you are piloting gains that enhancement so long as the mech meets its prerequisites.
feat-extra-shadow-clones:
Creating shadowy duplicates is simplicity itself for you.

Prerequisite: Shadow clone class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain two additional uses of your shadow clone class feature.
feat-extra-social-talent:
You have focused your study into the unique tricks of ninjitsu.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary ninja 3rd.

Benefit(s): You gain a social talent. If you do not have the dual identity class feature or another class feature which gives you a second identity, you cannot select social talents which require a second identity. If you do not have a second identity, you are always treated as though in your social identity for the purpose of social talents, although you cannot select the social grace social talent.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different social talent.
feat-faithful-channel:
Your devotion grants you some more clerical abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level divine spells, Cha 13, must have a familiar.

Benefit: You gain the channel energy class feature, as a legendary cleric. This functions like the cleric's channel energy ability, except that your effective cleric level is equal to your divine spellcasting class level –4.
feat-faithful-fighting-combat:
When you wield the weapon of your god, you fight with worthy effectiveness.

Requirements: Weapon Focus with your deity's favored weapon, cleric 8 or legendary inquisitor 8.

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls when attacking with your deity's favored weapon. This stacks with the bonus granted by Weapon Focus. In addition, your cleric and/or legendary inquisitor levels are treated as fighter levels for the purpose of qualifying for feats.
feat-familiar-cohort:
Your familiar is also your most trusted adventuring ally.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (arcana, nature, or religion) 7 ranks, Improved Familiar, effective wizard level 7, ability to acquire a new familiar.

Benefit: You gain a special cohort instead of a new familiar.

This must be a monster with an indicated cohort level and able to become a familiar, such as a cassisian or a pseudodragon. The cohort's level is calculated as per your character level; the monster gains empathic link and share spells at its 1st class level, deliver touch spells at 3rd level, and scry on familiar at 13th level.

Special: This feat counts as the Leadership feat for the purposes of prerequisites. A character cannot have both Leadership and Familiar Cohort.
feat-familiar-strike:
When your familiar delivers touch spells, it is a sneak attack.

Prerequisite(s): Deliver touch spells class feature, familiar class feature, assassin level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can temporarily strengthen the empathic bond between you and your familiar, granting it your sneak attack ability. When your familiar delivers a touch spell for you that deals damage, you can use your empathic link to guide it as a standard action. If the touch attack hits, the familiar delivers the spell and adds your sneak attack damage to the spell's damage.
feat-fashion-dictator:
You deftly merge your occult casting with your sybarite focus.

Prerequisite(s): Sybarite focus, mesmerist level 17

Benefit(s): You can cast sybarite focus spells simultaneously as part of the same action, using the highest casting time among them. The targets for each spell cast in this way must be the same when possible. Each target attempts only one initial saving throw, if any. Its DC is that of the lowest level spell cast. On a success, the target resists all spells you've cast on it. In addition, you can always dismiss your focus spells, whether or not they are normally dismissable.
feat-fast-duty:
You are quick and precise in the pursuit of your office.

Prerequisite(s): Office class feature.

Benefit: The action required to activate an office ability becomes a step faster. A standard action becomes a move action; a move action becomes a swift action; and a swift action becomes an immediate action. This feat doesn't affect abilities that are already activated as an immediate or free action.
feat-favored-wandering-spirit:
One of the spirits you can bond with resonates more strongly with you.

Prerequisite(s): Wandering spirit or bonded spirit class feature.

Benefit: Select one wandering spirit or bonded spirit. You can use powers granted by this spirit as if your shaman level were 1 higher.
feat-feral-swashbuckler:
You can use your natural weapons as lethal fencing swords.

Prerequisite Finesse training class feature.

Benefit Choose one of your natural weapons. The selected natural weapon counts as a light piercing weapon for the purposes of swashbuckler class features and of feats and abilities that have these features as prerequisites.

This feat may be selected more than once; every time it applies to a different natural weapon.

Normal Swashbuckler class abilities such as precise strike don't apply to natural weapons.
feat-fey-wild-shape:
Your wild shape is infused with wild faerie energies.

Prerequisite(s): Wild shape class feature, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend an additional daily use of your wild shape class feature to add the plane of Faerie creature template to your animal form. You don't reincarnate or reappear on Faerie if you die while in fey wild shape. If you score a critical threat against a blighted fey creature while using your form's natural weapons, you gain a +2 bonus on the attack roll to confirm the critical hit.
feat-fey-wild-shape-mythic:
Your wild shape gains a number of fey abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Fey Wild Shape.

Benefit(s): When you use wild shape to take the form of an animal, you can expend two additional daily uses of your wild shape class feature and 2 points of mythic power to add the fey creature template to your animal form. You can select new fey special abilities every time you change into a fey creature wild shape.
feat-field-mechanic-item-creation:
Prerequisites(s): Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks, Craft (mechanical) 5 ranks, Technologist.

Benefit(s): When creating technological items, you no longer require a lab. However, if you craft a technological item without the use of the appropriate lab, the Craft DC increases by 10.

Special: This feat may be restricted at GM discretion, as not all GMs may wish for free crafting of technological items.
feat-fiendish-familiar:
You open a conduit to the lower planes to invest your familiar with its essence.

Prerequisite(s): Familiar, 5th level, non-good alignment

Benefit(s): Your familiar gains the fiendish simple template, though its type remains unchanged. If you gain an improved familiar, that familiar also gains this template unless it possesses the good subtype.

Special: A familiar cannot gain both the celestial and fiendish simple templates.
feat-find-the-gap:
You are adept at spotting the weak spots in your target's defenses.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +1d6

Benefit(s): When you are attacking a creature while they are flanked or would otherwise lose their Dexterity bonus to their AC, you have an added benefit on the attack. Reduce the target's armor, shield, or natural armor bonuses by 1/2 the number of your sneak attack dice, to a minimum of 0.
feat-flagellant-focus:
Pain gives you focus and suffering brings you strength of mind.

Prerequisite(s): Endurance or Iron Will

Benefit(s): You can spend 1 hour inflicting pain on yourself, dealing at least 2 points of nonlethal damage. In exchange, you gain damage reduction equal to half the amount of nonlethal damage you have, up to a maximum DR equal to your level plus your Wisdom modifier. This damage reduction applies only against nonlethal damage.

As long as you have any amount of nonlethal damage, you gain a +1 morale bonus to saving throws or ability checks to resist effects that would cause you to become exhausted, fatigued, sickened, staggered, or stunned, as well as mind-affecting effects and effects with the pain descriptor. If the amount of nonlethal damage you have is greater than your level plus your Constitution modifier, this bonus is doubled to +2.

If you receive an effect that cures lethal damage, you may choose whether or not that effect also cures your nonlethal damage. You may not choose to have it partially affect your nonlethal damage. If you are unconscious, you cannot choose to ignore healing of your nonlethal damage.

Normal: Effects that cure lethal damage also cure an equal amount of nonlethal damage.
feat-fleet-of-foot:
You are able to shift the trajectory of your run without losing momentum.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Run.

Benefit(s): When running or charging you can make a single direction change of 90 degrees or less. You cannot use this feat while wearing medium or heavy armor or carrying a medium load or more. You must move at least 10 feet before or after the turn.

Normal: Without this feat you must run or charge in a straight line.
feat-flowing-breath-breath:
You are capable of using your breath weapon without hesitation.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait, character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You no longer have to wait 1 turn in between uses of your breath weapon.

Normal: You must wait 1 turn in between uses of your breath weapon.
feat-focused-death-attack:
Your death attack is harder to survive.

Prerequisite(s): Assassin 1st.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to the DC of your death attack.
feat-focused-death-attack-greater:
Your death attack is even harder to resist.

Prerequisite(s): Focused Death Attack, assassin 4th.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional +2 bonus to the DC of your death attack. This stacks with the bonus from Focused Death Attack.
feat-focused-handler:
The intensity of pain you cause keeps your thralls in line.

Prerequisite(s): Pain focus, Rule of the Lash spell-like ability, mesmerist level 15

Benefit(s): Whenever a creature affected by rule of the lash is the only target of your focus, it becomes dazed rather than staggered from high damage. Furthermore, that creature can be ordered to perform tasks that require any skill check.
feat-fortified-corpsecraft:
Prerequisite: Ability to create undead creatures.

Benefit(s): Any undead creature that you create gains a +2 enhancement bonus to natural armor, as well as DR/good equal to 1/2 your caster level (if you do not have a caster level, instead use your Hit Dice -2 as your caster level). If an undead creature already possesses better damage reduction, that damage reduction becomes DR/good if you so choose.
feat-fulfilled-legacy:
Your draconic heritage has slowly been unlocked.

Prerequisite(s): Limited draconic heritage racial trait, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): Select either magical sleep effects or paralysis; you become immune to that condition.

Special: You can select this feat up to two times, each time selecting a different condition. If you select this feat twice, your type changes to dragon.
feat-futuristic-armory-psionic:
Prerequisites(s): Technologist, ability to manifest call weaponry, manifester level 3rd.

Benefit(s): When you manifest call weaponry, you can use the following augment:

Augment For every 2 additional power points you spend, you may call a technological weapon that is worth +1 more enhancement bonus reduction from the emulate technological melee weapon* or emulate technological ranged weapon* soulknife blade skills. For example, you may spend 4 additional power points to call an arc rifle (worth +2), 2 additional power points to call a chainsaw (worth +1), or 16 additional power points to call a vortex gun (worth +8). The item that you call comes equipped with half its maximum number of charges and 3d6 uses of whatever type of ammunition it uses (or the maximum number of charges or uses it can carry, whichever is less).
feat-genius-vigilante:
Your intellect empowers your vigilante tricks.

Prerequisite: Vigilante 1st.

Benefit(s): You use your Intelligence instead of your Charisma for any vigilante ability you gain, such as the save DCs of your vigilante talents or the bonus spells, spell save DCs, and spell effects of spellcasting or alchemy and other abilities gained from vigilante archetypes.

Normal: A vigilante uses their Charisma modifier to determine the save DCs of their social and vigilante talents.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or before your 1st level of vigilante. A vigilante can choose to gain this feat in place of their 1st level social talent.

Special: You cannot select this feat if you possess the Charismatic Caster or Wise Vigilante feat.
feat-glorious-heat-mythic:
Your fire spells are a nearly inexhaustible font of healing.

Prerequisite(s): Glorious Heat.

Benefit: You double the healing and attack roll bonus provided by this spell. By expending one use of mythic power, you extend the duration of the attack bonus to 1 round per mythic tier you possess.
feat-glorious-strike-combat:
Your holy strikes are powered by your heart, not by your body.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature, Channel Smite, proficiency with your deity's favored weapon.

Benefit: With your deity's favored weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier instead of your Strength or Dexterity modifier on attack rolls.
feat-godstouched:
Gods gave you a sign of their favor, and at the same time a trial.

Benefit(s): Select an oracle's curse you don't already possess. You gain all effects of the curse, treating your effective oracle level as equal to ½ your character level, even if you have levels in oracle. If the curse grants spells to add to the oracle's known spells list, you instead gain these spells as spell-like abilities usable once per day.
feat-godstouched-focus:
Your cursed blessing becomes stronger.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 16, Godstouched, character level 11th.

Benefit(s): You add 5 to your effective oracle level for the purposes of determining the effects of the curse you gained with the Godstouched feat.
feat-good-shepherd:
When you can no longer spare the rod, the rod can at least spare you.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus with any bludgeoning weapon, Craft Rod or Craft Staff.

Benefit: You gain a +1 shield bonus when wielding a rod or staff that you have created. This bonus stacks with other shield bonuses.
feat-greater-mounted-archery-combat:
Your ability to make ranged attacks from your mount is preternatural.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Mounted Archery, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, Ride 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You suffer no penalties to ranged weapon attacks while mounted, regardless of the amount of movement taken by your mount.
feat-greater-psychomachy-psionic:
Prerequisite(s): Psychomachy*, one or more metapsionic feats.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Psychomachy metapsionic feat, you may expend 4 additional power points to deal damage to a second mental ability score of your choice.
feat-greater-shot-on-the-run-combat:
You are a moving hurricane of arrows.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, Acrobatic Steps, Dodge, Improved Shot on the Run, Mobility, Nimble Moves, Shot on the Run, base attack bonus +16.

Benefit(s): When you use Shot on the Run, you can select three targets to attack during your movement instead of one. The second attack made this way is made at your full base attack bonus – 5, and the third attack made this way is made at your full base attack bonus – 10. All restrictions of Shot on the Run apply to each target, and your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from any of your targets. You can't target the same creature more than once. You must be able to make multiple attacks in a round with the weapon used.
feat-greater-slayer:
You are a master of judgment in battle.

Prerequisite(s): Judgment office, slayer ability.

Benefit(s): You can focus on multiple judgments at once.

Select two judgments to gain the benefit of the slayer ability. Once a round, you can change even a slayer-focused judgment as a swift action.
feat-greater-two-weapon-defense:
Your two-weapon skills create a wall of defense.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 19, Improved Two-Weapon Defense, Two-Weapon Defense, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +11.

Benefit(s): When wielding a double weapon or two weapons (not including natural weapons or unarmed strikes), you gain a +3 shield bonus to your AC.

When you are fighting defensively or using the total defense action, this shield bonus increases to +6.

Special: A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
feat-grenade-focus-combat: Benefit(s): The saving throw DC of any grenade you use to attack increases by 2.
feat-grin-and-bear-it:
You're able to take on a bit more than others due to some hidden stamina.

Prerequisite(s): Grit, Inspiration, Mettle or Panache pool.

Benefit(s): You gain a bonus to one kind of saving throw (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) chosen when you gain this feat equal to 1/2 your grit, inspiration, or panache pool's daily starting value. If you have multiple such pools, use the largest to determine the bonus granted by this feat.
feat-guides-advisor:
The spirits sent you a counselor to guide you on the path of wisdom.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded spirit oracle class feature, Favored Wandering Spirit.

Benefit: You gain a spirit animal as per the shaman's class feature, using your character level as your shaman level. Your familiar gains a spirit animal's special ability fit for your mystery or your favored wandering spirit (your choice).
feat-hacking-counterspell-champion-count:
Prerequisites(s): Spellhacking sphere, Counterspell, casting class feature, magic skill bonus +5.

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully counterspell a magical effect, you may apply a (hack) talent that you know to the effect rather than dispelling it. If you counterspell multiple effects at once, you must spend an additional spell point and apply the same (hack) to all of them. If you have the ability to counter technological effects and apply (hack) talents to them, you may use this feat on technological effects.
feat-hard-wired-sprite-champion:
Prerequisites(s): Technomancy* sphere, Tinker UEn sphere (at least one (gizmo) talent).

Benefit(s): One gizmo that you create (excluding permanent gizmos) contains a sprite with a permanent duration that cannot be transferred. This sprite replenishes itself after 1 minute if it is dispelled or destroyed. You may change which gizmo is affected by this feat in a process that takes 1 hour.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times. Each time, you may select a different gizmo to gain a sprite.
feat-harmonic-counter-counterspell:
Prerequisites(s): Tinker UEn sphere (Disruption Setn (gizmo)) or Counterspell.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use Countergizmo battery use, you may affect magic effects in the area or on the target as per Counterspell, using your gizmo penetration check in place of your MSB. If you have the Advanced Arsenal UEn legendary talent, this improves to Improved Counterspell if you use an Improved Countergizmo battery use and Greater Counterspell if you use a Greater Countergizmo battery use.

When you use Counterspell, you may affect gizmos in the area or on the target as per a Countergizmo, using your MSB in place of your gizmo penetration check. This improves to affecting them as per an Improved Countergizmo if you use Improved Counterspell on a single target or a Greater Countergizmo if you use Greater Counterspell.

You can counterspell effects which were created with the Alien Source at no penalty. Your abilities that would suppress magic (such as such as the Spell Ward and Antimagic Aura effects of the Protection sphere) function normally against all magic effects regardless of source. In addition, you can attempt to use any of your Counterspell feats or other magic-negating abilities on technological equipment from outside the Tinker sphere as if it were magical equipment. Treat such a technological item's MSD as if it were the item's Craft DC -5.
feat-harmonic-resilience:
Benefit(s): Any spell or power resistance or immunity that you possess applies against magic from any source, including those from casters with the Alien Source boon. If using any ruleset in which psionics and magic are not transparent, any spell resistance or immunity that you possess also applies against psionic powers that allow power resistance, and vice versa.

Any spell or power resistance you possess also applies against technological effects. Whenever you would be affected by an effect from a piece of technological equipment or a technological construct which imposes a condition or damage type other than bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, the source of the effect must attempt a gizmo penetration check against your spell resistance (using the item's craft DC -15 or the source's CR in place of a gizmo penetration check if the item or creature is not a gizmo). On a failure, any conditions or damage besides bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage from the effect do not take effect.
feat-heart-ripper-combat:
Your bloodthirsty fighting style builds towards a brutally lethal finish, as you seek to rip the still-beating heart from a defeated enemy's chest.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Critical (unarmed strike), Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefit(s): Your critical threat range is increased to 18-20 when you use an unarmed strike against a humanoid or monstrous humanoid no more than one size category larger than yourself. In addition, when you reduce such a creature to -1 or fewer hit points with an unarmed strike, you can tear the victim's heart out as a free action. The target is entitled to a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom bonus) to negate this effect. If you kill a creature with an unarmed strike, you automatically tear their heart out. A corpse missing its heart cannot be raised, as if killed with a death effect.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Intimidate checks against any creature that witnessed you using this feat to rip out a victim's heart. This bonus lasts for 1 minute, and it stacks if you have ripped out the hearts of multiple creatures.
feat-heavy-weaponry-implantation-weapon-:
Your body can host the most powerful implanted firearms.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack +11, heavy weaponry deeds class feature.

Benefit(s): You treat a two-handed firearm or a heavy weapon as a light melee weapon or one-handed firearm for the purpose of implanted weaponry. Such an implanted weapon costs 20,000 gp and consumes 4 implantation points. Its install DC is 30, the craft DC is 29, and its crafting cost is 10,000 gp. You also can select heavy weapons for your technic training class feature.

Two-handed and heavy firearms can only be implanted in a cybernetic limb; each limb can still host only one implanted weapon. Two-handed weapons are fired by swinging back the forearm and revealing the weapon's muzzle at the elbow's height. Such a weapon still needs to be operated with both hands. An implanted two-handed firearm or heavy weapon is much easier to notice, only requiring a DC 15 Perception check.
feat-hidden-sneak:
You strike with deadly effectiveness when you catch foes off guard.

Prerequisite: Hidden strike +1d8 or sneak attack +1d6.

Benefit(s): Whenever you would make an attack against a foe who are unaware of your presence, who consider you an ally, or who are made flat-footed by your startling appearance class feature, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on attack and damage rolls against that foe until the beginning of your next round. At 9th level and again at 17th level, this circumstance bonus increases by +1.

Special: If you have the hidden strike class feature, your hidden strike is considered equivalent to a sneak attack with the same number of dice for the purpose of meeting prerequisites or using abilities that depend on sneak attack.

Special: If your hidden strike would normally deal 1d8 damage with the attack, the circumstance bonus on damage rolls increases to +2.
feat-hidden-threat-combat:
You gain greater benefit from being unnoticed before you strike.

Prerequisite(s): Stealth 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain an additional +2 bonus on attack rolls against targets unaware of your presence and reduce the penalty for sniping while staying hidden to -10. If your attack is a critical hit, this penalty is -5.
feat-impression-of-will:
You can embed specific instructions into your telepathic contact.

Prerequisite(s): Drawn to awe spell-like ability, character level 5

Benefit(s): Whenever you use drawn to awe, a telepathic description of a single course of action, described in no more than 15 words, is carried across by your aura to all creatures inside it as part of the action. The description is automatically understood by them, within the limits of their mental ability scores. They are under no obligation to follow the suggestion, but those who do remain Helpful towards you for the purposes of this task until it is complete, you cause them harm, or the duration expires.
feat-improved-cast-rune:
You can invoke the power of your chosen runes more often.

Prerequisite(s): Cast Rune.

Benefit: Choose one rune you selected with the Cast Rune feat. You can now invoke this rune's power three times per day.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to another of your selected runes.
feat-improved-implantation: Benefit(s): Your Constitution and Intelligence scores are both treated as 4 higher for the purpose of the maximum implantation value of cybertech within your system.
feat-improved-rapid-shot:
You have learned ways to make your quick shots more accurate.

Prerequisite(s): Manyshot, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot.

Benefit(s): You ignore the -2 penalty to your ranged attack rolls from using the Rapid Shot feat.

Special: A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
feat-improved-shot-on-the-run-combat:
You deftly loose shots while keeping the momentum going.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Dodge, Mobility, Point-Blank Shot, Shot on the Run, base attack bonus +9.

Benefit(s): When you use Shot on the Run, you can select two targets to attack during your movement instead of one. The second attack made this way is made at your full base attack bonus – 5. All restrictions of Shot on the Run apply to both targets, and your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from either target. You can't target the same creature twice. You must be able to make multiple attacks in a round with the weapon used.
feat-improved-two-weapon-defense:
Your learn better two-weapon defensive techniques.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, Two-Weapon Defense, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When wielding a double weapon or two weapons (not including natural weapons or unarmed strikes), you gain a +2 shield bonus to your AC.

When you are fighting defensively or using the total defense action, this shield bonus increases to +4.

Special: A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
feat-inducting-power-metapsionic:
Prerequisites(s): Unwilling Participant, collective class feature.

Benefit(s): To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. This feat can be applied only to mind-affecting powers that allow a Will save. If a target fails a Will save against the power, they are immediately added to your collective. In order to make room for creatures, you may remove others from the collective as a free action as part of manifesting the power.

Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 2. The power's total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
feat-inescapable-grasp-combat-mythic:
It is almost impossible for foes to wriggle free from your grasp.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Grapple or grab special attack.

Benefit(s): Your CMD against attempts to escape from your grapple is increased by an amount equal to your mythic tier, whether such attempts are made as a grapple combat maneuver or an Escape Artist skill check. In addition, you can grapple creatures using freedom of movement, though you take a base -20 penalty on combat maneuver checks made to grapple such a target. This penalty is reduced by an amount equal to your mythic tier (if your target is a mythic creature or is using mythic freedom of movement) or by twice your mythic tier otherwise.
feat-injected-infusions:
You are always ready to inflict your infusions on others.

Prerequisite: Alchemy class feature, infusion discovery.

Benefit(s): You can place your infusions or mutagen into needles, injecting them into creatures. Using an injection normally takes the same action as an infusion, but does not require the creature's mouth to do, allowing you to use injections on another creature as a standard action even if they are helpless, requiring a touch attack to do so.
feat-inscribed-rune-item-creation:
You can inscribe or carve arcane runes upon your flesh, the flesh of others, or unliving items.

Prerequisite(s): Either the ability to cast runecasting or Cast Rune, Profession (scribe) 2 ranks.

Benefit: You can create temporary runes, drawing them on a surface with any coloring substance. Inscribing a rune on an object or a creature in this way grants the wearer a bonus on the rune's associated skill equal to 1/2 your rank in Profession (scribe). A temporary rune's effects last for 1 hour.

You can also carve permanent runes. Carving a rune on an object or a weapon, or tattooing or scarring it on a creature's flesh, requires components worth 1d4 x 10,000 gp and 1d8 days of work. Once completed, the rune grants the wearer or wielder of the carved item the bonus or penalty (your choice) for that rune listed under "Runic Divination". Non-permanent effects can be used once per day. An item, tattoo, or scar created this way has a magic aura depending from the specific rune depicted.

Negative or reversed runes are considered to be cursed items.
feat-integrated-combat-combat:
Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls with implanted weapons. In addition, you gain a +2 bonus on all skill checks attempted as part of any martial maneuver made while wielding an implanted weapon.

Special: This bonus does not stack with the Weapon Focus feat, but counts as Weapon Focus with all implanted weapons for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
feat-intimidating-scold-metamagic:
You know not only how to be obeyed, but how to be feared too.

Benefit(s): When casting a language-dependent spell or a power word spell on a creature, if you know the full name of that creature, you can add it to the spell's verbal component.

The spell will affect that creature only (even if it normally can affect more creatures), but if the target fails its save, it is also shaken for a number of rounds equal to the spell's original level (as Fearsome Spell). If the spell doesn't allow a save, the target can attempt a Will save (against the same DC the spell would have if it did allow a save) to negate the shaken effect. If the spell effect already causes creatures to become shaken, on a failed save, add the duration of this metamagic effect to the duration of the shaken condition imposed by the spell. An intimidating scold can't cause a creature to become frightened, even if that creature is already shaken.

An intimidating scold uses up a spell slot 1 level higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-inured-to-toxin:
Through exposures to a poisonous substance, you can build a resistance

Prerequisite(s): Saved against previous exposure to the chosen poison.

Benefit(s): You gain immunity to one poison, chosen when you take this feat and gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves against poisons of the same type (contact, ingestion, inhalation, or injury).
feat-keen-hunter-combat:
Your keen senses can give you an advantage in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 1 rank, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): As a standard action you may make a Perception check with a DC equal to an enemy's armor class. If you succeed, until your next turn that enemy gains no bonus from flanking against you and you may move at half speed when leaving one of their threatened squares to avoid provoking an attack of opportunity.

This feat counts as Combat Expertise and Int 13 for the purposes of meeting feat prerequisites which include Combat Expertise.
feat-kinetic-invocation-mythic:
Prerequisite(s): Kinetic Invocation.

Benefit: You gain the mythic version of one spell selected as a wild talent with Kinetic Invocation. In addition, the selected spell counts as psychic magic for all prerequisites. If the selected spell serves as a prerequisite for a prestige class that usually increases spellcasting abilities at some levels, that class instead increases your effective kineticist level for purposes of determining the highest level of wild talents you can select, the effective spell level of your kinetic blast and defense wild talents, and the amount of burn you can accept each round. You continue to gain utility wild talents and infusions as if levels in the prestige class were levels of your class that grants kinetic blast. You don't gain or increase other related class features, such as infusion specializations.

Special: This mythic feat can be selected more than once, every time granting access to the mythic version of a different selected spell.
feat-latent-mesmerism:
A talent for mental influence has awakened within you.

Prerequisite(s): You do not have the hypnotic focus class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to apply hypnotic focus, as the legendary mesmerist class feature, except it does not grant access to spells, will enforcement or a bonus feat. Your focus uses the rules for the opportunist focus. Its penalty cannot exceed -2. It cannot be doubled. If you later gain levels in a class that grants psychic spells, you lose this benefit, but add a 1st-level spell from the opportunist focus spell list to your class spell list and list of spells known.
feat-lesser-prophecy:
The gods chose you as the bearer of their will.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 12, Knowledge (religion) 5 ranks.

Benefit: Choose one mystery (it has not to be a mystery associated with a deity you worship). The chosen mystery can be one you already have access to, or a different one. Twice per day, by presenting a holy symbol of your deity and calling out in supplication, you can cast the 1st-level spell associated with the chosen mystery. Your caster level for this effect is equal to your total Hit Dice, and the saving throw DC, if any, is Charisma-based.
feat-look-at-me:
Your stare transfixes your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Stare focus, ability to cast lock gaze, character level 9

Benefit(s): Whenever you cast a spell or use transfix on at least one creature, you may cast lock gaze on one of the targets as part of the same action. Lock gaze applies first.
feat-magical-beast-wild-shape:
You can take the form of creatures from myth and legends.

Prerequisites Knowledge (nature) 7 ranks, wild shape class feature.

Benefit You can use your wild shape ability to take the form of a magical beast. At 8th level, this functions as beast shape III; at 10th level, as beast shape IV; and at 12th level, as magical beast shape. Your magical beast shape counts as an animal shape for the purpose of feats that give you new abilities when you are in wild shape.
feat-magical-hair:
A supernatural event has left its mark on you via your hair, allowing you to utilize a remnant of its power so long as your locks remain unmarred.

Prerequisite(s): Race with natural hair (GM's discretion).

Benefit(s): Choose a single hair color from the list below. You may cast each of the listed spells once per day as a spell-like ability. Your caster level is equal to your total Hit Dice, and you may choose to have your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma act as your ability modifier for this spell-like ability's saving throw (if any); once made, this choice cannot be changed.

You lose access to this feat's spell-like abilities if your hair is ever shaved off or if it's dyed another color. If completely shorn, your hair regrows in one week. Illusions that change your hair color (such as disguise self or invisibility) do not prevent you from using this feat, but polymorph effects do unless your polymorphed form retains your chosen hair color.

A feat allowing a spellcaster to use an enemy's full name to intimidate them is definitely in the right place here.

• Black (antipaladin)—bane, death knell, murderous command

• Blonde (paladin)—bless, liberating command, positive pulse

• Blue (summoner)—mount, protection from chaos/evil/law/good (choose one), summon minor monster

• Brunette (ranger)—blend, hunter's howl, tracking mark

• Gray (medium)—calm spirit, object reading, unseen servant

• Green (mesmerist)—detect charm, memory lapse, remove fear

• Orange (bloodrager)—break, magic weapon, spiked armor

• Pink (bard)—ear piercing scream, negative reaction, true skill

• Red (druid)—charm animal, pass without trace, shillelagh

• White (cleric)—ceremony *, divine favor, shield of faith

Special: The magic of this feat is difficult to remove from yourself, doubling the cost of retraining this feat for another. Retraining this feat does not change your hair color, only removing the magic associated with it.

This feat cannot be taken if you have the white-haired witch archetype.

*Choose two domains whose ceremonies you can also perform. If you have access to clerical domains from another source, these choices must match those. Any alignment domains you select must match your own alignment.

Note: Each color is associated with a specific class spell list, from which it draws three 1st-level spells. Each spell list is parenthetically noted so that GMs wishing to add other hair colors to this feat can more easily differentiate the spells associated with them. For example, purple hair might be indicative of psychic magic, choosing mindlink, psychic reading, and see alignment—all 1st-level spells from the psychic spell list—for its associated spells.
feat-magical-transformation:
Your magical power transforms you.

Prerequisite: Magical child 3rd.

Benefit(s): You gain the powerful transformation class feature of the outrageous lyricist archetype.
feat-mantis-swarm-form:
You can use your mantis form ability to become a swarm.

Prerequisite(s): Crimson assassin 6th.

Benefit(s): You can temporarily turn your mantis form into a teeming swarm of diminutive mantises. When in mantis form, you can spend a swift action to change into a mantis swarm (treat this as a nonpoisonous centipede swarm). If you are carrying one or two magic sawtooth sabers in hand when you take mantis form, then your swarm damage can bypass DR/magic. You can maintain the mantis swarm form for a number of rounds equal to your crimson assassin level. These rounds do not need to be used consecutively and can be used in 1 round increments. Mantis swarm form can be dismissed as a free action, returning you to mantis form.

At 8th level, your mantis swarm form inflicts 1d6 bleed in addition to its swarm damage. At 10th level, your mantis swarm form inflicts 1 negative level in addition to its swarm damage.
feat-martial-bond-combat:
You can channel the abilities of a weapon through your unarmed strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike.

Benefit(s): You can select 1 melee weapon, forming a bond with it over 24 hours. Once you do so, your unarmed strikes are treated as though they possessed all magical enhancements of the bonded weapon. Any enhancement which would be an invalid choice for an unarmed strike (such as returning) does not function with this ability. You must be within 5 ft. of your bonded weapon at all times to benefit from this feat, and you can select a new weapon with which to bond by spending another 24 hours bonding with it, breaking your previous bond.
feat-masked-identity:
You take on a second identity to combat your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (disguise).

Benefit(s): You gain the dual identity class feature of a vigilante of your character level.

Special: You cannot select this feat if you have the dual identity class feature or a feature that grants you a second identity.
feat-masked-identity-greater:
You become a more talented masked vigilante.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 9th, Improved Masked Identity.

Benefit(s): You gain a vigilante talent, treating your character level as half of your vigilante level for the purposes of which vigilante level you can select with this feat, but for the purpose of the vigilante talent's effect, your effective vigilante level is equal to your full character level. At 16th and 20th level, you can change your vigilante talent to a new one for which you qualify.
feat-masked-identity-improved:
You are better at keeping your identities separate.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 5th, Masked Identity or dual identity class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +5 bonus on Disguise checks to appear as your current identity, increasing to +10 at 10th level. This bonus stacks with seamless disguise.

Special: If you possess a class feature that provides a second identity (such as the chaotic vigilante class feature of the brute archetype), you can treat it as dual identity for the prerequisites of this feat.
feat-mind-trick:
"This is not the one you are looking for."

Prerequisite(s): 5 skill ranks in selected skill

Benefit(s): Select 1 class skill which uses Dexterity as its associated ability score, such as Sleight of Hand or Stealth. You can use Charisma as its associated ability score instead (this allows you to ignore armor check penalty for the chosen skill). In addition, when you use the aid another action to provide a bonus to another creature attempting a check with the selected skill, increase that bonus by your Charisma modifier.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack; you must select a different class skill each time you take this feat.
feat-minor-miracle-mythic:
The miracles your deity grants to you are as great as your faith.

Prerequisite(s): Minor Miracle.

Benefit(s): Add 1/2 your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use the Mythic Miracle feat. You may use the feat to cast any one spell from the selected domains whose level is equal or lesser than your mythic tier.
feat-misers-magic:
You can squeeze just a bit of magic out of your own luck.
