Prerequisite(s): Grit, panache, mettle, or inspiration pool; Spellcraft 3 ranks, no class feature which grants spells or extracts.

Benefit(s): Choose 2 1st-level spells from the sorcerer/wizard spell list. You may cast these spells by spending one point from the pool you used to qualify from this feat. Use your character level as the caster level for these spells and the ability modifier used to determine your grit, panache, mettle, or inspiration pool (whichever is highest if you have multiple pools) is used to determine the save DC of these spells if applicable.
feat-monstrous-companion-mythic:
Your monster companion participates in your mythic nature.

Prerequisite(s): Monstrous Companion, character level 7, 2nd mythic tier.

Benefit(s): Add your mythic tier to your effective druid level to determine your monstrous companion's effective cohort level.

The magical beast you gain as a cohort from the Monstrous Companion feat is a mythic creature with a mythic tier equal to 1/2 your own mythic tier. As a rule, a magical beast's cohort level is equal to twice its challenge rating. So, for example, to gain a mythic griffon (CR 5/MR 2) you must have an equivalent druid level of 13 and be at least mythic tier 4.

Additionally, if your magical beast cohort dies you may replace it in 24 hours by calling on the source of your mythic power. However, doing so causes you to have 1 fewer uses of mythic power per day for the next 30 days.

Special: This feat counts as the Mythic Leadership feat for the purposes of prerequisites.
feat-moving-target:
Your speed helps you dodge incoming threats.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13.

Benefit(s): When you move at least 40 feet in a turn, you gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC and Reflex saves until the beginning of your next turn.

Special: This feat is considered to be Dodge for prerequisite purposes.

A fighter may select this feat as a fighter bonus combat feat.
feat-mysteriously-chosen:
The gods granted you a fraction of power.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Godstouched, character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): Select one oracle mystery. This mystery cannot be a mystery you already have.

You gain one revelation from the chosen mystery that is available to a 1st-level oracle.

For purposes of using that revelation, treat your oracle level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in oracle.
feat-mysteriously-elected:
Your divine power is growing.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Godstouched, Mysteriously Chosen, character level 9th.

Benefit(s): You gain a new revelation from the mystery you selected with the Mysteriously Chosen feat.

This revelation must be available to a 7th-level oracle. For purposes of using that revelation, treat your oracle level as equal to your character level – 2, even if you have levels in oracle.
feat-mysteriously-sanctioned:
Your divine revelations are stronger than ever.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 17, Godstouched, Godstouched Focus, Mysteriously Chosen, Mysteriously Elected, character level 15th.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional revelation from the mystery you selected with the Mysteriously Chosen feat.

This revelation must be available to an 11th-level oracle. For purposes of using that revelation, treat your character level as your oracle level for all your revelations granted by this feat, Mysteriously Chosen, and Mysteriously Elected.
feat-mystic-accuracy-combat:
Your mystic bolts are deadly accurate.

Prerequisite: Mystic bolts class feature.

Benefit(s): You deal additional damage when attacking with mystic bolts equal to half of your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1), and you can apply the Deadly Aim, Piranha Strike and Power Attack feat to attacks made with them even if they are touch attacks (due to the piercing bolts class feature). If you have the Clustered Shots feat, you can total the damage from all hits before applying an opponent's energy resistance.

Special: If you have the Genius Vigilante feat, the bonus to damage from that feat increases to your full Intelligence modifier (minimum +1). If you have the Charismatic Caster feat, the bonus to damage from this feat increases to your full Charisma modifier (minimum +1) instead of half your Intelligence modifier. If you have the Wise Vigilante feat, the bonus to damage from this feat increases to your full Wisdom modifier (minimum +1) instead of half your Intelligence modifier.
feat-mythic-patron-mythic:
You possess the ability to bestow mythic power on others.

Prerequisite(s): Mythic tier 1

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to become a mythic patron (see the mythic patron rules.)
feat-mythic-virtuous-creed-mythic:
The miracles your deity grants to you are as great as your faith.

Prerequisite(s): Minor Miracle.

Benefit(s): Add 1/2 your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use the Mythic Miracle feat. You may use the feat to cast any one spell from the selected domains whose level is equal or lesser than your mythic tier.
feat-natural-connection:
You have learned to harness just a touch of nature's power.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13+

Benefit(s): Choose 2 cantrips from the druid spell list and one 1st-level spell from the druid or ranger spell lists. You may cast the cantrips at will and you may cast the 1st-level spell a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier. Your caster level for these spells is equal to your class level and all three spells use your Wisdom modifier to determine their save DC.
feat-officers-strike-combat:
You mete out divine punishment through your fists.

Prerequisite(s): Office class feature.

Benefit: When you gain this feat, choose one office ability that you can use to affect no more than one opponent. If you successfully hit an opponent in combat (either with a weapon or an unarmed strike), in addition to dealing normal damage, you can use a swift action to deliver the effects of the chosen ability to that opponent. Doing so provokes no attacks of opportunity.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, you apply it to a different qualifying office ability.
feat-order-study:
Despite your lack of allegiance, you know how to emulate an order's power.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary Cavalier 1st, must not belong to an order.

Benefit(s): Select 1 unique aura from an order, instantly gaining access to it.

Normal: A legendary cavalier without an order cannot access unique auras.
feat-overflowing-ki:
"It's simple, I don't run out of power.".

Prerequisite(s): Yakuza 7th, ki class feature

Benefit(s): You are treated as though you always had at least 1 point in your ki for the purpose of abilities which require points to be remaining in your ki. If you have 0 points in your ki, you can meditate for 1 hour to regain 1 point of ki.
feat-passionate-focus:
The clashing of your will against another has been refined into an euphoric experience for you. It may instill you with confidence, burden you, or excite you, but there is nothing else quite like it.

Prerequisite(s): Hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus class feature, character level 9

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully apply your hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus to at least one creature, you gain a morale bonus to damage rolls and saving throws equal to the penalty. This bonus lasts for as long as your hypnotic focus is maintained.
feat-passionate-preacher:
Your energy and commitment are the source of your divine power.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary cleric 1st.

Benefit(s): You may use your Charisma instead of Wisdom for any legendary cleric ability you gain, such as spells, faith, channel energy, or domain abilities. In addition, select 1 Charisma based skill; you gain a +2 bonus to skill checks made with that skill.

Normal: A legendary cleric uses Wisdom to determine their class features.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or before your 1st level of legendary cleric.

Special: This feat cannot be combined with the Student of the Canon feat.
feat-peacemaker-mythic:
Your chosen path of virtue brought you close to sainthood.

Prerequisite(s): Virtuous Creed, must be good.

Benefit: You gain an aura of good as a paladin of your character level. In addition, when selecting this mythic feat, choose one of the creeds you selected with the Virtuous Creed feat. You gain a special ability related to that creed.

• Abstinence: You gain the mythic sustenance mythic universal ability.

• Courage: You gain the resurgent words mythic marshal ability, whatever your chosen mythic path is.

• Chastity: You gain the irrepressible soul mythic guardian ability, whatever your chosen mythic path is. This ability only works against charm and compulsion effects, domination effects, and any effects that control your mind and behavior.

• Freedom: You can apply your result on a rerolled Will save against a charm or compulsion effect to all allies within a 5 ft. radius. Spending one mythic power use, the area of effect extends to a 30 ft. radius.

• Humility: You gain the divine countenance mythic hierophant ability, whatever your chosen mythic path is.

• Mercy: When using a weapon that deals lethal damage to instead deal nonlethal damage, you inflict a number of bonus damage points equal to your mythic tier. This bonus damage stacks with other bonuses granted by different fonts, like a merciful weapon.

• Obedience: As a standard action, once per day you may spend one use of mythic power to issue a command on a member of your same faith who has an aura of faintest intensity than yours (or no aura) as a supernatural ability.

• Peace: As a standard action, you may expend one use of mythic power to surround yourself with a 5 ft. radius aura of calm emotions as a supernatural ability. This aura lasts a number of rounds equal to your mythic tier.

• Poverty: As a standard action, as long as you don't wear any armor, you may expend one use of mythic power to gain a bonus on your AC as a monk of your character level for 1 minute.

• Purity: You gain the affliction resistance mythic guardian ability, whatever your chosen mythic path is.

• Protection: As a standard action, you may spend one use of mythic power to cast sanctuary on all creatures within a 5 ft. radius of yourself as a supernatural ability. This effect lasts a number of rounds equal to your mythic tier.

Special: You can gain this feat once for each creed you selected with the Virtuous Creed feat.
feat-phoenix-burn-combat-style:
Attackers must beware the fire in your body.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 15, Phoenix Style, Elemental Fist, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +11 or monk level 7th.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional Elemental Fist attempt per day. When you use Phoenix Style, you are surrounded by a nimbus of flame. Creatures that attack you must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or suffer damage as if they were hit by your elemental fist.
feat-phoenix-style-combat-style:
You mastered the secrets of fire to heal yourself and burn your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Elemental Fist, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +9 or monk level 5th.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional Elemental Fist attempt per day. While you are in this style, your Elemental Fist attack deals fire damage.

When you are the target of a fire attack while using this style, you don't suffer damage and are instead healed by 1 hp for every dice of damage the attack would have dealt.
feat-phoenix-wings-combat-style:
Your fire aura lifts you in the air.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 17, Phoenix Burn, Phoenix Style, Elemental Fist, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +13 or monk level 9th.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional Elemental Fist attempt per day. When you use Phoenix Style, you can fly as per the wind jump unchained monk ki power. If you already have the wind jump power, your fly speed doubles.
feat-piercing-breath-weapon-breath:
Your elemental bond is strong enough to pierce any protection.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait.

Benefit(s): Your breath weapon ignores an amount of energy resistance or damage resistance equal to 1/2 your character level + your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). At 12th level, you treat immunity to the element of your breath weapon as resist 20, although this feat does not allow you to ignore that resistance.
feat-potent-breath-weapon-breath:
You have trained to keep your breath weapon potent, regardless of how you use it.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use a feat or ability which would reduce the damage die of your breath weapon by 1 or more steps, you ignore 1 step of the reduction (For example, if you used the Advanced Breath Weapon feat while you possessed this feat, the damage of your breath weapon would be reduced by 1 step instead of 2). At 8th level and again at 16th level, you may ignore an additional reduction to your breath weapon's damage die.
feat-potent-conduit:
You can convert excess positive or negative energy into physical power.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast cure or inflict spells.

Benefit: Whenever you cast a cure spell, until the end of your next turn you gain a morale bonus on your next attack roll equal to the spell cast.

Whenever you cast an inflict spell, until the end of your next turn you deal extra damage on your next weapon damage roll equal to twice the level of the spell.
feat-powerful-breath-weapon-breath:
Drawing on your heritage, you can empower your breath weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): The damage your breath weapon deals increases to d8s. At 10th level, it instead deals d10s, and at 15th level it deals d12s.

Special: If you possess the Channeled Breath Weapon feat, this damage increase applies to the additional damage added by that feat.
feat-powerful-thrower-combat:
You fend off foes with one hand while making a thrown attack with the other.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack

Benefit(s): When making a thrown weapon attack you may apply Power Attack to the attack and damage roll.

For every -1 on the attack roll you apply from Power Attack you increase the range increment of the attack by 10 feet. This does not stack with additional damage from the Deadly Aim feat.
feat-practiced-healer:
You know how the body functions and so understand how best to apply positive energy.

Prerequisite(s): Heal 3 ranks, ability to cast spells which restore hit points or a class feature which restores hit points.

Benefit: Whenever you cast a spell or activate a class feature which restores hit points you add +2 to the hit points restored for each die you would roll. If the spell or class feature does not use dice to determine the hit points restored, such as a monk's Wholeness of Body class feature, you instead add 1/2 your character level to the amount healed.
feat-practiced-killer-combat:
You can strike a lethal wound as easily as drawing breath.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You ignore an amount of concealment miss chance equal to 5 times your character level when determining whether or not you can deal precision damage to a creature (or deliver a coup de grace).
feat-practiced-reconnoiter:
Your long days spent observing people, animals, and the wilderness has made you more keenly aware of your surroundings.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 3 Ranks

Benefit(s): Once per round, you may make a Perception check as free action and searching an area takes you only half the normal amount of time. In addition you gain a +2 bonus to initiative checks.
feat-precise-rays:
You are particularly adept at aiming your ray spells.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (ray), sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When making an attack roll with a ray you ignore any penalties on the roll for your target being in melee. In addition, when making a sneak attack, or other precision based attack which adds damage dice, with a ray you may reroll your precision damage once per round, this requires no action.
feat-protected-throw-combat:
You fend off foes with one hand while making a thrown attack with the other.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, Weapon Focus with a thrown weapon

Benefit(s): While wielding two weapons, if one of them has a range increment, you may make a thrown weapon attack with that weapon without provoking attacks of opportunity from creatures you threaten. This includes alchemical splash and grenade-like weapons.
feat-proximal-focus:
The mental contact of your magic allows you to send your stare across long distances.

Prerequisite(s): Hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus class feature

Benefit(s): When casting a mind-affecting spell, or detect/observe a creature through a divination spell on the same round you cast it, you may initiate your hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus as part of the same action on a failed saving throw(if any), regardless of range. If the spell is mind-affecting but does not allow a saving throw, you must be in the normal range of your focus or stare to affect them. If the creature moves out of the range of the spell, or the spell ends and the target is not within normal range of the hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus, the hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus ends. If there are multiple creatures affected or detected/observed by the spell, only one may be targeted by the hypnotic stare or hypnotic focus. This feat does not obviate the requirements of a hypnotic focus or hypnotic stare other than its range. In particular, the Magnificence focus requires its target to be within the mesmerist's aura.
feat-puppet-theory:
Your puppet minions can perform complex tasks.

Prerequisite(s): Puppeteer spell-like ability, Refined Gestures, Sleight of Hand 9 ranks

Benefit(s): Choose two skills based on physical ability scores. You are considered to have ranks in those skills equal to your character level for the purposes of controlling a body through Puppeteer. You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you do, it applies to different skills.
feat-raise-the-stakes-combat:
Luck turns in your favor as you go all in with a deadly stroke.

Prerequisite(s): Bestow Luck.

Benefit(s): You gain an extra daily use of either your Defiant Luck or Inexplicable Luck feat, which you must share with an ally. In addition, you can grant additional uses of your Inexplicable Luck to allies by expending one use of mythic power each time you wish to use an immediate action to Bestow Luck.
feat-rakish-presence:
Your underhanded demeanor puts others on edge.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack

Benefit(s): You gain a bonus on Intimidate checks equal to the number of sneak attack dice you possess. In addition whenever you demoralize a foe the duration of the shaken condition is increased by an additional round for every 4 character levels you possess.
feat-raven-marked:
Being marked as a bad omen has granted you affinity with curses.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast a spell with the curse descriptor.

Benefit(s): Whenever a creature fails a saving throw against a spell you cast with the curse descriptor that applies a numeric penalty, such as bestow curse, increase that penalty by 1.
feat-refined-gestures:
Your puppet mastery affects many foes.

Prerequisite(s): Puppeteer spell-like ability, Sleight of Hand 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You can target multiple creatures with your hypnotic focus by spending a move action each turn to concentrate by continuously gesturing at them. This allows you to control multiple creatures through Puppeteer at the same time, as long as you make all of them take the same actions. When your concentration ends, you may choose one target upon which you maintain your focus. While you control the body of a single creature through Puppeteer, its speed is not penalized, and its movements become lifelike. If you attempt to make it replicate its own mannerisms, use your modifier for Sleight of Hand checks to make a Disguise check, opposed by Sense Motive checks in place of Perception. You may force it to communicate and take actions that require rolls or checks, other than telepathy and purely mental actions. It uses its physical ability scores for its actions, but otherwise uses your bonuses. All above actions you have the target do requires you to concentrate, expending the same actions as it. Roth uses of this feat require somatic components as part of your concentration.
feat-refocusing-defense-combat:
You can center yourself in combat to focus your tactics.

Prerequisite(s): base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You can use total defense to readjust your initiative. When you enter total defense you gain all the normal benefits, but if you do not move on your turn, you treat your initiative as though you rolled a natural 20 for the rest of combat.
feat-reinforced-magic:
Your magic is stubborn and harder to overcome.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells

Benefit(s): Whenever a caster level check is rolled against one of your spells that check takes a -2 penalty.
feat-relay-will:
Your mental magic makes you a master of hypnosis.

Prerequisite(s): Conveyance focus

Benefit(s): Whenever you gain a bonus on Diplomacy checks from at least one spell you've cast, you may use the hypnotism skill unlock a number of additional times equal to the bonus for the spell's duration. If the duration expires during the hypnotism before you implant a suggestion, you fail. You may gain no more uses in this way each day than your character level.
feat-resistant-scales:
You can weather your element far better than most.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic resistance racial trait, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): Your resistance to your element increases to resist 10.
feat-rule-the-rabble:
Bending your lessers to your will is not a point of pride. It is merely a foregone conclusion.

Prerequisite(s): Supremacy focus, mesmerist level 9

Benefit(s): You may cast focus spells on any creature with at least 5 fewer Hit Dice than you have without expending spell slots until it succeeds on a saving throw against any of your spells or abilities. In addition, as a downtime activity, in any region where the average creature has at least 5 less hit dice than you, you may spend 1 day to ensure an area with a radius of up to medium range of a mesmerist spell you cast will be either cleared of or filled with an arbitrary number of bystanders in anticipation for a period of no longer than 8 hours on the following day. You may leave specific creatures unaffected if desired. An hour before or after this period, the crowd gradually thins or grows as appropriate. Each member of the crowd will have seemingly legitimate reasons to be present or absent (though many of those reasons will be false or fabricated by you). You may not cause overcrowding to the point where the crowd becomes a danger to itself or deprive the surrounding area of so many creatures that local life grinds to a halt. A crowd you create will not cause a disturbance outside of the norm for the area, and punishment for trespassing, if any, will be lenient. If the lowest possible punishment for trespassing in the area is incarceration, or lethal, the crowd will restrict itself to public places. If obstacles or terrain prevent creatures from accessing parts of the area at the designated time, they will congregate in parts they can access until that changes. When you influence the crowds in this way, roll a d20. On a 1, you influence or inconvenience someone important in a way that will come back to negatively impact you.
feat-sacramental-brew:
You can give your potions a holy zing.

Prerequisite(s): Brew Potion, able to cast bless water and enhance water.

Benefit: You can imbue a potion with positive energy as if it were water, creating it as both holy water and the potion it was made from. The cost of creating a sacramental brew is equal to 25 gp + the cost of the potion.
feat-sacrificial-power:
You can empower your magical energies by drawing forth the life force of other people.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Focus (any one) or Spell Penetration, Knowledge (arcana) 3 ranks, Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks, Spellcraft 3 ranks

Benefit(s): When you perform a successful coup de grace upon a sentient creature, it allows you to enhance the power of any spell you cast by doubling the effect of one or more of the following feats: Greater Spell Focus, Greater Spell Penetration, Spell Focus, or Spell Penetration feats you 21 have. You may double the effect of one of the above feats of your choice (though you must double a normal feat before doubling its Greater version) per Hit Dice of the slain creature; if the sacrifice has 4 or more Hit Dice, you double the effect of all of the above feats. You must cast the spell to be enhanced within a number of rounds after the coup de grace equal to the slain creature's Hit Dice or the power of the sacrifice is lost.
feat-sacrificial-summons:
The lives of others are nothing but fuel for your appetite for communing with creatures from beyond.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Focus (conjuration), Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks

Benefit(s): When you perform a successful coup de grace upon a sentient creature, it allows you to enhance the power of a calling or summoning spell. You may add the effect of a metamagic feat you know to a calling or summoning spell without altering the spell's level or casting time. The metamagic feat you choose must be one that increases the spell's level by one level.

You must cast the companion spell within a number of rounds after the coup de grace equal to the slain creature's Hit Dice. If time allows, you can combine several sacrifices together in order to enhance the effect of a spell, allowing you to modify your calling or summoning with metamagic feats requiring a multiple-level increase. If your cohort, followers, or called or summoned creature(s) are adjacent to you, they may also perform a coup de grace on a sentient creature, each additional sacrifice allows you to add one additional level of metamagic increase. You can add more than one metamagic feat to a spell in this fashion, but the spell's total adjusted level cannot exceed 9th. If the spell is not cast by the time the sacrificial energies dissipate, the spell fails completely when cast. All sacrificial energy you have accrued is dissipated when you cast the spell; any leftover sacrificial energy is lost.

You can enhance a calling or summoning spell with a metamagic feat you do not know, but the cost in sacrifices is increased by 1 for each such feat you apply.
feat-share-breath-mythic:
You and your allies can share another's breath above the waves or below them.

Prerequisite(s): Aquatic or water subtype.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can imbue an ally with the ability to breathe water. Your ally must remain within 5 feet times your mythic rank or tier. This ability persists until you revoke it as a full-round action or until the creature moves farther from you than the above distance. If the ability ends while that creature is still underwater, it may begin to drown. If you expend one use of your mythic power, you can share this ability with a number of additional allies equal to your mythic rank or tier.
feat-shared-curse:
The curse you bear also afflicts your pet.

Prerequisite(s): Oracle's curse, must have an animal companion, familiar, or eidolon.

Benefit: Your animal companion, familiar, or eidolon gains your oracle curse, suffering all the same effects as you from your curse.
feat-shout-of-kings:
You understand how to rouse warriors beyond their normal limits.

Prerequisite(s): Commander's shout class feature, legendary cavalier 11th.

Benefit(s): You can spend 6 rounds of your commander's aura class feature to affect an ally who has already been affected by your commander's shout during the same day. An ally cannot be affected by your commander's shout two times within 5 minutes, even with this feat, and a creature cannot benefit from the commander's shout class feature more than two times per day, even if another creature also has this feat.
feat-silence-foe-combat:
You can steal an opponent's voice with a well placed strike.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When you deal sneak attack damage to a target you can choose to roll 2 fewer dice than normal to render your opponent unable to speak for 1 round unless they succeed at a Fortitude save with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + the number of sneak attack dice you possess.
feat-silent-takedown-combat:
You can take down lone enemies very effectively.

Prerequisite(s): sneak attack +2d6

Benefit(s): When you deal sneak attack damage to a target who is unaware of you, while no allies are within 60 feet, you may make a Stealth check with a -10 penalty, opposed by your target's Perception check. If your Stealth check is successful your target must make a Fortitude saving throw with a DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + the number of sneak attack dice you possess. If they fail they are knocked unconscious for one minute and creatures more than 60 feet away do not make Perception checks to notice the attack.
feat-spirit-call:
Your familiarity with spirits grants you the limited use of a hex.

Prerequisite(s): Mystery or domain class feature.

Benefit: Choose one shaman hex when you take this feat.

This must belong to a spirit matching your oracle mystery or related to your domain (like the Life spirit for the Healing domain). You can use this hex twice per day. Your effective shaman level is the highest level that you have in the class that grants the mystery or domain class feature.
feat-spirit-masters-channel:
Your devotion empowered your dominion over life energy.

Prerequisite(s): Divine touch Ni class feature, 4th level character.

Benefits: You may expend 2 uses of your divine touch ability to channel energy as a warpriest of your same level.
feat-spirit-masters-channel-mythic:
Your mythic power fuels your channeling ability.

Prerequisite: Spirit Master's Channel.

Benefit: You add your tier to all damage dealt or healed with your channel energy ability.
feat-spontaneous-summon-fey:
Instead of summoning natural allies, you can instead cast summon fey.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks, ability to spontaneously cast summon nature's ally spells.

Benefit(s): You can "lose" a prepared spell in order to cast any summon fey spell (see below) of the same level or lower, instead of casting a summon nature's ally spell as you normally would. For the purpose of this feat only, the summon fey spells of the appropriate spell levels count as being on your spell list at the same spell level as for a druid, if they were not already on your spell list.
feat-spontaneous-summon-fey-mythic:
You can cast more of your spells spontaneously.

Prerequisite(s): Spontaneous Summon Fey.

Benefit(s): You can use your spontaneous casting ability to cast domain spells or spirit spells that you did not prepare ahead of time.
feat-spot-weakness-combat:
Your perception is honed to the point of finding weakness in your opponent's defense.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Feint

Benefit(s): You may make a Perception check rather than a Bluff check to feint.
feat-stand-still-combat-mythic:
None shall pass.

Prerequisite(s): Stand Still.

Benefit(s): When you successfully use the Stand Still feat to make a combat maneuver check to force a foe to stop moving, you may also deal melee damage to that foe with a natural or unarmed attack or a weapon you have in hand.
feat-student-of-the-canon:
Your knowledge of doctrine allows to you to perform a variety of miracles.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary cleric 1st.

Benefit(s): You may use your Intelligence instead of Wisdom for any legendary cleric ability you gain, such as spells, faith, channel energy, or domain abilities. In addition, select 1 Intelligence-based skill; you gain a +2 bonus to skill checks made with that skill.

Normal: A legendary cleric uses Wisdom to determine their class features.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or before your 1st level of legendary cleric.

Special: This feat cannot be combined with the Passionate Preacher feat.
feat-swift-shots-combat:
You are exceptionally quick with your bow.

Prerequisite(s): base attack bonus +4, proficient with any bow

Benefit(s): When wielding a bow with which you are proficient, as a standard action you may make two attacks at your highest base attack bonus. Each of these attacks suffers a -2 penalty on the attack and damage roll.
feat-swim-by-attack:
Your fluid grace allows you to effortlessly combine your actions while moving beneath the waves.

Prerequisite(s): Swim speed.

Benefit(s): When you are using a move action to swim, you can take a standard action at any point during your movement; you are not required to complete your move action before using your standard action (or vice versa). You cannot use your standard action to perform a second move (though you can use it to perform other move actions).

Mythic: If you make a melee attack as your standard action while using this feat, your movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity from the creature you attack. In addition, if you spend one use of your mythic power, you can move up to twice your swim speed in addition to your standard action, rather than being limited to your swim speed.
feat-switchblade-combat:
Your deft hands and dancing feet make you a blur on the battlefield.

Prerequisite(s): Swap Places, Weapon Finesse, positioning attack rogue talent.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can make a single melee attack with a light weapon as a melee touch attack. Your attack deals half damage, and after resolving your attack you can take a 5-foot step into the space of a willing ally. That ally can take a 5-foot step as an immediate action to move into the space you have just left. Your ally need not have the Swap Places feat to make this movement.
feat-sword-and-pistol-flurry-combat-styl:
You unleash a rapid series of many shots while keeping enemies at bay with your sword.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Snap Shot, Sword and Pistol, Sword and Pistol Sharpness, Two–Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +10.

Benefit(s): When you use Sword and Pistol and Rapid Shot in a round, you can make an additional attack either with your primary hand or off-hand weapon at your highest attack bonus. This stacks with the additional attack granted by Rapid Shot.
feat-sword-and-pistol-sharpness-combat-s:
Your finesse when wielding a firearm and a melee weapon together increases.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 14, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Snap Shot, Sword and Pistol, Two–Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): When you use the Two–Weapon Fighting feat while wielding a one-handed melee weapon and a crossbow or firearm, the penalty on attack rolls both for your primary hand and your off hand lessens by 2. This stacks with the penalty reduction granted by Two–Weapon Fighting.
feat-tailed-adept:
Unlike other wyrmtouched, your tail is incredibly dangerous.

Prerequisite(s): Powerful tail racial trait, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Your tail attack is treated as a primary attack.

Special: If you possess the brutal dragoon racial trait, the damage die increase also applies to your tail.
feat-thrown-weapon-savant-combat:
Your weapons always strike true.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any thrown weapon)

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a ranged attack with a thrown weapon for which you have Weapon Focus, it gains your choice of one of the following special abilities until the beginning of your next turn; distance, returning, or seeking.
feat-touch-of-faith-mythic:
Gods and spirits increased their influence on your life when you gained mythic power.

Prerequisite(s): Touch of Fate.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional revelation from the mystery tied to Touch of Fate for every five levels you have beyond 5th. For the first revelation you selected with the non-mythic version of this feat, use your full character level to determine its effect; you can select and use your other revelations as if you were an oracle of your character level –2.
feat-trail-of-blood-combat:
You cut a bloody swathe through your foes, turning their weapons against each other and themselves.

Prerequisite(s): Treacherous Goad, Bluff 15 ranks, befuddling strike rogue talent, sneak attack +2d6.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can move up to your speed.

Your movement provokes attacks of opportunity, but you can use your Treacherous Goad feat against each creature that makes an attack of opportunity. Even if your Bluff check fails against an attacker, you can make an Acrobatics check against a DC equal to your attacker's CMD to avoid its attack of opportunity.
feat-transfer-charge:
You can steal power from one magic item to charge another.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to craft a spell-trigger magic item.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can cause a magic item with a number of charges in your possession to lose one charge and transfer that charge to another similar item. The item that loses a charge becomes non-functional and cannot be targeted by this feat again for 24 hours.
feat-treacherous-goad-combat:
Your bewildering blows lure a target into harming itself.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 10 ranks, befuddling strike rogue talent, sneak attack +2d6.

Benefit(s): If a target affected by your befuddling strike misses you with an attack of opportunity, you can attempt a Bluff check as if to feint the target as an immediate action. If the feint succeeds, the target automatically hits itself with its attack of opportunity, dealing half damage to itself. If the target is flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus against you when it makes its attack of opportunity, you add one-half your sneak attack damage to the damage it takes.

You can use this feat against any foe that misses you with an attack of opportunity; however, you take a -10 penalty on your Bluff check when using it against enemies that you have not affected with your befuddling strike.
feat-triple-jump:
Your practiced leaps can cover impossible distances.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 10 ranks, acrobatic stunt rogue talent

Benefit(s): Whenever you make an Acrobatics check to jump, you may roll three times and take the best result. In addition, once per day you can roll three times when making an Acrobatics check to jump, adding the results of all three checks together to determine the distance you jump. You can exceed your speed with the distance of this jump.
feat-triumph-of-the-will:
Your powerful rhetoric and subtle implications of lurking danger drive others into a panicked yet lasting faith in you as the one they can trust.

Prerequisite(s): Persuasive, Intimidate 5 ranks, Cha 13+

Benefit(s): When you use Intimidate to force a single creature to act friendly toward you, the effect lasts for 1d6 hours, plus one hour for every point by which your Intimidate check exceeds the DC. Alternatively, you can attempt to force a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier to act friendly toward you for 1d6 minutes plus one minute for every point by which your Intimidate check exceeds the DC. You make a single check against the highest Intimidate DC (10 + Hit Dice + Wisdom modifier) among your targets, increasing the DC by 2 for each creature after the first. All creatures to be affected must be within 30 feet
feat-turn-alignment-mythic:
You can make creatures of your hated alignment flee.

Prerequisites(s): Turn Alignment.

Benefit(s): Your turn alignment ability affects any creatures with the same alignment as those affected by non-mythic Turn Alignment (not just outsiders, neither just those with the alignment subtype), but these targets gain a +4 bonus on their Will save unless they have an aura of that alignment (like clerics, paladins and warpriests). Alternatively, you can expend two uses of mythic power when using Turn Alignment to affect all targets of the chosen alignment as if they had that alignment subtype.
feat-turn-infidel:
Enemies of your faith will flee before you.

Prerequisite(s): Chaotic, evil, good, or lawful alignment, ability to command or turn undead, divine spellcaster.

Benefit: Select an alignment that opposes one aspect of yours (i. e., if you are Chaotic Good, you can select evil or lawful). You can spend one use of your command or turn undead ability to attempt rebuking one divine spellcaster of the chosen alignment. This follows the same rules to turn intelligent undead.

Special: This feat can be granted as a bonus feat by some deities or in some campaigns heavily based on religion wars.
feat-twist-the-knife-combat:
You can apply speed and strength along with precision to deal grievous harm with smaller weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Finesse, powerful sneak rogue talent, sneak attack +3d6.

Benefit(s): When you hit an opponent that is flanked or denied its Dexterity bonus with a light weapon, as a swift action you can twist the weapon in the wound, applying both your Strength and Dexterity modifier as a bonus to your damage roll.
feat-two-toned-hair:
Your hair has a vibrant streak of a second color running through it, representing minor access to a second source of magic.

Prerequisite(s): Magical Hair.

Benefit(s): Select a second color from the list in the Magical Hair feat, which must be different from the color you took when you selected that feat. You may choose a single spell-like ability from those listed for that color, which you can use once per day. This spell-like ability has the same restrictions and limitations as those gained from Magical Hair, and its save DC (if any) is calculated with the same mental ability score that you chose for that feat.
feat-tyrant-fang:
Your bite can crack anything.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Strike or spell strike class feature, bite attack.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Vital Strike feat or spell strike class feature with a bite attack, your bite attack is considered 1 size larger when determining its damage (this does not stack with other such size increases, such as the impactue weapon quality).
feat-unbound-breath-weapon-breath:
Your spring of elemental power is limitless.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic breath weapon racial trait.

Benefit(s): Your breath weapon can be used once every other round, regardless of your Constitution modifier.

Normal: You may only use your breath weapon a number of times per day equal to your Constitution modifier.
feat-unholstering-strike:
You have learned a close-quarters fighting style that allows you to draw a firearm after striking an opponent in melee.

Prerequisite(s): Str 12+, grit class feature, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When you successfully hit an opponent in melee combat you may draw a holstered firearm as an immediate action. You must have enough free hands to appropriately wield this firearm in order to draw it. If you have additional attacks you may make in the round, you may attack with your drawn firearm.

Additionally, when you successfully use Unholstering Strike and then attack with your newly drawn firearm on the same round you may spend 1 point of grit in order for that ranged attack to not provoke attacks of opportunity from the creature you just hit in melee.
feat-valas-curse:
Your magic abilities come at the price of an oracular curse.

Prerequisite: Valkyrie with the vala archetype.

Benefit: You gain one oracle curse. This progresses using your valkyrie level as your equivalent oracle level. If a curse grants access to spells, 4th- and 5th-level oracle spells are added to your spell list as 3rd-level spells, and 6th- and 7th- level spells are added to your spell list as 4th-level spells. If you possess an oracle curse from another class or gain one later, your valkyrie levels instead stack with your levels in that other class for the purpose of your curse's effects.
feat-valas-magic:
You have access to your mystery's unique spells.

Prerequisites: Valkyrie with the vala archetype, Cha 14, 4th level character.

Benefit: You add the 1st-4th level spells from your chosen mystery to your known spell list. These cannot be exchanged for different spells at higher levels.
feat-valhallas-fury:
You share the same rage of the worthy warriors you come to aid or collect.

Prerequisites: 1st level valkyrie, vanquish foe class feature.

Benefits: You can expend one use of your vanquish foe ability to rage as a barbarian for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution bonus. You can use your valkyrie rage powers while raging as normal.
feat-vanquishing-rage-general:
You strike your chosen enemy with righteous fury.

Prerequisites: Rage class feature, vanquish foe class feature, base attack bonus +5

Benefit(s): When using your vanquish foe ability while raging, you add an additional +2 to your damage rolls against your chosen target in a round for each additional round of rage you choose to expend in that round, up to ¼ of your total.
feat-vexing-assassin-combat:
Your movements and grace give you more openings in combat.

Prerequisite(s): ability to deal precision damage

Benefit(s): Whenever you benefit from flanking you also gain a +2 bonus on melee damage rolls and on critical confirmation rolls.
feat-vital-magic:
You know how to strike with impressive force even while casting.

Prerequisite(s): Spell combat class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use the spell combat class feature as a standard action. If you do, you no longer need a free hand to cast. You also treat your character level as your BAB to determine when you qualify for feats with 'Vital' in their name. You cannot use the spellstrike class feature while using this feat.

Special: If you have the Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike feats, you may use it with the spell combat class feature with this standard action.
feat-vital-power:
You know where to strike to most effectively empower your spells.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Magic, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use the Vital Magic feat, the DC of a spell cast during your spell combat class feature increases by +1. At 14th level, the spell's DC increases by an additional +1.
feat-vital-spellstrike:
You only require a single swing to devastate foes with magic.

Prerequisite(s): Vital Magic, spellstrike class feature, character level 7th.

Benefit(s): You can use the spellstrike class feature while using Vital Magic as well as removing the -2 penalty on attack rolls when using spell combat.
feat-wolf-master:
You can tame more than ordinary hounds.

Prerequisite(s): Houndmaster 1st.

Benefit(s): You can select a wolf for your animal companions.

Normal: You can select a dog or wolf dog for your animal companions.
feat-wrath-bearer:
When you can no longer spare the rod, you can at least spare the lives of your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Battle mystery, Craft Magic Arms and Armor.

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls when wielding a magic weapon that you have created.
feat-wyrmtouched-scion:
You stand above other wyrmtouched, a paragon of your race.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 5th, wyrmtouched.

Benefit(s): You gain one of the following racial traits or alternate racial traits from the wyrmtouched race:

• Brutal dragoon

• Draconic breath weapon

• Elevated awareness

• Wyrm wings

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different racial trait.

Special: You cannot select the brutal dragoon racial trait if you have the monstrous growth racial trait.
feat-additional-inspiring-command:
Your commands are more versatile.

Prerequisite(s): Inspiring Command class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional inspiring command. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this inspiring command.

Special: You can gain Additional Inspiring Command multiple times.
feat-advanced-cognatogen:
Your mutagenic form can enhance your mental abilities rather than your muscles.

Prerequisite(s): Advanced mutagen class feature, cognatogen or inspiring cognatogen discovery.

Benefit(s): You add the following advanced mutagens to the list of those you can select:

This cognatogen is identical to the alchemist discovery of the same name and counts as that discovery for the purpose of qualifying for other discoveries or advanced mutagens.

In her mutagenic form, the master chymist's refined mind gives her an alchemical bonus on Intelligence checks, Wisdom checks, and Intelligence-based skill checks as well as a bonus to concentration checks and caster level.

The bonus is equal to half the master chymist's class level.

This cognatogen is identical to the alchemist discovery of the same name and counts as that discovery for the purpose of qualifying for other discoveries or advanced mutagens. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 16 and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability. If the master chymist has the inspiring cognatogen discovery, this may instead function as grand inspiring cognatogen.

This cognatogen is identical to the alchemist discovery of the same name and counts as that discovery for the purpose of qualifying for other discoveries or advanced mutagens. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 12 and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability. If the master chymist has the inspiring cognatogen discovery, this may instead function as greater inspiring cognatogen.

Inspired Trick: The master chymist selects an investigator talent to use while she is under the effect of her inspiring cognatogen. This is in addition to other investigator talents gained through inspiring cognatogen discoveries and the inspired chemist archetype.

The master chymist treats all Knowledge skills as class skills, and the bonus gained from the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen increases to her class level. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 11 and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability.

When the chymist assumes her mutagenic form, she gains outsider features depending on her alignment. The chymist chooses one outsider subtype when selecting this advanced cognatogen; once selected, this choice cannot be changed. The chymist gains the energy resistances of the selected outsider subtype and may channel positive or negative energy once per transformation into her mutagenic form, curing or inflicting 5d6 points of damage (Will half, DC 10 + the chymist's class level + the chymist's Charisma modifier). The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 16, must know the infuse self extract, and must have the collective memory discovery or advanced cognatogen to select this ability.

This cognatogen functions as the universal monster ability of the same name, except that it only applies in the chymist's mutagenic form.

The master chymist gains an additional +2 bonus on a mental ability whenever she imbibes a cognatogen. The character must have an effective alchemist level (alchemist level plus chymist level) of at least 16 and must know the eagle's splendor, fox's cunning, or owl's wisdom extract to select this ability.
feat-advanced-mutagen:
Your mutagenic form can enhance your muscles rather than your mental abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Advanced cognatogen class feature, mutagen discovery.

Benefit(s): You gain the master chymist's advanced mutagen class feature and can select advanced mutagens normally even if you have the alchemical genius archetype.
feat-arcing-weapon-mythic:
Your blasts become even more powerful when delivered through your weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Arcing Weapon.

Benefit(s): You can deliver a touch spell, a ray spell or a spell with a defined target or number of targets (rather than an area) through your weapon. Only a single target struck by your weapon is affected, even if the spell normally affects multiple targets.
feat-battle-planner-mythic:
Your allies move on the battlefield as an all-consuming force, following your precise directives.

Prerequisite(s): Battle Planner.

Benefit(s): You can use your inspire action class feature on all allies within 60 feet. If you possess the mythic inspire action class feature, this applies to it too.
feat-blend-with-scenery:
You can disguise yourself as a statue, a chest, or even a sofa.

Prerequisite(s): Master of disguise class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use Disguise to pass for an object of your approximate size, with a Disguise check modifier of -20. You apply your bonus from the master of disguise ability when you use this feat.
feat-channel-spirit-mythic:
Though you may not be a medium, you have a strict relationship with your spirit guide.

Prerequisite(s): Channel Spirit

Benefit(s): The spirit bonus you gain from one spirit selected with the Channel Spirit feat is equal to the spirit bonus you would gain from a medium level equal to your character level. You also can select a taboo, and let your spirit gain influence over you as if you were a medium.

Special: You may select this feat once for every spirit selected with the non-mythic version of Channel Spirit. This feat counts as having the spirit ability for all prerequisites.
feat-continued-studies:
You continue to improve the abilities of your original career even after undertaking a new path.

Prerequisite(s): Favored Prestige Class with selected prestige class.

Benefit(s): Choose one class feature (other than spellcasting) that improves with your class level, like barbarian rage or bardic performance. You add your level in your chosen prestige class to your level in the class that grants you the selected feature for that feature's purpose. This doesn't grant you any new abilities.

Special: You can select the Continued Studies feat more than once. Each time, it affects a different class feature. If your favored prestige class grants bonus feats, you may select this feat in place of a bonus feat.
feat-continued-studies-mythic:
You reached a complete mastery of your previous class abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Continued Studies.

Benefit(s): You can gain new abilities related to the feature you selected with Continued Studies as you advance in level (new oracle revelations, magus arcana, bardic performances and so on). You also use your character level as your class level in order to qualify for feats that have the selected class feature as a prerequisite.

Special: You may select Mythic Continued Studies once for each time you selected the non-mythic Continued Studies feat.
feat-dueling-grace-combat:
You strike elegantly and precisely with your piercing weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Canny defense class feature, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus with chosen weapon.

Benefit(s): Choose one kind of one-handed piercing weapon (such as the trident). You gain the swashbuckler finesse ability with the selected weapon, and you can add your Dexterity modifier instead of your Strength modifier to that weapon's damage. The weapon must be one appropriate for your size.
feat-expanded-enhance-arrows-mythic:
You can confer nearly any power to your arrows and bow.

Prerequisite(s): Expanded Enhance Arrows.

Benefit(s): You gain the mythic enhance arrows ability, as seen under Mythic Arcane Archer Options. If you already have that ability or gain it later, you add the following qualities to the ones you can grant to your arrows or bow: brilliant energy, greater designating, heart-piercing, speed, tailwind.
feat-explosive-weapon-mythic:
Magic channeled through your weapon becomes truly devastating.

Prerequisite(s): Explosive Weapon.

Benefit(s): You can release a non-instantaneous area spell through your weapon as part of a melee or ranged attack.

You can choose to center the spell effect on the target of your melee attack rather than on yourself.
feat-extra-defensive-power:
You have unlocked a new ability to use while in your defensive stance.

Prerequisite(s): Defensive power class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional defensive power. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this defensive power.

Special: You can gain Extra Defensive Power multiple times.
feat-extra-defensive-stance:
You can maintain your defensive stance longer.

Prerequisite(s): Defensive stance class feature.

Benefit(s): You can maintain your defensive stance for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Defensive Stance multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-extra-fervor:
You have a more fervent belief in your place as the sword-arm of your faith.

Benefit: You gain two additional uses of fervor per day.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times and its benefits stack.
feat-extra-hail-of-arrows-mythic:
Your arrows are a shower and a cataclysm for your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Extra Hail of Arrows, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use hail of arrows. This stacks with the uses of hail of arrows per day gained through the nonmythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Extra Hail of Arrows, this feat may be selected only once.
feat-extra-improved-wild-shape:
You unlocked a new shapechanging ability.

Prerequisite(s): Improved wild shape class feature.

Benefit(s): Select an additional spell from the improved wild shape list. Your improved wild shape ability can now have that effect as well. You can only select an effect you would normally have access to based on your shapemaster level.
feat-extra-inspiring-command:
Your inspiring commands last longer.

Prerequisite(s): Inspiring Command class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use inspiring command for 6 additional rounds per day.

Special: You can gain Extra Inspiring Command multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-extra-psychic-esoterica:
Your psychic power combined in new ways with your physical prowess.

Prerequisite(s): Psychic esoterica class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional psychic esoterica. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this esoterica.

Special: You can gain Extra Psychic Esoterica multiple times.
feat-extra-spell-synthesis-mythic:
You are a master at fusing different magic traditions.

Prerequisite(s): Extra Spell Synthesis, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use spell synthesis. This stacks with the uses of spell synthesis per day gained through the nonmythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Extra Spell Synthesis, this feat may be selected only once.
feat-favored-prestige-class-mythic:
You gain the maximum advantage from the prestigious path you chose.

Prerequisite(s): Favored Prestige Class.

Benefit(s): You gain both 1 hit point and 1 skill point per level when you gain a level in the prestige class you selected. You may replace one of these benefits with a favored class bonus if that class grants one. In addition, you can always take 10 or 20 on checks of the skill you selected with this feat's nonmythic version, even when you are rushed or threatened.
feat-frontline-ranger-combat:
Bows are more versatile in your hands than most.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Weapon Focus (any bow)

Benefit(s): You may wield a long bow as a quarterstaff or a shortbow as a club, doing so requires no action and you threaten adjacent squares while wielding these weapons. You may make both melee and ranged attack rolls in the same round with these weapons. Whenever you make a melee attack with a bow in this way and deal damage to your target you may make a free trip attempt against them without provoking an attack of opportunity.
feat-get-er-done:
You know how to get the job done.

Prerequisite(s): Getting the job done class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional getting the job done choice.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time grants an additional getting the job done.
feat-greater-channel-spirit-mythic:
Your mythic nature deepens even more your bond with the spirits.

Prerequisite(s): Greater Channel Spirit.

Benefit(s): You gain one of the following feats, or the mythic version of a feat you already possessed: Absorb Spirit, Fortune Teller, Free Spirit, Improved Legendary Influence, Incorporeal Intuition, Legendary Influence, Spirit Ally, Spirit Beacon, Spirit Focus, Spirit Rebuke, Spirit Ridden, Spirit Sense, Spirit Sight, Spirit Speaker, Spirit Vision. You can't gain a feat that relies on a class feature you don't possess. In addition, In addition, you treat your character level as your medium level for any intermediate or greater powers you gain from the Greater Channel Spirit feat.
feat-hamper-divination:
You can sneak past magic if the need arises.

Prerequisite(s): Stealth 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Your Stealth checks can evade divination spells and effects. For magic items, traps, and other effects. Compare your Stealth check to 15 + the caster level of the effect you are avoiding. Success means the divination does not perceive you as if you were successfully protected by the spell nondetection until you are discovered by other means (such as by a Perception check) or you end your Stealth. When using Stealth and encountering an active spell or when a spell is cast that would target you or include you in its area the caster must make a caster level check with a DC equal to 10 + your ranks in Stealth + your dexterity modifier. If this caster level check fails you are treated as if were successfully protected by the spell nondetection for the duration of the spell which triggered the check.
feat-improved-channel-spirit-mythic:
Your bonded spirit taps into your mythic energies and multiplies its power.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Channel Spirit.

Benefit(s): You gain spirit abilities granted by your chosen spirit as a medium with a level equal to your character level -2. For that spirit's minor power, use your full character level to determine its effect; for all other spirit powers, treat your medium level as your character level –2.
feat-improved-companion-bond:
Your bond with your animal companion is stronger than ever.

Prerequisite(s): Companion walk class feature.

Benefit(s): Your animal companion becomes your familiar, gaining all the abilities and granting the same benefits of a familiar (except it doesn't grant a familiar bonus). It retains all the abilities of an animal companion as well. It is possible for a character to have two familiars this way. Your animal companion still cannot take archetypes reserved for familiars.
feat-improvisational-focus-combat-mythic:
An improvised weapon is a lethal instrument in your hands.

Prerequisite(s): Catch Off-Guard or Throw Anything, Improvisational Focus, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Your bonus on attack rolls with improvised weapons from Improvisational Focus and feats that use Improvisational Focus as a prerequisite (such as Greater Weapon Focus) doubles. With improvised weapons, ½ your character levels count as fighter levels for the purpose of selecting feats that improve your ability with a weapon (such as Weapon Specialization).
feat-inspiring-banner:
Your troops are encouraged by your brave words while they follow your banner.

Prerequisite(s): Banner and inspiring command class features.

Benefit(s): Morale bonuses on attacks and saving throws against fear provided by your inspire courage bardic performance stack with those granted by your banner ability.
feat-lesser-spell-synthesis-mythic:
You can concentrate on different spell traditions with astonishing ease.

Prerequisite(s): Lesser Spell Synthesis, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use lesser spell synthesis. This stacks with additional uses of lesser spell synthesis per day gained through the non-mythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Lesser Spell Synthesis, this feat may be selected only once.
feat-lingering-breath-mythic:
Your breath weapon's effects are more severe.

Prerequisite(s): Lingering Breath, mythic tier 3rd.

Benefit(s): Your lingering breath deals an additional number of lingering damage points equal to your mythic tier.
feat-martyrs-countenance:
The sight of your stigmata is inspiring for the members of your faith and terrifying for your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Stigmata class feature.

Benefit(s): When your stigmata are active, you gain a bonus equal to your holy vindicator class level on Diplomacy skill checks with members of your faith, and on Intimidate skill checks with members of faiths opposite to yours on the chaos/law or evil/good axis.
feat-mind-strike-mythic:
Your sneak attacks leave your target bewildered for a long time.

Prerequisite(s): Mind Strike.

Benefit(s): Whenever you deal sneak attack damage, the penalty on your target's Will saves lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1 + ½ your mythic tier (minimum +1). Each time you deal sneak attack damage to an affected target, the duration stacks.
feat-murderous-sniper-mythic:
You can deliver a killing strike from very long distances.

Prerequisite(s): Murderous Sniper.

Benefit(s): You can hit a target up to 60 feet of distance with a ranged death attack. For every additional round you spend studying the target, you can extend this range by 20 feet.
feat-omnicomprensive-learning-mythic:
You learned to take the maximum out of all your favored classes.

Prerequisite(s): Two or more favored classes, at least one among Mythic Eclectic, Mythic Fast Learner, Mythic Favored Prestige Class, or Mythic Multitalented Mastery.

Benefit(s): Every time you gain a level in a favored class, you receive all the favored class bonuses you would have access to for gaining a level in all your favored classes.
feat-prestigious-spellcaster-mythic:
Your magic abilities grow much more quickly when you take levels in a prestige class.

Prerequisite(s): Prestigious Spellcaster.

Benefit(s): Your favored prestige class is considered to grant an increase in effective level for the purpose of casting spells at every level. This effect is retroactive if you gain this feat at a level beyond the point where your favored prestige class would normally have not advanced your spellcasting.

If your favored prestige class does not have the spells per day class feature, it is considered to grant a level increase at every odd level. This feat still does not work if the prestige class already grants a level increase at every level (like arcane trickster or loremaster), and the total increase to your effective caster level still cannot exceed your actual prestige class level.
feat-secret-of-magical-discipline-mythic:
Your magical versatility is unparalleled.

Prerequisite(s): Secret of Magical Discipline.

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to the number of times per day you can use Secret of Magical Discipline.

This stacks with additional uses of the ability per day gained through the non-mythic version of this feat.

Special: Unlike the non-mythic Secret of Magical Discipline, this feat may be selected only once.
feat-shadows-embrace-mythic:
You are a creature of darkness and a gloomy aura hides your moves.

Prerequisite(s): Shadow's Embrace.

Benefit(s): Your shadow's embrace ability functions now as mythic darkness. You are still able to raise or lower the illumination level of the effect, up to normal light.
feat-song-of-valhalla:
Your music draws you near to the fallen heroes in battle.

Prerequisite(s): Call down the legends class feature.

Benefit(s): Your call down the legends ability functions as if you had used an Ohalia's horn. The summoned berserkers still come with the listed equipment; if a sleipnir is summoned, it comes with +2 leather barding and horseshoes of crushing blows +2.
feat-spirit-mastery-mythic:
Your ability in dancing with the spirits is unparalleled.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd mythic tier, medium spirit class ability.

Benefit(s): You gain the spirit swap mythic ability from the path of the mystic, whatever your mythic path is.
feat-spirit-ridden-mythic:
You learned to become a true friend of the spirits.

Prerequisite(s): Spirit Ridden

Benefit(s): Your called spirit stays with you for 24 hours.

You gain the Psychic Sensitivity or Signature Skill feat (your choice) for the purpose of using skill unlocks with the granted skill, for all the time the séance's effects last.
feat-spirits-enemy:
Your spirit guide bestows its wrath upon some foes in particular.

Prerequisite(s): Spirit guardian class feature.

Benefit(s): Choose a creature type from the ranger favored enemies table that isn't normally affected by your spirit guardian ability. You gain your bonus from spirit guardian and spirit warrior when battling this creature type.
feat-stalwart-restraint:
Will for peace and for battle balance harmoniously in you.

Prerequisite(s): Defensive stance class feature, rage class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use rounds of rage and rounds of defensive stance interchangeably.

Special: This feat may be selected in place of a rage power or defensive power.
feat-stalwart-restraint-mythic:
You may use your prowess equally well to defend or attack.

Prerequisite(s): Stalwart Restraint.

Benefit(s): You can use defensive powers during a rage, or rage powers/bloodrager bloodline powers during a defensive stance. If not otherwise restricted, you can even use defensive and rage/bloodline powers at the same time.
feat-star-scrier:
You have received enhanced gifts by the heavens.

Prerequisite(s): Heavens mystery, mystery magic class feature.

Benefit(s): You add your stargazer level and your cleric level to your oracle level when determining the effects of all revelations from the Heavens mystery.
feat-storm-of-arrows-mythic:
You can hit all your foes with one release only.

Prerequisite(s): Storm of Arrows

Benefit(s): You add your mythic tier to the number of creatures you can target when using hail of arrows.
feat-superior-channel-spirit-mythic:
You are one with the spirits as an actual medium.

Prerequisite(s): Superior Channel Spirit.

Benefit(s): You use your character level as your medium level for the purpose of gaining and using spirit powers granted by the medium spirit selected with Channel Spirit. In addition, you gain the propitiation ability with your spirit as a medium of your character level.
feat-surprising-strategy-mythic:
You bewilder your opponent in battle with your fast and precise maneuvers.

Prerequisite(s): Surprising Strategy

Benefit(s): You add ½ your mythic tier to your CMB for dirty trick, disarm, or sunder attempts when you successfully parry an attack (minimum +1). In addition, you can attempt any other combat maneuver allowed by the circumstances, applying the benefits of the non-mythic Surprising Strategy feat.
feat-terrain-hopper:
You can shift between two of your dominions in different terrains.

Prerequisite(s): Terrain dominance class feature, at least two terrain dominances.

Benefit(s): You can plant one pennant with your personal symbol in a place within each of the terrains you selected for the terrain dominance class feature.

You cannot plant more than one pennant in each terrain. Once per day, you may teleport yourself and creatures in contact with you to one of your pennants, as greater teleport or plane shift. This is considered a spell-like ability and doesn't work if the pennant you want to reach was dislodged from its place.
feat-unassuming-posture:
No one suspects that you are anything more than average.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Bluff)

Benefit(s): When rolling for initiative you may also roll a Bluff check against a DC of 10 + the highest CR among enemy creatures + the highest wisdom modifier among enemy creatures. If you succeed, your enemies assume you are not a priority target until you attack one of them. They are not committed to attacking you at full strength and underestimate you, taking a -2 penalty on attack rolls against you and a -2 penalty to AC against your first attack. Once you have attacked an enemy these penalties no longer apply to any of them. This feat has no effect on mindless creatures. For the purposes of this feat, an attack is considered to be any of those actions listed as an attack in the invisibility spell description.
feat-versatile-polymorph:
You are able to take on even more alternate forms.

Prerequisite(s): Shifter training class feature.

Benefit(s): You may use your shifter shape ability to assume one of the following forms (your choice): elemental (as elemental body IV), object (as object form III), or undead (as undead anatomy IV).

Special: You may select this feat more than once. Each time you must choose a different form to assume.

Special: This feat is for the Polymorph Savant prestige class from Legendary Shifters.
feat-wardens-versatility:
Undead must be contained, but this can be done either by destroying or controlling them.

Prerequisite(s): Channel damage ability, neutral alignment on the good/evil axis.

Benefit(s): Your channel damage ability counts as both channel positive energy and channel negative energy for the purpose of feat prerequisites. When you take this feat, you immediately gain a feat that requires the ability to channel positive or negative energy as a bonus feat. If you worship a deity, this must be a deity who is neutral with respect to good and evil, and the selected bonus feat must be one that your deity would normally grant.
feat-alternate-favored-magic:
Your dedication to magic studies allows you to tap into different sources of spells.

Prerequisite(s): Human, able to select a favored class bonus allowing to add to the list of spells known or spellbook.

Benefit(s): Next time you could add a spell to your known spells list or spellbook by selecting a favored class bonus, you may choose a spell from a list different from yours. This must still be a spell of the same type you normally cast (arcane, divine, or psychic). For example, an oracle with this feat could select spells from the druid or ranger lists, but not from the bard or wizard lists.
feat-at-the-envoys-end-combat-panache:
Bardic inspiration guides your sword's point.

Prerequisite(s): Amateur Swashbuckler feat or panache class feature, bardic performance class feature.

Benefit(s): As a swift action, you can end an Act, Comedy, Dance, Oratory, or Sing performance to gain a morale bonus on an attack that uses the bleeding wound, deadly stab, perfect thrust, precise strike, stunning stab, or targeted strike deeds. The bonus gained is equal to the number of bardic performance rounds you spent.
feat-atavistic-magic:
You have gained access to some psychic magic secrets.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, atavistic caster class feature.

Benefit(s): Choose a 1st-level spell, a 2nd-level spell, a 3rd-level spell, and a 4th-level spell from the spiritualist spell list. Add those spells to your list of bloodrager spells known.

Once chosen, these spells cannot be changed.
feat-atavistic-will:
Your ancestral rage protects you from psychic domination.

Prerequisite(s): Atavistic avatar class ability, 12th-level bloodrager.

Benefit(s): Once per day while in a bloodrage, when you fail a saving throw against a mind-affecting effect, you can delay the effect's onset until the end of your bloodrage. You lose your bonuses from Skill Focus granted by the atavistic avatar ability while the effect is delayed.

Special: This feat counts as the shared consciousness class ability for the purpose of prerequisites.
feat-clever-ranger:
Prerequisite: Legendary Ranger level 1st

Benefit: You may use your Intelligence score instead of your Wisdom score for any legendary ranger ability you gain, such as the Herbalism gift or the spellcasting class feature. This also applies to abilities gained from archetypes. In addition, select 1 Intelligence based skill; you gain a +2 bonus to skill checks made with that skill.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or at the same level you gain your 1st level of legendary ranger and may not be combined with the Compelling Ranger feat.
feat-compelling-ranger:
Prerequisite: Legendary Ranger level 1st

Benefit: You may use your Charisma score instead of your Wisdom score for any legendary ranger ability you gain, such as the Herbalism gift or the spellcasting class feature. This also applies to abilities gained from archetypes. In addition, select 1 Charisma based skill; you gain a +2 bonus to skill checks made with that skill.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or at the same level you gain your 1st level of legendary ranger and may not be combined with the Clever Ranger feat.
feat-dual-primeval-spell-metamagic:
Benefit: When you cast a primeval spell, you may cause the attack to double in mid-air, allowing you to attack two different targets with one attack. Roll separately for each attack. Both targets can take damage from the initial attack and can be affected by the primeval spell.

Level Increase: +2 (a dual primeval spell uses up a slot two levels higher than the spell's actual level.)
feat-ecstatic-fury:
You choose the way in which you express your inner exuberance.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage, rage or raging song class feature; spirit dance or spiritual invocation class feature.

Benefit(s): You may spend rounds of bloodrage, rage, or raging song as rounds of spirit dance or spiritual invocation, and the other way round. You can choose to use any rage powers you possess with either ability, and your levels in the classes that grant you either ability stack for the purpose of determining the effects of your rage powers.
feat-eldritch-secrets:
The deity to which you have pledged your loyalty is a patron of witches too and lent you some of their power.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, ability to cast 1st-level divine spells.

Benefit: Pick a patron from the witch patrons list. It must be suitable for your alignment, ethics, and deity (GM's discretion). You add that patron's granted spells to your spell list and spells known at the appropriate levels. Once chosen, the patron cannot be changed. If you have access to witch hexes and your patron grants any special hexes, you gain access to those hexes, but you still have to meet any other prerequisites to select them.
feat-eldritch-warden:
Your arcane abilities are devoted to protecting nature.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast arcane spells, elf.

Benefit(s): You add all summon nature's ally spells to your arcane spell list. Your arcane spellcasting qualifies in place of divine casting for the nature warden prestige class, and you may increase spellcasting in your arcane class as you progress in nature warden levels. If you have the Attuned to the Wild and Mage of the Wild feats, those count as the favored terrain ability for all prerequisites.
feat-ensorcelled-quiver:
Prerequisite: Access to Primeval spells

Benefit: Whenever you roll initiative, you may regain the use of a primeval spell you have expended.
feat-extra-ki-power:
You gain a new way to use your ki.

Prerequisite(s): Ki power class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional ki power. You must meet the level requirement for this power.

Special: You can take Extra Ki Power multiple times.
feat-extra-ranger-talent:
Prerequisite: Legendary Ranger level 5th

Benefit: You gain an additional ranger talent for which you qualify.

Special: This feat may be taken a second time starting at 11th level and a third time starting at 17th level.
feat-greater-channel-spirit:
You reached an even greater connection with the spirit within you.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Channel Spirit, Improved Channel Spirit, Spirit Ridden, character level 13th.
