Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Illusion Mastery for every odd mythic tier you possess. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level illusion (figment) spell. This spell may have a level equal to 3 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
feat-implement-mastery-item-mastery-myth:
You can use your mythic power to hide magic effects into your implements and trigger them later.

Prerequisite(s): Implement Mastery.

Benefit(s): When using an implement to activate an item mastery or mythic item mastery feat, you can spend a number of mythic power uses equal to the feat's base Fortitude save bonus prerequisite to place the spell you need into the implement as if using the talismanic implement spell, except this ability works with spells of any level. The selected implement's mental focus is reduced by 1 per level of the infused spell, including for the purposes of determining the effects of resonant powers.
feat-impossible-range-synergy-item-maste:
Distance matters little when you take aim.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Weapon Focus with a ranged weapon.

Benefit(s): When attacking with a magic ranged weapon while you are wearing an eye slot magic item, the weapon gains the effects of the longshot spell.
feat-isolation-demarcation-combat:
You can let an enemy experience a fraction of the loneliness of deep space.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to Claim creatures, two Sagitta Stellaris maneuvers known.

Benefit(s): Whenever you Claim a creature while you have an active trail, you may create additional spaces of your trail within all spaces occupied by or adjacent to that creature.

These new spaces of your trail then extend upwards and downwards as normal. If you can Claim multiple creatures with the same action, you must choose only one to apply this effect to.
feat-magic-weapon-focus:
You become more effective with magic weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Weapon Focus (any weapon), BAB +1.

Benefit(s): Your Weapon Focus feat applies to any magic weapon you are proficient with.
feat-magical-stability-item-mastery:
Your magic items become harder to destroy.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one magic item in your possession. That item gains 10 bonus hit points and its hardness is increased by 1 while you wear or carry it. You can replace your chosen item with another through a 24-hours attunement ritual.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times. Each time, it applies to a different magic item.
feat-metamagic-item-application-item-mas:
You can apply the effects of metamagic feats to some magic items.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Select one metamagic feat with a level increase no higher than +1. Once per day, you can apply the effects of this metamagic feat to a spell you are casting with a spell completion or spell trigger item. This feat does not grant you the metamagic feat you are selecting, only its effects for the purpose above.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you must select a different metamagic feat or gain an additional use of Metamagic Item Application per day.
feat-panoply-dabbler-core-occultist:
Your familiarity with implements allowed you to tap into the powers of a panoply.

Prerequisite(s): Amateur Occultist, access to one focus power for every arcane school related to the selected panoply, Int 13, Use Magic Device 1 rank, no levels in a class with the mental focus class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one occultist panoply. You can use one focus power from the selected panoply through your implements, as if it were a focus power you had selected with Dilettante Implementer.
feat-racial-item-mastery-item-mastery-my:
You can use more various or powerful racial powers through a magic item.

Prerequisite(s): Racial Item Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Racial Item Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. If your race includes different subraces with specific spell-like abilities, you can use your magic item to cast those spell-like abilities instead of your own. If you also expend one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of the selected spell-like ability instead.
feat-resistance-mastery-item-mastery-myt:
You become quicker at extracting extra power from your armor.

Prerequisite(s): Resistance Mastery.

Benefit(s): You only need a standard action to gain the bonus from Resistance Mastery. If you take 10 minutes to meditate, you can double the saving throw bonus or the energy resistance gained. You can also apply every 5 extra points of energy resistance to a different type of energy rather than using it all against one type only.
feat-restoration-mastery-item-mastery-my:
You use items to remove more grave conditions.

Prerequisite(s): Restoration Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Restoration Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. You can force the item to cast restoration by spending 2 daily uses of the feat, or greater restoration by spending 3 daily uses. If you have 9 ranks in both Heal and Use Magic Device, you can instead cause an item that has a conjuration (healing) spell of 3rd-level or higher listed in its construction requirements to cast either remove curse or remove disease. By also expending one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of a selected spell instead.
feat-sagitta-stellaris-shift-combat:
With a single wave, you can shift the nature of your trails, or make them flicker briefly into overlapping planes.

Prerequisite(s): Sagitta Stellaris Style, Knowledge (Geography) 7 ranks.

Benefit(s): As an immediate action when you have a trail active, you may expend one of your readied [Trail] strikes to instantly change the effect of an active trail to that of the expended strike, as if the trail were made by that strike. Creatures in the shifted trail are subject to the new effect as if they had entered the trail, unless they had not moved since the original trail was formed. If the shifted trail has a saving throw, its DC is set to 12 + half your highest initiator level + your initiation modifier if it would otherwise be lower. This change is applied before other effects that would increase the DC, such as Discipline Focus.

Additionally, when a creature teleports past your trails (determined if a straight line between the start and end points of their teleportation passes through a space affected by your trail), you may choose to affect them as if they entered that trail. This does not interrupt their teleportation in any way; applicable effects occur after they arrive at their destination.
feat-sagitta-stellaris-spotlight-combat:
You suffuse yourself or allies with the excess cosmic power from your trails, glowing with the brightness of the stars.

Prerequisite(s): Sagitta Stellaris Style, Sagitta Stellaris Shift, Knowledge (Geography) 13 ranks.

Benefit(s): You have a 15-foot aura that you can enable or disable as a free action once per turn each, and its area always counts as part of your active trail. Whenever you enable this aura, you can make it originate from an ally you can see, instead of yourself. As usual, moving this aura onto a stationary creature does not count as them entering the trail, but the aura bearer can be considered to enter the trail upon any movement at all.

The aura fills its radius with bright light. You can exempt yourself and your allies from any effects of this aura if you choose. The aura effect changes automatically with your active trail – when you have no active trail, the aura has no effect and creates no light, but is still present.

At 15th and 19th initiator levels, the aura radius increases by 5-foot.
feat-sagitta-stellaris-style-combat-styl:
You become adept at creating cosmic trails.

Prerequisite(s): 1 or more Sagitta Stellaris stances, Knowledge (Geography) 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): Trails you create from trail strikes that would expire at the beginning of your next turn instead last until the end of your next turn, or until you create another trail, whichever comes first. A creature still cannot trigger the effect of entering the same trail multiple times.

In addition, increase the maximum length of all your [trail] strikes by 10 feet, and all of your trails deal additional force damage equal to your initiation modifier to enemies who enter them.
feat-stalking-snake-star-sign-combat:
You are one of the rare Steel Serpent users who can create their own night sky to hide under.

Prerequisite(s): Two Sagitta Stellaris maneuvers known, two Steel Serpent maneuvers known.

Benefit(s): Once per round when you move at least 10 ft. within one of your Trails, you can expend a readied Steel Serpent maneuver to gain the ability to use the Stealth skill while being observed for 1 round as long as you remain in your trail, then make a Stealth check to hide as a free action.

You do not need to expend a Steel Serpent maneuver to do this if you are in a Steel Serpent stance, or if the trail was created by a Steel Serpent Strike (such as with the Stellar Trailblazer feat).

If your trail's duration ends while you are using Stealth within it, you remain hidden until you move, take an action, or the end of that turn. An attack made this way gains the benefits of Stealth as normal.

You take no penalties to Stealth for moving over half your speed within your trails. In the event they would apply, penalties to Stealth from sniping are halved for you within your trails.
feat-stellar-trailblazer-combat:
A tenet of Sagitta Stellaris is that every projectile's path means something, and you can extend that teaching to other martial disciplines.

Prerequisite(s): Initiator level 3rd, two Sagitta Stellaris maneuvers known.

Benefit(s): Whenever you initiate a standard-action Strike maneuver without the [Trail] descriptor that targets a single creature, makes only one attack, and is used with a ranged attack, you may add the [Trail] descriptor to it. Trails created this way have a length equal to the range increment of the weapon you are using, to a maximum of 90 feet before other bonuses, and the following effect: Enemies that enter the trail receive a penalty to damage on the first attack they make within 1 round equal to double the level of the maneuver that created the trail.

After applying this feat to a maneuver, you must recover at least two maneuvers (not necessarily including the strike you used this feat with) before you can use this feat again.
feat-symbolic-mastery-item-mastery-mythi:
You can use your holy symbol to unleash bursts of divine energy.

Prerequisite(s): Symbolic Mastery.

Benefit(s): You can expend 2 daily uses of Symbolic Mastery to channel positive or negative energy, depending from your alignment and that of your deity. You channel energy as a cleric of a level equal to your number of ranks in Use Magic Device. If you wish, you can also choose a variant channeling ability based on your deity's portfolio. You cannot apply feats that influence and modify the channel energy ability to this channeling effect.
feat-telekinetic-mastery-item-mastery-my:
You can unleash great telekinetic force from your magic item.

Prerequisite(s): Telekinetic Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Telekinetic Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. You can force the item to cast telekinetic sphere by spending 3 daily uses of the feat, or telekinetic storm by spending 5 daily uses. By also expending one use of mythic power, you can cast the mythic version of a selected spell instead.
feat-teleportation-mastery-item-mastery-:
You can "persuade" a teleportation magic item to bring you almost anywhere.

Prerequisite(s): Teleportation Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Teleportation Mastery at 1st mythic tier, plus one additional use at 4th, 7th, and 10th tier. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level conjuration (teleportation) spell.

This spell may have a level equal to 4 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
feat-transfer-magic-armor-or-shield-spec:
You can transfer a magic armor or shield special ability to a different suit of armor or shield.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Craft (armor) 5 ranks, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Through an 8-hour meditative ritual, you can transfer one special ability from one suit of magic armor or shield to another. The receiving armor or shield must be of masterwork quality or magical and suited for the transferred ability (for example, a suit of light armor cannot receive the bolstering ability). The transfer is permanent.

The transference ritual requires expensive materials to complete. The cost of transferring a magic armor or shield special ability is 25% of the normal cost required to add the same ability to the receiving suit of armor or shield.
feat-transfer-magic-weapon-special-abili:
You can transfer a magic weapon special ability to a different weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Craft (weapons) 5 ranks, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Through an 8-hours meditative ritual, you can transfer one special ability from one magic weapon to another. The receiving weapon must be of masterwork quality or magical and suited for the transferred ability (for example, only a melee weapon can receive the mighty cleaving ability). The transfer is permanent.

The transference ritual requires expensive materials to complete. The cost of transferring a weapon special ability is 25% of the normal cost required to add the same ability to the receiving weapon.
feat-undead-mastery-item-mastery:
You can extract necromantic power from magic items to force undead to obey you.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 2 ranks, base Fortitude save bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You can cause an item that has a necromancy spell of 2nd level or higher in its construction requirements to cast command undead.

You can use this feat once per day, plus an additional time per day at base Fortitude save bonus +6, +8, +10, and +12.
feat-vision-mastery-item-mastery-mythic:
By manipulating a divination magic item, you obtain access to a variety of divinatory powers.

Prerequisite(s): Vision Mastery.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional daily use of Vision Mastery for every odd mythic tier you possess. By expending mythic power, you can force the item to cast a higher-level divination spell. This spell may have a level equal to 2 + 1 for every use of mythic power spent.
feat-wand-division-item-creation:
You can create two wands from one wand.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Wand, caster level 9th.

Benefit(s): In a 30-minute ritual, you can create two wands from one original wand. The two new wands are identical to the original wand, but each contains half as many charges (round down for an odd number of charges). The original wand is destroyed during the ritual. Wand Division can only be used once per week.
feat-weapon-evoker-mastery-item-mastery-:
The damage from your magic weapon persists even after it hits.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Evoker Mastery.

Benefit(s): A target hit with your magic weapon when using Weapon Evoker Mastery suffers half the energy damage sustained with the first hit as persistent damage for a number of rounds equal to ½ your mythic tier.
feat-akashic-arms-and-armor:
You have learned how to enhance your veils.

Prerequisite(s): At least 1 veil known with the Enhanced descriptor, character level 5th

Benefit(s): You may treat yourself as having the Craft Magic arms and Armor item creation feat for the purposes of enhancing your veils that contain the Enhanced descriptor.

You may treat your character level as caster levels for determining prerequisites for crafting this way. If you do not meet the prerequisites for the weapon special quality (such as lacking the proper spells to enhance your veil with flaming burst), the DC for enhancing your veil increases by 5 for each prerequisite you do not meet, as normal.
feat-consume-magic:
You can metabolize the magic you prepare to infuse your blood with sorcerous power.

Prerequisite(s): Blood pool

Benefit(s): You gain the following ways to gain blood points:

• As a free action once per round you may expend one spell slot to gain a number of blood points equal to twice its spell level, or expend up to 1 spell point per 4 caster levels (minimum 1) to gain four times that many blood points.

• As a free action once per round you may consume a scroll or 2 charges from a wand to gain a number of blood points equal to the level of the spell contained in the item. The item must have a caster level at least equal to 1 per 4 legendary bloodrager levels you have (minimum 1).
feat-distill-blood:
You can focus your will to infuse your blood pool with energy.

Prerequisite(s): Blood pool

Benefit(s): You may spend a standard action to gain a blood point. You may do so even out of combat, but it disappears after one minute as normal. Once you have used this ability, you may not do so again for 1 hour.
feat-heightened-excitations:
Your blood energy can magnify your spellcasting prowess.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane excitation class feature, Heighten Spell

Benefit(s): When you cast a spell affected by the Heighten Spell metamagic while in a bloodrage you may forgo gaining blood points from eldritch elation to increase your caster level and its effective spell level by 1. (This stacks with the increase from Heighten Spell.)
feat-improved-galdralag:
You are skilled crossing over into other magical fields of study.

Prerequisite(s): Galdralag class feature, Spell Focus

Benefit(s): You learn a single spell of each level of legendary bloodrager spell you can cast from the bard, sorcerer/wizard, or witch spell lists. These must be from a school you have Spell Focus for. When you rest to regain spell slots you can choose to learn a new spell in place of one of these. The new spell's level must be the same as that of the spell being exchanged and must be from a school you have Spell Focus for. When you gain access to a new spell level, you learn a spell of that level in the same manner.
feat-lucid-fury:
Your bloodrage does not interfere with the skills you have truly mastered.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage

Benefit(s): Choose a skill you cannot normally use while bloodraging. You may now do so and gain a +2 bonus in that skill while not bloodraging. At 7th and again at 15th level, you may choose an additional skill to use with this feat.
feat-rage-mage:
You weave your bloodrage talents with other magical traditions.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage, able to cast spells from a class other than legendary bloodrager.

Benefit(s): You can cast spells from other classes while in bloodrage, but only of a spell level up to your legendary bloodrager level. You also gain a +2 bonus to Concentration checks while in bloodrage.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Casting for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
feat-raging-archetype-specialist:
Your talents are unique in ways that others could only dream about.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary Bloodrager 1 or barbarian 1, an archetype which replaces either fast movement or uncanny dodge and improved uncanny dodge.

Benefit(s): Choose either fast movement or uncanny dodge and improved uncanny dodge. You can immediately apply a second archetype to your class which replaces that class feature, regardless if it has already been replaced or altered. If the applied archetype would replace or alter other class features, it must still be a legal choice, replacing or altering other class features as normal.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level. Normal: You cannot select two archetypes which replace or alter the same class feature.
feat-riastrad:
Your bloodrage is terrifying to your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage or rage

Benefit(s): Upon entering bloodrage or rage you may spend a swift or immediate action to demoralize all enemies within 10 feet.
feat-true-scion:
You can master blood powers far beyond your normal training.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary bloodrager, bloodline

Benefit(s): You count as 4 levels higher, up to your HD, for the purpose of determining which bloodline powers and defenses you have access to, as well as their effects and saving throws.
feat-aerial-superiority:
Animal companion may do full attacks after a move while flying.

Prerequisites: Companion level 9th, fly speed

Benefit(s): You can perform a full attack action while moving up to your total fly speed. Each attack of this full attack must be made against a different target.
feat-alchemical-archetype-specialist:
Your talents are unique in ways that others could only dream about.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemist 1st, an archetype which replaces poison resist +2, +4, +6, +8, and poison immunity.

Benefit(s): You can immediately apply a second archetype to your class which replaces or alters poison resist +2, +4, +6, +8, and poison immunity, regardless if it has already been replaced or altered. If the applied archetype would replace or alter other class features, it must still be a legal choice, replacing or altering other class features as normal. (A 2nd level alienist/red headed merchant would gain dimensional stability and renowned seller at that level).

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level.

Normal: You cannot select two archetypes which replace or alter the same class feature.
feat-alchemical-weapon-master:
The weapons of alchemy are but playthings to you.

Benefit(s): You gain proficiency with all 'alchemical' weapons as well as a +1 bonus to attack rolls with those weapons.

Special: This feat is treated as Weapon Focus (alchemical weapons) for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of feats, prestige classes, and other such things.
feat-amateur-performer:
Prerequisite(s): Perform 1 rank, no levels in a class that grants the bardic performance class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a number of rounds of bardic performance each day equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), and gain a bardic performance of your choice. You count as a 1st level legendary bard for the purposes of qualifying for and using this performance.

In addition, you may use this feat to qualify for any feat that has the legendary bard's bardic performance as a requirement.

Special: If you later take levels in a class that grants you the bardic performance class feature, you may immediately retrain this feat for either the Extra Bardic Performance or Extra Performance feats.
feat-blackened-alchemist:
You are willing to sacrifice even more for your power than others.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemist 1st.

Benefit(s): You gain the burn class feature of the kineticist, being able to accept burn in place of spending quintessence.

You can only accept an amount of burn equal to your Intelligence modifier.
feat-bloodsense:
Animal companion can detect bleeding targets as through blindsense.

Prerequisites: Companion level 5th, Superior Scent

Benefit(s): You can smell bleeding creatures much more easily. You can detect bleeding creatures as though you had blindsight with a range of 15 feet, furthermore, when following the trail of a bleeding creature, you do not need to make a skill check to follow the tracks unless there is an overpowering scent nearby or more than an hour has passed since the traces were left.
feat-bond-of-magic:
Animal companion gains a spell as a spell-like ability.

Prerequisites: Wis 13, Companion level 5th

Benefit(s): Your connection to your master has allowed you to grasp the rudiments of their magical abilities. Choose a single spell from your master's spell list. You gain that spell as a spell-like ability. Your spellcasting ability for this spell-like ability is Wisdom. The spell chosen must be at least one level below the highest level of spell cast by your master, and your Wisdom score must equal 10 + the spell's level. You may use this spell like ability a number of times per day equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times, each time choosing a new spell. Uses per day are shared between all spell-like abilities granted by this feat.
feat-classically-conditioned:
Train animal companion to take trick commands through a specific means.

Prerequisites: Companion level 3rd

Benefit(s): By training you to make associations between certain things, your master has gained the ability to use nonverbal signals to issue commands.

By spending 1 hour, your master can teach you to accept a command through means other than verbal speech by using a signal. This signal might be making a hand sign, whistling a certain tune, or waving a certain object. Each signal has a single specific meaning, and you can only remember a number of signals equal to your wisdom score. If your master tries to teach you a new signal when you already know your maximum number, you forget another in its place. Each signal must rely on either sight or sound. A signal that uses smell may be used as well, but only if you have the scent special ability. If you cannot precisely understand the signal (being unable to see a visual signal, hear an auditory one, or if an overpowering odor masks an olfactory one), you cannot follow the command.
feat-clockwork-speaker:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Your training has taught you to blend arcane arithmetic and mathematical chants into your performances, allowing them to affect creatures of the construct type with mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations. However, doing so requires you to expend 1 additional round of bardic performance each round you start and maintain a performance augmented by clockwork speaker.

Normal: Construct creatures are immune to your mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations.
feat-conductor-of-filth:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (dungeoneering) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Your familiarity with creatures of filth and corruption has granted you knowledge of how to influence them with your performances, allowing them to affect creatures of the ooze or vermin type with mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations. However, doing so requires you to expend 1 additional round of bardic performance each round you start and maintain a performance augmented by conductor of filth.

Normal: Ooze or vermin creatures are immune to your mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations.
feat-cursed-jutsu:
Prerequisite(s): Jutsu pool class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a hex as per the witch class feature, treating your ninja level as though it was your witch level to determine its DC and uses your Charisma in place of your Intelligence to determine its DC.

All effects of hexes end upon refreshing your jutsu pool. Using this hex costs 1 jutsu point, although hexes granted by this feat do not have any limitations of how often they can affect a creature.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, each time selecting a different hex.
feat-daring-technique:
Prerequisite(s): Jutsu pool class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a deed from the swashbuckler class except for opportune parry and riposte or precise strike, treating that deed as though it were a secret technique for determining its save DC. Your ninja level must be the same as or higher than the level at which the swashbuckler would gain that deed, and if the deed would require you to spend panache, you must instead spend jutsu points equal to the panache needed to use that deed.
feat-do-you-know-who-i-am:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic renown or bardic notoriety class feature

Benefit(s): Whenever you speak to a creature who is unaware of your identity and is not hostile to you, you may ask if they know who you are. The creature must make a Wisdom check with a DC of 10 + 1/4 your legendary bard level + your Charisma modifier. If this creature fails this check, the creature's attitude shifts two stages towards helpful towards you for a number of minutes equal to your Charisma modifier. If the creature fails this check by 5 or more, it instead lasts for a number of hours equal to your Charisma modifier. You cannot use this check while disguised, but you may remove your disguise as a part of asking the creature, causing it to take a -2 penalty on its check due to your showmanship.
feat-dual-enhanced-veils:
You have learned how to change the properties of your weapon each time you shape them.

Prerequisite(s): At least 2 veils known with the Enhanced descriptor.

Benefit(s): When shaping at least 1 veil with the enhanced descriptor for the day, you may choose a second veil with the enhanced descriptor that you know that you did not shape and store it in this feat. By burning a point of essence as a move action, you may swap an enhanced veil that you have shaped with the veil stored in this feat. This unshapes the veil and stores it in this feat, and shapes the veil that was stored in this feat. Essence invested in these veils becomes uninvested. If you are capable of binding the newly shaped veil, you may bind them as long as you have the capability of doing so.
feat-einhander-combat:
With grace, you sweep through your enemies with a single blade.

Benefit(s): As long as you are only wielding a light or onehanded weapon in one hand and no other weapons or shields in your off-hand(s), you gain a +2 dodge bonus to your armor class.

In addition, once per round when a creature within your weapon's reach misses you with a melee attack while you are wielding a light or one-handed weapon in one hand and no other weapons or shields in your off-hand(s), you may make an attack of opportunity against that creature.
feat-excruciating-venom:
The venom of the animal companion is much more potent.

Prerequisites: Companion level 5th, poison special ability

Benefit(s): The DC of your poison special ability increases by 2. In addition, whenever a creature fails its fortitude saving throw against your venom, choose one of the following effects:

• The creature becomes staggered for the duration of your poison.

• The creature becomes dazed for 1 round.

• Extend the duration of your poison by an additional 2 frequency periods.
feat-expanded-domain-magic:
You have learned to easily access a wider variety of spells on command.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary cleric, domain spells or equivalent ability

Benefit(s): Choose up to three spells on the cleric spell list. You may treat these spells as if they were also domain spells.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times, each time selecting three different spells.
feat-exquisite-accompaniment-teamwork:
Prerequisite(s): Perform 5 ranks, bardic performance class feature

Benefit(s): If one of your allies within 30 feet with this feet is performing a bardic performance, you may accompany them as a standard action, duplicating the effects of their performance using your own statistics, but using their level to determine its effects. You must spend rounds of bardic performance as normal for starting and maintaining the accompanied performance, but don't need to know the performance yourself.
feat-extra-bardic-performance:
Prerequisite(s): Legendary bards bardic performance class feature

Benefit(s): You gain a bardic performance for which you meet the prerequisites.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, gaining a new bardic performance each time it is selected.
feat-extra-faith:
Your passion is such that you can invoke many miracles.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary cleric, faith class feature

Benefit(s): You gain 2 additional points of faith per day.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times.
feat-extra-quintessence:
You have far more personal reserves of life than others.

Prerequisite(s): Quintessence class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain 2 additional quintessence.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-extra-school-training:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic school class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain the benefits of a single bardic school of your choice.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times, gaining the benefits of a single bardic school each time it is selected.
feat-false-arcanist:
You can disguise your miracles as arcane machinations.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast divine spells

Benefit(s): Aou are able to disguise your divine spellcasting, presenting it as arcane or magic of some other kind. Typically, this is as an alchemist, bard, sorcerer, or wizard magic, although other classes can be mimicked as well.

You must make a skill check (DC 10 + twice the level of the spell) to disguise this casting and successfully cast the spell. The type of skill check depends on the type of caster you pretend to be: Craft (alchemy) for alchemist, Perform for bard, Knowledge (arcana) for sorcerer or wizard, and Knowledge (planes) for psychic or occultist are some examples. Using Spellcraft to identify the spell works normally, though unless the observer beats the DC by 10 or more, they don't suspect the source of the magic is divine.

You must still provide any divine focus components for the spells you cast. However, the divine focus doesn't need to be an obvious symbol of his faith. It could be a small coin, tattoo, or garment bearing the symbol, whether presented openly, disguised, or hidden within a larger picture.
feat-fatal-fangs:
Makes the Fierce Fangs feat more potent.

Prerequisites: Companion level 15th, Fierce Fang

Benefit(s): When you deal a critical hit against a creature, as a free action you may use your Fierce Fang feat without spending one of the uses per day.

Additionally, once per day, as a standard action you may attempt to cause a hemorrhage in a bleeding creature. Make a single attack roll with either your bite or claw natural attack, if it hits, that creature must make a fortitude saving throw with a DC of 10 + 1/2 your companion level + your Strength or Dexterity modifier. If that creature fails the saving throw, they die instantly, otherwise they take the damage of your natural attack + 1d6 per two companion levels you have.

Creatures that are immune to precision damage are immune to the effects of this feat.
feat-fetch:
The companion or familiar can retrieve thrown weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Companion or familiar level 1st

Benefit(s): You have the ability to retrieve weapons thrown by your master. As a full-round action, you can move up to your maximum movement speed, retrieve a single weapon that was thrown by your master, and return it to them. If you are tiny sized, you may only return light weapons sized for a medium creature, if you are small sized, you may return one-handed or light weapons, and if you are medium sized or larger, you may return any thrown weapon appropriately sized for a medium creature. For weapons sized for creatures other than medium, increase the highest weight category retrievable by one for each size smaller than medium, and reduce the highest retrievable category for each size larger than medium.
feat-fierce-fangs:
The companion can deal additional bleed damage with a natural attack.

Prerequisites: Companion level 11th, Improved Natural Attack, bite or claw natural attack

Benefit(s): When taking this feat, choose Strength or Dexterity. A number of times per day equal to the modifier of the chosen ability, as a free action you may deal additional bleed damage with your bite or claw natural attack. The amount of bleed damage is equal to the modifier of the chosen ability. Using this feat on a creature that is already bleeding instead causes the creature to take 1 point of Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution bleed damage.

Creatures that are immune to precision damage are immune to the effects of this feat.
feat-flash-jutsu:
Prerequisite(s): Ninja 9th, secret technique class feature.

Benefit(s): You can select one secret technique you possess which requires a swift action to activate; one per round, you can increase the jutsu cost of that secret technique by 1 to activate it as a free action.
feat-fluid-theory:
You have learned how to change the properties of your weapon each time you shape them.

Benefit(s): When you shape a veil with the Enhanced descriptor with at least a +2 weapon bonus, you may change the configuration of enhancement bonuses and weapon special properties of that veil. For example, if you shape a veil with the Enhanced descriptor that is a +1 flaming, you may change the enhancement bonuses for that veil to a +1 frost, a +2, a +1 keen, and so forth.

Special: If you possess the Unified Theory feat, you may change the Enhanced veil separately from one another, allowing them to possess different enhancement bonuses and weapon special properties.
feat-focused-mounted-archery-combat:
You have dedicated your combat-training to the skill of using a missile weapon while riding at top speed.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 18, Ride 8 ranks, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: Completely negate the penalty you take when using a ranged weapon while mounted. In addition, you add the mount's Dexterity bonus, if any, to your AC while firing from its back.

Archers may use Rapid Shot and Mythic Rapid Shot to gain multiple attacks per round.
feat-formulae-familiarity:
Your understanding of certain formulae is second nature.

Prerequisite(s): Extract class feature.

Benefit(s): Choose a number of extracts equal to your Intelligence modifier; you can prepare these extracts without referring to a formulae book. Whenever you gain a level, you can change the formulae you selected with this feat.

Normal: Without this feat, you must use a formulae book to prepare all your extracts.
feat-improved-einhander-combat:
A formidable blade makes for a formidable opponent.

Prerequisite(s): Einhander feat, Character 7th level

Benefit(s): As long as you are only wielding a single, light or one-handed weapon in one hand and no other weapons or shields in your off-hand(s), you may add your half of the total of your enhancement bonuses (to include weapon special properties) of your weapon to your armor class as a dodge bonus (minimum 1). For example, a +2 icy burst would have a total of +4, granting you a +2 dodge bonus to AC.
feat-improved-fetch:
The companion or familiar can retrieve multiple thrown weapons at once.

Prerequisites: Companion or Familiar level 3rd, Fetch

Benefit(s): Your ability to retrieve thrown weapons has improved greatly. When using the Fetch feat, you may return up to two thrown weapons at once. The number of thrown weapons that you can retrieve increases by 1 at 8th level, and again at 13th level.
feat-improved-trample-combat:
You have honed your ability to crush your opponents under your mount's hooves.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Ride 6 ranks, Mounted Combat, Trample, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit: You do not provoke an attack of opportunity when performing an overrun combat maneuver while mounted. In addition, you receive a +2 bonus on checks made to overrun a foe while mounted.
feat-intimidating-mount:
You and your mount dishearten your opponent.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 4 ranks, Ride 4 ranks.

Benefit: While mounted, you gain a +4 bonus to your Intimidate check to either influence or demoralize the targeted creature. In addition, you may use your mount's size in place of your own if doing so is beneficial to your check. The shaken effect lasts twice as long with this feat.
feat-jutsu-focus:
Prerequisite(s): Ninja 1st, secret technique class feature.

Benefit(s): The DCs to resist your secret techniques are increased by 1. In addition, you are always treated as though you had 1 jutsu for the purpose of 0-cost secret techniques.
feat-launching-crossbow-flurry:
Your expertise with the launching crossbow allows you to rain devastation on others.

Prerequisite(s): Proficiency with alchemical launching crossbow, multibomb class feature.

Benefit(s): You treat attacks with the alchemical launching crossbow as normal attacks with bombs, allowing you to load the additional bomb(s) you can throw with the multi bomb or flurry bomb class feature into your alchemical launching crossbow and fire it during the same attack action.

Special: If you have an ability which would increase the range increment of your bombs, you can also have it increase the range increment of your alchemical launching crossbow.
feat-magical-thrower:
Prerequisite(s): Jutsu pool class feature.

Benefit(s): You learn the magical thrower secret technique (0 jutsu points):

As a full round action, the ninja can attune themselves to any thrown weapon or 50 pieces of thrown ammunition such as shuriken. The ninja can choose to draw a copy of the attuned weapon whenever they would draw the attuned weapon. These copies lasts until the end of the ninja's turn or until it deals damage to a creature, possessing any qualities the attuned weapon did such as enhancement bonus or any material of which the weapon was made.
feat-major-cursed-jutsu:
Prerequisite(s): Cursed Jutsu, jutsu pool class feature, ninja 14th.

Benefit(s): You can select a major hex as per the witch class feature, although using this hex costs 3 jutsu points.
feat-martial-animal:
The animal companion gains +1 attack and is considered to have Int 13 and Combat Expertise for prerequisites.

Prerequisites: Companion level 5th, Wis 13

Benefit(s): Your master has trained you to be able to fight in many extraordinary ways. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with your natural attacks. Also, for the purposes of learning the feats Improved Bull Rush, Greater Bull Rush, Improved Grapple Greater Grapple, Improved Steal, Greater Steal, Improved Sunder, Greater Sunder, Improved Trip, and Greater Trip, this feat counts as having an Intelligence score of 13 and the feat Combat Expertise.
feat-mighty-shield-combat:
You excel at using your strength and shield in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Strength 15

Benefit(s): Your penalties on attack rolls for fighting with two weapons are reduced, provided that your off-hand weapon is a shield. The penalty for your primary hand lessens by 2 and the one for your off hand lessens by 6. In addition, when two-weapon fighting, you also treat heavy shields as light weapons, and you do not lose your shield bonus to AC when performing a shield bash.

Special: This feat counts as having Two-weapon fighting and Improved Shield Bash for the purposes of meeting prerequisites, and you may use your Strength score in place of your Dexterity score to qualify for any feat that also has Two-weapon fighting as a prerequisite.

This feat and Two-weapon fighting do not stack.
feat-mounted-spring-attack-combat:
Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Ride 6 ranks, Mounted Combat, Ride-By Attack, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit: As a full-round action, you can move your mount up to its speed and make a single melee attack without provoking any attacks of opportunity from the target of your attack. You can move both before and after the attack, but you must move at least 10 feet before the attack and the total distance that you move cannot be greater than your speed. You cannot use this ability to attack a foe that is adjacent to you at the start of your turn. You can move in any direction after the attack, even backwards (at half speed).

Normal: You cannot move before and after an attack.
feat-performance-focus:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature

Benefit(s): Select a single bardic performance you know. Add +2 to the saving throw DC of the selected performance.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you select the feat, it applies to a new bardic performance.
feat-philosophical-spellcasting:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic spellcasting class feature

Benefit(s): You use your Wisdom instead of your Charisma to learn, prepare, and cast spells, and when determining their bonus spell slots from high ability scores with your bardic spellcasting ability.
feat-practiced-alchemist:
You have continued to improve your alchemical research while pursuing other lines of inquiry.

Prerequisite(s): Extract class feature.

Benefit(s): Your caster level for your extracts gains a +4 bonus as long as this bonus doesn't raise your caster level above your current Hit Dice.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-practiced-bomber:
You have continued to improve your explosives knowledge while pursuing other lines of inquiry.

Prerequisite(s): Bomb class feature.

Benefit(s): The damage and saving throws of your bombs are calculated as though your alchemist level were 4 levels higher, to a maximum effective alchemist level equal to your character level.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-practiced-discipline:
You have continued to improve your disciplines while pursuing other lines of inquiry.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemical discipline class feature.

Benefit(s): The abilities of your alchemical discipline are calculated as though your alchemist level were 4 levels higher, to a maximum effective alchemist level equal to your character level.

Special: If you possess two alchemical disciplines, you must select one of them of which to apply this feat's benefits.

In that situation, you can select this feat a second time to apply its benefits to both of your alchemical disciplines.

Special: This feat does not affect alchemical disciplines gained through corruptions.
feat-praise-motivated:
The companion can be praised for killing or succeeding at a critical hit for additional bonuses.

Prerequisites: Companion level 3rd

Benefit(s): When you score a critical hit or land the killing blow on a creature, your master may praise you as an immediate action. If they do, you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls for 2 rounds. This bonus increases by 1 at 12th level and again at 18th.

This feat requires you to be able to hear your master to receive its benefits.
feat-repairing-channel-channeling:
Your magic affects artificial structures as well as it does life forms.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy class feature

Benefit(s): When you channel energy to heal or harm living or undead creatures, you may instead choose to heal or harm constructs and unattended objects within range.
feat-scholarly-spellcasting:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic spellcasting class feature

Benefit(s): You use your Intelligence instead of your Charisma to learn, prepare, and cast spells, and when determining their bonus spell slots from high ability scores with your bardic spellcasting ability.
feat-signature-bomb:
Your practice with a specific bomb formula has yielded incredible results.

Prerequisite(s): Bomb class feature, discovery class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one bomb discovery which requires a creature to make a saving throw; increase that saving throw by 2.
feat-smooth-drinker:
You are able to imbibe magical liquids without drawing attention.

Prerequisite(s): Sleight of hand 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Whenever you imbibe a potion, extract, elixir, or similar item, you can make a Sleight of hand check opposed by all observer's Perception check. If they fail to exceed your check, they do not notice you imbibe your chosen liquid. For each additional round you use this ability to imbibe a liquid, they gain a +5 circumstance bonus to their Perception check.

Special: In a location where constantly drinking would be considered normal, such as at a bar or while eating, you gain a +5 circumstance bonus to your Sleight of hand check.
feat-sneaky-splash:
Even your splash weapons are precise enough to cause precise damage.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemy class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you land a direct hit with a splash weapon (but not bombs from the bomb class feature), your attack can deal precision damage against the creature your attack landed against (but not dealt splash damage) if it would normally qualify for it, such as by attacking an unaware creature while possessing the sneak attack class feature. This precision damage deals the same type of damage as the splash weapon.

Normal: You cannot deal precision damage with ranged touch attacks.
feat-split-channel-channeling:
You call upon healing and harming magics simultaneously.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy 3d6

Benefit(s): You can channel energy to heal and harm simultaneously. When you do so, you restore only 1/2 the usual amount of hit points and deal only 1/2 the usual number of points of damage (or 1/4 on a successful saving throw).
feat-stray-gambit:
The companion or familiar can pretend to be wild or untrained on command.

Prerequisites: Companion or Familiar level 3rd, Wis 13

Benefit(s): Your master has trained you to be able to behave like a wild, untrained animal on command. When instructed by your master, for a number of hours equal to your wisdom modifier, onlookers must pass a Sense Motive check opposed by a Bluff check to figure out that you aren't a feral animal. For the purpose of this Bluff check you may use your master's skill ranks, Charisma modifier, or both when making this check.

This Sense Motive check gains the following bonuses if any of the below are true:

• Animal species is foreign to the area: +2

• Animal species is rare or exotic: +5

• Onlooker has seen you with your master: +2

• Wearing equipment or magical items: +5
feat-stray-strut:
When the companion or familiar can use Stray Gambit without a command.

Prerequisites: Companion or Familiar level 7th, Stray Gambit

Benefit(s): You are able to exercise a degree of independence when on your own that allows you to pass yourself off as a stray animal. Even when not instructed by your master, you may use the Stray Gambit feat but you take a -5 penalty if you didn't receive a command to use the feat.
feat-stray-threats:
When the companion or familiar uses Stray Gambit, use masters Intimidate ranks and Cha modifier.

Prerequisites: Companion level 7th, Stray Gambit

Benefit(s): You have been trained to appear dangerous to others by your master. When instructed to use Stray Gambit, you can also make Intimidate checks to scare people off. During the duration of your master's command, you may make an Intimidate skill check using their skill ranks, Charisma modifier, or both. The opposed Sense Motive check gains the same bonuses under the same conditions as listed under the Stray Gambit feat.
feat-subtle-performance:
Benefit(s): When you use a performance that is an enchantment, creatures that succeed on the saving throw have only a 50% chance to realize they succeeded on the saving throw (instead of it being automatic). If the creature fails the saving throw, or is affected by such a performance with no saving throw, the creature does not realize they are under the effects of the performance (even after the performance ends), and the Sense Motive DC to notice the creature is under the effects of an enchantment increases by 5.

Normal: Anyone who successfully saves against one of your enchantment performances notices the mental intrusion automatically, and automatically realizes the mental intrusion after the effect ends.
feat-superior-scent:
Able to use scent to pinpoint as a swift action and up to 15 ft.

Prerequisites: Scent special ability, Companion or Familiar level 3rd

Benefit(s): Your sense of smell is even more acute than others of your species. You can find the direction of a scent or pinpoint creatures using your scent ability as a swift action. The range of pinpointing a creature extends to 15 feet. Additionally, the range of your scent ability is increased to 60 feet. (120 feet for strong scents, 180 for overpowering scents.)
feat-sworn-to-protect:
Through a unique ritual, you may swear yourself to protect an individual with your life.

Benefit(s): By performing a 1 hour ritual, you may bind yourself with one other individual with an oath to protect them from harm. This individual is known as your Charge, and you may only have 1 Charge at a time. You may change your Charge to another creature, or remove any Charge you may have by performing this 1 hour ritual again.

You always know the state of your Charge if you are within 30 feet of them, as per the status spell. If you are further than 30 feet from your Charge, you know their relative location to you, as well as a general distance (close, medium, long, or far). If they are on another plane other than yours, you know what plane they are on.

If you are adjacent to your Charge, you may, as an immediate action, redirect any single target spell or effect, or an attack made against them to yourself.
feat-sylvan-empathy:
The animal companion gains familiar-like abilities.

Prerequisites: Companion level 3rd, Wis 13

Benefit: Your intuition paired with your connection to your master has granted you improved communication abilities. You gain the familiar's empathic link ability when you take this feat. Furthermore, you gain the abilities speak with master and speak with animals of its kind at 5th and 7th level respectively. You retain these speech abilities as long as you are within 30 feet of your master, and as long as you are within this range, you gain a +2 morale bonus to Intelligence.
feat-toxin-focus:
Your study into the field of toxicology has made your toxins far more deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Toxicologist alchemical discipline class feature.

Benefit(s): The DC of your toxins increases by 2.
feat-two-handed-spirited-charge-combat:
Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 10 ranks, Ride 10 ranks, Spirited Charge, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: When mounted and using the charge action, you make a single melee attack with both weapons you have equipped (including a shield bash). Make your attack rolls separately to determine if each weapon hits your target, but add the damage together for the purposes of overcoming damage resistance and similar abilities.

Both weapons must be used to attack the same foe.
feat-unique-splash:
Your talent with bombs also extends to other alchemical items.

Prerequisite(s): Alchemy class feature, 1 or more [shape] discoveries.

Benefit(s): Whenever you spend 1 quintessence to increase the damage of an alchemical splash weapon, you can also apply a [shape] discovery to it as though it was a bomb, paying any associated quintessence cost the discovery may have.
feat-verdant-voice:
Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance class feature, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You can combine traditional fey songs and chants into your bardic performances, allowing them to affect creatures of the plant type with mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations. However, doing so requires you to expend 1 additional round of bardic performance each round you start and maintain a performance augmented by verdant voice.

Normal: Plant creatures are immune to your mind-affecting bardic performances and inspirations.
feat-virulent-toxins:
Your study into the field of toxicology has made your toxins ignore common defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Toxicologist alchemical discipline class feature, alchemist 7th.

Benefit(s): Whenever a creature must make a saving throw against one of your toxins, that creature cannot benefit from racial or circumstance bonuses to poison effects (this does not interact with poison immunity).
feat-daunting-interface:
Your electronic and mechanical devices are difficult for others to manipulate.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Technological Item

Benefit(s): The DC of Disable Device and Perception checks to identify or activate technological devices (weapons, traps, etc.) you craft increases by +2. For the purposes of this feat, a technological device is one that uses some mechanism, but has no component of magic in its basic operation. Enhancement bonuses to elements of your device (such as magic weapons in a mechanical trap or a spell that increases the hardness of your materials) don't negate this ability.
feat-deafening-blast:
Your bombs erupt with an ear-splitting clangour.

Prerequisite(s): Bomb class feature, bomb damage 4d6.

Benefit(s): Whenever you damage creature with a bomb or grenade, it creates a deafening blast that deafens those creature(s) for 1 round unless they succeed on a Fortitude save with the same DC as the bomb or grenade.

In addition, you are so used to dealing with loud noises that you gain a +2 bonus on saving throws to avoid becoming deafened. You are never deafened by your own bombs.
feat-demolitions-expert:
Your bombs are devastating to structures and objects.

Prerequisite(s): Bomb class feature.

Benefit(s): Your bombs deal full damage to objects and structures, rather than half damage. This also applies to other alchemical weapons, grenades, and similar explosives you use to damage a structure.

Normal: Most energy attacks deal half damage to objects and structures.
feat-environmental-adaptation-mythic:
Your legendary nature allows you to survive any environment to fulfill your destiny.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are in an environment that requires a check or save, deals damage, or imposes a condition on a regular basis (such as dealing damage, suffocation, etc.), the check, damage, or condition occurs half as often. For example, walking across lava only deals damage every other round, or you only make Constitution checks after holding your breath in outer space every two rounds. If you fail a check or saving throw against an environmental hazard, you can spend a point of mythic power to reroll the attempt and add your mythic tier to the total. Creature abilities (such as poison) and magical effects (such as the suffocate spell) work normally.
feat-extra-legendary-arcana:
Your training has unlocked the secrets of a new arcana.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary magus arcana class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional legendary magus arcana.

You must meet all the prerequisites for this legendary magus arcana.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times.
feat-greater-arcane-strike:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd level arcane spells, Arcane Strike

Benefit(s): The bonus damage granted by your Arcane Strike feat is increased by 3 points. In addition, when you activate your Arcane Strike you can choose to reduce its bonus damage. For every 2 points you reduce the damage by (to a minimum of 0), you gain a cumulative +1 (circumstance) bonus to hit with your imbued weapons.
feat-improved-flyby-attack:
You can unleash a barrage of attacks while in flight.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, fly speed, Flyby Attack, base attack bonus +7.

Benefit(s): When flying, you can take a move action to fly in a straight line and take a full-attack action at any point during the move. You cannot take a second move action during a round when you make a flyby attack.

Normal: Without this feat, you must take a standard action either before or after your move.
feat-lasting-summons-metamagic:
You can make your summons last for hours.

Benefit(s): You extend the duration of a summoning spell with a duration of 1 round/level or more to 1 hour/level. Creatures summoned this way avoid combat if possible but defend themselves if attacked; if they attack, the remaining duration of the spell changes from 1 hour per level to 1 round per level (so if the spell had 5 full hours left, the creature(s) remain in combat for 5 rounds before the spell ends).

Level Increase: +1 (a lasting summons spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.) You can use Lasting Summons to summon a creature with full duration even in combat, but this increases the level increase of the feat to +3.

Special: A summoner can use this to affect his summon monster spell-like ability, reducing the numeral of the summoning ability instead of increasing the effective spell level.
feat-new-best-friend:
You make good use of scavenged equipment.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You only take half the nonproficiency penalty for weapons or equipment that you are not proficient with. If a weapon or piece of equipment requires expertise or technology you have no exposure to, you can still use it, but must spend an hour practicing with it to reduce your nonproficiency penalty.

Special: You can take this feat twice. If you take it a second time, you take no penalties for nonproficiency, but still do not count as proficient for the purposes of feats or other abilities.
feat-of-one-mind-teamwork:
You and your allies keep each other apprised of danger.

Prerequisite(s): One other teamwork feat.

Benefit(s): You and all allies possessing this feat within 60 feet are equally aware of threats.

None of you are considered flanked.
feat-sin-magic-initiate:
You have learned to specialize your magic in the style of the ancients

Prerequisite(s): Ability to prepare arcane spells

Benefit(s): Choose a school of magic. For every spell level you are capable of casting, you may prepare one additional spell per day so long as the spell is of that chosen school, and you are considered to be a wizard of your character level specializing in that school for the purpose of meeting prerequisites. However, you cannot prepare any spells from your two prohibited schools, which are based on your chosen school. If using a spell trigger or spell completion item to cast a spell from your prohibited schools, you must use the Use Magic Device skill to do so as if the spells were not on your class spell list.

Special: A wizard who is already a Sin Magic Specialist cannot select this feat.

Table: Schools and Prohibited Schools

Chosen School Prohibited Schools

Abjuration Evocation and Necromancy

Conjuration Evocation and Illusion

Divination Any two other than divination, chosen when you select the feat

Enchantment Necromancy and Transmutation

Evocation Abjuration and Conjuration

Illusion Conjuration and Transmutation

Necromancy Abjuration and Enchantment

Transmutation Enchantment and Illusion
feat-summon-fey-ally-general:
You have the power to summon allies from the fey realms to aid you.

Prerequisite(s): Summon nature's ally spell or ability, non-lawful alignment.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon nature's ally. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by fey allies are dispelled when summon nature's ally ends.

• Summon nature's ally I: grimple (gremlin), fuath (gremlin), jinkin (gremlin), grig (no fiddle), haniver (gremlin), sprite, primordial weasel

• Summon nature's ally II: atomie, brownie, corby (dire), faun (no pipes), grindylow, gathlain, zoog

• Summon nature's ally III: forlarren, jack-o'-lantern, nixie, nuglub (gremlin), pooka, seps (juveline), slurk

• Summon nature's ally IV: adaro, amphisbaena, fey giant toad, living topiary, quickling, peryton, twigjack

• Summon nature's ally V: bagiennik, blodeuwedd, lampad, leucrotta, manticore, pixie, redcap, swan maiden

• Summon nature's ally VI: encantado, hangman tree, oceanid, remorhaz, sangoi, veela (air, earth, fire, water)

• Summon nature's ally VII: adlet, aurumvorax, giant flytrap, ijiraq, nuckelavee, nymph, rukh, sargassum fiend

• Summon nature's ally VIII: catoblepas, frost worm, lukwata, seps, sleipnir

• Summon nature's ally IX: akhlut, ankou, seaweed siren, viper vine
feat-summon-giant-general:
You can summon brutish humanoids to fight by your side.

Prerequisite(s): Summon nature's ally spell or ability.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon nature's ally.

Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by summoned creatures from this list are dispelled when the summoned creature disappears.

• Summon nature's ally I: orc

• Summon nature's ally II: half-ogre

• Summon nature's ally III: thawn

• Summon nature's ally IV: ogre, firbolg

• Summon nature's ally V: cave giant, river giant, wood giant

• Summon nature's ally VI: hill giant, slag giant, stone giant

• Summon nature's ally VII: cliff giant, desert giant, fire giant, frost giant, jungle giant

• Summon nature's ally VIII: ash giant, cloud giant, taiga giant

• Summon nature's ally IX: ocean giant, storm giant
feat-summon-guardian-ally-general:
You can summon magical beasts and steadfast guard creatures to serve you.

Prerequisite(s): Summon nature's ally spell or ability, nonchaotic alignment.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon nature's ally. These creatures can only be summoned in a location or situation typical of its kind, tough summoned guardians are less picky than a normal creature of its type. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by guardian allies are dispelled when summon nature's ally ends.

• Summon nature's ally I: badger, goat, gourd leshy, great horned owl, primate (baboon), skunk, swan (trumpeter)

• Summon nature's ally II: almiraj, axe beak (diatryma), amoeba (giant), leaf ray (no seed), ningyo, ram, reefclaw

• Summon nature's ally III: blink dog, foo dog, fungus leshy, hippogriff, kappa, shikigami kami, shocker lizard

• Summon nature's ally IV: flytrap leshy, foo lion, gargoyle, griffon, hydra, seaweed leshy, tanuiki

• Summon nature's ally V: divine guardian hydra, kodama kami, lotus leshy, hypnalis, lunar naga, mudlord, shambling mound

• Summon nature's ally VI: cerynitis, dosojin kami, gorgon, grey render, gynosphinx, stymphalidies, water naga

• Summon nature's ally VII: couatl, guardian naga, kapre, spirit naga, treant, zuishin kami, water orm

• Summon nature's ally VIII: amarok, cat lord, lorelei, lukwata, royal naga, sea serpent, thunderbird

• Summon nature's ally IX: azruverda, charybdis, cherufe, ghorazagh, red reaver, wakandagi, zuijin kami
feat-summon-mount-general:
You can summon a wide variety of steeds willing to be ridden by you and your allies.

Prerequisite(s): summon monster or summon nature's ally spell or ability.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon monster and summon nature's ally spells. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by summoned mounts are dispelled when the summoning ends. You can summon a creature (not only the creatures on these lists, although the GM may judge some creatures unsuitable as mounts) into the space occupied by you or an ally. When you do so, the summoned creature is considered combat trained as a mount, appears with any required saddle and tack, and if the ally is of a smaller size category than the summoned creature, the ally can mount the creature as a free action that does not require a Ride check.

• Summon nature's ally I: dolphin, horse (common), horse (pony)

• Summon nature's ally II: axe beak (diatryma), camel, dog (riding), elk, giant bee, horse (heavy)

• Summon nature's ally III: axe beak, giant black widow spider, giant seahorse, hippogriff, monitor lizard, seps (juveline)

• Summon nature's ally IV: black bear, giant chameleon lizard, giant eagle, giant locust, pegasus, unicorn

• Summon nature's ally V: blink dog (can blink and dimension door with rider), hieracosphinx, giant owl, manticore, shadow mastiff (evil), wyvern

• Summon nature's ally VI: behir, cerynitis, elephant, criospinx, gorgon, kirin

• Summon nature's ally VII: abaia, androsphinx, couatl, dragon horse, roc, water orm

• Summon nature's ally VIII: amarok, frost worm, sea serpent, seps, thunderbird

• Summon nature's ally IX: emperor kirin, sleipnir
feat-summon-spirit-of-awakening-general:
You can summon spirits to possess mundane objects.

Prerequisite(s): summon monster or summon nature's ally spell or ability.

Benefit(s): Add the following creatures to the list you can summon with summon monster and summon nature's ally spells. Using this ability requires a separate focus item for each creature, a miniature replica of the object the summoned creature looks like. You get to select any ability options each creature has, like the construction points of animated objects. This not include any additional options or add-on abilities exceptional creatures of this type might have. You can only give a summoned creature alignment or domain specific abilities if you have that alignment or domain. Spell-like abilities with a duration other than instantaneous used by summoned creatures from this list are dispelled when the summoned creature disappears.

Abilities usable on a weekly or longer basis are unavailable to creatures summoned this way.

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally I: animated object (tiny), homunculus (any poison ends when the creature disappears, though harmful effects such as damage remain), leaf ray (no seed), gourd leshy, xtabay

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally II: animated object (small) (no construction points or hardness), celedon, jack o' lantern, gourd leshy, gluttongrass, leaf ray (no seed)

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally III: animated object (small), foo dog, fungus leshy, koto-furunishi, raktavarna rakshasa, shikigami kami, soulbound doll, waxwork human (no regeneration)

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally IV: animated object (medium), foo lion, guardian scroll, flytrap leshy, gargoyle, kasa-obake tsukumogami, scarecrow, seaweed leshy, taxidermic grizzly bear

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally V: animated object (large), boroboroton tsukumogami, graven guardian, kodama kami, lotus leshy, skinstitch, terra cotta soldier

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally VI: animated object (huge), treant (cannot animate trees), soulbound mannequin, urannag, cephalophore, tupilaq

• Summon nature's ally VII: animated object (gargantuan), cryptguard, kapre, tophet, tiberolith, zuishin kami

• Summon monster or Summon nature's ally VIII: animated object (colossal), bonethorn, juggernaut, soulbound shell, taotieh

• Summon nature's ally IX: kikituk, wickerman
feat-summoning-concentration-general:
With concentration, you can extend the duration of your summons.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast a summon monster or summon nature's ally spell.

Benefit(s): When you cast a conjuration (summoning) spell with a duration of 1 round/level, that spell gains a duration of concentration + 1 round/level.

Special: This can be used with the summoner's summon monster class feature, giving it a duration of concentration + 1 minute/level.
feat-swift-summon-ally-general:
Your specialized training allows you to reach out and call for certain types of allies more quickly.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast summon nature's ally, plus another class feature, see table.

Benefit(s): Choose one creature type from Table 5: Quick Allies for which you fulfil the prerequisite. When you cast a summon nature's ally spell to summon a creature of this type, the casting time of the spell becomes 1 standard action. This does not work on creatures that have a template.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time, select a different type of creature.

Table 5: Quick Allies

Type Prerequisite

Animal Wild Empathy

Fey Resist nature's lure

Humanoid A thousand faces

Magical Beast Able to cast (or use wild shape to duplicate) beast shape III

Outsider Able to cast (or use wild shape to duplicate) elemental body III

Plant Woodland stride

Vermin Wild empathy usable with vermin
feat-technique-specialization:
You have improved your training in a potential technique, making it less strenuous to perform.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary magus 11, ability to use arcane potential

Benefit(s): Select a single potential technique that costs 2 or more potential and cannot have a varying amount of potential spent on it. Reduce the potential cost of this technique by 1, to a minimum of 1.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times, each time selecting another potential technique.
feat-translated-spell-metamagic:
Your magic transcends the barriers of strange worlds and alien beings.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st, Linguistics 3 ranks

Benefit(s): A spell modified with this feat loses the [language-dependent] descriptor. The essential meaning of any words spoken during the spell is apparent to any creature that can hear you cast the spell. Effects that modify language-dependent spells still modify this spell (such as changes to caster level or save DCs), but any creature can understand it. This feat has no effect on spells that do not have the [language-dependent] descriptor. A translated spell uses a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-winged-heritor:
Your wings reflect the soaring saurian of your ancient ancestors.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), zvarr, stretched wings racial trait.

Benefit(s): Your racial fly speed increases to 40 feet (average maneuverability), and you no longer need to make Fly checks to fly upward.
feat-wingslash:
Your wing talons are deadly weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Winged Heritor, Str 13, Skill Focus (Fly), zvarr, stretched wings racial trait, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): You gain two wing attacks. These are secondary natural weapons that deal 1d3 points of slashing damage.
feat-additional-hypercharge:
You have learned to push your bonded vessel in a new way.

Prerequisite(s): Hypercharge class feature

Benefit(s): You may select an additional hypercharge from the list of helmsman hypercharges, adding it to your list of hypercharges known.
feat-akashic-supply-akasha:
Your internal reserves ensure that your ammunition never exhausts.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13 or ability to shape veils

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to invest essence into a weapon you are carrying. For every point of essence invested, you may make one attack per round with that weapon which does not consume ammunition or charges.

This ability does not enable you to make additional attacks per round with a weapon.

You gain one point of essence.
feat-artificial-spartan-akashic-combat:
Your mechanical facets enable you to substitute keen learning where mortals rely upon emotion.

Prerequisite(s): Android or forgeborn, daevic/metahuman level 1st

Benefit(s): You may use Intelligence in place of Charisma for all of your daevic/metahuman class abilities. In addition, you may invest essence into your nanite surge racial trait to gain an additional use per day for each point invested or invest essence into your fearless, strange mind, natural armor, crystal skin, memory matrix, or constructed racial traits (individually) to increase any of their bonuses by 1 for each point invested.

You gain one point of essence.
feat-blind-warrior-combat:
Without sight, you've learned to perceive the environment through heightened senses and dedicated training.

Benefit(s): You gain blindsense 30 feet and blindsight 5 feet as long as you are unable to see. For every three hit dice you possess, your blindsense increases by 5 feet. For every six hit dice you possess, your blindsight increases by 5 feet.

Special: Upon selecting this feat, you are permanently blinded (if you weren't previously blind). If you would somehow regain your sight, you immediately lose this feat, and must retrain it instantly.
feat-cockpit-jacker-combat:
You have learned not only to inhibit mechs, but to steal them as well.

Prerequisite(s): Pilot Render, Disable Device 3 ranks

Benefit(s): When you use a dirty trick maneuver on a disrupted mech, you may choose to eject the existing pilot of the mech and enter it yourself.

When you have entered the cockpit, you now pilot the mech, and can continue piloting it until someone steals it from you, it is destroyed, or you choose to leave it.
feat-craft-companion-vehicle:
You can craft motorized vehicles.

Prerequisite(s): Technologist, Craft (mechanical) 9 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 9 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create vehicles based on the companion vehicles presented in this supplement.

Any character with access to the vehicle's key or other control mechanism may drive and use this vehicle.

Creating a vehicle takes 1 week for every 1,000 gp in the vehicle's price. To create the object, you must use up raw materials costing half of this total price. See Non-Companion Mechs and Vehicles for more information.

You can repair a broken vehicle if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft the vehicle from scratch.
feat-craft-dorje-psionic-item-creation:
You can create small devices that store knowledge of psionic powers.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 5th

Benefit(s): You can create a dorje of any psionic power you know (barring exceptions as noted in a power's description). Crafting a dorje takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price. A newly created dorje has 50 charges.
feat-craft-power-stone-psionic-item-crea:
You can create power stones to store psionic powers.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can create a power stone of any power that you know. Encoding a power stone takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price.
feat-craft-psicrown-psionic-item-creatio:
You can create psicrowns, stores of versatile and immense psionic power.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 11th

Benefit(s): You can create any psicrown whose prerequisites you meet. Crafting a psicrown takes one day for each 1,000 gp in its base price.
feat-custom-vehicle:
You have created your own custom vehicle for use on your adventures.

Prerequisite(s): Technologist, character level 4th, must not have an animal companion, mount, or vehicle companion that advances as a mech or animal companion.

Benefit(s): You gain a companion vehicle of your choice as if you were a pilot or druid of your character level –3. If you later gain an animal companion or vehicle through another source (such as the Animal domain, divine bond, hunter's bond, mount, or nature bond class features), the effective druid or pilot level granted by this feat stacks with that granted by other sources.
feat-cybernetic-integration:
You and your mech are one.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded Mech class feature or Mech Piloting feat, Craft (mechanical) 5 ranks, Knowledge (engineering) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You can convert your mech into a set of cybernetic body armor. If your mech is currently larger than your size, it is broken down for parts and converted into a same sized creature; characters with multiple bonded mechs may choose one to receive this reconfiguration. If the mech had previously benefited from size increases for level, it instead increases its base Dexterity bonus by +2 and gains 10 additional hit points; if the mech had taken any size increasing enhancements, it may retrain any that would increase its base size above that of its pilot. While the mech is converted in this manner, you gain several benefits: you gain a +5 bonus to disguise checks to make the mech appear as a standard suit of armor, your arms (if you have any) are not occupied by piloting and may be used to wield weapons as normal, and you may pilot a mech up to one size smaller than yourself. There are also a few minor drawbacks: your mech now causes 15% spell failure due to its more confined configuration interfering with fine movements, you cannot stack weapon slots to wield a weapon more than one size category larger than yourself, and if the mech is smaller than your size, its bonuses to Strength and Dexterity are decreased by two points (minimum 0).
feat-extra-iaijutsu-technique-combat:
Your talent in iaijutsu cannot be measured.

Prerequisite(s): Iaijutsu technique class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an iaijutsu technique.

Special: This feat can be selected multiple times.
feat-iaijutsu-expert-combat:
You can unlock the true power of iaijutsu techniques.

Prerequisite(s): Iaijutsu technique class feature
