Benefit(s): Select an iaijutsu technique you possess; if that iaijutsu technique would force a creature to making a saving throw, the DC of that saving throw is increased by +2. All other iaijutsu techniques you possess have their DC increased by +1.
feat-ingenious-craftsman-item-creation:
No realm of magic or machinery is beyond your capacity to create.

Prerequisite(s): Master Craftsman, Technologist

Benefit(s): When crafting a magical item, you may choose to have it draw its powers from a technological source, or vice versa. A magic item made technological is not affected by anything that would inhibit magic (such as antimagic fields or mage's disjunction) but becomes vulnerable to effects that alter technology (such as discharge or antitech field). Likewise, technological items that are built as magic are not subject to effects that affect technology but are subject to spells that alter magic.

In addition, the following item creation feats may be used to craft items which require the other as a prerequisite.

Standard Feat Alternative Feat

Craft Magical Arms and Armor, Craft Rod Craft Technological Arms and Armor

Brew Potion Craft Pharmaceutical

Craft Wondrous Item, Forge Ring Craft Technological Item

Craft Construct Craft Robot (you may use this equivocation to add or remove the robot subtype from a construct)

Demon Grafter Craft Cybernetics

Items made with technological crafting feats are always technological, and items made with magical crafting feats are always magical.
feat-irradiating-power-metapsionic:
Your psionic abilities taint targets with radiation.

Benefit(s): To use this ability, you must expend psionic focus. Any creature affected by an irradiating power must succeed on a Fortitude save or contract radiation of a certain level. The Fortitude save and level of radiation are based on the amount of power points spent on the power (including power points spent to use this metapsionic feat). Manifesting a power in this way requires an expenditure of 4 additional power points, and the total expenditure cannot exceed your manifester level.

Table: Radiation Effects

Power Points Radiation Level Fort Save DC Primary Effect Secondary Effect

0-7 Low 13 1 Con drain 1 Str damage/day

8-13 Medium 17 1d4 Con drain 1d4 Str damage/day

14-19 High 22 2d4 Con drain 1d6 Str damage/day

20+ Severe 30 4d6 Con drain 2d6 Str damage/day
feat-kinetic-forger-psionic:
Rather than using ectoplasm, you construct your armaments from your surroundings.

Prerequisite(s): Must have knowledge of at least one metacreativity power.

Benefit(s): When you manifest a metacreativity power, you may manifest it as a psychokinesis power instead. When you do, the result of the power is created from unattended items in your surroundings rather than from ectoplasm. The manifester may choose to have any properties of surrounding materials be applied to the construct (such as having an astral construct's attacks strike as silver if it was created in a silver-rich area or having a created item assume the hardness of the stone it was created from). A creation made with this ability is of the same quality as an ectoplasmic construct unless the manifester specifies otherwise.
feat-legacy-weapon:
The weapon you wield has been passed down from generations.

Benefit(s): You begin play with a masterwork weapon with a cost of 500 gp or less, gaining a +1 bonus to damage with this weapon. In addition, this weapon can be enhanced as though its owner possessed the Craft Magic Arms and Armor feat, treating its owner as though they possess whatever spells would be required to enhance it.

Special: This feat can only be selected at 1st level.

Special: If you possess the ancestral weapon trait, your damage bonus from this feat increases to +3.

Special: If you possess the heirloom weapon trait, you gain a +1 trait bonus to attack rolls with this weapon.

Special: If you possess both the ancestral weapon and heirloom weapon traits, you also reduce the cost of enhancing this weapon by 10% and treat this feat as thought it was also Weapon Focus for the purpose of meeting prerequisites.
feat-machine-poltergeist:
Having no body, you gain the ability to steal mechanical ones.

Prerequisite(s): Incorporeal subtype, Intelligence 15

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to possess a machine or robot that can maintain an AI, much in the way certain spirits possess fleshy targets. This functions as the coded incarnation power, save that your body becomes the AI inside the device. You may leave the device as a standard action, recreating your normal form in a space adjacent to the machine.
feat-mech-master:
Whereas most have an ally, yours is a vessel for military might.

Prerequisite(s): Technologist, must possess an animal companion

Benefit(s): You lose the animal companion you possess, gaining a mech in its place. The abilities of your mech use the same level as your animal companion's effective level.
feat-mech-piloting-psionic:
You've gained access to a powerful techno-psionic suit.

Prerequisite(s): Psicrystal Affinity, Psi-Core Upgrade, Technologist, manifester level 5th.

Benefit: You gain access to a bonded mech as a pilot of your character level -4. If you later gain a mech through another source, the effective pilot level granted by this feat stacks with that granted by other sources, up to your total character level.

While piloting a psi-mech suit your psi-core must be in the mainframe configuration.
feat-mechanical-emulation-item-creation:
The wonders of advanced science stand in nicely for the effects of magic.

Prerequisite(s): Ingenious Craftsman, Master Craftsman

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to craft spell trigger and spell completion items without using the required spells (much as you would with the Master Craftsman feat normally), and may choose to create such items as technological devices rather than magical ones. In addition, spell trigger and spell completion items that you craft ignore spell resistance of targets. You still require the normal item creation feats needed to craft such items, however.
feat-mechanical-magician:
You understand magic much as you would science.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (engineering) 1 rank

Benefit(s): You may make Knowledge (engineering) checks in place of Use Magic Device checks.
feat-pilot-render-combat:
What mech pilots tend not to realize is how fragile their control really is.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Dirty Trick, Disable Device 1 rank

Benefit(s): When you use the dirty trick combat maneuver on a mech, you may choose to impose a disrupted condition on the mech rather than the normal conditions available. While disrupted, the pilot is unable to do anything to control their mech. This condition lasts as long as other dirty trick conditions and can be removed in the same way.
feat-psi-core-upgrade-psionic:
Your psicrystal has been converted into a versatile techno-psionic tool.

Prerequisite(s): Psicrystal Affinity, Technologist, manifester level 3rd.

Benefit(s): Your technologically modified psicrystal is now a psi-core that can be used for a variety of new purposes and gains the robot subtype. By expending your psionic focus, you may assemble your psi-core into one of the following configurations:

Techno Hilt: Your psi-core bonds itself to a single weapon you wield. While bonded in this way, the psi-core cannot be targeted separately from the weapon, though if the weapon is destroyed the core reverts to an unconfigured psi-core with ½ its maximum hit points. While in this configuration the psi-core adds an additional 1d4 electricity damage to all attacks made with the bonded weapon, and when its master activates a touch power he may make a single free melee attack with the modified weapon to deliver it in place of the free touch attack normally granted by the power.

Multi Tool: While in this configuration the psicore gains the constant benefit of the Flight (Su) ability normally gained at 9th level, regardless of the master's level, though the granted flight speed is halved until the master reaches that level.

The psi-core may serve as a masterwork tool for any skill you have at least 3 ranks in and gains a ranged touch attack with a range of 10 feet that deals 1d6 electrical damage. Whenever you expend your psionic focus, you may change the type of this damage to fire, sonic, or back to electrical.

Mainframe: While in this configuration, your psicore accelerates your mental processes, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus on all Intelligence based skill and ability checks. In addition, your psi-core can be used to interface with various specialized types of technological equipment and may be attached to any technological weapon or device that can be powered via a battery, allowing you to convert 5 power points into a single charge.
feat-psychic-programmer-psionic:
Machines are no less vulnerable than minds if one knows how to properly exploit them.

Prerequisite(s): Manifester level 9th

Benefit(s): You may ignore the immunity of constructs to mind-affecting effects. This does not prevent your mind-affecting powers from being susceptible to power resistance.
feat-salvage-crafter:
Your greatest tools are the scraps you gather from foes.

Prerequisite(s): Any item creation feat.

Benefit(s): you become adept at repurposing used or irrelevant items. In a process that takes 1 hour, you trade in an item for an amount of crafting potential based on a fraction of its crafting cost (not price). If the item is a permanent item or has had no charges or uses used up, it can be salvaged for it's full crafting cost. If the item is partially charged, it may be salvaged for a percentage of its crafting cost equal to the percentage of charges it has remaining. You can use this potential to make a new item, subtracting the potential from the cost it takes to make a new item.

For example, you could use a wand of haste (caster level 5th) with 25 charges in place of 2,812 gp for crafting items (50% of the wand's crafting cost of 5,625 gp) or a Gray Hologram Generator with 8 charges in place of 3,000 gp for crafting items (20% of the Generator's 15,000 gp). He then follows the normal rules for crafting and item. If you pay 100% of the cost of an item in this fashion, he crafts the item at double the normal speed. In the process of cannibalizing the old items, some parts may still remain, and any leftover gp value remains as components for further crafting.
feat-scholarly-samurai:
You harness and channel your spiritual might through rigorous mental discipline rather than outward force of personality.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary samurai 1st.

Benefit(s): You may use your Intelligence instead of your Charisma for any legendary samurai ability you gain, such as iaijutsu techniques, kiai arts, or spirit limit. In addition, select 1 Intelligence-based skill; you gain a +2 bonus to skill checks made with that skill.

Normal: A legendary samurai uses Charisma to determine their class features.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or before your 1st level of legendary samurai.

Special: This feat cannot be combined with the Wizened Samurai feat.
feat-tear-resilience-psionic-combat:
You have learned to fight around bolstering abilities that would normally staunch your strikes.

Prerequisite(s): Psionic Weapon or Psionic Fist

Benefit(s): Your melee attacks ignore any temporary hit points the target may have. The target retains these temporary hit points, but damage from your attack subtracts from the creature's regular supply of hit points without acknowledging the temporary hit points.
feat-transcendent-power-metapsionic:
Your psionic abilities cross over into the realm of magic.

Benefit(s): To use this feat, a character must expend their psionic focus. The power manifested using this feat is treated as a magic spell of no particular school for all purposes (feats, class abilities area effects, spell resistance, etc.). This does not allow metamagic feats to be applied to the power. Manifesting a Transcendent power costs 2 additional power points, and the total cost cannot exceed the character's manifester level.
feat-transcendent-spell-metamagic:
Your magical abilities replicate the strange techniques of psionics.

Benefit(s): The spell cast using this feat is treated as a psionic power of no particular discipline for all purposes (feats, class abilities area effects, power resistance, etc.). This does not allow metapsionic feats to be applied to the spell.

Level Increase: +2 (a transcendent spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's actual level.)
feat-vehicle-expert:
You've spent time learning the ins and outs of using and designing vehicles.

Benefit(s): You get a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (engineering) and Ride skill checks. If you have 10 or more ranks in one of these skills, the bonus increases to +4 for that skill.
feat-wizened-samurai:
You harness and channel your spiritual might through meditation and insight rather than outward force of personality.

Prerequisite(s): Legendary samurai 1st.

Benefit(s): You may use your Wisdom instead of your Charisma for any legendary samurai ability you gain, such as iaijutsu techniques, kiai arts, or spirit limit. In addition, select 1 Wisdom based skill; you gain a +2 bonus to skill checks made with that skill.

Normal: A legendary samurai uses Charisma to determine their class features.

Special: This feat must be selected at 1st level, or before your 1st level of legendary samurai.

Special: This feat cannot be combined with the Scholarly Samurai feat.
feat-morphic-nature:
Each time you traverse an interplanetary gate, you automatically adapt and acclimate to a new world.

Prerequisite(s): Player character (or heroic NPC, at GM's discretion)

Benefit(s): When passing through an interplanetary gate, you experience an instantaneous and permanent physical transformation to facilitate survival on a new world. This includes environmental compatibility with the local atmosphere (as determined by the planetary atmosphere at the time of the gate's crafting, but not the ability to survive in a hard vacuum). You also acclimate to local diseases, such that you still prove susceptible to disease, but retain no special vulnerability to alien pathogens on other worlds. You also learn the rudiments of the local Common language, speaking, reading, and writing a passable dialect (though this may not become evident until interacting with a given world's native inhabitants). When you pass through a gate to another planet, these benefits are lost or exchanged for acclimation to the new world.
feat-agile-swimmer:
You flip, twist, and turn in the water with grace.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Acrobatics and Swim checks. If you have at least 10 ranks in either skill, your bonus improves to +4 with that skill.
feat-amphibious-adaptation:
You can survive out of water far longer than your aquatic kin.

Prerequisite(s): Aquatic subtype.

Benefit(s): You can survive out of water for a number of hours equal to your Constitution score before you risk suffocation. If you already have the ability to survive out of water for a limited amount of time before suffocating or suffering other ill effects, that amount of time is doubled. If you do not possess a land speed, you gain a land speed of 5 feet. If you possess a land speed that is less than 20 feet, your speed on land increases by 5 feet.
feat-augment-plant-symbiont:
Your expertise in creating plant symbionts allows you to add augmentations to them.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Create Plant Symbiont, Symbiont Handler, Knowledge (nature) 6 ranks

Benefit(s): When you successfully create a new plant symbiont, you may choose for it to grow one additional new augmentation.

The plant symbiont gains a bite attack appropriate to its size if it does not already have one. If the symbiont already has a bite attack, it gains the trip universal monster ability.

The plant symbiont gains a claw attack appropriate to its size if it does not already have one. If the symbiont already has one or more claw attacks, it instead doubles the threat range for all its claw attacks.

The plant symbiont gains a slam attack appropriate for its size if it does not already have one. If the symbiont already has a slam attack, it instead gains the push universal monster ability.

The plant symbiont gains a tentacle attack appropriate to its size if it does not already have one. If the symbiont already has a tentacle attack, it instead gains the grab universal monster special ability.
feat-bestial-endurance:
You can store reserves of food and water efficiently, allowing you to go without food and water for long periods.

Prerequisite(s): Bestial species, Con 13 or Endurance feat.

Benefit(s): You can go twice as long as normal without food or water, and the DC of Constitution checks to resist the effects of starvation and thirst increases at only half the normal rate. In addition, you gain a +2 racial bonus on such Constitution checks and on saving throws against magical effects that cause starvation and thirst, such as feast of ashes and cup of dust.
feat-body-modification-attunement:
You can wear magic items over your body modifications.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 7th.

Benefit(s): Choose one magic item slot. Body modifications that occupy no that magic item slot on your body no longer impede you from wearing a magic item on that body slot, effectively allowing you to install a body modification and wear a magic item in the same slot. For example, with this feat, you can wear a magic amulet or necklace even if you have filtering gills (see above) installed.

Normal: Body modifications occupy the magic item slot indicated in their description.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you do, select a different magic item slot on your body.
feat-body-modifications-expert:
You are accustomed to having body modifications installed.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves to avoid infection from a new body modification. You may install a number of body modifications equal to your Constitution modifier + 1 (minimum 1).

Normal: The maximum number of body modifications you can install is equal to your Constitution modifier.
feat-body-modifications-veteran:
You are so used to body modifications that you hardly even notice them.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, Body Modifications Expert.

Benefit(s): You no longer need to succeed at a Fortitude save to avoid infection whenever you have a new body modification installed. The maximum number of body modifications you may have installed is equal to your Constitution modifier + 2 (minimum 2).

Normal: You must succeed at a Fortitude save to avoid infection when a new body modification is installed.
feat-body-muffle:
You use your enemies to silence the noise of your firearms.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any one-handed firearm), Stealth 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When firing your chosen firearm while adjacent to your target, you may press the muzzle directly against their body to reduce noise. Doing so provokes attacks of opportunity (even if firing a ranged weapon in melee does not ordinarily do so for you) and requires a successful combat maneuver check. If you succeed, creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 10 Perception check (modified by distance as normal) to hear your firearm discharge.

Normal: The Perception DC to hear a firearm being discharged is –10.
feat-combat-balladeer:
You fought as an elite combat balladeer in the Century War and were allowed to retain your instrument weapon after your service.

Prerequisite(s): Human, Infused, or Phalanx. You may only select this feat at 1st level.

Benefit(s): You gain an instrument weapon, a special combination of masterwork weapon and masterwork musical instrument that is an identifier of your military service to the Hierarchy.

Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus on Diplomacy checks made against members of the Protectorate.
feat-craft-aethertech-item-creation:
You can create unusual fusions of magic and technology known as aethertech.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (mechanical) 3 ranks, Knowledge (arcana or engineering) 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create aethertech, special fusions of magic and technology powered by aetheric units of energy.

Crafting aethertech takes 1 day for each 1,000 au in its price. To create aethertech, you must use up raw materials costing half of its base price. You can also mend a broken aethertech item if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft that item.
feat-craft-body-modification-item-creati:
You can craft magical body modifications.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You can create any magical body modification whose construction requirements you meet. Crafting a body modification takes 1 day for each 1,000 gp in its price. To create a body modification, you must use up raw materials costing half its base price.

You can also mend a broken body modification if it is one that you could make. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to craft that modification.

See the magic item creation rules for more information.
feat-craft-nethertech-item-creation:
You can create terrible nethertech weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Aethertech

Benefit(s): You can create nethertech items, a variant of aethertech fueled by negative energy.
feat-create-advanced-plant-symbiont:
You can create advanced plant symbionts without the normal cost involved.

Prerequisite(s): Int 15, Create Plant Symbiont, Knowledge (nature) 10 ranks

Benefit(s): When you create a plant symbiont, you may choose to apply the advanced simple template to it without paying the additional cost. You must still succeed on the ability check with the increased DC.

Normal: Creating an advanced plant symbiont increases the cost of the plant symbiont by 50%.
feat-create-plant-symbiont:
You possess the knowledge to create plant symbionts.

Prerequisite(s): Int 11, Craft (alchemy) 5 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create a wide variety of plant symbionts.

Creating a plant symbiont takes 1 day for each 1,000 gp/au in its price. Creating a plant symbiont requires raw materials costing half of its base price. You can also revive a plant symbiont that has been dead for a number of days equal to or less than its Constitution score. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to create that plant symbiont.
feat-cunning-mechanic:
You rely on a keen understanding rather than nimble fingers when dealing with machines.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Craft (mechanical) 1 rank

Benefit(s): You use your Intelligence modifier rather than your Dexterity modifier on Disable Device checks.
feat-eel-strike-combat:
You can strike swiftly and retreat beyond your enemy's reach.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, swim speed.

Benefit(s): While swimming, if you use the withdraw action you can take a single melee attack as a swift action before you begin your movement.
feat-efficient-recharger:
It is a simple matter for you to recharge aethertech devices.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (mechanical) or Knowledge (arcana) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When you recharge a non-firearm aethertech device using an aetheric capacitor, you may do so as a move action.

Normal: Recharging non-weapon aethertech requires a standard action.
feat-elemental-ki-focus-combat:
You empower your monk weapons with elemental energy.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Wis 13, Elemental FistB, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): You can imbue the elemental energy from your Elemental Fist into an attack you make with any weapon with the monk property, as if they were unarmed strike attacks. If you confirm a critical hit with your weapon when using this feat, that attack does not count against the number of Elemental Fist attacks you can make each day.

Special: A monk of the four winds can select this as a bonus feat at 7th level, in place of gaining the wholeness of body monk class feature.
feat-endless-arsenal-combat:
You imagine weapons more frequently than other trained penthe warriors.

Prerequisite(s): Fantastic Bullets, wondrous arsenal racial trait, fighter level 4th

Benefit(s): You can use your wondrous arsenal racial trait to conjure weapons an extra number of times per day equal to one-half your character level.

Normal: You can use wondrous arsenal to conjure a weapon once per day.
feat-fantastic-bullets-combat:
Your ability to imagine weaponry is not limited to melee weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Wondrous arsenal racial trait, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): You can use your wondrous arsenal racial trait to conjure ranged weapons. Reloading a weapon takes the same action as normal, but you conjure regular ammunition for the weapon as needed to reload. Your conjured weapons are no longer dismissed if you are not holding them.
feat-fast-swimmer:
You have exceptional speed in the water.

Prerequisite(s): Swim speed.

Benefit(s): Your swim speed increases by 10 feet.
feat-greater-intuitive-riff:
You have honed your skill at playing off the Score.

Prerequisite(s): Intuitive Riff, superior repertoire verse class feature, phalanx

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can use a verse or greater verse from a hymn you do not have rehearsed. You cannot use superior verses in this way. If the verse or greater verse's effect is ongoing, it lasts for 1 round per cantor level.
feat-hear-the-sea:
Your ears are keenly attuned to faraway sounds in the water.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on hearing-based Perception checks, and you reduce the distance penalty on hearing-based Perception checks to -1 per 30 feet at the water's surface and -1 per 60 feet underwater. In addition, you can detect the location of creatures moving creatures in the water within 5 feet (or within 20 feet for creatures lacking a swim speed) as if you had tremorsense.
feat-improved-suppressing-fire-combat:
Your automatic firearm attacks leave your enemies vulnerable.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Reflexes, Suppressing Fire, base attack bonus +8

Benefit(s): When you use Suppressing Fire, all enemies in the line of your automatic fire are considered flat-footed against the next ranged attack to target them (other than your own) until the start of your next turn.
feat-improved-symbiont-resilience:
You can coax additional protection out of your symbiont.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Resilience, Symbiont Handler

Benefit(s): The damage reduction you gain from Symbiont Resilience now lasts for 1 minute per Hit Die of your bonded symbiont, and this damage reduction may be activated as an immediate action. If you are bonded with more than one plant symbiont, you must choose which plant symbiont you gain the damage reduction from.

You must remain bonded with the plant symbiont while benefiting from its damage reduction.
feat-intuitive-riff:
Your aetherite core responds strongly to music, allowing you to more easily intuit the most appropriate verse for the moment.

Prerequisite(s): Greater repertoire verse class feature, phalanx

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can use a verse from a hymn you have not rehearsed. You cannot use greater or superior verses in this way. If the verse's effect is ongoing, it lasts for 1 round per cantor level.
feat-lifelike-prostheses:
Your prostheses are so realistic and your attunement to them so strong that onlookers scarcely notice the aids.

Benefit(s): You gain a +5 bonus on Sleight of Hand checks to conceal the properties of your prosthetic limbs or body parts, and creatures must succeed at a Perception check (DC = 10 + your Sleight of Hand modifier) in order to identify a prosthetic you are wearing. Creatures farther than 15 feet away from you cannot identify your prosthetic body parts.

Normal: Most intelligent creatures can immediately identify a prosthetic limb or body part just by looking (if 15 feet or closer and the body part is visible) or succeeding at a Perception check (DC = 10 + your Sleight of Hand modifier). Unintelligent creatures can make a Perception check (DC = 15 + your Sleight of Hand modifier) to identify a prosthetic, though this may have little to no effect on how they interact with you depending on their level of unintelligence.
feat-lucid-crafter:
You can imbue a sense of reality to objects you create in the Dimension of Dreams.

Prerequisite(s): Lucid Dreamer

Benefit(s): Objects you create through use of the Craft skill or Item Creation feats in the Dimension of Dreams are physical objects which can be carried between planes by physically present creatures. Objects created by impossible feats are not affected by this feat.
feat-overwatch-combat:
You are adept at setting up kill zones with firearms.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Squad Tactics, base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you designate a 45-foot cone originating from one corner of your space. Any enemies moving within or into this area provoke attacks of opportunity from you unless moving behind cover or occupied squares.

Normal: Characters do not threaten attacks of opportunity while wielding ranged weapons.
feat-penthe-thoughtwalker:
You are experienced in traveling to and through dreamscapes.

Prerequisite(s): Dreamspeaker racial trait, character level 11th

Benefit(s): You can cast dream travel once per day as a spell-like ability. This dream travel has a range of personal and a target of you, with a caster level equal to your character level.
feat-playful-creature:
You're charming enough that others assume any faux pas is just a delightful quirk.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank, Diplomacy 1 rank, bestial species.

Benefit(s): If you fail a Bluff check to deceive, an Intimidate check to gain a target's cooperation, or a Sleight of Hand check to steal from another creature, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check against the same DC as a free action. If you succeed, your target assumes your actions were in jest or just some awkward misunderstanding between your bestial inclinations and the social norms of others. The creature's attitude toward you does not immediately worsen (though later actions can still shift its attitude toward hostile). You can use this feat only once per day per target.
feat-reactor-siphon:
You can generate small amounts of power from your internal power source to recharge aethertech devices.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (arcana or engineering) 3, phalanx

Benefit(s): Once per day as a standard action you may recharge a piece of aethertech by a number of charges of aetheric energy equal to your Constitution bonus (minimum 1). These charges are temporary and any charges unused at the end of the round are lost.

Special: If you have the Efficient Recharger feat, you may use Reactor Siphon as a move action.
feat-sea-shooter-combat:
You are deadly with ranged attacks underwater.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit(s): You use thrown weapons underwater, taking a -2 penalty for every 5 feet of water they pass through. Only piercing weapons and nets can be thrown underwater in this way. Attacks with other types of ranged weapons take a -2 penalty for every 10 feet of water they must pass through.

In addition, targets in the water do not gain cover or total cover against your ranged attacks when you are outside the water. The water's surface does, however, count as the beginning of a new range increment for determining range penalties.
feat-sea-sight:
Your eyes are accustomed to penetrating the murk of the sea and the creatures lurking in it.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 3 ranks, swim speed or Skill Focus (Swim).

Benefit(s): You can see out to double the normal range in the water. If you have darkvision, the range of that darkvision is also doubled underwater. When your attack misses a creature in the water due to concealment or total concealment, you can reroll that miss chance once per attack.

Normal: A creature can see out to 4d8 x 10 feet in normal water and 1d8 x 10 feet in murky water.
feat-sea-singer:
Your powerful humming carries your music underwater with power.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 1 rank, bardic performance class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use potent subsonic humming to create bardic performances with auditory components underwater and cast bard spells with verbal components while underwater, even while holding your breath, without the need for a special concentration check. These spells and effects have the normal range and effect, save that language-dependent effects do not function in conjunction with this feat. You cannot use this feat to cast spells from other classes.
feat-skilled-body-modder:
Your experience and agility make you an able body modder for your patients.

Prerequisite(s): Heal 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): You gain a +5 bonus on Heal checks to install or remove body modifications. If you fail a Heal check to install or remove a body modification, the target does not take bleed damage.
feat-squad-tactics-combat-teamwork:
You excel when close to allies using firearms.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any firearm), base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): You receive a +1 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls with your chosen firearm as long as you are within 10 feet of an ally who possesses this feat.
feat-steaming-spell-metamagic:
Your magic merges fire and water into boiling steam.

Benefit(s): A steaming spell delivers searing heat through supercharged steam. A spell must have the fire or water descriptor to be cast as a steaming spell. A steaming spell with the fire descriptor functions normally underwater, without the need for a caster level check, and if cast outside of water and the spell affects an area, that area is filled with steam for a number of rounds equal to the spell's unadjusted level. This steam obscures vision, granting concealment to creatures more than 5 feet away from an observer. The steam never grants total concealment.

A steaming spell with the water descriptor that deals hit point damage deals an additional 1 point of damage per die; this additional damage is fire damage. Such a spell that affects an area also produces a cloud of steam as above that fills all areas within 10 feet of the water it affects or creates.

A steaming spell uses up a spell slot two levels higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-submarine-skirmish-combat:
You can flip, twist, and turn in deadly and dangerous attacks in the water.

Prerequisite(s): Favored terrain (water).

Benefit(s): When you use the charge action while swimming, you may choose to negate the normal -2 penalty to your AC for using the charge action. Alternatively, you can accept that penalty in order to take your charge attack at any point during your movement, continuing the remainder of your movement in a straight line after attacking. You must move at least 10 feet before taking your charge attack.

If you use the withdraw action while you are swimming, you may take a single melee attack before beginning your movement.
feat-suppressing-fire-combat:
Your automatic firearm attacks deter your enemies from returning fire.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Reflexes

Benefit(s): When you make an automatic-fire ranged attack with a firearm with the automatic weapon quality, every creature in the line of fire takes a –2 penalty on ranged attack rolls for 1 round. The penalty is reduced to –1 if the target is protected by any form of cover.
feat-symbiont-bearer:
You can bond with additional symbionts.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Handler, Handle Animal 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You may bond with one additional symbiont regardless of your Constitution bonus.

Normal: You can bond with a number of symbionts equal to your Constitution bonus (minimum 1).

Special: You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select this feat, its effects stack.
feat-symbiont-damage-redistribution:
Your bond with plant symbionts allows you to redistribute the damage they take.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Bearer, Symbiont Handler, Handle Animal 4 ranks

Benefit(s): Your enhanced empathic bond with your plant symbionts allows you to transfer damage amongst your plant symbionts. Whenever a bonded plant symbiont takes damage, as a free action you may choose to have another bonded plant symbiont take half the damage dealt.

Additionally, when resting for at least 8 hours, you may choose to have one bonded plant symbiont transfer the hit points it would receive from its symbiont healing ability (even if it is at maximum hit points) to another bonded plant symbiont. The recipient symbiont cannot exceed its maximum hit points. Both plant symbionts must be bonded with you during the full 8 hours to benefit from this effect.
feat-symbiont-handler:
You can train a symbiont to perform special tasks.

Benefit(s): You gain access to the Symbiont Handling skill unlock of Handle Animal.

Normal: You cannot use the Handle Animal skill to train plant symbionts.
feat-symbiont-handling-expert:
You are an expert in commanding plant symbionts.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Handler

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on all Handle Animal checks made to influence symbionts. If you have 10 or more ranks in Handle Animal, your bonus increases by +4.

Additionally, when you attempt to teach a plant symbiont a command, for every 5 points by which you exceed the DC you reduce the time it takes to train the plant symbiont that command by 1 day.
feat-symbiont-healer:
You are able to restore your symbiont's health at the cost of your own.

Prerequisite(s): Con 11

Benefit(s): When you get a full 8 hours of rest, you may transfer any number of hit points you would have recovered (even if you are not injured) to any symbiont bonded with you. If you are bonded with more than one symbiont, you may divide the hit points among them as you wish. A bonded symbiont gains these hit points at the end of the 8 hours of rest, in addition to any hit points it would normally gain from its symbiont healing ability.

Excess hit points are lost. You must remain bonded to the receiving symbiont for the full 8 hours of rest.
feat-symbiont-resilience:
Your symbiont can afford you additional protection.

Prerequisite(s): Symbiont Handler, Handle Animal 4 ranks

Benefit(s): You may gain the damage reduction from a symbiont you are currently bonded with for a number of rounds per day equal to twice the plant symbiont's Hit Dice. Activating this feat is a swift action and the effect can be ended with a free action. The rounds do not have to be used consecutively but are used in 1-round increments.

If you are bonded with more than one plant symbiont, you must choose which plant symbiont you gain damage reduction from. You must remain bonded with the plant symbiont while benefiting from its damage reduction.
feat-symbiotic-hit-points:
You and your plant symbiont are harmoniously entwined, able to share your life force.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Symbiont Handler, Handle Animal 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You and any plant symbionts you are bonded to are able to transfer hit points between yourselves as a swift action. For every two hit points you transfer to any plant symbiont bonded to you, it gains one hit point. If you have multiple plant symbionts bonded to you, you can divide the transferred hit points amongst them. Additionally, you can transfer hit points from a single bonded plant symbiont to yourself, gaining one hit point for every two it transfers. Neither you nor the plant symbiont can exceed your or its maximum hit points.
feat-winter-coat:
Your fur or feathers are adapted to conditions of extreme cold and your coloration matches icy conditions.

Prerequisite(s): Bestial species.

Benefit(s): You treat cold environments as one step less severe and gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves to resist the effects of cold climate. Your white plumage or fur also grants you a +2 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks in snowy or icy conditions.
feat-blade-and-black-magic:
You have studied spells that complement your agile approach to combat.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, panache class feature, ability to cast 1st-level antipaladin spells.

Benefit(s): Add the following spells to your antipaladin spell list at the indicated levels: 1st-duelist's parry, 2nd-alacrity, 3rd-dance of a hundred cuts, 4th-greater bladed dash.
feat-bullet-and-black-magic:
You have sought out spells to enhance your guns and cut down your foes with dark power.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, grit class feature, ability to cast 1st-level antipaladin spells

Benefit(s): Add the following spells to your antipaladin spell list at the indicated levels: 1st-stabilize powder, 2nd-ricochet shot, 3rd-quieting weapons, 4th-greater named bullet.
feat-desecrating-destruction:
Items of holy power are particularly satisfying to destroy.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, Improved Sunder or ability to cast break, rune of ruin or shatter.

Benefit(s): You deal additional damage equal to your character level when you successfully sunder a weapon that is good-aligned, a shield or armor that grants DR/evil, or an object with an aura of good. If you deal damage to such an object with another ability, you deal additional damage equal to half your character level. When you inflict the broken or destroyed condition on an item of this kind, you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute.
feat-empower-fiend:
Your touch of evil is a powerful restorative to all manner of diabolical creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, touch of corruption class feature

Benefit(s): You can use your touch of corruption to heal evil outsiders. If the creature is healed by negative energy, you can heal it as though it were undead. Otherwise, you grant temporary hit points which can't take the creature above its maximum, and persist for up to 1 hour. This temporary healing stacks with itself.
feat-fiendish-phantom:
Your phantom is twisted into a nightmare form.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, phantom class feature

Benefit(s): Your phantom gains the evil subtype, making its attacks evil-aligned and strengthening its evil aura. It also gains immunity to poison and resistance 5 to one form of energy you choose. Your phantom can exchange its slam attacks for claw attacks that deal bludgeoning and slashing damage.

Note: this feat allows your phantom to qualify for several feats, including Fiendish Serpent, Fiendish Wings, Possess Object, Possess Location, and Possess Creature.
feat-gaze-of-malevolence:
The baleful power of your watchful eye renders your enemies helpless.

Prerequisite(s): Ominous stare class feature, two bold stare improvements

Benefit(s): When a creature penalized by your ominous state makes a charge attack against you, its penalty to Armor Class is increased by -2, and any bonus it receives to attack and damage rolls is halved. When a creature penalized by your ominous stare attempts to use a spell, spell-like or supernatural ability granted by a good deity or with the good descriptor, it must succeed at a concentration check or lose the action (though not the spell). The DC is equal to 10 + half your class level + your Charisma modifier.
feat-malign-fury:
You relish the terrifying power of your rages, and the devastation they permit you to unleash.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage or rage class feature, smite good class feature, antipaladin level 5th.

Benefit(s): Your antipaladin levels stack with levels in one class that grants bloodrage or rage, for the purpose of determining when you gain rage powers or bloodline powers. Also, your levels in the raging class stack with levels of antipaladin when determining the effects of your smite.

Special: If you have the malevolent shot or malevolent strike class features, or a smite ability that replaces smite good, you can select this feat and apply this benefit to that ability instead.
feat-malign-magic:
You have woven sorcerous fury and the gifts of your dark patrons into a single unholy fusion.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 1st-level antipaladin and bloodrager spells, Malign Fury.

Benefit(s): When you select this feat, choose either your bloodrager spellcasting or your antipaladin spellcasting. Your levels in the two classes that grant these features stack for the purpose of determining your spells known, spells per day, caster level and all other effects of your spells. The other class no longer grants you any form of spellcasting, but you can add one spell from each level of that class's spell list to the spell list of your remaining spellcasting class. Your casting is considered both antipaladin and bloodrager spellcasting for the purpose of effects such as blood casting and prerequisites.
feat-scornful-superiority:
Your contemptuous fighting style humiliates and unnerves your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Evil alignment, panache class feature, menacing swordplay deed, Antagonize

Benefit(s): When you use the menacing swordplay deed or the Antagonize feat, you can accept a -2 penalty to AC until the end of your next turn. If you do so, you gain a +4 bonus on the skill check. If you confirm a critical hit against a creature you have intimidated with the Antagonize feat, you can intimidate it an additional time that day.

Special: You can use this feat in place of Precise Shot to qualify for Signature Strike Style, and in place of Improved Unarmed Strike to qualify for Diabolic Style. You can make the attacks of opportunity granted by Diabolic Style with any light or one-handed melee weapon with which you have Weapon Focus.
feat-vindictive-display:
You strike fear into the hearts of onlookers when you destroy the living with corrupting power.

Prerequisite(s): Touch of corruption class feature

Benefit(s): When you reduce a creature to below 0 hp with a touch of corruption, or when a creature fails its saving throw to resist your cruelty, you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize all foes within 30 feet who can see the result.

Special: This feat counts as Dazzling Display for the purpose of prerequisites.
feat-aegis-overdrive-combat:
Use their strength against them and watch them fell themselves.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, BAB +7, Aegis Slam, Shield Focus, Skewering Aegis Style

Benefits: While using this style, you gain a bonus on damage rolls equal to your shield bonus to AC against creatures that missed you with an attack in the previous round and increase the damage multiplier of your attack readied against a charge by 1.
feat-aegis-phalanx-combat:
Those who stand as one stand firmest.

Prerequisite(s): Con 15, BAB +5, Aegis Slam, Shield Focus, Skewering Aegis Style

Benefits: While using this style, you gain an additional +1 shield bonus to AC after a creature misses you with a melee attack for 1 round. You may spend an immediate action to grant this bonus to all adjacent allies. They lose the bonus if they stop being adjacent to you.
feat-aegis-slam-combat:
They want to come to you? Greet them warmly.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, BAB +3, Shield Focus, Skewering Aegis Style

Benefits: While using this style, you may ready your weapon as an immediate action against a charge. If your your readied attack hits a creature taking an AC penalty from charging, they take that penalty until the end of their next turn.
feat-alkari-survivalist-racial:
Sometimes you have to go by the old alkari adage: use everything against everything.

Prerequisite(s): Karkus native human, Survival 5 ranks

Benefits: You can notice natural traps and hazards with Survival instead of Perception, and when attacked in the surprise round, you may make a Survival check. If you meet or exceed the highest initiative roll, you may also act in the surprise round. For the surprise round, treat your initiative as +4 higher when determining turn order. This does not carry over to normal initiative.
feat-alkark-terrorjaw-racial:
Aaaah! Aaaah! AAAAAH! Ker-runch.

Prerequisite(s): Alkark, BAB +7, natural weapons

Benefits: Increase the damage multiplier of your bite attack by 1.
feat-androsphinx-heritage:
One of your parents was a regal androsphinx and you now know just how important you are.

Prerequisite(s): Half-Sphinx, cannot possess any other feat with "half-sphinx" as a prerequisite and "heritage" in it's name

Benefit(s): Once per day you can take a standard action to let out a supernaturally powerful androsphinx roar. It is a mind-affecting, sonic, fear effect that fill a 30-foot-radius burst, centered on the half-sphinx; the save is DC 10 + 1/2 character level + your Charismabased. If a creature fails it is frightened for 1d6 rounds. All sphinxes (including other half-sphinxes) are immune to the effects of this roar. You gain 1 additional use of this ability for every 5 character levels you possess.
feat-august-tyrant-style-combat-style:
You plow through victims with primal fury.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +1 or one natural attack

Benefits: When fighting using this style, your unarmed strikes deal +1 damage, +1 for every 4 BAB you possess. Once per round, you may cause an opponent you successfully damaged with an unarmed strike to be knocked off-balance, taking a -1 penalty to AC until the end of their next turn. Creatures immune to being tripped are immune to this penalty. This bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage.

Special: This feat's benefits apply to two-handed weapons and natural attacks. A monk treats his monk level as his BAB for this feat's benefits.
feat-behemoth-grip:
Generating power from a low stance and four powerful arms, you can put more force behind your melee attacks than other creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): For every hand you grip a one-handed or two-handed weapon with after the 2nd, you gain an additional 0.5x your Strength modifier for each hand.
feat-blood-chugger:
"They say blood is thicker than water- I tend to agree.

It also has a kind of milk-shake quality to the flavor."

Prerequisite(s): Stirgo OR stirgi and Constitution 15

Benefit(s): Your blood drain deals 1d4 Constitution damage.
feat-bloody-vermin-critical:
You have become adept at sneaking a taste of the goods before the battle is over…

Prerequisite(s): Stirgi, Improved Critical

Benefit(s): On a critical hit with a natural weapon your blood drain racial ability can trigger.
feat-bred-for-war:
Your familiarity with martial weapons is matched only by your thirst for conquest.

Prerequisite(s): Thaun

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 racial bonus on damage rolls with martial (not simple or exotic) melee weapons while in combat.
feat-cat-skull-combat-combat-style:
The killing arts of the kreyu prey on the unwary and unprepared.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +1, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: When using this style and attacking during the surprise round with an unarmed strike, you gain a +2 bonus on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn. Special: This style's benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.
feat-cat-skull-deathblow-combat:
Eliminate the problem by eliminating their defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +7, Cat Skull Combat, Cat Skull Repulsion, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: While using this style, you may forgo confirming a critical hit to make a feint instead. This attack only counts for your or an ally's next attack. Until that attack, the target counts as unaware of you, but may still make attacks against you at no penalty. You may make a melee attack as a full-round action with an unarmed strike against an unaware target. This attack automatically threatens a critical hit.

Special: This style's benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.
feat-cat-skull-momentum-combat:
When the enemy gets careless, the enemy gets extinct.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +5, Cat Skull Combat, Cat Skull Repulsion, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: When using this style, if you hit a flatfooted creature in the previous round, you gain a +4 bonus to confirm critical hits against that creature. This stacks with Critical Focus.

Special: This style's benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.
feat-cat-skull-repulsion-combat:
Knocking an unwary foe off-balance is as easy as tipping a sleeping paramylodon.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, BAB +3, Cat Skull Combat, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: When using this style, you may gain a +2 bonus to AC against flatfooted creatures you hit with your unarmed strike until the end of your next turn. You may also give this benefit to an adjacent ally.

Special: This style's benefit applies to light weapons, natural weapons, and one-handed weapons.
feat-childs-champion:
Living without children puts their value into perspective.

Prerequisite(s): Cuill

Benefit(s): If a cuill is within 30 ft. of a young creature he gains a +2 on any aid another checks as he attempts to aid that creature.
feat-chimeric-chimera:
Your hodge-podge of parts becomes a coordinated symphony of physicality.

Prerequisite(s): Dai'Chi.

Benefit(s): You may gain one of the following dai'chi racial traits that you do not already possess: viper tail, strong wings, dragon blood, goat-footed, or lion's roar.

Special: This may be taken multiple times. Each time it grants a different racial trait.
feat-clatter:
The marionette has developed a way to mimic the vocal requirements of a spell with the clatter of his movements.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1, marionette

Benefit(s): You may cast spells without a voice. Your clatter still becomes silenced within silent fields.
feat-cloistered-philosopher:
By shutting out external distractions, a cuill gains access to an inner peace unique to his race.

Prerequisite(s): Wisdom 15, cuill, Knowledge (history) 1 rank, Knowledge (religion) 1 rank

Benefit(s): A cuill can count his Wisdom as if it were 2 points higher for the purpose of determining his spells known and spells per day.
feat-comic-relief:
Marionettes have mastered the art of defusing tension with their playful antics.

Prerequisite(s): Marionette

Benefit(s): You may may substitute a Perform check in the place of a Diplomacy check when trying to influence someone's attitude.
feat-communal-healing:
A kapre knows how to relax and has made an art out of comfort on the road.

Prerequisite(s): Kapre, Heal 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain twice your HD when you rest. In addition, if you make a DC 15 Heal check on an ally before they rest they benefit from this feat as well. A kapre may only make such a Heal check on one type of creature.
feat-copycat-performance:
Although marionettes don't always understand an action, they have a funny habit of copying everything they see with the a performing flair.

Prerequisite(s): Marionette, Perform(any) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): Choose one type of Perform skill that you have 5 ranks in. You gain the benefit of the versatile performance class ability of the bard, allowing you to substitute a Perform check in the place of a check of an associated skill.

The types of Perform and their associated skills are: Act (Bluff, Disguise), Comedy (Bluff, Intimidate), Dance (Acrobatics, Fly), Keyboard Instruments (Diplomacy, Intimidate), Percussion (Handle Animal, Intimidate), and String (Bluff, Diplomacy).
feat-corsath-murmur-racial:
What was that? Sounds like an arrow to the eardrum.

Prerequisite(s): Corsath, whisper, Stealth 9 ranks

Benefits: You may make sniping attacks at no penalty to Stealth checks. Attempts to eavesdrop on your conversations automatically fail.
feat-desert-spider:
Your feet are particularly dexterous and thus you are able to manipulate things quite well.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Climb 8 ranks, Hand and Foot

Benefit(s): You gain a climb speed equal to your land speed.
feat-distracting-dermis:
Your can manipulate your swarm body with dexterity to make it writhe and wriggle, and can be used to distract your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, mannequin

Benefit(s): As a standard action a mannequin can cause any living creature that occupies an area that he threatens to become nauseated. A Fortitude save with a DC of 10 + ½ the mannequin's hit dice (minimum 1) + the mannequin's Constitution modifier negates this effect. Creatures who succeed on their saves must make a Concentration check (DC 20 + spell level) when casting a spell or concentrating on a spell, failure means the spell is lost. Using skills requiring patience and concentration within the areas threatened by the mannequin require a DC 15 Will save. A mannequin with this feat can perform this action a number of times per day equal to his Constitution modifier (minimum 1).
feat-dynavik-delight-racial:
Making a dynavik happy is as easy as losing a few gallons of blood.

Prerequisite(s): Dynavik, natural weapons, BAB +6

Benefit(s): Your natural attacks deal 1 point of bleed damage on a successful hit. This stacks with the existing bleed damage a target is suffering. You no longer take a penalty to AC from using your talon attacks.
feat-empowered-ruby:
Through almiraj rituals your ruby has grown larger and more powerful.

Prerequisite(s): Magic Ruby, 9th level, magic horn racial trait, Almiraj

Benefit(s): The enhancement bonus of your magic horn is equal to 1 + the level of the highest level spell you can cast (rounded down). Your horn cannot exceed a +5 enhancement bonus.

Normal: Your magic horn has a +1 enhancement.

Example: If you could cast 4th level spells your magic horn would have a +5 enhancement.
feat-erudite-predator-style-combat-style:
Each mistake is a way to end a fight.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Bluff 1 Rank, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: While using this style, you gain a +1 bonus to AC against each opponent who misses you with an attack until the start of your next turn. For each attack an opponent misses you with, you gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls with unarmed strikes against that opponent the following round.

Special: This style's benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-extra-erratic-mutation:
Through wizardry, pluck or talent, you have become able to improve your mutation powers.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe, Constitution 15, character level 9

Benefit(s): You may choose to enhance an additional mutation per day.

Special: You may take up to four times in total, but each time you do, the Constitution prerequisite to be able to pick it increases by 2.
feat-familiarity-bond:
Your form is that of a bonded weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, arcane bond with a bonded weapon that matches the arma's weapon form or bladebound magus with a black blade matching his weapon form.

Benefit(s): An arma may spend a swift action to treat its bonded weapon or black blade as its weapon form for one turn. This grants all the enhancement bonuses, weapon special abilities, and intelligent item abilities of the arma's weapon form. The weapon is considered to have the same stats as the arma's weapon form to determine the effects of their intelligent item abilities.
feat-flying-rats:
"Bats are just rats with wings! Disgusting, uncultured, vermin!"

"Hey, as a Stirgi, I resemble that remark!"

Prerequisite(s): Fly (5 ranks), stirgi

Benefit(s): You gain a fly speed equal to your base land speed with average maneuverability. A stirgi who hasn't feed in 24 hours loses this benefit.
feat-gaoth-eyes:
Your keen eyes are adept at spotting the best deals.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Appraise 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 racial bonus on any Appraise checks to determine the value of items and to Spellcraft checks to identify the properties of magical equipment.
feat-gaoth-grappling-combat:
You use your feet as effectively as your hands in a grapple.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Hand and Foot

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 racial bonus on grapple checks.
feat-gaoth-sellsword-combat:
Your aptitude for combat is matched only for your willingness to sell it.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, base attack bonus +5, Dexterity 13

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 morale bonus on Initiative checks and gains a +1 racial bonus on attack rolls with any weapon with "gaoth" in its name.
feat-gift-of-ganesh:
Your worship of Ganesh as one his favored returns good fortune.

Prerequisite(s): Ganeshan, must worship Ganesh, character level 3, Rahasya racial trait

Benefit(s): You gain an additional rahasya.

Special: A monk may ignore the racial prerequisite as long as he meets all other prequisites in order to select this feat as a monk bonus feat.
feat-grand-recovery:
Ganeshans are masters at expanding upon the use of ki, deriving from multiple resources.

Prerequisite(s): Ganeshan, Intelligence 15, Wisdom 15, ki pool class feature, extra ki, character level 11

Benefit(s): Once per day you may choose to add a number of ki points to your ki pool equal to your intelligence or wisdom modifier, up to your maximum amount of ki. You retain this ki for a number of rounds equal to your character level, after which any unused ki goes away.

Special: A monk may ignore the racial prerequisite as long as he meets all other prequisites in order to select this feat as a monk bonus feat.
feat-great-shaman-fruitable:
Prerequisite(s): Fruitable, shaman alternate racial trait.

Benefits: The fruitable's telepathy range increases to 20 feet, plus 5 feet per 2 Hit Dice the fruitable possesses. This increased telepathy range does not allow the fruitable to see or hear using a creature's senses if they were not in contact with the fruitable. In addition, the fruitable chooses one 1st-level spell from the druid's spell list and may cast that spell once per day as a spell-like ability. Just like the fruitable's other spell-like abilities granted by the shaman alternate racial trait, this spell is treated as being from a fey source for the purposes of the druid's resist nature's lure class feature and similar abilities.
feat-gynosphinx-heritage:
One of your parents was a gynosphinx and you learned how to tap into their magic.

Prerequisite(s): Half-Sphinx, cannot possess any other feat with "half-sphinx" as a prerequisite and "heritage" in it's name

Benefit(s): Once per day you can cast either comprehend languages or see invisibility as a spell-like ability (using your character level as your caster level and your Intelligence as your casting ability score).

You gain 1 additional use of this ability for every 5 character levels you possess.
feat-hand-and-foot:
Your feet are particularly dexterous and thus you are able to manipulate things quite well.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Climb 1 rank, Dexterity 13 or base attack bonus +5 or Monk 5

Benefit(s): You ignore the penalty associated with accelerated climbing on Climb checks.

Normal: You normally suffer a -5 penalty on Climb checks for trying to move at half your speed (rather than one quarter of your speed).
feat-hidden-heritage:
You are able to use your powers to conceal your nature.

Prerequisite(s): Mimicman

Benefit(s): You can, as an immediate action, precisely mimic the physical features of any individual you have encountered, granting you a +10 circumstance bonus on Disguise checks made to fool others with your impersonation, this bonus doesn't stack with other bonuses to Disguise checks, instead only the highest applies. This change lasts until you dismiss it and is a polymorph effect
feat-honorary-bladeling:
Once you are sworn in, you must leave your old culture behind for you are reborn as a proud bladeling warrior!

Prerequisite(s): Non-Bladeling, must have gone through ritual of acceptance

Benefit(s): You count as both your base race and as a bladeling for any effects related to race. For example, if you are a dwarf, you are considered both a dwarf and a bladeling for the purpose of taking traits, feats, how spells and magic items affect you, and so on.
feat-hunter-missile-combat:
You overwhelm your target with a quick move.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Improved Unarmed Strike, Rising Hunter Style, Fly 5 ranks

Benefits: While using this style and successfully attacking a target at a lower elevation than your own with an unarmed strike, reduce their maneuverability by one step and any vertical movement they make with their first move action during their next turn is halved. If you make a charge attack from a position at least 10 feet above a creature, you deal double damage with that attack if you use an unarmed strike.

Special: This feat's benefits apply to light weapons, ranged weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-hunters-obliteration-combat:
Finishing a wounded victim requires an up close and personal touch.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 17, Hunter's Spring, Improved Unarmed Strike, Rising Hunter Style, Fly 7 ranks

Benefits: While using the Rising Hunter Style feat, after moving as a swift action using Hunter's Spring you may choose to have your first successful unarmed strike deal double damage and allow you to hook onto the target. If the target moves, you move with them without provoking an attack of opportunity as though it were forced movement. If you take a move action while hooked onto a target, you may choose to spend any amount of movement in 5 foot increments instead of. The target's next movement has an amount of movement equal to the movement you spent negated. The target may attempt to shake you off as a swift or standard action by making a CMB check against your CMD. If they do so, their movement is not negated. If you choose to move away, you are no longer hooked onto the target and their movement is not negated.

Special: This feat's benefits apply to light weapons and natural weapons.
feat-hunters-spring-combat:
Rise to the occasion.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, Rising Hunter Style, Fly 3 ranks

Benefits: While using this style, you may spend a swift action to move 10 feet into the air if you are on the ground, or to move 5 feet in any direction if you are airborne. If this movement would put you adjacent to an airborne opponent, you may make an unarmed strike against that opponent as a free action. This is in addition to your normal movement and provokes an attack of opportunity from a creature if you leave that creature's threatened area.

Special: This feat's benefit applies to light weapons, ranged weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-improved-erratic-mutation:
Through unforeseen means, you've learned how to perform new and amazing mutations.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe, Con 13, character level 5

Benefit(s): Choose one of the following mutation traits. You gain it in addition to your mutations. You may choose to enhance this mutation too.

Molecular Mending

The Ouphe gains the ability to recover from serious injuries by reshaping its body.

Benefit(s): This mutation grants Godless Healing as a bonus feat. Double all healing done by this ability.

Enhanced: As long as this mutation is enhanced, whenever you use Godless Healing, you may cast restoration on yourself as a spelllike ability and you may use Godless Healing regardless of your remaining hitpoints.

Mystery Might

The Ouphe is granted a stronger frame and improved muscular power.

Benefit(s): This mutation allows the Ouphe to count as one size larger for the purpose of determining CMB and the Ouphe's ability to perform combat maneuvers (for example, an Ouphe with this mutation may perform grapple combat maneuvers against large foes). Enhanced: As long as this mutation is enhanced, the Ouphe counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining CMD and how combat maneuvers affect it.

Mystic Metronome

The Ouphe develops an organ to quickly reproduce spells.

Benefit(s): This mutation grants the Ouphe the Echoing Spell metamagic feat. Enhanced: As long as this mutation is enhanced, recasting spells becomes second nature to the Ouphe, allowing her to cast a spell and the copy granted by Echoing Spell simultaneously as a full-round action.
feat-improved-flawless-complexion:
No blemish, no pain.

Prerequisite(s): Constitution 17, Toughness, cuill

Benefit(s): A cuill reduces the amount of bleed damage he takes each round by his Constitution modifier to a minimum of 0.
feat-improved-pattern-recognition:
You have expanded your pattern recognition skills beyond the regular ability of your race.

Prerequisite(s): Oc'cli; Wisdom 13+; pattern recognition ability.

Benefit(s): You can use your pattern recognition ability one additional time per day and you increase its bonus by 1.

Special: This feat can be taken once for each point of Wisdom bonus you have; its effects stack.
feat-inherent-magics:
From deep within your newly forged soul, you summon forth some of the magic that use to lay within you when you were a magical weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, Character level 5th

Benefit(s): You may give your weapon form a number of magic weapon special abilities equal to 1/4th your character level. You may change which abilities you have via a special ritual that takes eight hours to complete.
feat-ki-efficiency:
Experience with ki usage can lead to more efficient use of certain abilities.

Prerequisite(s): Ki pool class feature and Ganeshan, character level 10

Benefit(s): Select a class ability, qinggong** feat, or rahasya that expends ki as part of its use; you reduce the ki used by one. You may not lower the cost of an ability lower than 1 in this fashion.

Special: A monk may ignore the racial prerequisite as long as he meets all other prerequisites in order to select this feat as a monk bonus feat.
feat-kreyu-conquerer-racial:
Why did the kreyu win all those wars? Big, pointy teeth.

Prerequisite(s): Kreyu, fangs of legacy, BAB +7

Benefit(s): Increase the threat range of your bite attack by 1. This can be multiplied by Improved Critical or the keen enhancement.
feat-laced-finger-blow:
A special technique developed by more dexterous behemoths, this ability makes use of both arms on a side striking in near perfect unison.

Prerequisite(s): Behemoth, base attack bonust +5 or monk 5, Improved Unarmed Strike, Dexterity 15

Benefit(s): When making an unarmed strike with at least 2 arms free you may use them in unison for your unarmed strikes, but doing so has you treated as having one less limb. When making unarmed strikes with those particular limbs in this fashion you deal damage as if you were one size larger.
feat-lord-of-the-fruitable:
And it towered over the fields, lord of all which grew and prospered. The great aplocopenoberrynanacadokin.

Prerequisite(s): Fruitable.

Benefits: The fruitable chooses three fruitable subspecies they do not already possess, gaining their subspecies abilities. The fruitable may use their inconspicuous ability to disguise and hide as a fruit of any of their subspecies.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time a fruitable takes this feat, the fruitable selects three other fruitable subspecies.

Special: This feat may be taken in place of a number of class features, such as alchemist discoveries, fighter combat feats, rogue talents, sorcerer bloodline feats, subject to GM discretion.
feat-magic-ruby:
The magic you learn enhances the natural magic in your horn as your ruby grows.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells, magic horn racial trait, Almiraj

Benefit(s): The enhancement bonus of your magic horn is equal to 1 + 1/2 the level of the highest level spell you can cast (rounded down). Your horn cannot exceed a +5 enhancement bonus.

Normal: Your magic horn has a +1 enhancement.

Example: If you could cast 9th level spells your magic horn would have a +5 enhancement. (9/2 = 4.5, rounded down to 4, +1 = 5).
feat-malicious-mandibles:
Your natural aberrant heritage allows you to spout a gnashing mouth, like a true mimic, and with time a hideous double mouth.

Prerequisite(s): Mimicman, Mimic Object ability

Benefit(s): You gain a 1d6 bite attack while using your mimic object ability.

Special: If you have 5 or more HD you may use your mimic object ability as an immediate action, if you have 10 or more HD you gain an additional bite attack and the damage on each of them improves to a D8.
feat-manticore-tutelage:
Your nemean tail positively bristles with spines, and with some training from your manticore lord you can fire twins spines with frightening accuracy.

Prerequisite(s): Nemean, spine shot racial trait.

Benefit(s): The number of spines you may fire per day improves to your Constitution modifier + 1/2 your character level. Additionally, you may fire up to 2 spines with the same attack action. Both spine attacks are made as primary natural attacks, made against up to 2 targets within 30 feet of one another.

Normal: You may only fire a number of spines equal to your Constitution modifier + 1/4 your character level, and you may only fire 1 spine at a time.
feat-nemean-roar:
You unleash a primal roar to scatter the cowering mice before you.

Prerequisite(s): Nemean, bellowing voice racial trait, Dazzling Display OR wild empathy class feature.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you may make a single Intimidate check against all enemies within 30 feet.

Roll once and compare the result against the DC of each creature. If an affected creature is already shaken, it instead becomes frightened for the duration you would have caused it to be shaken.

Normal: Using Intimidate to demoralize an enemy can't raise their fear level above shaken.
feat-non-violent-self-defense:
The answer is never violence.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to channel positive energy, base attack bonus +1, 1st level divine caster, theck.

Benefit(s): Add +2 to the damage of any attack that deals non-lethal damage.
feat-palm-tree-stance-combat:
You have learned to wield a shield with one of your feet.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Hand and Foot

Benefit(s): You can wield a shield with one of your feet but cannot move while doing so. The shield wielded may not be a tower shield. While in this stance you suffer a -2 penalty to your CMB against trip and bull rush combat maneuvers.
feat-pattern-magic:
Awareness of mystic patterns allows you to wield magic in tune with the universe.

Prerequisite(s): Oc'cli; pattern recognition ability.

Benefit(s): You can use your pattern recognition ability to gain a bonus to concentration checks and caster levels checks made to penetrate Spell Resistance. If you use this ability you add your pattern recognition bonus to damage or healing caused by the spell being cast.
feat-pattern-strike:
When you let the patterns guide your aim, the effects are devastating.

Prerequisite(s): Oc'cli; pattern recognition ability.

Benefit(s): When you use pattern recognition ability to gain bonus to attack roll, the same bonus applies to the damage roll of that attack.
feat-pertifying-horn:
Legend says the horn of an almiraj could petrify a man.

Prerequisite(s): Critical Focus, 11th level, Almiraj, magic horn racial trait

Benefit(s): On a critical hit a creature struck by your magic horn is petrified for 1d4 rounds.
feat-plane-flitter:
You are native of this plane, and have learned much of its peculiarities and customs.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe; must be taken at 1st level

Benefit(s): You gain proficiency with an exotic weapon of your choice and you gain a +1 bonus to all Knowledge skills.
feat-plane-tarrier:
You have just broken into this plane from the Twixt, the place between worlds, and its power still glows within you.

Prerequisite(s): Ouphe; must be taken at 1st level

Benefit(s): As a swift action, you may consider all your mutations as enhanced for 1d3 rounds. You may use this ability a number of times per day equal to your Constitution bonus.
feat-poisoned-spines:
Much like your far-off savage ancestors, your spines have a powerful poison.

Prerequisite(s): Nemean, spine shot racial trait, 7th level.

Benefit(s): When you deal damage to a creature with your spine shot, the target must also save against manticore poison. Elephants, and elephant-esque creatures (GM's discretion), are immune to manticore poison.

Manticore Poison: injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 level + Con modifier; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Str damage; cure 1 save.
feat-predator-whirl-combat:
The vulnerable will become dust in the wind and a faded memory.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Bluff 6 Ranks, Erudite Predator Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, Predator's Cunning

Benefits: While you use this style, you may take an immediate action to do either of the following: make an unarmed strike against a target you attacked since the end of your last turn or reroll an unarmed attack against a target you hit since the end of your last turn and have just missed. Creatures who roll a natural 1 on skill checks or caster level checks within your reach provoke an attack of opportunity from you. If you use the immediate action from this feat after the target provokes an attack of opportunity from you by rolling a natural 1, they take a penalty on their next d20 roll equal to your damage bonus from Erudite Predator Style.

Special: This style's benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-predators-cunning-combat:
Those who are overconfident will be lost in the pain you give.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Bluff 3 Ranks, Erudite Predator Style, Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefits: While using this style, you gain a bonus on damage rolls equal to highest number of attacks any opponent missed you with the previous round against any opponent who missed you in the previous round.

A creature within your reach who rolls a natural 1 on an attack roll (even on a critical confirmation roll) provokes an attack of opportunity from you.

Special: This style's benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-quad-grip:
Though you are only medium-sized, your powerful arms allow you to treat yourself as a larger creature.

Prerequisite(s): Behemoth Grip, base attack bonus +10

Benefit(s): You count as being one size category larger for the purpose determining what size weapon you can wield if you grip it with multiple arms. If you are a medium creature you can wield a one-handed weapon sized for a large creature in three hands or a two-handed weapon sized for a large creature in four hands with no penalty. You do not gain the benefit of the Behemoth Grip feat while using multiple arms to grip a weapon of a large size category than you could wield without this feat.
feat-rising-hunter-style-combat-style:
Beware of death from above.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Improved Unarmed Strike, fly or glide speed, Fly 1 rank

Benefits: You grow adept at fighting while flying with certain weapons and gain more options while flying and using this style. You may move up to 5 feet after making an attack while flying as part of a full-round action, provided you remain within the target of your last attack's reach. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. If the target is killed, knocked unconscious or loses their threatening reach somehow, you can't take a 5 foot step. This 5 foot step may be made in a vertical direction if you are on the ground. You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls against airborne targets while on the ground, and a +1 bonus on attack rolls against creatures on the ground when in the air.

Special: This feat's benefit applies to light weapons, ranged weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-ritualistic-bone-shield:
By practicing certain dietary habits and soaking their bone shield in ritualistic liquids a cuill's bone shield can become as solid as steel and feintly magical.

Prerequisite(s): Proficiency with heavy armor, base attack bonus +3, cuill

Benefit(s): The bonus from the cuill's bone shield racial trait improved by +1 (total of +3). Additionally, a cuill's bone shield may be enchanted as if it were a heavy steel shield.
