Finally, a cuill's bone shield counts as a shield for the purposes of feats and abilities (shield bashing for example). When shield bashing with it, a cuill may treat this as a natural weapon.
feat-ruthless-predator-combat:
When you find a small opening, tear it big enough to walk through.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Bluff 6 Ranks, Erudite Predator Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, Predator's Cunning

Benefits: While you use this style, you gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls with your unarmed strikes for every previous consecutive hit against any opponent in the same round. Creatures who roll a natural 1 on a saving throw within your reach provoke an attack of opportunity from you.

Special: This style's benefit applies to finessable weapons, light weapons, and natural weapons.
feat-sharding-vajra:
Prerequisite(s): 5th level stormbound

Benefit(s): When the vajrin confirms a critical hit with their Vajra veil, or if a creature fails their Reflex saving throw against its Hands bind effect with a natural 1, it leaves behind shards of electrified crystalline akasha in the affected creature. These shards cause such a creature to take 1 point of magical slashing damage and 1 point of electricity damage at the start of each of their turns. The damage from the storm power ignores any electricity resistance, electricity immunity, or damage reduction a creature might possess unless the damage reduction is adamantine, — or epic. This damage can be ended early with a successful DC 15 Heal check or through the application of any spell or magical effect that cures hit point damage. The damage from this storm power stacks with itself up to a number of points of each type of damage equal to the vajrin's veilweaving modifier.
feat-skewering-aegis-style-combat-style:
A wall protects, but also breaks bones.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, BAB +1, Shield Focus

Benefits: While using this style, you gain an additional +1 shield bonus to AC when wielding a one-handed weapon and a shield.
feat-skyguard:
You have trained with the skyguard, elite thaun warriors skilled at aerial combat.

Prerequisite(s): Thaun, base attack bonus +5, Fly 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your attack rolls made while flying. This bonus also applies to melee damage rolls against creatures on the ground while you are flying.
feat-slakar-charger-racial:
What's worse than being charged down by a slakar? Being charged down by three slakar on triceratops.

Prerequisite(s): Slakar, BAB +6, protected charge

Benefits: After successfully hitting an opponent with a charge attack, you grant yourself and up to two adjacent allies a +2 shield bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. This bonus stacks with an existing shield bonus, but only increases it by +1 unless the creature has made a charge attack.
feat-snowcaller:
There are those among the erqigdlet that learn to channel their mystical connection to the tundra.

Prerequisite(s): Erqigdlet, frozen presence racial trait, must be at least character level 5

Benefit(s): Erqigdlet may use the frozen presence ability to deal damage in a 10 foot burst a number of times per day equal to their character level and the damage of their ray of frost increases to 1d6. They may consume an additional use to do either of the following; increase the range of this ability by +10 feet per character level or increase its damage by +1/2 character level.
feat-soul-sheath:
Drawing on the magic inherent to the ritual that gave you a body, you can create a sheath of spiritual energy around your fits that resembles your weapon form.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, base attack bonus +1

Benefit(s): The arma may, as a move action, grant his unarmed strikes the weapon profile of his weapon form. Changing back is a move action as well; in the case of a ranged weapon the arma may fire his ranged weapon as though he were wielding it. If your weapon form is a ranged weapon you must still provide ammunition.
feat-spiked-shifting:
Prerequisite(s): Bladeling, wild shape class feature

Benefit(s): When you use your wild shape class feature you retain the armor spikes from your spiked skin racial trait. The damage of the armor spikes scales with the size of the creature you shift into.

Special: If you have the Honorary Bladeling feat this applies to any armor spikes you wear.
feat-spine-mutation:
By tapping into your ancestry you can force yourself to grow a handful of spines per day that you can launch from your body.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6

Benefit(s): You can grow 1d6 spines per day, after resting for 8 hours, on your shell. They may be drawn and thrown as if they were javalines that are stored in an easily accessible place. A tarrasqueling with the feat may never have more than 6 spines at one time. These spines do not increase the weight of the tarrasqueling.
feat-sticky-situation:
You can sometimes secrete a dangerous adhesive similar to what more traditional mimics use to ensnare prey.

Prerequisite(s): Mimicman

Benefit(s): You are treated as if you had the adhesive armor quality (Pathfinder: Ultimate Equipment). The mimicman may use the abilities of this armor quality a number of rounds per day equal to 2 + your character level. This otherwise functions just like the adhesive armor quality. When making or receiving and attack that is an unarmed strike or natural melee attack you may make a grapple attempt against them as an attack of opportunity that doesn't provoke attacks of opportunity. Using this ability to grapple consumes 2 rounds of your adhesive armor quality.
feat-surefooted-nomad:
Your years of wandering have granted you a sure foot.

Prerequisite(s): Gaoth, Acrobatics 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You may ignore the first 5 feet of difficult terrain you encounter per turn and treat it as if it were normal terrain. This allows you to charge through at least 5 feet of difficult terrain.
feat-swarming-strike:
You have much more proficiency manipulating your swarm body, and this proficiency grants you a swarm attack.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, mannequin

Benefit(s): As a full round action, the mannequin can make a single swarm attack against all adjacent creatures. The damage from a mannequin's swarm attack is treated as though it were a swarm with an HD equal to the mannequin's class level -2. (As indicated on Table: Swarm Damage by Size in the Pathfinder Core Rulebook).
feat-taste-the-air:
Darting your sensitive tongue in and out of your mouth, you gain information about the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Mihia, Perception 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain the scent universal monster ability with a 30 foot range
feat-terramor-flier-racial:
Take to the skies!

Prerequisite(s): Terramor, Fly 9 ranks

Benefits: You gain a fly speed of 30 feet with good maneuverability. The bonus to Fly checks from you maneuverability does not stack with that of glide.
feat-thaun-fencing:
The art of the olak and splick are the traditional fencing weapons of the thaun.

Prerequisite(s): Thaun or Two-Weapon Fighting.

Benefit(s): You become proficient in both the splick and the olak.
feat-thought-before-movement:
The ganeshan monks have mastered the art of minimalist dodging and deflection.

Prerequisite(s): Ganeshan, monk level 3, Intelligence 15

Benefit(s): You may choose to apply your Intelligence modifier (instead of your Dexterity modifier) to your Armor Class. This bonus is lost if you are wearing any armor or shields. You may spend two points from your ki pool to also apply your Intelligence modifier (instead of your Dexterity modifier) to initiative and reflex saves for 24 hours, however doing so makes you treat your total ki pool as 2 points smaller for the purposes of all effects until 24 hours has passed.

Special: A monk may ignore the racial prerequisite as long as he meets all other prerequisites in order to select this feat as a monk bonus feat.
feat-three-heads-are-better-than-one:
You have the qualities of a goat, a dragon, a lion, a snake, and person- that gives you a lot of insight into a lot of minds.

Prerequisite(s): Dai'Chi.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 insight bonus on all Charisma based skill checks against goats and goat-like creatures, dragons and dragon-like creatures, lions and lion-like creatures, snakes and snake-like creatures, and chimeras and chimera-like creatures.
feat-town-mandragora:
You were a town's golem crafter.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Construct, free homunculus

Benefits: A free homunculus may create constructs in 1/4th the normal amount of time.
feat-transferred-spell-metamagic:
You can cast certain spells of someone who wields you in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, caster level 11th, ability to cast spells

Benefit(s): An arma who casts a spell with a range of personal modified with this feat may cast that spell on his wielder.

Level Increase: +3 (a transferred spell uses up a spell slot three levels higher than the spell's actual level). Spells that do not have a range of personal do not benefit from this feat.
feat-tyrannic-exchange-combat:
Tooth for a tooth. A blow for a blow.

Prerequisite(s): Str or Dex 15, August Tyrant Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +3

Benefit(s): When a creature you threaten successfully attacks you while you are using this style, you may make an attack against that creature as an immediate action after the triggering attack is resolved.

Special: This feat's benefit applies to two-handed weapons and natural attacks.
feat-tyrant-crush-combat:
All who oppose you fall before your might.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, August Tyrant Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +3

Benefit(s): When making a single attack as a standard action while using this style, your target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + ½ character level + Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. Creatures taking an AC penalty from August Tyrant Style take that same penalty to this Fortitude save, and creatures with a size modifier to CMB apply that modifier to their save.

Special: This feat's benefit applies to two-handed weapons and natural attacks. This feat's benefit may be applied to any attack you make as a standard action.
feat-tyrant-rave-combat:
The bones of your prey will form your throne.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, August Tyrant Style, Tyrant Crush, BAB +6

Benefit(s): While you are using this style, your attacks against a creature who damaged you since the end of your last turn or prone creatures deal double the bonus damage from August Tyrant Style. If you apply the AC penalty from August Tyrant Style to a creature, it is instead a -2 penalty to AC if you were using Power Attack.

Special: This feat's benefit applies to two-handed weapons and natural attacks.
feat-unpleasant-surprise:
You can strike an unaware target in an instant.

Prerequisite(s): Mimicman or mimic

Benefit(s): You may make an attack of opportunity against a creature that enters your threatened area, provided that they were not aware of your presence when they did so.
feat-vritra-slayer:
Prerequisite(s): 3rd level stormbound

Benefit(s): The vajrin is especially skilled at fighting vritra and creatures that share its nature. The vajrin gains a +2 insight bonus on Bluff, Knowledge, Perception, Sense Motive, and Survival checks against creatures with the dragon type or the akashic or aquatic subtypes. They also get a +1 insight bonus on weapon attack and damage rolls against such creatures. At 5th level and every 5 stormbound levels thereafter this insight bonus increases by+1.
feat-wandering-parts:
Although commonly disjointed, some marionettes attain a level of cohesion that allows them to control wayward limbs.

Prerequisite(s): Constitution 16, marionette

Benefit(s): For a number rounds per day equal to your Constitution score, you can treat dismembered limbs as dancing weapons. Dismembered limbs modified in this fashion use the damage profile of a club. In addition, a marionette that has lost his head is no longer blind as long as there is line of sight between his head and the rest of his body.
feat-war-and-peace:
Si vis pacem, para bellum ("If you want peace, prepare for war")

Prerequisite(s): Thaun, Knowledge (history) 3 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Diplomacy checks made to sway an opponent's attitude during combat.
feat-weapon-soul:
Though you have a humanoid form, your soul is still made of steel.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, Weapon Focus in weapon form, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): You gain the benefits of Weapon Specialization with the weapon your weapon form is patterned after, and you can use your character level in place of your fighter level for the purpose of qualifying for feats that benefit a specific weapon, such as Greater Weapon Focus and Greater Weapon Specialization. You can use this feat instead of Weapon Specialization to qualify for such feats.
feat-weaponized-spell:
While in your weapon form you can cast spells.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, Inherent Magics, Character level 5th, ability to cast spells

Benefit(s): While in weapon form you may cast spells without their verbal and somatic components and you may even use any material components or focuses you possess, even though such items are melded within your current form. Spells cast in this manner take one action type greater than normal (a swift becomes a standard, a standard becomes a full round, etc.) spells with a casting time of more than one full round action cannot be cast in this manner. Spells cast in this manner do not provoke attacks of opportunity.
feat-winters-cold-embrace:
The erqigdlet have a strong mystical connection with snow and winter, which can permeate their magic.

Prerequisite(s): Erqigdlet

Benefit(s): When dealing fire, acid, electricity or sonic damage via a spell or class feature, the erqigdlet can opt to instead deal an equal amount of cold damage instead.
feat-wisdom-of-the-wielded:
You may bolster the magics inherent to your former state.

Prerequisite(s): Arma, Inherent Magics, Character level 11th

Benefit(s): You gain any number of intelligent item powers with a cost totaling no more than 2,000 gp per character level you possess. You may only utilize these powers while in weapon form, and you may change them in the same manner as you would with the Inherent Magics feat. Special: You may take this feat one additional time, if you do you may add an additional 500 gp per character level to the amount of intelligent item abilities you may possess.
feat-artistic-appreciation:
No one appreciates an artist.

Prerequisite(s): Artist's inspiration class feature, Craft (any) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): When in the presence of one item you created with the Craft skill of at least masterwork quality or a value over 100 gp, you may switch your artistic inspiration from one technique to another as a swift action.

Special: At 13th level, you may switch your artistic inspiration as an immediate action.
feat-deific-casting:
Prerequisite(s): Must possess the deity type, must be able to cast spell-like abilities, and must have a divinity score of at least 19

Benefit(s): Gods with this power may cast one spell-like ability they possess as a swift action each turn.
feat-extra-technique:
You have learned a new technique to further express your skill at your discipline.

Prerequisite(s): Technique class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional wandering artist technique. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this technique.

Special: You can gain Extra Technique multiple times. Each time you must select a different technique.
feat-inspire-design:
You can inspire greater imagination within your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Inspiration class feature, Craft (any) 5 ranks

Benefit(s): A wandering artist may spend 1 round of inspiration to grant a creature a +4 circumstance bonus on a Craft check. This may only be used on a Craft check that falls under the purview of a Craft skill you have at least 5 ranks in. Spending the inspiration is a swift action and the bonus remains for 1 minute per wandering artist level, but is consumed upon the first Craft check the subject attempts during this time. This may be used on any willing creature.
feat-legendary-magic:
Prerequisite(s): 22 or more HD, the ability to cast spells, may not be a player character

Benefit(s): Creatures with this feat are capable of magic far greater than that of mere mortals. Their magic is either so expertly crafted or conjured with such raw power that resisting them is nearly impossible. The DCs of spells or spell-like abilities cast by this creature increase by 10.
feat-mightier-than-the-sword:
Through understanding the world, you understand the movements and motives behind combat.

Prerequisite(s): Artist's inspiration class feature.

Benefit(s): You may spend 1 round of inspiration to improve your effective BAB while you maintain this technique. Your BAB improves by +1 for every 3 levels of wandering artist you possess, to a maximum of +6 at 18th level, for as long as you maintain this technique.

Special: This enhanced BAB grants you extra attacks. It cannot be used to qualify for feats.
feat-blood-in-the-air:
A scarlet death flies on iron wings.

Prerequisite(s): summon flying blade class feature, carnage class feature.

Benefit(s): You may deliver reaping strikes with your flying blades. Additionally, you may treat bladestorm levels as blood knight levels when determining the bonus damage dealt by reaping strikes.
feat-divine-astra:
You imbue your deity's aura into your flying blades, conjuring magnificent divine armaments.

Prerequisite(s): summon flying blade class feature, worship a deity, either domain class feature, Weapon Focus (deity's favored weapon), or blessing class feature.

Benefit(s): When you create a flying blade that matches your deity's favored weapon, it counts as a weapon aligned to match the alignment of your deity (so lawful good deity would create a lawful- and goodaligned flying blade). Additionally, you may treat it as a holy symbol of your deity.
feat-extra-bladestorm-dance:
Prerequisite(s): dance class feature.

Benefit(s): You learn a dance. You must meet all the prerequisites for the dance as normal.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times; each time it grants a different dance.
feat-extra-necrosis:
Prerequisite(s): necrosis pool class feature.

Benefit(s): The maximum value of your necrosis pool increases by your Intelligence modifier.

Special: This feat can be taken more than once. Its effects stack.
feat-pale-as-death:
Prerequisite(s): deathly pallor class feature.

Benefit(s): Select a deathly pallor you qualify for. Add deathly pallor to the list of effects you can choose from when you use necrosis shroud.

Special: You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, select a new deathly pallor.
feat-pallor-shift:
Prerequisite(s): deathly pallor class feature, necroknight level 9th.

Benefit(s): While you have temporary hit points granted by necrosis shroud, as a move action you may change the benefit granted by your deathly pallor class feature.

Normal: After you use necrosis shroud, you cannot change your selected deathly pallor benefit while you have temporary hit points remaining.
feat-selective-burst:
Prerequisite(s): necroburst class feature, Intelligence 13.

Benefit(s): When you use your necroburst class feature, you may select any number of creatures, up to your Intelligence modifier. These creatures are not affected by your necroburst.

Normal: Necroburst affects all creatures within the area.
feat-sorcerous-blade:
You have learned how to charge a flying blade with a spell, using it to deliver the arcane payload.

Prerequisite(s): summon flying blade class feature, either caster level 3rd or spellstrike class feature.

Benefit(s): You may deliver touch spells via a flying blade as though it was your familiar. This functions as the familiar's deliver touch spell ability.
feat-unique-creative-strike:
Prerequisite: Creative strike class feature.

Benefit: You can use your creative strike class feature with crossbows, firearms (but not siege weapons), and other ranged weapons properly sized for you which would not normally be able to used with the creative strike class feature. In addition, this feat is treated as Point- Blank Shot for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of feats and prestige classes.
feat-esotery-sculptor:
You have expanded your talents at shaping flesh towards the shaping of inorganic matter as well.

Prerequisite(s): Sculpting touch class feature

Benefit(s): Your sculpting touch works on all forms of creatures, dealing its full damage and subjecting them to a Will save as if they were formed of flesh. Additionally, you can use your sculpting touch on inanimate objects. When targeting a held, worn, or wielded item, you target the touch AC of the creature utilizing the object, and that creature makes the Will save for the object. When an affected object fails its Will save, it gains the broken condition instead of the normal conditions applied by your sculpting touch. If the item is also under 50% HP, and thus would naturally have the broken condition, the penalties from the broken condition are instead doubled.

Additionally, your skill with warping inanimate objects has granted you the ability to utilize your skill to craft esoteric and magical items. You may use your promethean level in place of your caster level when qualifying for crafting feats (such as Craft Magic Arms and Armor or Craft Wondrous Item) and may use your promethean level in place of your caster level when crafting magical items. You must still follow all other rules for crafting items, as normal.
feat-essence-honed-flesh-akashic:
Investing your own flesh with your essence allows you to hone your skin to act as a potent magical armament.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13 or veilweaver level 1

Benefit(s): Your unarmed strikes and natural attacks are always imbued with the remnants of your essence, allowing them to count as magical weapons for the purposes of bypassing damage reduction. Additionally, you can invest essence in this feat. For each point of essence invested, you gain a +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls with your unarmed strikes and natural attacks. Special: Unlike normal essence receptacles, this feat has its own essence capacity progression that cannot be increased or modified. Its essence capacity is 1 at character level 1, and increases by an additional 1 at character levels, 4, 8, 12, and 16. If an ability would allow you to invest essence in another receptacle in place of this feat, such as the Akashic Knowledge forbidden knowledge, that essence receptacle uses this essence capacity when interacting with this feat. If an ability would allow you to treat this feat as if it were invested with more essence, or allow you to bypass this feats essence capacity, its effects are limited to this feats essence capacity.

You gain 1 point of essence.
feat-savage-flurry:
You have adapted your natural weapons to a fighting style focused more on number of attacks than precision.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6, one primary natural attack

Benefit(s): You can use one of your primary natural attacks in place of a manufactured weapon when making a full attack. If you have the two-weapon fighting feat, you can use a second primary natural attack in place of your off-hand manufactured weapon as well. Using your natural attacks in this way grants you all the benefits and penalties of making a full attack with a manufactured weapon, such as iterative attacks and their associated penalties, penalties for two-weapon fighting, causing other natural attacks to become secondary attacks, etc. The natural attacks you use as part of this feat count as light weapons for the purposes of two-weapon fighting. When using only one natural attack as a manufactured weapon using this feat, it is treated as a two-handed weapon when determining its damage (such as with the Power Attack feat, or when adding your Strength modifier to its damage). When using two natural weapons with this feat, your off-hand natural attack does not have its damage reduced while being used as an off-hand weapon.
feat-empathic-diplomat:
You have long followed the path of common sense and empathic insight when using diplomacy.

Benefit You modify your Diplomacy checks using your Wisdom modifier, not your Charisma modifier.
feat-inferno-torch:
Your blazing torches burn hotter than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro blazing torch special torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): Your blazing torches inflict an extra 1d8 fire damage, instead of 1d4. At 14th level, this improves to 2d6, and at 18th level, it improves to 2d8. Also, creatures with light blindness or light sensitivity are affected by your blazing torches as if they were daylight spells.
feat-cunning-torch-and-steel:
Opponents are bemused by your unorthodox torch and steel fighting style and are unused to defending against it.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, Catch Off-Guard, Two-Weapon Fighting.

Benefit(s): When you fight with a simple, martial or exotic (non-torch) melee weapon in one hand and a torch in the other hand, opponents often overlook your torch as a threat. On the first round that you attack a target, you gain a +2 bonus on all attack and damage rolls with your torch and your torch inflicts x3 damage on a critical hit. The damage bonus only applies to the torch bludgeoning damage, not torch fire damage. This feat applies every time you engage a new target for the first time, but it only works once per combat on each opponent. This ability has no effect against other pyros. The benefits of this feat cannot be combined with sneak attacks, if the pyro has sneak attack from another class or ability. A pyro with sneak attack must choose to either use this feat or the sneak attack on the first round of engagement.
feat-divine-fire:
Your pyro skills synergize with and fuel your faith.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, ability to cast 1st-level divine spells, Chaos, Destruction or Fire domain (or any fire subdomain) or oracle flame mystery.

Benefit(s): You count half your pyro levels as cleric levels for determining which domain granted powers you can use and their effects. For example, a cleric 3/pyro 6 counts as a 6th-level cleric when using the Fire domain fire bolt power, and also gains the domain's fire resistance power. These benefits apply to only one domain which you must select when taking this feat.

If you are an oracle, you count half your pyro levels as oracle levels for determining how many flame revelations you get and the effectiveness of their powers. For example, a flame oracle 2/pyro 2 counts as a 3rd-level oracle for determining revelations, and so has two Flame revelations instead of one. When using a Flame revelation power, he counts as a 3rd level oracle.

Special: If you have levels of both cleric and oracle, this feat applies to only one of those classes. The choice must be made upon taking the feat, and cannot be changed.
feat-double-torch-strike:
Striking the target with your torch multiple times, you can inflict terrible burns.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, Dex 17, Torch Weapon Mastery base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): If you hit an opponent with your melee torch attack at least twice in the same round, you deal an additional 2d6 points of fire damage (or cold damage for witchlight torches). You can only deal this additional damage once each round.
feat-extended-form-of-the-dragon:
You can assume dragon form for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Dragon class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your Form of the Dragon ability increases to three minutes per level, instead of one minute per level.
feat-extended-form-of-the-mythical-beast:
You can assume mythical beast form for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Mythical Beast class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your Form of the Mythical Beast ability increases to five minutes per level, instead of one minute per level.
feat-extended-giant-form:
You can assume giant form for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Giant Form class feature.

Benefit(s): The duration of your Giant Form ability increases to three minutes per level, instead of one minute per level.

Special: This feat can only be taken once.
feat-extra-favored-form:
You are adept at assuming more effective forms than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter favored form class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an extra favored form.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new form.
feat-extra-form-of-the-dragon:
You can assume dragon form more often than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Dragon class feature, base attack bonus +9.

Benefit(s): You may use your Form of the Dragon ability two additional times per day.
feat-extra-form-of-the-mythical-beast:
You can assume mythical beast form more often than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Mythical Beast class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): You may use your Form of the Mythical Beast ability two additional times per day.
feat-extra-form-power:
You gain an additional form power.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter form power class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional form power.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time, a different form power must be taken.
feat-extra-giant-form:
You can assume giant form more often than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Giant Form class feature, base attack bonus +11.

Benefit(s): You may use your Giant Form ability two additional times per day.
feat-extra-pyro-talent:
Through constant practice, you have learned another special pyro trick.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro talent class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain one additional pyro talent. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this pyro talent.

Special: You can take Extra Pyro Talent multiple times.
feat-extra-shapechange:
You can assume animal and magical beast form more often than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter shapechange class feature, base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): You may use your shapechange ability two additional times per day.
feat-extra-special-torch-attack:
You are particularly gifted and have learned an additional pyro special torch attack.

Prerequisite(s): Special torch attack class feature, knowledge of at least one pyro special torch attack.

Benefit(s): You learn another pyro special torch attack, provided you meet the prerequisites.
feat-extra-special-torches:
You are extremely adept and efficient at making special pyro torches.

Prerequisite(s): Special torch class feature.

Benefit(s): You can create three additional special torches per day.

Special: You can take Extra Special Torches multiple times. Its effects stack.
feat-flaming-weapon-master:
You are skilled with flaming weapons and are able to ignite opponents with them.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): When you hit an opponent with a weapon that you are proficient with and that has the flaming or flaming burst property, you re-roll all ones on fire damage caused by the weapon, and you have a chance to ignite the target. The chance is the same as your chance to ignite targets with your pyro melee torch attack. Ignited targets suffer the same ignited fire damage as they would from your torch attack. If you have the immolation pyro special torch attack, targets are immolated when ignited by your flaming weapon.
feat-greater-natural-weapon-focus:
Choose one type of natural attack (bite, claw, slam, gore, etc.) for which you have already selected Weapon Focus. You are a master of this attack.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form class feature. Weapon Focus with selected natural attack, base attack bonus +1, 8th-level shapeshifter.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls you make using the selected natural attack. This bonus stacks with other bonuses on attack rolls, including those from Weapon Focus.
feat-improved-favored-form:
One of your favored forms is more powerful than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Favored Form class feature.

Benefit(s): Select one of your favored forms to apply this feat to. All your favored form bonuses (Dex or Con bonus, skill bonuses, and favored terrain bonuses) are doubled when you assume this form. Once selected, the chosen form cannot be changed. However, if you swap the chosen favored form for another favored form due to leveling up, you may apply this feat to a different favored form.
feat-improved-form-of-the-dragon:
You may assume more powerful dragon forms than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Dragon class feature.

Benefit(s): You count as two levels higher for determining which forms of the dragon you can assume, their powers, and how long they last. This feat does not increase the number of times per day you can assume dragon form.

Special: This feat stacks with Extended Form of the Dragon.
feat-improved-form-of-the-mythical-beast:
You may assume more powerful mythical forms than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Form of the Mythical Beast class feature.

Benefit(s): You count as three levels higher for determining which forms of the mythical beast you can assume, their powers, and how long they last. This feat does not increase the number of times per day you can assume mythical beast form.

Special: This feat stacks with Extended Form of the Mythical Beast.
feat-improved-giant-form:
You may assume more powerful giant forms than normal.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Giant Form class feature.

Benefit(s): You count as two levels higher for determining which giant forms you can assume, their powers, and how long they last. This feat does not increase the number of times per day you can assume giant form.

Special: This feat stacks with Extended Giant Form.
feat-inquisitors-fire:
Your zeal for hunting your faith's enemies allows you to transform pyro torch fire damage into holy/unholy damage and empowers your inquisitor judgements.

Prerequisite(s): Inquisitor judgement class feature, pyro torch attack or special torch attack class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a new "Inquisitor's Fire"judgement. When using this judgement, half your fire damage from pyro torch attacks and special torch attacks is transformed into holy damage (or unholy damage, depending on your alignment) against outsiders and divine casters opposed to your alignment (good vs. evil), and undead. Neutral inquisitor/pyros must choose which type of opposed alignment this ability affects (good or evil) upon taking the feat, and once the choice is made, it cannot be changed. The holy damage is not subject to being reduced by resistance to fire-based attacks. In addition, you count half your pyro levels as inquisitor levels for determining the daily number of uses of all your inquisitor class judgement abilities. For example, a pyro 4/inquisitor 2 would count as a 4th level inquisitor for determining daily judgement uses.
feat-master-fire-breather:
You have mastered the ability to breathe fire through your torches, and can do so with great effect.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro fire breather special torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): Your fire breather special torch attack ability inflicts 1d8 points of damage per two levels, instead of 1d6, and has a 50% chance to ignite targets that fail their save, as if they had been ignited by your torch melee attack. You may also now imbibe the volatile alchemical liquid as a free action instead of a move action, though spitting the fire still requires a standard action.
feat-master-imbuer:
When you use your special torch ability to imbue a weapon with the torch's power, the weapon remains imbued for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Any pyro special torch attack class feature that can be used to imbue a weapon (e.g., blazing torch, sparking torch, thundering torch, witchfire torch, etc.), base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): When you use one of your special torches to imbue a weapon with its power, the duration of the imbuement is doubled. For example, when a 4th level pyro with this feat uses a blazing torch to imbue a weapon with the flaming ability, the weapon remains flaming for four minutes, instead of two minutes. Normally, a weapon remains imbued for only one minute per two pyro levels. In addition, you can now use a swift action to imbue a weapon. Normally, imbuing a weapon requires a standard action.
feat-master-immolator:
Your experience settings thing on fire has taught you how to ignite targets for maximum effect, to ensure the flame spreads rapidly.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro immolation special torch attack class feature, Torch Weapon Mastery or Master of Arson.

Benefit(s): Your immolation special torch attack ability inflicts d6 additional damage per round instead of d4 (e.g., 1d6, 2d6, 3d6, etc.) and the immolation lasts for five rounds, inflicting 5d6 damage on the fifth round with a +5 to the extinguish DC.
feat-master-of-arson:
You have mastered the art of setting things ablaze.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): Once per day, plus one additional time per two pyro levels, when you hit with a pyro torch attack, special torch attack or another pyro ability that has a chance of igniting the target, you may choose to automatically ignite the target, even if you did not roll high enough to do so. For attacks which may ignite multiple targets at once, such as sparking torch, you may automatically ignite more than one target, but each additional target counts toward your maximum daily uses.
feat-natural-attack-specialization:
You are skilled at dealing damage with one type of natural attack.

Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter level 6th.

Benefit(s): Choose one type of natural attack (bite, claw, slam, gore, etc.). You gain a +2 bonus on all damage rolls with the selected natural attack when using your Shapechange, Form of the Mythical Beast, Form of the Dragon, or Giant Form abilities.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Its effects do not stack. Each time you take the feat, it applies to a new type of natural attack. This feat does not stack with the Weapon Specialization feat.
feat-searing-burns:
Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): When a target is ignited by any of your pyro abilities, it suffers terrible pain and must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your pyro level + your Intelligence or Dexterity modifier, whichever is higher) or it counts as sickened as long as it remains ignited, and for 1d4 rounds after the fire dies out or is extinguished. A target only has to make one save per round, regardless of how many times you ignite it in a single round. Any effect that removes sickening will stop the pain. Creatures that are immune to pain or critical hits are not affected, nor are those that take no fire damage due to energy resistance or immunity.
feat-searing-critical:
Your searing critical hits cause system shock.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, Torch Weapon Mastery, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): Whenever you score a critical hit with a lit torch and the target takes fire damage, the target is severely burned (or frostbitten for witchlight torches) and takes 2d6 damage per round from life threatening system shock. System shock works like a bleed effect, but the damage comes from continually worsening shock instead of bleeding. System shock can be stopped by a successful DC 15 Heal skill check or through the application of any magical healing. The effects of this feat stack. Undead, constructs, elementals and creatures that take no fire or cold damage from the attack (due to energy resistance or immunity) are immune to the system shock damage.

Special: You can only apply the effects of one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
feat-supreme-fire-breather:
Your fire breathing ability is terrifyingly deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro fire breather special torch attack class feature, Master Fire Breather, base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): Your fire breather special torch attack ability inflicts 1d10 points of damage per two levels and the fire cone increases to 25 ft.
feat-supreme-immolator:
Your immolation ability has reached a near-fatal level.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro immolation special torch attack class feature, Master Immolator.

Benefit(s): Your immolation special torch attack ability inflicts d8 additional damage per round (e.g., 1d8, 2d8, 3d8, 4d8, 5d8).
feat-torch-weapon-mastery:
You have acquired deadly skill when using a torch as a bludgeoning weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): Increase the amount of bludgeoning damage dealt by your torches by one step (for example, 1d3 becomes 1d4, 1d4 becomes 1d6, etc.). Your torch now has a critical threat range of 19–20, with a critical multiplier of ×2.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each time, it increases the base bludgeoning damage dice of your torches by one step (to a maximum of 1d8), but it does not increase the threat range. However, it does not further increase the damage bonus. This feat does not stack with Improvised Weapon Mastery or Improved Critical. The improved threat range doesn't stack with any other effect that expands the threat range of a weapon.
feat-blood-conversion:
You can channel your own living blood to power your blood powers.

Prerequisite(s): Non-undead, cruomancer level 1st.

Benefit(s): Any time that you would spend blood points, you may choose to take 1 point of Constitution damage instead of spending 1 of those blood points, allowing you to activate abilities requiring blood points even when you don't have any, or to spend more blood points than you are capable of having in your blood point pool at any given time. Because the source of the power comes from the lost vitality, any effect that prevents this Constitution damage causes this effect to fail, although the Constitution damage can be healed normally later without consequence.
feat-novice-cruomancer:
You have learned some of the secrets of blood magic.

Prerequisite(s): Must not have a cruomancer level.

Benefit(s): You gain a cruomancer level equal to 1/2 your Hit Dice, and a blood point pool with a maximum number of blood points equal to your cruomancer level. Further, you learn how to drain blood from living creatures in order to gain blood points. This functions as the Vampire's Bite feat, except that you must have a dagger or similar light weapon that deals piercing or slashing damage, and you do not count as possessing the Vampire's Bite feat for the purposes of anything that requires that feat as a prerequisite (you can still take Vampire's Bite separately).
feat-shang-gou-mastery-combat-style:
You rend apart for foes with hooked blades.

Prerequisites: Shang Gou Specialization, Shang Gou Training, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6.

Prerequisites (monk): Shang Gou Specialization, Shang Gou Training, monk 6.

Benefit: Once per round, when you hit a target with two shang gou attacks with your primary and off-hand, you may rend the target for an additional 1d6 + 1-1/2 times your strength modifier damage.

Special: If you possess the Two-Weapon Rend feat you may gain the benefits of each feat once per round; however, each rend must be made on a separate set of attacks.

Note Weapon style feats function the same as unarmed style feats except that they require the user to wield one or more specific weapons.
feat-shang-gou-specialization-combat-sty:
You are capable of lashing out with linked shang gou and leaving vicious wounds in your opponents.

Prerequisites: Shang Gou Training, base attack bonus +4 or monk 4.

Benefit: When attacking with a single—or paired—shang gou, its critical modifier increases to ×3.

When attacking with a pair of linked shang gou, your natural reach increases by 5 feet for the attack.

Note Weapon style feats function the same as unarmed style feats except that they require the user to wield one or more specific weapons.
feat-shang-gou-training-combat-style:
You use combat maneuvers to create an opening for a quick attack.

Prerequisites: Weapon Focus (shang gou), base attack bonus +2 or monk 2.

Benefit: Once per round, when you successfully disarm or trip an opponent with a shang gou, they provoke an attack of opportunity from you. This attack must be made with another light weapon or an unarmed strike. Additionally, when you wield two shang gou they gain the performance weapon quality.

Note Weapon style feats function the same as unarmed style feats except that they require the user to wield one or more specific weapons.
feat-shang-gou-whirlwind-style-combat-st:
You become a whirlwind of deadly spinning blades and stunningly graceful movements.

Prerequisites: Shang Gou Specialization, Shang Gou Training, Improved Two-Weapon Fighting or monk 8.

Benefit: As a swift action, you can switch from standard shang gou style to the shang gou whirlwind style. While fighting in this style you may treat a pair of linked shang gou as a double weapon with the reach quality.

Special: While fighting in this style, you cannot gain the benefits of the Shang Gou Mastery feat or the increased critical modifier of the Shang Gou Specialization feat.

Note Weapon style feats function the same as unarmed style feats except that they require the user to wield one or more specific weapons.
feat-almighty-resilience:
Prerequisite(s): (Aasimar)

Benefit(s): You gain lightning resistance equal to your radiant resistance of 5 + 1/2 your level.
feat-angelic-bearing:
Prerequisite(s): 21st level, aasimar

Benefit(s): While you are not bloodied, attackers take a -2 penalty to attack rolls against you.
feat-cover-scent:
The perfumes you create cover other more suspicious odors.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (alchemy) 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You can create contact poisons with a pleasant odor. The DC to detect the poison as a trap increases by +2.
feat-creation-tongue:
Prerequisite(s): 11th level, aasimar

Benefit(s): You can speak Supernal so that listeners understand your words as if spoken in their native language. You can use make whole without a ritual book and can master rituals from the creation category without ever needing a ritual book to perform them.
feat-god-killer:
Fighting against the followers of cults and religions has made you savvy to the ways of divine spellcasters and unholy monstrosities.

Prerequisite(s): Human, Knowledge (religion) 4 ranks, no divine spellcasting ability

Benefit(s): Your racial bonus to saving throws against divine spells and effects increases by +1, and you gain a +1 bonus to melee attack and damage rolls against anyone with divine spellcasting ability. As a full-round action, you may make a single melee attack against a divine spellcaster and gain an attack and damage bonus equal to the highest-level spell that the caster currently has prepared.

This bonus supersedes—and does not stack with—the normal +1 bonus granted by this feat. If the target currently has no divine spells (or no spells above level 0) prepared, you gain no bonus from this special attack, but you can still gain the normal +1 attack and damage bonus on regular melee attacks.

Special: If you ever gain divine spellcasting ability, you lose the benefits of this feat.
feat-improved-rally:
Your ability to rally others makes you a natural leader of men.

Prerequisite(s): Human, Diplomacy 4 ranks or Intimidate 4 ranks

Benefit(s): When you use your rally racial ability, your skill check counts as a new Will saving throw for every ally—except yourself—within 30 ft. Allies must still be able to hear you, as normal. This effect functions only on allies who failed a Will save since your last turn.

Normal: Your rally racial ability affects one ally.
feat-insightful-rapture:
Prerequisite(s): Aasimar

Benefit(s): You can use Streetwise passively whenever you enter a settlement to immediately learn about the community. You can also make one Streetwise check during each rest within a settlement.
feat-love-of-knowledge:
You pursue philosophia, the love of knowledge.

Prerequisite(s): Human, any Knowledge skills 4 ranks total

Benefit(s): You may make untrained Knowledge skill checks, even if you do not have any ranks in the Knowledge skill, regardless of the DC of the skill check. Once per day per four character levels (minimum of once per day), you may ruminate on a subject for 2 minutes in order to take 20 on a Knowledge skill check. As usual, you may only take 20 if you are not under stress or threat and have uninterrupted time to consider the question.

Normal: You may only make untrained Knowledge skill checks if the DC is 10 or less. You may not take 20 on Knowledge skill checks.
feat-pinpoint-shot:
Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): You gain a damage bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier when attacking with a bow or crossbow at ranges up to 30 ft. This bonus does not stack with any other ability modifier to damage such as the Strength bonus granted when using a composite bow.
feat-prescient-focus:
Prerequisite(s): Aasimar

Benefit(s): You only take a -2 attack penalty for targeting a bloodied foe with superior cover or total concealment instead of the normal -5 attack penalty.
feat-prophetic-intuition:
Prerequisite(s): 11th level, aasimar

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 feat bonus to passive Insight checks. When you make an Insight check, roll twice and use the higher result.
feat-restorative-hands:
Your lay on hands ability can heal more than just injuries.

Prerequisite(s): Lay on hands 2d6, Extra Lay on Hands

Benefit(s): After rolling the damage to be healed by your lay on hands ability, you may opt to reduce this amount in order to heal the target of ability damage or drain. For every 2 points you spend in this manner, you may heal the target of 1 ability damage. For every 4 points, you may heal 1 ability drain. Any remainder of the damage is applied normally.
feat-revitalizing-hands:
Your lay on hands ability is so potent that you can even return lost life force.

Prerequisite(s): lay on hands 6d6, Extra Lay on Hands, Restorative Hands

Benefit(s): In addition to the benefit of your Restorative Hands feat, you may also reduce the amount to be healed by your lay on hands ability in order to remove temporary or permanent negative levels from the target. For every 5 points, you may remove 1 temporary negative level the target possesses and for 10 points you may remove 1 permanent negative level.
feat-sublime-denial:
Prerequisite(s): Aasimar

Benefit(s): You can use your angelic defiance ability against attacks that target your Fortitude or Will defense, but the bonus that lasts until the end of your next turn only applies against the triggered defense score.
feat-tengu-mimicry-general:
Prerequisite(s): Tengu, Linguistics 6 rank

Benefit(s): You can recreate any sounds of the surrounding environment with perfect clarity and detail, as well as street noises, animal calls, natural sounds (such as wind or leaves), and voices with accents in any language that you can speak.

When duplicating a specific person's voice, you must make a Bluff check; creatures familiar with the voice being imitated make opposed Sense Motive checks against your Bluff. You receive a +2 competence bonus if you have spoken with the imitated person for at least 30 minutes.
feat-tengu-temple-watcher-general-combat:
Prerequisite(s): Tengu, BAB +4, Perception 6 ranks

Special: You must have been hired and charged by an elder to protect a specific sacred site, temple, shrine, or religious group.

Benefit(s): As a temple watcher, you gain a +1 bonus to all attacks, a +2 bonus on saves against enchantments, and a +4 bonus to Perception checks when made within 300 ft. of the temple, religious event, or holy site you have been charged with protecting. A tengu fighter may take this as a class bonus feat.
feat-the-nose-knows:
You know a perfume by its scent.

Prerequisite(s): Craft (perfume) 7 ranks

Benefit(s): You can determine the type and ingredients of any perfume that you can smell (Craft (alchemy) DC 20).

You can also use this check result to determine the perfume's maker as if you had made a Diplomacy skill check to gather information about an individual.
feat-necrotic-spell-metamagic:
By expending multiple lower level spells, you can fuel a single, higher level spell.

Prerequisites: Knowledge (arcana) 4 ranks, Spellcraft 4 ranks, Spell Focus (necromancy).

Benefit: You can expend multiple spell slots or prepared spells to power a single, higher-level spell. The combined spell slots or prepared spells expended must equal or exceed the level of the higher-level spell you wish to cast. Any unused spell level energy is wasted.

This allows you to cast an additional prepared or known spell of that higher level, even if you have exhausted your spells per day for that spell level. It does not allow you to cast a spell of a level you cannot normally cast. Casting a spell in this way requires more time than a regular spell. If the higher level spell's normal casting time is a standard action, the siphoned spell instead takes a full-round action to cast. A siphoned spell with a longer casting time requires an additional full-round action to cast.
feat-siphon-spell-metamagic:
Your spells are more effective against corporeal undead.

Prerequisites: Spell Focus (necromancy).

Benefit: You treat corporeal undead that were once humanoids as humanoids for the purposes of determining which of your spells affect them. In addition, you may affect any corporeal undead creature with mind-affecting spells, regardless of its Intelligence score. A necrotic spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell's actual level.
feat-improved-martial-focus:
Your commitment to the martial arts rivals that of even the most fearsome fighters.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +5, Martial Focus

Benefit: Choose one fighter weapon group. While wielding a weapon from this group with which you are proficient, you gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls. When your base attack bonus reaches +9, and every 4 points thereafter, this bonus and the bonus granted by the Martial Focus feat increase by +1.

Special: The Improved Martial Focus feat counts as the weapon training class feature with the chosen fighter weapon group. Your weapon training bonus is equal to the bonus granted by this feat.
feat-acrobatic-greater:
You are much more adept at your leaping and tumbling.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatic, Acrobatics 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): You are able to leap, fall, and tumble more adeptly than your peers. You increase the bonus provided by the Acrobatic feat by 2. Additionally, you treat any fall as 20 feet shorter. This stacks with other reductions to effective fall height.
feat-ascetic:
You have honed your mind to gain control over your body.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 12, Iron Will.

Benefit(s): You are strong of mind and body and are able to push your needs back in your mind. You gain a +1 bonus to Fortitude and Will saves. Additionally, you require half the amount of food, water, and sleep than normal people of your ancestry. To prepare or regain spells, you still need to take the requisite time.
feat-beloved-by-the-world:
You are favored by the spirits of the world and can prepare a small number of spells from other elements that compliment your attuned element.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13 or higher, ability to cast 1st-level geomancer spells.

Benefit(s): In lieu of preparing a spell from your attuned element whenever you regain your daily geomancer spells, you may instead prepare a spell of equal spell level from a complimentary element to your attuned element. You may only prepare 1 spell for each spell level you are capable of casting in this way. Below are the complimentary elements for each of the five elements.

• Earth: complimented by Fire or Metal.

• Fire: complimented by Wood or Earth.

• Metal: complimented by Earth or Water.

• Water: complimented by Metal or Wood.

• Wood: complimented by Fire or Water.

Special: If your attuned element is Blood or Void, in lieu of preparing a spell from your attuned element whenever you regain your daily geomancer spells, you may instead prepare a spell of equal level from the divination, runescribing, or universal arcane schools (the spell cannot belong to any one of the 5 elements above). You may only prepare 1 spell for each spell level you are capable of casting in this way.
feat-cosmic-clarity:
You can grant someone a temporary boon that stems from the whispered mutterings of the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment and Cosmic Soul Expert.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic clarity ability.

Once per day, as a standard action, you may touch a target creature to grant them one of 24 the following benefits of their choice for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD: a combat feat or a number of skill ranks into one skill equal to their ability score modifier for that chosen skill.

The target creature must meet any prerequisites for the combat feat gained in this way and they cannot exceed the normal maximum number of skill ranks allowed for any skill based on their HD. If a combat feat granted by cosmic clarity has a daily use limitation (such as Stunning Fist), any use of that combat feat by the target creature counts towards its daily limit for that creature.

A creature can only be under the effects of one use of cosmic clarity at any given time.

Special: You may expend 2 ki points or 2 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic clarity. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic clarity in this way once for every 4 HD you possess.
feat-cosmic-cycling:
You can grant someone a temporary boost that stems from your continued research into the harmony between body and spirit.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, and Cosmic Guidance.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic cycling ability.

Once per day, as a standard action, you may touch a target creature to grant them the following benefit. The target creature may use their highest ability score at the time in lieu of one of their lower ability scores of their choice. Once this choice is made, the effect lasts a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD. This modifies accordingly all statistics and checks related to ability scores, with the following exceptions:

•

• Hit Points: hit points gained in this way are treated as temporary hit points instead.

• Skills and Spells: skills ranks and bonus spell slots do not change.

• Other: daily uses or frequency for any ability, feat, or effect the creature possesses do not change.

A creature can only be under the effects of one use of cosmic cycling at any given time. Certain statistics from optional rules may not be affected by this ability, subject to the GM's discretion.

Special: You may expend 4 ki points or 4 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic cycling. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic cycling in this way once for every 6 HD you possess.
feat-cosmic-guidance:
You can gain a brief boost over your fate, empowered by your deep insights into the cultivation of spiritual power.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, and Cosmic Clarity.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic guidance ability.

Once per day, as a free action, whenever you make a d20 roll, you may add a bonus equal to 1/2 your HD to the result. You can only use this ability on the roll before you learn if the roll is a success or not.

Special: You may expend 3 ki points or 3 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic guidance. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic guidance in this way once for every 5 HD you possess.
feat-cosmic-soul-expert:
Through your natural talent and hard work, your projected consciousness continuously delves deeper to reveal more secrets of the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Wis 18, Cosmic Soul Adept, and 13 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the divine senses ability.

Except as described below, your divine senses otherwise function as cosmic senses from the Cosmic Soul Adept feat (including sharing the same daily uses and how to regain a daily use).

Your activated cosmic senses, now known as divine senses, have evolved to collect additional information and perceive the world with greater insight. While your divine senses are active, you may spend a swift action to gain the benefits of analyze aura on a number of observed targets equal to your Wisdom modifier.

Unlike analyze aura, the auras you can read on a target require a minimum number of ranks in Spellcraft (see below). You gain the additional information from all unlocked upgrades simultaneously on all of your selected targets for the round. Each upgrade is a sensory acuity usable with your divine senses.

•

• 13 Ranks: You can read the target's "magic aura."

• 14 Ranks: You can read the target's "alignment aura."

• 15 Ranks: You can read the "emotion aura." The circumstance bonus from reading the target's emotion aura is instead equal to your HD when making Sense Motive skill checks related to the target (up to 1 hour after reading the target's emotion aura).

• 16 Ranks: You can read the "health aura."

• 17 Ranks: You can read a new aura known as the "mind aura." Reading a target's mind aura functions as if you have a constant detect thoughts spell in effect and have spent 3 rounds concentrating on the target. A target can resist this effect each round with a successful Will save (DC 10 + effective spell level of your divine senses + your Wisdom modifier). Unlike reading the other auras, you can only read the mind aura of one of the targets you selected each round with divine senses in this way.
feat-cosmic-strike:
Reaching one of the peaks of cultivation knowledge, you learned a terrifying heavenly technique to strike at a creature's soul directly.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, Cosmic Suppression, and 17 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic strike ability.

Once per day, as a standard action, you may make a melee touch attack on a target creature. On a successful hit, the target creature must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failure, they suffer 1d4 temporary negative levels for 24 hours (these negative levels cannot result in permanent level loss).

For each such negative level you bestow in this way, you gain 5 temporary hit points that stacks with any other temporary hit points for one hour and you gain either a +1 bonus to your caster level or a +1 bonus to your attack rolls for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD.

A creature can only be under the effects of (or benefit from) one use of cosmic strike at any given time.

Special: Due to your understanding of the harmony between body and spirit, the negative levels bestowed by this ability cannot benefit an undead creature (or any creature with negative energy affinity), harming them in the same way as a negative level would usually affect a living creature.

Special: You may expend 6 ki points or 6 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic strike. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic strike in this way once for every 11 HD you possess.
feat-cosmic-suppression:
Your mastery of spiritual arts paves the way to leveraging the inner workings of body and spirit to cause a drastic imbalance in another creature.

Prerequisite(s): Any neutral alignment, Cosmic Soul Expert, Cosmic Cycling, and 15 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit(s): You have unlocked the cosmic suppression ability.

Once per day, as a standard action, you may make a melee touch attack on a target creature. On a successful hit, the target creature must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Wisdom modifier). On a failure, the target is forced to use their lowest ability score in lieu of any one of their other ability scores of your choice. Once this choice is made, the effect lasts a number of rounds equal to 1/2 your HD. See Cosmic Cycling for how statistics and checks are affected in this manner.

A creature can only be under the effects of one use of cosmic suppression at any given time.

Special: You may expend 4 ki points or 4 daily uses of your 1st-level power from an arcane school, elemental school, or domain to regain your daily use of cosmic suppression. You may only regain your daily use of cosmic suppression in this way once for every 7 HD you possess.
feat-cultivation-prodigy:
You are a generational prodigy, able to seamlessly use your spiritual energies fluidly among the various learned spiritual traditions you learn.

Prerequisite(s): Int, Wis, or Cha 13+, character level 5th, and at least two separate classes you possess that grants you ki pool, jutsu pool, mettle, or resolve.

Benefit(s): You pool together the levels in all classes you possess that grant you points to a ki pool, jutsu pool, mettle, or resolve ability to determine the total number of points in the combined pool, but only one of the associated mental ability score modifiers is added to the total. The choice of which ability score to use is made when you take this feat; it cannot be later changed.

You use the points from this combined pool to power any of your class abilities, feats, or spells that use points from ki pool, jutsu pool, mettle, or resolve.
feat-defensive-throw-combat:
You have learned techniques to use your opponent's momentum against them.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Improved Unarmed Strike, and Improved Trip.

Benefit(s): If an opponent misses you with a melee attack, you can use an attack of opportunity to attempt to trip them.
feat-extra-spiritual-boon:
You gain another boon from a spirit.

Prerequisite(s): Spiritual boon.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional spiritual boon. However, you still cannot choose a spiritual boon more than once.

Special: You can choose this feat multiple times but you must choose a different spiritual boon each time.
feat-friendly-fire-maneuvers-combat-self:
You and your teammates can anticipate one another's ranged attacks and stay out of each others' way.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot.

Benefit(s): Allies cannot provide soft cover to enemies, allowing you to make attacks of opportunity against an enemy even if those allies grant you soft cover against that foe's attacks. If an ally casts a spell that targets the area you are in as it allows a Reflex saving throw to avoid the effect (such as fireball), you gain a +4 dodge bonus on that saving throw.
feat-friendly-rivalry-combat-selfless-te:
You stoke your allies to fight harder when glory is on the line, egging them on to victory in single combat before your own.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): If you're the only one threatening a foe and an ally within 30 feet is the only creature threatening a different foe, your ally gains a +2 morale bonus on melee attack rolls against the foe that only they are threatening. Your allies gain this bonus only if neither of the qualifying opponents is flat-footed, helpless or otherwise unable to act. Your allies must be able to see you in order to gain the benefits of this feat. If another ally who is not threatening the chosen foes makes any sort of attack against said foes (such as a ranged attack or a spell), your allies lose this feat's benefit for 1 round. Multiple allies can benefit from this feat at once, so long as they meet all other prerequisites.
feat-giantslaying-team-combat-selfish-te:
When a giant attempts to hit your ally, that giant unwittingly reveals an opening in her defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +4, defensive training ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever a foe with the giant subtype you threaten misses with an attack of opportunity against an ally, you can make a melee attack against that giant as an immediate action.
feat-got-your-back-selfless-teamwork:
You protect an ally from attacks they don't see coming.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise.

Benefit(s): If you successfully use the aid another action to give an ally a +2 bonus to AC against an opponent's next attack, the ally is also not considered flanked or flat-footed against that opponent until the beginning of your next turn.

Normal: You can use aid another to grant an ally a +2 bonus to AC against the next attack from an adjacent foe.
feat-group-deliver-touch-spells-selfless:
Your teammates can deliver touch spells through your familiar.

Prerequisite(s): Group Shared Spells, must have a familiar with the share spells and deliver touch spells abilities.

Benefit(s): Your allies can cast spells through your familiar as though your ally had the share spells ability with your familiar. This feat otherwise functions as the share spells ability.
feat-group-shared-spells-selfish-teamwor:
You and your allies can cast spells through each other's familiars as if they were your own.

Prerequisite(s): Familiar with the share spells ability.

Benefit(s): Your allies can cast spells with a target of "you" on your familiars as touch spells. Both the target familiar and that familiar's master must be willing for the spell to take effect. Your allies can cast spells on your familiar even if the spells would not normally affect creatures of the targeted familiar's type.
feat-hammer-guards-the-anvil-selfless-te:
You cover your allies when their guard is down.

Benefit(s): Creatures threatened by you cannot make attacks of opportunity against your allies when they pick up an item from the ground, retrieve a stored item, sheathe a weapon, or stand up from prone.
feat-harder-they-fall-combat-selfless-te:
You can work with an ally to move or knock over a foe that's too large for either of you to overcome alone.

Prerequisite(s): Str 13, Int 13, Combat Expertise, Power Attack.

Benefit(s): When you use the aid another action to grant an ally a +2 bonus on a bull rush or trip combat maneuver check, the ally can attempt that maneuver even against foes two or more size categories larger than herself.
feat-harrying-partners-combat-teamwork:
Your movements perfectly synchronize with your ally's to greater effect.

Prerequisite(s): Any teamwork feat, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When you successfully use the aid another action to improve the Armor Class or attack roll of an ally, the benefit from aid another lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Normal: The bonus granted by aid another either grants your ally a +2 bonus on her next attack roll against an opponent or grants your ally a +2 bonus to AC against that opponent's next attack made before the beginning of your next turn.
feat-high-magic-focus-selfish-teamwork:
With the help of your fellow scholars, you can cast higher forms of magic, enhancing your spells by drawing upon their magical reserves rather than your own.

Prerequisite(s): Any metamagic feat, Spellcraft 7 ranks, ability to cast 2nd-level spells, human.

Benefit(s): With the help of allies, you can spontaneously apply metamagic feats to your spells without using a higher-level slot or increasing the casting time. Each ally must ready an action to cast the same spell you intend to cast. For each ally within 30 feet who does so, you reduce the cost of the spontaneous metamagic feat by 1 level (to a minimum of 0, and you must have at least one ally assist you, even if the metamagic feat is normally a +0 adjustment). The allies don't need to have the metamagic feat you choose to apply, and the effective level of the spell (after applying the metamagic feat) can't be higher than the highest level of spells you can cast. Lastly, when you use this ability, the spell each ally readies is lost, as if they had cast that spell.
feat-horde-charge-selfless-teamwork:
Your energy during a charge is infectious, making their charges more deadly.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, half-orc or orc.

Benefit(s): When charging an enemy, your allies gain a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls in addition to the normal bonus for charging if they charge as well this turn. If they can make multiple attacks on a charge, this bonus only applies to the first attack.
feat-improved-back-to-back-selfless-team:
After much practice, you and an ally have become adept at fighting in close proximity to one another.

Prerequisite(s): Back to Back, Perception 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): While you are adjacent to an ally who is flanked, you can spend a swift action to grant your ally a +2 bonus to AC against all flankers until the start of your next turn.
feat-improved-disarm-partner-combat-self:
You are ever the opportunist.

Prerequisite(s): Disarm Partner, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): When an ally fails a disarm combat maneuver check made on his turn against a foe that's within your melee reach, you can make an attack of opportunity against that foe. If that attack of opportunity hits the foe, you can also attempt a disarm combat maneuver check against that opponent as part of that attack of opportunity.
feat-improved-duck-and-cover-selfless-te:
Your ability to protect your ally from damage extends to area attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Duck and Cover.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use Duck and Cover, your ally is treated as having evasion or improved evasion if they already have evasion. If your ally's saving throw roll succeeds, half of the damage they would have taken is transferred to you. (This damage is not reduced by the ally's evasion or improved evasion.)
feat-improved-feint-partner-combat-selfl:
Knowledge of your companions' tricks and techniques allow your allies to take even greater advantage of your feints.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank, Combat Reflexes, Feint Partner, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully feint against an opponent, that opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from your ally.
feat-improved-outflank-combat-selfless-t:
You can easily find openings in your enemies' defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Outflank, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are threatening the same foe, your ally is considered to be flanking that foe if they are adjacent to an unoccupied square from which they would be able to flank the foe with you.

Normal: Your ally must be positioned opposite you to flank an opponent.
feat-improved-precise-strike-combat-self:
Your precise timing and smooth teamwork allow your allies to strike a foe where it hurts.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Precise Strike, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever your ally deals additional damage with Precise Strike, they also deal 1 point of bleed damage. This bleed damage does not stack with itself.
feat-improved-spell-sharing-teamwork:
Your link with your companion creature allows you to share your magic with it.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to acquire an animal companion, eidolon, familiar, or special mount.

Benefit(s): When you are adjacent to or sharing a square with your companion creature, you can cast a spell on yourself and divide the duration evenly between yourself and the companion creature. You can use this feat only on spells with a duration of at least 2 rounds. For example, you could cast bull's strength on yourself, and instead of the spell lasting 1 minute per level on yourself, it lasts 5 rounds per level on yourself and 5 rounds per level on your companion.

Once the spell is cast, you and the companion creature can move farther apart without ending the effect.
feat-improved-swap-places-combat-teamwor:
When you switch places with your comrade, your sizes don't matter.

Prerequisite(s): Swap Places.

Benefit(s): When you and your ally use Swap Places, your ally can be up to one size larger or smaller than you, and your movement into the ally's square does not provoke an attack of opportunity. If your ally cannot fit into the space you had been occupying and there are no available adjacent squares to accommodate the rest of the ally's space, the ally must squeeze. Alternatively, as part of its movement, the ally can attempt a bull rush combat maneuver against a creature that occupies a space your ally would occupy, but this bull rush cannot move the creature more than 5 feet.

Normal: Using Swap Places requires you and your ally to be the same size, and your movement into the ally's square provokes attacks of opportunity.
feat-improved-underhanded-teamwork-comba:
You and your allies have trained together long enough to know how to exploit an opponent's disadvantage to make her predicament even worse.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Dirty Trick, Underhanded Teamwork, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally performs the dirty trick combat maneuver against a foe that you both threaten, you may attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver against the same foe as an immediate action to inflict a second condition. If the foe uses an action to remove the first condition, it also removes the condition imposed by your immediate action.
feat-inspiring-talent-selfish-teamwork:
Your innate adaptability allows you to imitate others of your kind nearly flawlessly, to the extent that you can utilize their mastery over skills almost as if you had personally trained in their use.

Prerequisite(s): Half-elf, adaptability or ancestral arms ancestral traits.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 30 feet of an ally, you gain the following benefits. If the ally has a Skill Focus feat, you also count as having that feat for the purpose of the following skill uses: Acrobatics checks to move through threatened squares, Bluff checks to feint, Escape Artist checks to escape a grapple, Intimidate checks to demoralize, Knowledge checks to identify a monster, and Perception checks to notice a creature using Stealth. Furthermore, if the ally has a weapon proficiency gained through the ancestral arms ancestral trait, you also count as having that weapon proficiency.
feat-intercept-charge-combat-teamwork:
You can get in the way of an opponent charging your ally.

Benefit(s): When an opponent charges your ally, as an immediate action you can move up to your speed toward any square in the path of the charge. If you end your movement in the path of the charge, the opponent must stop when it becomes adjacent to you and then attack you instead of your ally. Your movement from using this feat counts toward your movement on your next turn.
feat-interweave-composite-blast-combat-t:
You can combine your blasts with those of another kineticist.

Prerequisite(s): Kinetic blast class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 15 feet of another character, you can ready an action to activate a simple blast of your choice. When that character unleashes a simple blast, yours is triggered, creating a composite blast for which the two simple blasts meet the prerequisites. The composite blast's caster level is equal to the average of the caster levels of both participants and deals damage as the appropriate composite blast created by a kineticist of that level (for example, if a 10th-level pyrokineticist and a 6th level hydrokineticist worked together to create a steam blast, its base damage would be 4d6+4 points of fire damage and 4d6+4 points of bludgeoning damage).
