One participant can provide a form infusion appropriate for the composite blast, and the other can provide an appropriate substance infusion. Each participant accepts the burn cost for the infusion they provide. The participant who didn't take the special ready action can apply a metakinesis to the blast, and they are the only one who can gather power to reduce the blast's cost (since only they have a move action to take prior to the blast). However, whatever metakinesis they apply affects the entire composite blast.

If the two participants aren't adjacent to each other, the origin point of cones, lines, and other effects that normally originate from a character's square instead originate from a point in the square located halfway between the two participants in a straight line (where the two simple blasts meet and form the composite blast).

The blast uses the Constitution modifier of whoever provided the substance infusion and the Dexterity modifier of whoever provided the form infusion. If the blast includes only one infusion, the blast uses the Constitution or Dexterity modifier of the kineticist who supplied that infusion, as appropriate for the infusion provided. If no infusions are used, the two kineticists choose one of them to provide the Dexterity modifier, and the other provides the Constitution modifier.
feat-joined-wings-selfless-teamwork:
You have developed a deep rapport with your comrades that allows you to swiftly convey divine grace.

Prerequisite(s): Fervor or lay on hands class feature.

Benefit(s): You can use your lay on hands or the healing granted by fervor on allies as a swift action.
feat-juju-way-teamwork:
You can use spirits of the unseen world to carry your spells for you.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (religion) 3 ranks, human.

Benefit(s): You can cast spells with the range of "touch" at a range of 20 feet if the recipient is a willing ally of the same culture.
feat-last-stand-phalanx-selfish-teamwork:
When battling the terrifying hordes of enemies, you find strength in your shield brothers and sisters.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +3, good alignment.

Benefit(s): You grant a sacred bonus to your adjacent allies AC against the attacks of evil creatures and a sacred bonus to saves against the spells and abilities of evil creatures equal to the number of adjacent allies who also have this feat including yourself.
feat-linnorm-hunter-coordination-combat-:
You are adept at working with your animal companion to strike the same location and deal increased damage.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Dex 13, Dodge, Linnorm Hunter Retreat, Linnorm Hunter Style, base attack bonus +6, must have or be an animal companion.

Benefit(s): When you and an ally are using Linnorm Hunter Style and threatening the same target, you can make a single melee attack at your highest base attack bonus against that target as a full-round action. If your attack is successful, you deal extra damage with this feat equal to the damage of one of your ally's natural attacks. This damage treats as if being successfully hit by your allies natural attack, and provides all concurrent benefits (poison, trip, etc.). This extra damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.

Special: Animal companions with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 can take this feat.
feat-linnorm-hunter-retreat-combat-selfl:
You and your animal companion have learned to cover each other in combat.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, Dex 13, Dodge, Linnorm Hunter Style, base attack bonus +4, must have or be an animal companion.

Benefit(s): When you use Linnorm Hunter Style and hit a target with a melee attack, your ally can move 5 feet as an immediate action without provoking an attack of opportunity from that target.

Special: Animal companions with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 can take this feat.
feat-linnorm-hunter-style-combat-selfles:
You and your animal companion work together to make coordinated strikes against your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, must have or be an animal companion.

Benefit(s): Once per round while using this style, when you hit a target that both you and your ally threaten using a melee attack, your ally gains a +2 bonus on attacks of opportunity made against that target for 1 round. Enemies that provoke attacks of opportunity from you also provoke attacks of opportunity from your ally so long as they threaten them (even if the situation or an ability would normally deny you the attack of opportunity).

Special: Animal companions with an Intelligence score of 1 or 2 can take this feat.
feat-living-fortress-selfless-teamwork:
Stubborn, tenacious, and proud, you're all but immovable when you have kin to back you up.

Prerequisite(s): Dwarf, hardy ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you fight defensively and you're adjacent to an ally, your allies' ancestral bonus on saving throws against spells and spell-like abilities increases by 2. If they do not have them, they are treated as having an initial ancestral bonus of +0.
feat-lookout-selfless-teamwork:
Your allies help you avoid being surprised.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally may act in the surprise round as long as you would normally be able to act in the surprise round. If your ally would normally be denied the ability to act in the surprise round, their initiative is equal to your initiative roll or the roll of your ally –1, whichever is lower. If both you and your ally would be able to act in the surprise round without the aid of this feat, your ally may take both a standard and a move action (or a full?round action) during the surprise round.
feat-loyal-to-the-death-selfless-teamwor:
You're so loyal to your family or friends that you're willing to suffer for them.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): Whenever an opponent makes a melee or ranged attack against one of your allies who is adjacent to you, you can spend an immediate action to shield the ally with your own body. You become the target of the attack, and the opponent gains a +4 bonus on their attack roll. For the purpose of determining distance, cover and concealment, you count as being in your ally's square when the attack is resolved. If the attack misses you due to concealment, blink, or a similar effect, it instead targets your ally as if you had not used this feat's ability.
feat-magical-dedication:
You have devoted some of your energies to improving the meager spellcasting you have gained.

Benefit(s): You change the 4-level spellcasting you possess, like those from a ranger or paladin, to be more potent and available earlier. Your caster level increases to your class level. The new progression table, for both prepared and spontaneous, is given below. This does not affect 6-level or 9-level spellcasting progression, nor does it work for 4-level casters with 'arcanist-style' spell progression.

For 0-level spells, you treat spells from the nearest 9-level or 6-level spellcasting class as your 0-level spell list.

For example, a paladin would gain a cleric's orisons and a bloodrager would gain a magus's cantrips. Your GM has final say on which class's 0th-level spells you gain.

For levels marked with a '0', you only gain spells of that level if you would gain them by having bonus spells from your spellcasting ability score.
feat-metamagical-synergy-coven-teamwork:
You and the other members of your coven can weave your spells together to great effect.

Prerequisite(s): Allied Spellcaster.

Benefit(s): If all three coven members cast the same spell in the same round, you can combine your efforts, resolving the spell only on the last member's initiative. The effects of the spell are resolved only once, but the coven can apply one of the following metamagic feats without altering the spell slot used: Empower Spell, Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Maximize Spell, or Widen Spell. Casters do not need the appropriate metamagic feat to apply it via this feat. The synergy spell resolves using the caster level, save DC, and other modifiers of the caster of the coven's choice. The spell does not apply other metamagic feats unless all three members included the same feat in their casting. This ability cannot be used if the chosen metamagic feat would normally alter a spell to use a spell slot above 9th level.
feat-mirror-kin-teamwork:
Combining your cunning with illusion magic makes you and your allies nearly indistinguishable.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 8 ranks, gnome, gnome magic ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to any gnome allies, your appearance and mannerisms change into an amalgam of the features of you and your allies, making you and your allies look exactly alike. Your shapes occasionally appear to blend into each other, making it impossible to distinguish you and granting you and any affected allies a 20% miss chance due to concealment. This is an illusion (figment) effect.

Spells and effects that don't require an attack roll, such as area spells, affect you normally. An attacker must be able to see and reach both you and your ally to be fooled. If you're invisible or the attacker is blind, the feat has no effect. Because this feat relies on the fact that both you and your ally are blending together to create the visual illusion, it doesn't function with effects like the inquisitor's solo tactics class feature. If you have more than one adjacent ally with this feat, this feat applies to all allies who qualify.
feat-my-blade-is-yours-combat-selfless-t:
You fight with seamless grace alongside your allies, complementing the inherent strengths of your weaponry.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, Sense Motive 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): When adjacent to an ally and wielding a weapon with the blocking, disarm, distracting, or trip weapon special feature, your ally can treat their own weapon as if it also had that feature. If your weapon has more than one of those features, your ally can choose one feature to emulate at the start of their turn.
feat-mystical-reverberation-selfless-tea:
Your ritualistic training has taught you to join in with the magic of others.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to spontaneously cast spells.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, select an ally who can spontaneously cast within 30 feet and select a metamagic feat you have. If that ally doesn't have the selected metamagic feat, she can modify a spell she casts before the end of her next turn with that metamagic feat. The spell is modified as normal, except it uses a spell slot 1 additional level above the normal spell level modification for that metamagic feat.

If the selected ally does have the metamagic feat you select, they can instead use that feat to modify a spell they cast before the end of their next turn without increasing the spell's casting time.
feat-one-mind-selfish-teamwork:
Your nearly supernatural mental connection with your allies keeps you in a constant state of readiness.

Prerequisite(s): Alertness, Sense Motive 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to an ally who is not flat-footed, you're also not considered flat-footed before you act in combat (you might become flat-footed in other ways, however). Additionally, if your ally can see a creature that you can't see, that creature doesn't gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls against you from being invisible, nor do you take a –2 penalty to AC for being blinded if your ally can see.
feat-open-up-combat-selfless-teamwork:
You pull an opponent's shield, opening your foe up to an unobstructed attack by an ally.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise.

Benefit(s): When you successfully use the aid another action to improve the next attack roll against an opponent by an ally, that attack also ignores any Armor Class bonus granted by the opponent's shield. This benefit affects only physical shields, not shield bonuses from spells or other sources.

Special: If you also have the Harrying Partners teamwork feat, all of your ally's attacks made before your next turn ignore the opponent's Armor Class bonus from a shield.
feat-out-of-the-sun-selfless-teamwork:
You and your allies use the sun's glare to your advantage.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 3 ranks, Stealth 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you hit with a melee attack, you can attempt a Bluff check as a move action to feint. You do not gain the benefits of this feint; instead, if you succeed at your Bluff check, an ally who is adjacent to you or your opponent gains the benefits, such that the opponent is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any) against your ally's next melee attack against that opponent. This attack must be made before the end of your ally's next turn. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your Bluff check in bright light. This bonus increases to +4 in natural sunlight. You cannot use this feat in dim light or darkness.

Special: If you have the Improved Feint feat, you can feint with Out of the Sun as a swift action after you hit with a melee attack.
feat-outflank-teamwork:
You look for every edge when flanking an enemy.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are flanking the same creature, your ally's flanking bonus on attack rolls increases to +4. In addition, whenever you score a critical hit against the flanked creature, it provokes an attack of opportunity from your ally.
feat-overwhelm-combat-selfless-teamwork:
You know how to lead others to overwhelm large foes with sheer numbers.

Benefit(s): Your allies are considered to be flanking an opponent if you are threatening that opponent and the opponent is at least two size categories larger than the larger of you or your ally, regardless of your actual positioning.

Normal: You must be positioned opposite an ally to flank an opponent.

Special: Animal companions may take this feat if it knows the Flank Trick.
feat-pack-attack-combat-selfless-teamwor:
You are skilled at surrounding your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When you are adjacent to an ally, the first time you melee attack an opponent, your ally can spend an immediate action to take a 5-foot step, even if they have otherwise moved this round.

Normal: You can take a 5-foot step only if you have not otherwise moved in a round.

Special: Animal companions may take this feat.
feat-pack-flanking-teamwork:
You and your companion creature are adept at fighting together against foes.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, ability to acquire an animal companion.

Benefit(s): When you and your companion creature are adjacent or sharing your square, and you both threaten the same opponent, you are both considered to be flanking that opponent, regardless of your actual positioning.

Normal: You must be positioned opposite an ally to flank an opponent.
feat-pack-intimidation-combat-teamwork:
You draw on the strength of numbers and your shared convictions to intimidate your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc, intimidating ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever your allies use the Intimidate skill to demoralize foes, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your check for every ally within 30 feet who also uses Intimidate this turn. Whenever you use Intimidate all allies within 30 ft. receive a +2 circumstance bonus on any intimidate checks they make. These bonuses stack to a maximum of +6.
feat-paired-opportunists-selfless-teamwo:
You know how to make an enemy pay for lax defenses.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +4 circumstance bonus on attacks of opportunity against creatures that you both threaten. Enemies that provoke attacks of opportunity from you also provoke attacks of opportunity from your ally so long as they threaten them (even if the situation or an ability would normally deny them the attack of opportunity). This does not allow your ally to take more than one attack of opportunity against a creature for a given action.
feat-passing-grace-selfless-teamwork:
Your bond with your allies allows you to share positive energy between yourselves.

Benefit(s): Whenever a healing spell or an effect would restore you to above your maximum hit points, you can redirect excess hit points to an adjacent ally. This ability functions only for effects that require an action to activate—fast healing, regeneration, and other passive effects that restore hit points are not shared.
feat-piercing-gambit-selfless-teamwork:
You cast a spell destined to fail in order to help your ally overcome an enemy's spell resistance.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Penetration or Bluff 3 ranks; caster level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can expend one prepared spell or spell slot, as if you had cast the spell, to weaken an enemy's defenses. Your spell has no effect, but a designated ally gains a bonus on their caster level check to overcome spell resistance equal to half the level of the spell or spell slot you expended, lasting until the start of your next turn.
feat-precise-strike-combat-selfless-team:
You are skilled at striking where it counts, as long as an ally distracts your foe.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are flanking the same creature, your ally deals an additional 1d6 points of precision damage with each successful melee attack. This bonus damage stacks with other sources of precision damage, such as sneak attack. This bonus damage is not multiplied on a critical hit.
feat-protective-line-combat-selfless-tea:
You look out for your teammates while they reload.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms).

Benefit(s): When you are adjacent to an ally, they do not provoke attacks of opportunity while loading a firearm.
feat-punch-through-combat-selfless-teamw:
You and your allies are adept at bypassing enemy defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you may make a single attack against a target. If the attack hits and deals damage to the target, all of your allies ignore up to 5 points of damage reduction against the same target for 1 round. This feat does not apply to damage reduction without a type (such as DR 10/-).
feat-pursuit-of-glory-combat-selfish-tea:
You know that daring deeds and heroics live forever in song, and sagas will carry your deeds into immortality.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): Whenever you start or end a charge attack in a space adjacent to an ally, you gain a +2 morale bonus on one attack roll you make as part of the charge. Furthermore, you can charge through a space containing an ally.
feat-rat-stack-combat-selfless-teamwork:
You coordinate efficiently in tight spaces.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, swarming ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): You can occupy the same square with up to two other creatures. If all participants also have the Tunnel Rat feat, up to four creatures can share the same space.
feat-relentless-cheer-selfless-teamwork:
Your undying optimism keeps you and your companions going even when things get rough.

Prerequisite(s): Halfling, fearless and halfling luck ancestral traits.

Benefit(s): Adjacent allies gain a +1 morale bonus on all saving throws. This bonus increases to +3 on saving throws against fear.
feat-rending-swarm-combat-selfless-teamw:
Together, you and your allies tear through enemies' defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Rat Stack, swarming ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on all melee damage rolls for each allied creature you share a square with.

If two or more allies sharing a square hit the same adjacent creature in a round, they tear it in different directions, dealing additional damage at the end of the round. This rend attack deals an amount of damage equal to 1d6 + the highest Strength modifier of all qualifying allies in the same square who struck the target this round.
feat-returning-throw-combat-selfish-team:
You have turned your deadly childhood games into a tactical advantage.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Sleight of Hand 3 ranks, goblinoid subtype.

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally makes an attack with a thrown weapon and misses the target by 4 or less, you can catch the weapon as an immediate action. Both you and your ally must be within 30 feet of the target, and you must be able to trace a line from any part of your space to any part of your ally's space so that the line passes through the target's space. As part of the action to catch the weapon, you can throw it at the target of the original attack. If your target has never seen you perform this maneuver before, it is denied its Dexterity bonus to AC against your attack. You must have at least one hand free to use this feat. You must be aware of the attack and not flat-footed.
feat-ruthless-opportunist-combat-selfish:
Your timing and fierceness take the enemy by surprise.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): When an ally hits with an attack of opportunity against an enemy both you and that ally are threatening, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on your melee attack rolls against that enemy for 1 round.
feat-sacrificial-aid-selfish-teamwork:
You convince an ally to help you disable a trap, but the ally takes the damage if you fail.

Benefit(s): When you attempt to disable a trap, an ally can bolster your efforts. The ally rolls 1d20 and adds either their total bonus on Disable Device checks or their character level, whichever is higher; if the result of the ally's roll is 10 or greater, you gain a +4 bonus on your Disable Device check. If you trigger the trap, your ally is the target of the trap's effects. In the case of a trap with multiple targets, your ally takes the effects both for themself and for you (potentially taking damage twice or attempting saving throws twice).

Normal: You can use the aid another action only if you are able to attempt the skill check in question. The bonus provided is only +2.
feat-scarred-legion-teamwork:
Your ritual scars make you more fearsome, and allies with similar scars grow bolder when they're near you.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Intimidate checks. You also grant a +2 morale bonus on Will saving throws to adjacent allies. When you charge, if your allies were adjacent to you at the start of the charge, they retain the bonus on Will saves until the start of your next turn.
feat-scion-of-the-land-selfless-teamwork:
You are strongly linked to natural terrain and to others who share your link.

Prerequisite(s): Survival 1 rank.

Benefit(s): When traveling through terrain in which you can leave no trail and be impossible to track (as a result of favored terrain, trackless step, or a similar class feature), you grant that ability to allies within 60 feet.

If an ally within 60 feet is also able to move normally through the current terrain without leaving tracks, you grant them a +1 bonus on Knowledge (nature), Perception, and Survival checks while in that terrain.
feat-scion-of-the-lost-empire-selfless-t:
Though you might not be able to trace your lineage back to ancient cultures, you project the feeling of that ancient power in your blood whenever you're near others like yourself.

Prerequisite(s): Human.

Benefit(s): While you're adjacent to another human ally, they may gain a +2 competence bonus on a single attack roll, saving throw, ability check, or skill check as an immediate action. They must choose to use this ability before making the roll.
feat-secret-language-teamwork:
You and your allies have worked out a complex set of codes and phrases that allow you to secretly pass information back and forth.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank, Linguistics 1 rank, Sense Motive 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You gain a +5 circumstance bonus on Bluff checks made to pass secret messages to other characters with whom you have spent at least 1 month teaching your secret language & codes, and can communicate as much information as you could normally say in one round as a swift action.
feat-seeping-darkness-selfless-teamwork:
Your innate magical darkness seeps through your skin and strengthens when you're near another creature whose soul is as wicked as yours.

Prerequisite(s): Drow, darkness ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to a drow ally, you can spend a move action to grant said drow ally concealment (20% miss chance) for 1 round.
feat-seize-the-moment-selfless-teamwork:
You and your allies are poised to pounce whenever one of you scores a telling blow.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Improved Critical.

Benefit(s): When you confirm a critical hit against an opponent that your ally also threatens, your ally can make an attack of opportunity against that opponent.
feat-shake-it-off-selfless-teamwork:
You support your allies and help them recover from crippling effects.

Benefit(s): When you are adjacent to one or more allies, they gain a +1 bonus on saving throws. This bonus stacks with other allies to a maximum of +4.
feat-share-healing-selfless-teamwork:
Your link with your companion creature allows you to share with it any healing magic that's cast upon you.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to acquire an animal companion, eidolon, familiar, or special mount.

Benefit(s): When your companion creature is adjacent to you or sharing your square, and you receive the benefit of a healing spell (whether from yourself or another source), you can divide the hit points healed evenly between yourself and your companion creature.
feat-share-spells-selfless-teamwork:
You can share individual magic with your partner.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded Mind, ability to share spells with an animal companion, eidolon, familiar, or phantom, caster level 1st.

Benefit(s): You can cast a spell with a target of "you" on an ally as a touch spell, as per the share spells familiar ability, so long as the ally possesses the Bonded Mind feat.
feat-shared-ownership-selfish-teamwork:
The concept of ownership is rather flexible among you and your friends.

Prerequisite(s): Well-Prepared, Sleight of Hand 1 rank, halfling.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're within 30 feet of a halfling ally, as a move action you can draw an item in that ally's possession as if it were on your person. This is not a magical effect—you just conveniently happen to remember that you had borrowed that item earlier. The item must be something that easily fits in a pocket or sleeve, such as a dagger, potion, wand, or scroll. When you or an ally draw an item (whether or not you do so using Shared Ownership) or otherwise definitively establish who is holding the item, you can't use Shared Ownership to draw the item in this manner until you have had at least 1 hour to mingle with your companions.
feat-shared-remembrance-selfish-teamwork:
You can combine fragments of monster myths into a coherent story.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (any) 1 rank, elf.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a Knowledge check to identify a monster, you gain a cumulative +2 circumstance bonus on the check for each ally within 30 feet who has ranks in the Knowledge skill required to identify that monster (maximum +10 bonus).
feat-shared-stash-selfish-teamwork:
You are adept at borrowing from your allies even in the middle of combat.

Prerequisite(s): Quick Draw, base attack bonus +1, Sleight of Hand 1 rank, swarming ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): While you are in the same square as a willing ally, you can draw a weapon from that creature as a free action or draw a hidden weapon or any other object as a move action. You can also take a held object from a willing ally in the same square as you as a free action. Drawing or taking an object (but not a weapon) in this way provokes an attack of opportunity.
feat-shield-wall-selfless-teamwork:
You form a unified defense with those around you.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Proficiency.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are wielding a shield and are adjacent to an ally wielding a shield, the AC bonus from your ally's shield increases, depending on the shield you are wielding. If you are wielding a buckler or a light shield, their shield bonus increases by +1. If you are wielding a heavy shield or a tower shield, their shield bonus increases by +2. Your ally keeps these bonuses even if you lose your shield bonus due to making a shield bash attack. If you use a tower shield to grant total cover, your ally also benefits if an attack targeting them passes through the edge of the shield.
feat-shielded-caster-selfless-teamwork:
Your allies cover you while you cast complicated spells.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +4 competence bonus on concentration checks. If you are wielding a buckler or a light shield, this bonus increases by +1. If you are wielding a heavy shield or a tower shield, this bonus increases by +2. Finally, if an enemy threatening you and your ally has the Disruptive feat, or another ability that increases the DC of concentration checks, the amount of the increase is halved.
feat-snapping-flank-combat-selfish-teamw:
You can make a swift bite attack against a flanked foe.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +9, bite attack.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are flanking with an ally, as a swift action you can make a bite attack against the opponent you and your ally are flanking.
feat-special-delivery-selfish-teamwork:
Your partner can carry your spells to their targets.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded Mind, Share Spells, ability to deliver spells through an animal companion, eidolon, familiar, or phantom, caster level 3rd.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are in contact with an ally who has the Bonded Mind feat and you cast a touch spell, you can designate the ally as the "toucher," as per the deliver touch spells familiar ability.
feat-spell-bluff-teamwork:
When you are in the area of effect of an ally's harmful spell, your foes are caught off guard.

Benefit(s): When you fail your saving throw (including voluntarily failing the save) against an ally's spell that would harm you with an area of effect that includes you, intelligent enemies within the spell's area take a –2 penalty on their saving throws to resist the spell's effects.
feat-spell-chain-selfless-teamwork:
You help your allies bypass your foes' magical defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Penetration.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a successful caster level check to overcome a target's spell resistance, the next ally that attempts to overcome the same target's spell resistance can roll twice when attempting his own caster level check, taking the better result. This benefit must be used within 1 round or else it is lost.
feat-spell-synergy-selfless-teamwork:
You can amplify the effects of beneficial spells upon an ally.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally and both of you are affected by the same spell or spell-like ability, you may amplify the spell's effect on your ally. As an immediate action as the spell affects you and your ally, you can increase the effective caster level of the spell by 3. This increase in caster level doesn't affect the spell's duration or the effects for any target of the spell other than your ally. The increase doesn't stack with any other effects that might increase the spell's caster level.
feat-spirit-of-the-corps-combat-selfish-:
You find inspiration in your fellow soldiers, trusting that your shared training and dedication will bring you victory on the battlefield.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 10 feet of an ally benefiting from a spell or effect that grants a morale bonus on a particular type of roll, once during that effect's duration, you can apply that morale bonus on a roll you make of that type. For instance, if an ally with this feat is benefiting from heroism, once during the duration of the spell you could gain a +2 morale bonus on one saving throw, attack roll, or skill check. You can use this feat only once per round, and only once per spell or effect.
feat-squirming-pile-combat-selfish-teamw:
Your body is easily lost in the muddy chaos of fighting as a swarm, making your vital areas difficult to target.

Prerequisite(s): Acrobatics 5 ranks, swarming ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): While sharing a square with an ally, you gain a 25% chance of negating the additional damage from a successful critical hit or sneak attack; if you negate the damage, it is instead rolled normally. This negation chance doesn't stack with similar protection provided by any other source, such as the fortification armor special ability.
feat-stealth-synergy-selfless-teamwork:
Working closely with an ally, you are able to move like twin shadows.

Benefit(s): While you can see one or more allies, whenever you and your allies make a Stealth check, your ally takes the highest roll and adds all their modifiers to Stealth.
feat-steel-the-body-and-mind-meditation:
When you take a moment to commune with the world around you, you gain certain benefits.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13+, Meditation Master, character level 9th.

Benefit(s): For 24 hours after you meditate, you steel yourself against physical and spiritual disruption. You gain a +4 bonus on saves against charm, compulsion, and polymorph effects as well as gain the ability to bypass an amount of DR possessed by spirits equal to 1/2 your class level.
feat-stick-together-combat-selfish-teamw:
You stick close to your allies in combat.

Benefit(s): When an adjacent ally moves, you can move up to your speed as an immediate action, as long as your movement ends adjacent to that ally. If you do so, you are staggered on your next turn. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.
feat-stone-dodger-selfless-teamwork:
By working with an ally to gauge the trajectory of incoming attacks, you can more easily avoid taking damage.

Benefit(s): As long as your allies are able to see and hear you, they receive a +4 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from hurled rocks (or projectiles of similar shape, including bludgeoning ranged attacks from siege weapons). If they are hit by such an attack while they have this bonus, your allies can attempt a Reflex save to take only half damage from the attack. The DC for this save is equal to the bonus of the ranged attack used to hurl the rock.
feat-suppress-regeneration-combat-selfle:
You and your allies can exacerbate a regenerating creature's weaknesses. By making a precisely timed attack to open a serious wound just a bit further, your allies can extend the length of time the creature's regeneration is suppressed.

Benefit(s): When you make a successful attack that causes a creature's regeneration ability to cease functioning for at least 1 round (such as by hitting a troll with alchemist's fire), any ally who is currently threatening the creature can make an attack of opportunity against it. This attack of opportunity deals no damage, but instead extends the time that the creature's regeneration is suppressed by 1 additional round. If multiple allies hit the creature with this attack of opportunity, the additional rounds of suppression stack.
feat-suppressive-fire-combat-selfless-te:
Your well-timed ranged attacks protect your allies as they advance on the battlefield.

Prerequisite(s): Far Shot, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, keen senses ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you damage a target using a ranged attack, that target can't make attacks of opportunity for 1 round against your allies when they move out of one of the target's threatened squares.
feat-swap-places-teamwork:
You are skilled at changing places with your ally during a chaotic melee.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, you can move into your ally's square as part of normal movement. At the same time, your ally moves into your previous space as an immediate action. Both you and your ally must be willing and able to move to take advantage of this feat. Your ally must be the same size as you to utilize this feat. Your ally does not provoke an attack of opportunity from this movement, but you provoke as normal. This movement does not count against your ally's movement on his next turn.
feat-swarm-scatter-selfless-teamwork:
You have studied the habits of swarming rats for defensive tactics.

Benefit(s): Each ally adjacent to you gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC. This bonus stacks with itself for each adjacent ally granting this bonus. As long as you are granting this bonus, you and your allies affected by it are immune to the swarm attack and distraction ability of rat swarms.
feat-swarm-strike-selfless-teamwork:
You and your allies have trained to overwhelm foes like a swarm of rodents.

Benefit(s): Whenever a foe provokes an attack of opportunity from you, you grant a +1 bonus on attack rolls to each ally who is also currently threatening that foe. This bonus stacks with any other Swarm Strike granted by your allies.
feat-swing-about-teamwork:
You can grab an ally and move them to a nearer position.

Prerequisite(s): Escape Route.

Benefit(s): If you have a free hand, as a move action you can grab a willing adjacent ally and place them in any other space adjacent to you. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity. You can do this only with allies who are able to move freely (not grappled, held, prone, slowed, or otherwise suffering restricted movement) and who are of your size or smaller.
feat-tag-team-interrogation-teamwork:
You and your partner work together to bewilder a target, alternating between fear and kindness.

Prerequisite(s): Intimidating Prowess or Persuasive; Diplomacy 1 rank; Intimidate 1 rank.

Benefit(s): When an ally you can see uses Diplomacy or Intimidate to shift the attitude of a creature, you can attempt to shift the creature's attitude at the same time. Your ally rolls either a Diplomacy check or an Intimidate check, and you roll a check with the other skill. If you both succeed, your ally chooses whether to apply the Diplomacy check's or Intimidate check's effects; the other check has no direct effect but instead provides the first check a +5 circumstance bonus to its result. If only one person succeeds, ignore the failed check, but the successful skill check's effect lasts only half as long. If you both fail, any effects resulting from both failed checks apply.
feat-take-the-hit-selfless-teamwork:
You can shield your partner's body with your own.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded Mind, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): As long as an ally with the Bonded Mind feat is adjacent to you, you can choose to absorb up to half of the hit point damage from any attack that strikes them, as if subject to a shield other spell. Using this ability is an immediate action, and it only applies to one attack, even if the ally is hit by multiple attacks as part of the same action.
feat-take-this-selfish-teamwork:
You can quickly retrieve items from the body of a companion who is unable to act.

Benefit(s): If you are adjacent to an ally who is unable to act, you can retrieve a held or openly carried item from their body as a swift action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

Normal: Retrieving a stored item or picking up a fallen item is a move action that provokes attacks of opportunity.

Special: This is an exception to the rule that allies who are unable to act do not count for the purpose of teamwork feats.
feat-tandem-evasion-combat-selfless-team:
You and your allies help each other evade deadly attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Dodge.

Benefit(s): You grant adjacent allies evasion against a dragon's breath weapon and tail sweep special attacks. If they already have evasion, they gain improved evasion instead.
feat-tandem-trip-combat-selfless-teamwor:
You know how to work together to trip your foes.

Benefit(s): Whenever your ally attempts a trip combat maneuver against an enemy threatened by you, your ally rolls twice and takes the better result.
feat-target-of-opportunity-combat-selfis:
You and your allies pelt your enemies with a deadly barrage of missiles.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When an ally makes a ranged attack and hits an opponent within 30 feet of you, you can spend an immediate action to make a single ranged attack against that opponent. Your ranged weapon must be in hand, loaded, and ready to be fired or thrown for you to make the ranged attack.
feat-team-pickpocketing-selfish-teamwork:
You distract a mark with friendly conversation while your partner robs the victim blind.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank, Sleight of Hand 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally succeeds a Bluff check to feint an opponent, if you are adjacent to that creature, you can spend an immediate action to make a Sleight of Hand check to pickpocket that opponent and gain a +4 bonus on that attempt.
feat-timely-coordination-selfish-teamwor:
You can precisely time your teamwork.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls and skill checks made as part of readied actions triggered by one of your allies. When you and an ally are attempting to overcome separate simultaneous obstacles as part of a heist or infiltration, you also gain this +1 bonus on attack rolls and skill checks.
feat-tinkering-grenadier-selfless-teamwo:
Training with alchemically inclined allies helps you avoid friendly fire.

Prerequisite(s): Precise Shot or Throw Anything.

Benefit(s): Whenever you hit a creature with a splash weapon, you may choose to exclude one creature within the weapon's splash area from taking splash damage. If a creature within the splash area also has this feat, it automatically ignores splash damage from your splash weapons on a successful hit.

In addition, if your ally misses with a splash weapon and the errant weapon lands in a square occupied or adjacent to you, you may attempt a DC 20 Reflex save.

If you succeed, you catch the weapon. If you also have the Snatch Arrows feat, you can toss the splash weapon back to your ally as an immediate action.
feat-topple-foe-combat-selfish-teamwork:
You and your allies can work together to trip larger foes.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Trip.

Benefit(s): If you attempt to trip a foe that is larger than you, you gain a +1 bonus on your CMB check to trip the foe as long as an ally is flanking the foe with you. If multiple allies are flanking the foe with you, you gain an additional +2 bonus on your Combat Maneuver check for each additional ally that's flanking the target after the first. The bonuses granted by this feat stack with those granted by Improved Trip and Greater Trip.

Each time you attempt to trip the same foe in consecutive rounds, the bonus granted to your trip attempt increases by +1 per ally, to a maximum bonus of +4 per flanking ally on the 4th round of consecutive trip attempts.
feat-trade-initiative-teamwork:
You're an expert at helping your partner respond faster, and vice versa.

Benefit(s): After initiative is rolled but before enemies' initiative is revealed, you may trade the results of your die roll (not including modifiers) with an adjacent ally.
feat-triangulate-teamwork:
Your distrust of magic has forced you to develop tactics to fight witches, fey, and other supernatural foes. No matter how clever they think they are, they can't hide.

Prerequisite(s): Blind-Fight, Greater Blind-Fight, Improved Blind-Fight, Perception 15 ranks, human.

Benefit(s): Whenever both you and an ally are within 30 feet of an invisible foe of whose presence you're aware, you automatically pinpoint the foe's location for you and said ally. Whenever both you and an ally are within 30 feet of a creature and your ally misses that creature because of its concealment, they can reroll their miss chance percentile roll.
feat-tribal-bond-selfish-teamwork:
Your bond with your totem spirit increases around others of the same tribe.

Prerequisite(s): Totem Spirit, human.

Benefit(s): If at least one ally from the same tribe is within 30 feet, double your benefits from the Totem Spirit feat.
feat-tribal-hunter-combat-teamwork:
From watching pack animals hunt, you learned to take down large prey as part of a group.

Prerequisite(s): Animal Affinity.

Benefit(s): When either you or an ally from the same tribe are adjacent to and flanking an opponent that is larger than either of you, you both are considered to be flanking the opponent as long as you remain adjacent to it.

Normal: You must be positioned opposite an ally to flank an opponent.
feat-tribe-mentality-selfish-teamwork:
You and your tribemates grant each other mental strength.

Benefit(s): When you're simultaneously subject to the same enchantment (compulsion) or [emotion] effect as another ally, you both roll saves but you can use either result.
feat-trusted-agent-selfish-teamwork:
Your supernatural bond to other agents strengthens your resolve and allows you to bolster your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Loyal Agent trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 30 feet of an ally who is a part of and loyal to your organization, you gain a +1 profane bonus on Reflex and Will saving throws. In addition, once per day as a swift action, you can forfeit the saving throw bonuses granted by this feat to increase the effectiveness of the aid another action. For a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1), when you use the aid another action to aid an ally who is also a part of and loyal to your organization, the bonus you grant to that ally's AC, attack roll, or skill check is increased to +4 instead of the usual +2. You don't benefit from the feat's saving throw bonuses for 24 hours, though you still qualify as having this feat for the purpose of other characters gaining the bonuses.
feat-umbral-shift-teamwork:
Your shadows dance in the darkness, carrying you with them swiftly and silently so that you're able to swap places with your kindred.

Prerequisite(s): Darkness ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally with the darkness ancestral spell-like ability are each in an area of darkness within 20 feet of an object radiating darkness from a darkness spell, you can swap places with that ally as a swift action. Your ally must be willing and must spend an immediate action to complete the swap.
feat-underhanded-teamwork-combat-selfles:
You and your allies know how to use coordinated maneuvers to set up an enemy with an unfair disadvantage.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Improved Dirty Trick.

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally performs a dirty trick combat maneuver against a foe you both threaten, you can use an immediate action to increase the inflicted condition's duration by 1 round.
feat-undermine-teamwork:
You and your allies take advantage of shifting terrain to unbalance enemies.

Benefit(s): When you use a combat maneuver to move a creature into or through a square adjacent to an ally, your opponent treats all squares adjacent to that ally as difficult terrain during their next turn. In addition, the DC of any of your opponent's Acrobatics checks in the affected squares increases by 2 for each of your allies who have this feat and are adjacent to them.
feat-unspoken-bond-selfless-teamwork:
You've gained the ability to read your most trusted companions' nonverbal acts.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 4 ranks, Sense Motive 4 ranks.

Benefit(s): You can communicate with another ally without speaking, instead using nearly imperceptible gestures. This message can relate basic instructions like "attack this person" or "be ready to fight" and cannot be used to discuss complex tactics or plans.
feat-unusual-heritage-teamwork:
Your heritage is strange or difficult to trace, and people fear your otherworldly powers.

Prerequisite(s): Changeling.

Benefit(s): Your mother was part of a powerful hag coven, and it shows when you are near your kin. As long as you are within 30 feet of at least two other changelings, you gain a +2 bonus on concentration checks and dispel checks. If at least two of them have this feat, these bonuses increase to +4.

Special: This version of Unusual Heritage is a teamwork feat.
feat-usurpers-guard-selfless-teamwork:
You work with your allies to create a defensive guard to facilitate spellcasting.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +3 or ability to cast 2nd-level spells.

Benefit(s): When an adjacent ally attempts a concentration check to cast a spell or use a spell-like ability defensively, you can attempt a combat maneuver check as an immediate action to guard that ally. Your ally can use either the result of her own concentration check or the result of your combat maneuver check to determine whether she succeeds at casting the spell or using the spell-like ability.
feat-void-core-cultivator:
You developed a Void Core, significantly raising your affinity and comprehension of the Void element, enabling you to to learn and cast a higher class of Void magic.

Prerequisite(s): Able to cast 1st-level spells, 1 rank in Spellcraft, the spells ability, and ki pool (or Ki Meditation feat). You may only select this feat at 1st level.

Benefit(s): You begin gameplay with a spiritual core within your soul known as a Void Core, allowing you to learn and cast spells with the void descriptor with greater ease. You may learn and cast such spells as if they were one spell level lower (to a minimum of 0thlevel) than the listed spell level for your spellcasting class.

Special: A 1st level legendary ninja may use their jutsu pool in place of a ki pool to qualify for this feat.
