feat-volley-fire-combat-selfless-teamwor:
You have trained to work in ranks of archers to rain arrows down upon your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit(s): You grant a +1 bonus on ranged attack rolls to each ally who makes a ranged attack against a target within 15 feet of your target before the start of your next turn, to a maximum of +4. These allies don't provide cover against your attacks.
feat-wall-of-flesh-selfless-teamwork:
You swarm with your allies, becoming a wall of creatures.

Prerequisite(s): Small size or smaller.

Benefit(s): Adjacent allies are considered one size category larger for determining CMD and the way combat maneuvers and abilities affect them.
feat-wounded-paw-gambit-combat-selfless-:
Your enemy sees you as an easy mark, but doesn't notice your allies poised to shoot.

Prerequisite(s): Broken Wing Gambit, Bluff 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use Broken Wing Gambit and an opponent attacks you as a result, each ally within 30 feet of that opponent can attempt a ranged attack against it as an immediate action. The ally's ranged weapon must be in hand, loaded, and ready to be fired or thrown in order to make this attack possible.

An ally can instead choose to benefit from Broken Wing Gambit and attempt an attack of opportunity against the foe, but cannot attempt both that attack of opportunity and this ranged attack.
feat-ablative-spellwork:
You can convert some of a spell's power into minor protection.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 3 ranks, ability to cast 2nd level spells.

Benefit: Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher you gain damage reduction until the beginning of your next turn. This is DR x/magic where x is 1/2 the level of the spell you cast, rounded up. This requires no action.
feat-alien-mindpaths-selfless-teamwork:
When you're in the company of other aliens, your mind makes the thoughts of others become difficult to follow.

Prerequisite(s): Any species alien to this planet or plane.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to at least one other ally alien to this world, said ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects and divination (scrying) effects, unless the effect comes from an android, kasatha, lashunta, or triaxian.
feat-allied-spellcaster-selfless-teamwor:
With the aid of an ally, you are skilled at piercing the protections of other creatures with your spells.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +2 competence bonus on level checks made to overcome spell resistance. If you have the same spell prepared (or known with a slot available if you are spontaneous spellcasters), this bonus increases to +4 and they receive a +1 bonus to the caster level for all level-dependent variables, such as duration, range, and effect.
feat-amateur-marshal-combat:
You have some practice at leading a group of soldiers.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +1 or Cha 13.

Benefit: You gain the ability to ready a single minor aura, chosen when you gain this feat, from among those available to marshals. Your aura bonus for this aura is +1, it improves to +2 at 8th level and +3 at 16th level.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times, but you must select a different aura each time. Regardless of how many times you select this feat you may only ready a single aura at a time.
feat-ambush-squad-combat-selfless-teamwo:
You know that the keys to victory are sudden attacks and even more sudden retreats.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When you're adjacent to an ally at the beginning of a surprise round, and both you and that ally can act during that surprise round, your allies can take both a standard action and a move action during that surprise round. Special: You may take both a standard & move action if another ally has this feat.

Normal: Characters can take only a standard action or a move action during a surprise round.
feat-amplified-radiance-selfish-teamwork:
The vicinity of another of your kind ignites your inner light into a shining aurora.

Prerequisite(s): Aasimar, daylight ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 15 feet of an outsider of good alignment who has the daylight ancestral spell-like ability, you gain an aura of radiance. You and your ally must both have at least one use of your daylight ancestral spell-like ability available to gain this benefit. This aura functions as per the daylight spell, except that it's a 10-foot-radius emanation centered on you without additional areas of weaker illumination. Creatures within this aura who take penalties in bright light double those penalties. The effects of overlapping auras of radiance don't stack. You can activate or suppress this aura as a swift action.
feat-amplified-rage-selfless-teamwork:
Your rage inspires other raging allies, making their rage even more powerful.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc or orc, rage class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are raging and adjacent to a raging ally, such as those under the effects of a rage spell or rage monster ability, or flanking the same opponent as a raging ally, their morale bonuses to Strength and Constitution increase by +4. This feat does not stack with itself (your ally only gains this bonus from one qualifying ally, regardless of how many are adjacent to them).
feat-arcane-messenger:
You've picked up a few magical tricks to aid in communication.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: arcane mark, comprehend languages, and message. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level.
feat-arcane-stunt:
You've learned to cast minor magics in order to increase your survivability.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit: Choose one of the following spells; expeditious retreat, feather fall, or jump. You gain the ability to cast the chosen spell as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) with a caster level equal to your character level.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time you do you either choose a new spell or increase the number of times per day you can use one of these abilities to 2 + your intelligence modifier (minimum 3).
feat-armed-evasion-combat:
You have learned to defend yourself against some magic attacks with your weapon of choice.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus in a melee weapon, (base attack bonus +6 or fighter level 5th).

Benefit(s): While fighting defensively or using the Combat Expertise feat while wielding a melee weapon you have chosen with Weapon Focus you may protect yourself from spells. If you are the target of a spell, including a spell which includes you in its area that requires a Reflex save, you may use your base attack bonus in place of your base save bonus. If the spell targets your AC you may make an attack roll at your highest base attack bonus. If the result of your attack roll exceeds the opponent's spell attack roll, their attack misses.
feat-artillery-team-combat-selfish-teamw:
Together, you and an ally can operate an oversized and unwieldy weapon.

Prerequisite(s): Proficiency with light crossbow, heavy crossbow, or musket; size Small or Medium.

Benefit(s): When you're adjacent to an ally, you both count as being Large for the purpose of using Large light crossbows, Large heavy crossbows, and Large muskets. Firing such a weapon this way requires you or your ally to support the barrel or bow of the weapon. You must be able to trace a line from the firer's space to the target's space in such a way that the line passes through the space of the ally that is not firing the weapon. The ally doesn't provide soft cover to the target. The ally not firing uses her actions to load the weapon, and the firer uses their actions to make attacks. The supporter holding the weapon applies all feats and abilities to reloading, while the firer applies all feats and abilities to making attacks. This feat does not allow you and your ally to act simultaneously on the same initiative.
feat-assisted-ascension-selfless-teamwor:
Your practiced skill at scaling heights as a team helps you aid others in their ascension.

Prerequisite(s): Climb 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at a Climb check, allies within 20 feet climb 5 feet along the same surface as an immediate action. You gain a +5 bonus on Climb checks to catch any falling ally who also has this feat.
feat-attune-magic-device:
You have a knack for using magic items.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 5 ranks, Use Magic Device 5 ranks.

Benefit: When you successfully activate an item with the Use Magic Device skill, you may attune yourself to the item as a free action. For the next 24 hours, You do not need to make Use Magic Device checks to activate that item. You can attune yourself to only one item at a time. If you attune yourself to a second item, the previous attunement ends.
feat-back-to-back-selfless-teamwork:
Your ally's eyes are your own, and yours are his.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): While your ally is flanked and adjacent to you, your ally receives a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against attacks from opponents flanking them.
feat-barrage-of-styles-combat-selfless-t:
You blend the diverse martial traditions of you and your allies' backgrounds into a unique combination.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): You grant a cumulative +1 morale bonus (maximum +4) on combat maneuver checks to each ally who is threatening the same foe and does not share an ethnicity or ancestry with you or any other ally threatening that foe.
feat-basic-harmony-selfless-teamwork:
Your performance interweaves with and enriches your ally's skills.

Prerequisite(s): Bardic performance or raging song.

Benefit(s): You can attempt a DC 10 Perform check to aid the Perform check of an ally. If you succeed, your ally gains a +1 bonus for each 5 points of your check result; a check result of 10 grants a +2 bonus, a result of 15 grants a +3 bonus, and so on. If you fail, the discord applies a –5 penalty on your ally's check.

Normal: Aid another checks grant a +2 bonus.
feat-blades-above-and-below-combat-selfl:
You attack high and your ally attacks low, denying your foe the chance to dodge your attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): When you and your ally threaten the same enemy, your ally is considered to be flanking that enemy, regardless of your actual positioning. To gain this benefit, you and your ally must be of different size categories, and your target must be the same size category as either you or your ally.
feat-blood-for-the-empire-selfless-teamw:
When fighting alongside you, the sight of a bloodied foe inspires your allies to greatness, while a martyred comrade compels all of you to vengeance.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): You grant a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls against any target that you damaged within the last round to all allies until the start of your next turn. When you or an ally dies within 30 feet of you, you or your allies gain the effects of haste for 1 round.
feat-bonded-mind-teamwork:
You and your partner are so close that you can almost read each other's minds.

Benefit(s): As long as you can see each other, you and an ally can trade nonverbal messages. These function as the message spell, except that you don't need to whisper or point, and you cannot be overheard.
feat-broken-wing-gambit-selfless-teamwor:
You feign weakness, making yourself a tempting and distracting target.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a melee attack and hit your opponent, you can use a free action to grant that opponent a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls against you until the end of your next turn or until your opponent attacks you, whichever happens first. If that opponent attacks you with this bonus, it provokes attacks of opportunity from your allies.
feat-brutal-grappler-combat-selfish-team:
You know how to aid in a grapple, allowing you and your allies to tear your enemy apart.

Prerequisite(s): Half-orc or orc.

Benefit(s): When you and an ally have grappled the same creature, your ally may attempt to damage the opponent on their turn (whether they were the one who first initiated the grapple or were assisting you in doing so). You and your allies are treated as aiding each other in the grapple (+2 bonus on your grapple combat maneuver) as long as all of you decide to maintain the grapple.

Normal: When multiple creatures grapple one target, the creature that first initiates the grapple is the only one that makes a check to damage a grappled opponent, with a +2 bonus for each creature that assists the grapple using the Aid Another action.
feat-burn-it-down-combat-selfless-teamwo:
Burning torches and the discordant symphony of riotous singing ignite the fervor within your goblin allies.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1, goblin.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make an attack with a torch, a flask of lamp oil fitted with a fuse, alchemist's fire, a flaming weapon, or are while on fire, you grant a morale bonus on damage rolls to all goblin allies within 30 feet. This feat stacks with other instances of this feat to a maximum of +4. This bonus damage is fire damage.
feat-bypass-ward-combat:
Your familiarity with magical protection allows you to bypass some of its effects.

Prerequisite(s): Disruptive or ability to cast dispel magic, base attack bonus +7

Benefit(s): When you attack a creature that is benefiting from an enhancement bonus to AC you may ignore an amount of that enhancement bonus equal to one quarter your base attack bonus, rounded down.
feat-casting-conduit-teamwork:
You are a conduit to spells, able to convey magic to an enemy you can touch, even if it is not your own.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 1 rank.

Benefit(s): When an ally is casting a spell with a range of touch that deals hit point damage, they can target you if you are willing and adjacent. You take the minimum damage from the spell, and as an immediate action the can make a touch attack against an adjacent foe to deliver the spell. If this attack hits, the spell deals its normal damage to the opponent. If you have the grappled or pinned condition, the spell is automatically transferred to the grappling or grappled foe with no attack roll needed. This ability has no effect if you are immune to the spell's effect (such as shocking grasp delivered to an ally immune to electricity).
feat-catch-weapon-combat:
You can use your shield to disarm unlucky foes.

Prerequisite(s): Shield Focus (light or heavy).

Benefit(s): When wielding a shield, if an opponent attacks you with a melee weapon and fails to hit your AC by 5 or more you may use an attack of opportunity to make a disarm combat maneuver attempt against that opponent. You gain a bonus on this attempt equal to your shield bonus to AC. This combat maneuver does not provoke an attack of opportunity from your target.
feat-cavalry-formation-selfish-teamwork:
You are skilled at riding in close formation with your mounted allies without impeding your effectiveness on the battlefield.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat.

Benefit(s): You and your mount can overlap the space of mounts, although no more than two creatures can share any one square. Further, you can charge through a space containing an allied mount, although the space from which you make your charge attack must comply with this feat's other benefit or be unoccupied.
feat-chain-spell-metamagic:
You can cast spells that affect whole swathes of enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Any metamagic feat.

Benefit(s): Any spell you cast which affects a single target and has a range greater than touch can be chained to affect a number of secondary targets equal to your caster level. You choose a primary target as normal and then choose any number of secondary targets up to your caster level within 30 feet of the original target.

Secondary targets make any associated saving throws with a +2 bonus, in addition if the effect deals damage secondary targets take only half the normal damage before any reduction for saving throws or other effects.

A chained spell uses a spell slot three levels higher than the original spell.
feat-choir-of-blades-combat-selfless-tea:
Your mastery of your people's martial styles extends to training, and you can share your skills with your allies, even though they lack your many long years of formal training.

Benefit(s): Allies adjacent to you of an ancestry different from your own gain the following benefits. If you have an ancestry bonus on attack rolls against a particular creature type or subtype, your ally also gains that bonus. If you have ancestral arms, weapon familiarity, or any other ancestral trait that grants weapon proficiencies, your ally also gains those proficiencies.
feat-choral-support-selfless-teamwork:
Raising your voice together with your allies', you wield sound itself as a weapon, your voices together becoming something powerful & divine.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (sing) 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can attempt a DC 10 Perform (sing) check to aid an ally. If you succeed at the check, spells cast by your ally before the start of your next turn that deal acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage instead deal sonic damage. Spells that would normally deal sonic damage deal half sonic damage and half damage resulting directly from divine power that is not subject to being reduced by resistance to sonic attacks.
feat-circling-offense-combat-selfless-te:
You are skilled at approaching large foes with an ally in a way that makes it difficult for your foes to find an advantage against your ally, creating a zone of relative safety for your allies to circle and attack from within, while punishing those who might strike back.

Prerequisite(s): Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): Your allies receive a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through a creature's reach, provided the creature is of a larger size category than them and provided you are within the creature's reach. If a creature that your ally is receiving this dodge bonus against attacks them and misses with the attack, it provokes attacks of opportunity from you.
feat-clever-engineer:
You are quite skilled at your craft and your work is surprisingly sturdy.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus in any Craft or Profession skill.

Benefit: Whenever you produce an item with a Craft or Profession skill which has a break DC, Hit Points, or Disable Device DC, those values increase by +2. For example if you have Craft (woodworking), a strong wooden door you produced would have a break DC of 25 and 22 hit points. When you reach 10 ranks in a Craft or Profession skill these bonuses increase to +4 when made using those skills.
feat-clever-leader:
Your council and wise words draw people to you.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership, Int 13

Benefit(s): You add your Intelligence bonus to your leadership score for the purpose of determining how many followers you gain from the Leadership feat. This also allows you to use your Intelligence in place of your Charisma for prerequisite purposes for other feats that also require Leadership.
feat-close-cohort:
You and your cohort are nearly equals.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership or ability that grants a cohort, leadership score 2 higher than your level

Benefit(s): Your cohort may be one level lower than you.

Normal: Regardless of your leadership score, you can only recruit a cohort who is two or more levels lower than you. Your cohort cannot gain levels to bring them within one level of you.
feat-cold-soul:
You radiate a bit of eerie cold which you've learned to use to create minor magics.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: chill touch, ray of frost, and resistance. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level. The save DC for these spell-like abilities is 10 + 1/2 your character level + the highest modifier among your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores.
feat-collective-recollection-selfless-te:
You and your allies can quickly jog each other's memories to remember essential facts.

Benefit(s): When an ally attempts a trained Knowledge skill check while within 30 feet of you, you may attempt an aid another check as a free action to improve that ally's skill check. You must have at least 1 rank in the Knowledge skill to be aided in order to use this feat. If you succeed at the aid another check, you automatically know any information your ally gains from the Knowledge check as if you had rolled the Knowledge check. Whether or not your aid another check is successful, you cannot attempt a Knowledge check to determine the same information as your ally after using this feat.
feat-combat-experience-combat:
You have learned to make greater use out of your accumulated martial knowledge and leverage the flow of battle to your advantage.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +2 and 2 ranks in Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier).

Benefit: You can use this feat a number of times per day equal to 1 + your highest mental ability score modifier. You may spend an immediate action to gain one of the following benefits:

• Gain a +1 competence bonus to an attack roll you make while that attack roll has applied a penalty of at least -1 due to the use of one of your combat feats.

• Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC against one attack roll made against you while your AC is currently benefiting from one of your combat feats. This circumstance bonus applies even to your touch and flat-footed AC.

• Gain a +1 competence bonus to your saving throw roll while that saving throw is currently benefiting from one of your combat feats.

For every 4 ranks above 2 you have in either Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier), whichever you have more ranks in, you increase the bonus granted through the use of this feat by +1.

Special: Whenever you use Combat Experience during a round, you must wait at least 1d4 rounds before you can use this feat again.
feat-combat-experience-greater-combat:
Your accumulated martial knowledge is so profound and innate at this point that its benefits last longer.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +14, Combat Experience, Improved Combat Experience, and 14 ranks in either Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier).

Benefit: If you use Combat Experience to gain a competence bonus to an attack roll, it applies to any two attack rolls you make that round. You choose at the time of your attack roll if you wish to apply the competence bonus to that attack.

If you use Combat Experience to gain a circumstance bonus to your AC, it applies against any two attack rolls made against you that round. You choose at the time of the attack roll if you wish to apply the circumstance bonus to your AC.

If you use Combat Experience to gain a competence bonus to your saving throw roll, it applies on any two such saving throw rolls you make that round. You choose at the time of the rolling a saving throw if you wish to apply the competence bonus to your roll.

Special: You no longer have to wait any additional rounds before you can use Combat Experience again after using it during any round but you are still limited to using two daily uses of Combat Experience at most during any round.
feat-combat-experience-improved-combat:
Your accumulated martial knowledge has been honed to an instinctive level where you can use it more freely.

Prerequisites: Base attack bonus +8, 8 ranks in either Knowledge (history) or Profession (soldier), and Combat Experience.

Benefit: You now can use Combat Experience as a free action but you are limited to using two daily uses of Combat Experience at most during any round.

Special: If you used Combat Experience during any round, whether it was one daily use or two daily uses, you must wait 1d2 rounds before you can use Combat Experience again in a future round.
feat-combat-medic-selfish-teamwork:
You know the urgency of treating wounds in the heat of battle, applying first aid to your allies with such speed that you assure no one gets left behind.

Prerequisite(s): Heal 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use Heal to provide first aid, treat caltrop wounds, or treat poison on an ally, you provoke no attacks of opportunity, and can take 10 on the check. Unlike with other teamwork feats, allies that are paralyzed, stunned, unconscious, or cannot otherwise act still count for the purposes of this feat.
feat-combat-rotation-combat:
You know when to relieve allies from combat by taking their place.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Initiative, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): Once per round as a swift action, you may trade places with a willing ally within your reach and within reach of an enemy. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity against you or your ally.

This ability does not count against your maximum movement for the turn or as movement for your target.
feat-compelling-harmonies-selfless-teamw:
Your harmonies reinforce and empower your allies' magic.

Prerequisite(s): Basic Harmony, Perform (keyboard, percussion, sing, string, or wind) 10 ranks, bardic performance or raging song.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you may expend one round of bardic performance to boost the effectiveness of the bardic performance of an ally within 60 feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, if that ally uses a bardic performance that allows a saving throw, increase that saving throw DC by 2.
feat-concentrated-fire-combat-teamwork:
Your simultaneous ranged attacks punch through your foe's defenses with ease.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, elf, weapon familiarity ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): If you and a single ally both ready an action to each make a ranged attack against the same opponent and choose the same condition for the readied action, when you and the ally make those attacks, each of you can use the highest of the two attack rolls for your attack roll. Furthermore, if you and your ally both hit the target, you can total the damage for both attacks before applying the target's damage reduction or energy resistance.
feat-conduit-casting-selfish-teamwork:
Your magic flows through your ally.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 3 ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are within 30 feet of an ally, you can channel your magic through them when casting a spell or using a spell-like ability, provided that they have the spell on their class list or has the ability to cast it as a spell-like ability. The spell cannot have a range of personal. When you finish casting the spell, the ally may spend an immediate action to act as your conduit. Your ally must concentrate to act as the conduit for the spell, just as if they were casting the spell, and the spell is lost if a concentration check is required and they fail (such as from damage, or to cast the spell defensively).

If successfully cast, the spell originates from the ally's space instead of yours. You remain the spell's caster for the purpose of determining the caster level, saving throw DC, and so on, but your ally selects the targets or area affected and makes any required attack rolls for the spell.
feat-cooperative-counterspelling-teamwor:
Thanks to your heritage, you can thwart magical attacks almost instinctively.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, ancestral spell-like ability replicating a spell of 1st level or higher.

Benefit(s): When you and an ally both ready an action to counterspell, you can counter a spell if you both expend any spell of the same level and school as the spell you wish to counter. If you both attempt to counterspell with dispel magic, you each gain a +2 bonus on your caster level checks. If you have more than one ally readying an action to counterspell, you can select only one of those allies for the purpose of this feat, and that ally must also select you.
feat-cooperative-disabling-teamwork:
You are skilled at working with an ally to disable traps.

Prerequisite(s): Disable Device 1 rank, trapfinding class feature.

Benefit(s): When an adjacent ally uses the Disable Device skill and fails the check against a trap and you are within reach of the trap you can attempt a Disable Device check against the same device as an immediate action. You must have remained adjacent throughout the process of disabling the device and must have either aided at the Disable Device check or taken no other action. If you succeed at the check, the attempt is considered to be successful. If you fail, the attempt is considered to have failed by 5 or more, even if the original check failed by 4 or less.
feat-cooperative-rend-combat-selfless-te:
You and an ally each sink a claw into your foe—then all you have to do is pull.

Prerequisite(s): Rend, troll.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and an ally are both threatening the same creature, you must hit the target with at least one of your claw attacks for your ally to use their rend ability.

Normal: You and your ally must hit with two of your claw attacks to use your respective rend abilities.
feat-coordinated-blast-teamwork:
With trained precision, you create safe pockets within the areas of your ally's spells, inside which your allies remain safe.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, any ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): Whenever your ally uses a spell or ability with an area (such as fireball or channel energy) with you in it, you can exclude any number of allies from that area of effect.
feat-coordinated-capture-combat-teamwork:
You work with allies to prevent foes from escaping.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): Whenever you and one or more allies threaten the same enemy, the enemy takes a penalty on Acrobatics checks and concentration checks to avoid provoking attacks of opportunity equal to the number of creatures with this feat that are threatening him (maximum -5). This does not stack from multiple allies with this same feat.
feat-coordinated-cavalry-combat-teamwork:
Your hoof-beats snap into form and your line charges as one.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat

Benefit(s): When you begin your turn adjacent to an ally that also has this feat and both of you are mounted you gain a +2 bonus to the first attack roll you make after your mount moves this turn. If an ally with this feat has previously moved and attacked a creature you attack this turn, you gain a +4 bonus to your first damage roll against that creature this turn.
feat-coordinated-charge-combat-selfish-t:
You are an expert at leading your allies into the fray.

Prerequisite(s): You have at least two other teamwork feats, base attack bonus +10.

Benefit(s): When an ally charges a creature that is no further away from you than your base speed, you can, as an immediate action, also charge that creature. You must be able to follow all of the normal charge rules.
feat-coordinated-defense-selfless-teamwo:
You are adept at working with allies to avoid being tripped, grappled, and subjected to other maneuvers.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +2 competence bonus to their Combat Maneuver Defense. This bonus increases to +4 if the creature attempting the maneuver is larger than both you and your ally.
feat-coordinated-distraction-combat-team:
When working in tandem, you can make it difficult for foes to use their magical abilities.

Benefit(s): When you and at least one ally threaten the same enemy, the enemy treats the DC to cast spells defensively as 2 higher for each threatening character with this feat. If you or your allies are incapable of taking an attack of opportunity against the target for any reason, the effects of this feat do not apply.
feat-coordinated-maneuvers-selfless-team:
You are skilled at working with your allies to perform dangerous combat maneuvers.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, your ally receives a +2 competence bonus on all combat maneuver checks. This bonus increases to +4 when attempting to break free from a grapple.
feat-coordinated-reposition-selfish-team:
You are skilled in coordinating combat positioning with your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Step-Up.

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally who is threatening a creature you are threatening takes a 5-foot step, you can move 5 feet as an immediate action. This movement does not provoke attacks of opportunity.
feat-coordinated-shot-combat-selfless-te:
Your ranged attacks against an opponent take advantage of your ally's positioning.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit(s): If you are threatening an opponent and are not providing cover to that opponent against your ally's ranged attacks, your allies gain a +1 bonus on ranged attacks against that opponent. If you are flanking that opponent with another ally (even if that other ally doesn't have this feat), this bonus increases to +2.
feat-counterpoint-to-inspiration-teamwor:
As your allies' morale swells, your enemies falter.

Prerequisite(s): Basic Harmony, Compelling Harmony, Perform (keyboard, percussion, sing, string, or wind) 10 ranks, bardic performance or raging song.

Benefit(s): When an ally within 60 feet uses a bardic performance or raging song that grants allies a morale bonus or competence bonus, you may perform the same bardic performance or raging song to increase those bonuses by +1. This increase only lasts as long as you and your ally each maintain the same performance, and cannot be extended with effects like Lingering Performance. Additional bards with this feat beyond the second don't increase the bonuses further.
feat-courage-in-numbers-selfless-teamwor:
Your allies give you courage when you face an enemy as one.

Prerequisite(s): Iron Will.

Benefit(s): You grant a +2 morale bonus on saves against fear to every ally within 10 feet. This bonus stacks with other instances of this feat to a maximum of +8.
feat-covering-fire-combat-selfless-teamw:
You distract your enemies with ranged attacks to protect your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit(s): You can use the aid another action with a ranged attack against an opponent, regardless of whether the opponent threatens an ally. Range penalties apply to this attack roll. Choose one ally when making the attack. If the attack is successful, that ally gains a +2 bonus to AC against that opponent's next attack, as long as the attack comes before the beginning of your next turn. All allies with this feat also gain this bonus against that opponent.
feat-covering-gunfire-combat-selfless-te:
Your shot can put an enemy off guard, giving your teammates the opportunity to act.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms), Weapon Focus (at least one firearm).

Benefit(s): When you hit a foe with a firearm for which you have Weapon Focus, that creature takes a –2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 round against any other ally; this changes to a –4 penalty on attacks of opportunity. The penalty applied by this feat does not stack with itself. However, if both you and an ally with this feat attack the same foe, you can cover each other (since a penalty you impose with this feat doesn't apply to attacks against you).
feat-craven-rat:
You are a sneaky, and dangerous coward.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack, cannot be immune to fear or mind-affecting effects.

Benefit(s): You take a -2 penalty on saving throws against fear effects but you deal 1 extra damage per character level when dealing sneak attack damage. This extra damage is considered precision damage and is not multiplied on a critical hit. If you become immune to fear or mind affecting due to spells, abilities or magic items, you lose the penalty and benefit of this feat.
feat-crooked-stride-combat:
Your erratic movement makes you a much harder target.

Prerequisite(s): Dodge, Mobility

Benefit(s): When you take an action to move at least 1/2 your speed, you may choose one square along your movement that you will not provoke attacks of opportunity for moving through.
feat-crowd-control-combat-selfless-teamw:
You are trained to work with your allies to prevent enemies from moving around or through your formation.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): You grant a +2 competence bonus to the CMD of your allies when an enemy uses Acrobatics to move through a square you and the ally both threaten. For each ally within your reach that also has this feat, the bonus increases by an additional 2.
feat-crowd-of-bullies-combat-selfless-te:
Your failed attempt to humiliate a foe reveals its weaknesses to your allies.

Prerequisites: Half-orc.

Benefit(s): Whenever you fail a combat maneuver check, your allies within 30 feet gain a +2 circumstance bonus on combat maneuver checks of the same type against the same foe for 1 round.
feat-cunning-maneuver-combat:
With a sharp mind and a little skill you can take stronger opponents by surprise.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13 or Cha 13.

Benefit: When you select this feat choose one of the following combat maneuvers: disarm, reposition, or trip. When performing the selected combat maneuver you use either your Intelligence or Charisma modifier in place of your Strength modifier when calculating your combat maneuver bonus and calculating your combat maneuver defense against the same maneuver. This feat counts as Combat Expertise for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisite.
feat-cunning-reflexes-combat:
You are perceptive enough to spot the weak points in an enemy's movement, and take advantage of them.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Perception 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You gain an additional attack of opportunity plus one for every 5 ranks in Perception you possess. This feat does not stack with the additional attacks of opportunity granted by Combat Reflexes.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Reflexes for the purpose of meeting prerequisites and you may use your Wisdom score in place of your Dexterity score to meet prerequisites of feats with Combat Reflexes as a prerequisite.
feat-danger-sense-combat:
You have learned to trust your gut, even against unseen foes.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): When attacked by an unseen opponent you may make a Perception check with a DC equal to your opponent's attack roll, if you succeed you do not lose your dexterity bonus to AC against that opponent until the end of your next turn, though they still gain a +2 to attack rolls against you for being unseen as you do not reveal their location.
feat-darting-retrieval-combat-teamwork:
As your ally disarms a foe, you knock the disarmed item out of the way.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Disarm.

Benefit(s): When an ally disarms an opponent and the disarmed item lands within your melee reach, as an immediate action you can move the disarmed item to another square within your melee reach. If you have at least one hand free and could carry the disarmed item, you can instead pick it up. Using this feat does not provoke an attack of opportunity.
feat-dazing-bash-combat:
You can daze an opponent with a sudden strike from your shield.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Shield Bash, Shield Focus, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit(s): As a full round action or at the end of a charge you may make a special shield bash. If you deal damage, the target must make a Fortitude save DC equal to 10 + 1/2 your character level + your Strength modifier or be dazed until the beginning of your next turn.
feat-dazzling-lancer-combat:
Your lance blows can be devastating, leaving your foes reeling.

Prerequisite(s): Mounted Combat, Dazzling Display

Benefit(s): When making a mounted charge with a polearm, if you reduce your target to 0 or fewer hit points you may make an Intimidate Check as a free action against each enemy within 30 feet.
feat-deadly-gambit-combat:
By taking a loose, less defensive stance while fighting you can create openings when your enemy attacks.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, Power Attack, (base attack bonus +11 or Fighter level 9th).

Benefit(s): When you use the Power Attack feat you may elect to leave an opening for your opponents. Each enemy you attack this round gains a bonus on attack and damage rolls against you equal to the penalty on attack rolls normally imposed by your Power Attack feat until the start of your next turn. Each time they attack you they provoke an attack of opportunity from you, providing you have one remaining. You must declare the use of this feat when you declare the use of Power Attack for the round. Abilities or feats that reduce the penalty from Power Attack do not reduce the bonus that your enemies receive.
feat-deadly-troupe-selfless-teamwork:
You combine elements of dance and acting with your combat style to distract your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Perform (act) or Perform (dance) 3 ranks, human.

Benefit(s): When you threaten a foe, your allies gain a +4 circumstance bonus against that foe on Bluff checks to feint, Bluff checks to create a diversion to hide, and Acrobatics checks to move through that foe's threatened squares. Your allies also gain a +2 circumstance bonus on steal and dirty trick combat maneuver checks made against that foe.
feat-defensive-wrestling-combat:
You have trained to defend yourself from many close range attacks.

Prerequisite(s): (Improved Unarmed Strike or Weapon Focus in a melee weapon from the close fighter weapon group), (base attack bonus +5 or Monk level 5th).

Benefit(s): If you possess the Improved Unarmed Strike feat or are wielding a melee weapon from the close fighter weapon group you have selected with Weapon Focus you may make an attack of opportunity when targeted by a bull rush, grapple, or overrun combat maneuver. This attack of opportunity may be made even if the attacker possesses a feat or special ability that otherwise would allow them to ignore attacks of opportunity with those combat maneuvers. If your attack hits and deals damage, you add the total damage dealt to your CMD against that opponent until the end of their turn.
feat-designated-antagonist-selfish-teamw:
When you antagonize your foes, you can redirect their enmity to your ally.

Prerequisite(s): Antagonize.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at a skill check using Antagonize, you can cause the target creature to focus its efforts on a willing ally, as if the ally had been the one to use the ability.
feat-diplomatic-ruse-teamwork:
With practiced gestures, you buy enough time to prepare yourself for an inevitable battle.

Prerequisite(s): Diplomacy 3 ranks, human.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to an ally, you can perform a quick, seemingly courteous gesture when you make an initiative check. As part of the gesture, you and your ally can perform a single free action, such as dropping an item or entering rage. This feat can be used only when combat breaks out after a conversation, such as from failed negotiations.
feat-disarm-partner-combat-selfish-teamw:
When your ally fails to disarm an opponent within your reach, you can try to disarm that same foe.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Benefit(s): When an ally fails a disarm combat maneuver check made on his turn against an opponent within your melee reach, as an immediate action you can attempt a disarm combat maneuver check against that foe.
feat-distracting-charge-combat-selfless-:
Your charge exposes an opening your ally can exploit.

Benefit(s): When you use the charge action and hit, your allies gain a +2 bonus on their next attack roll against the target of that charge. This bonus must be used before your next turn, or it is lost.
feat-diverse-dueling-blades-combat:
You are able to use your spectacular techniques with other blades.

Prerequisite(s): Weapons of the duelist.

Benefit(s): You may select a weapon from the heavy blades weapon group. You may consider this weapon as a finesse blade for purposes of any class abilities of the swordlord guardian, the Diverse Swordlord Techniques feat from this book, and the Weapon Finesse feat. This does not allow the wielder to use the weapons with two hands for swordlord guardian class abilities unless otherwise allowed.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time the feat is taken, a new weapon is chosen.
feat-diverse-swordlord-techniques-combat:
While you have attended a prestigious dueling school that focuses upon the dueling sword, you have learned to apply the techniques to other nimble blades.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (dueling sword).

Benefit(s): For any ability, feat, or trait that is restricted to the dueling sword, you may use any weapon from the light blades or heavy blades that may be used with Weapon Finesse. This includes qualifying for prerequisites. However, if you qualified for a feat that requires a feat that calls out the dueling sword, like Weapon Focus, you must meet that prerequisite with the substitute weapon, and it is only usable with that weapon. This does not extend to feats that select the dueling sword like Weapon Focus or Improved Critical.

Normal: There are many feats and class abilities that are only applicable when using a dueling sword.
feat-diversion-shot-combat-selfless-team:
You can use your shots to distract opponents.

Prerequisite(s): Stealthy, Target of Opportunity.

Benefit(s): When you hit a target using Target of Opportunity, your ally can attempt a Stealth check to hide from your target as an immediate action, even if your target is aware of your ally's presence. This Stealth check applies only to the target you hit, and the stealth ends if the ally takes any action other than to move in to cover or concealment.
feat-divine-counterspell:
You have discovered that your divine connection allows you the power to undo magic.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, channel energy or lay on hands 3d6.

Benefit: You may spend two uses of channel energy or lay on hands to cast dispel magic with a caster level equal to your character level. When your channel energy or lay on hands class feature reaches 6d6 you may cast greater dispel magic instead.
feat-drinking-buddy-teamwork:
You and your allies have almost preternatural luck when you've all had a few drinks.

Benefit(s): Once per day, if you or your allies are drunk (or worse) within 10 feet of each other and are also drunk (or worse), your or your allies can reroll one d20 roll as a free action. The second result must be taken, even if it is worse.
feat-dual-opportunist-combat:
You move both of your weapons as one when catching an opponent off guard.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): When wielding two weapons, when an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you may attack once with each weapon at your highest base attack bonus, applying all penalties for two weapon fighting as normal. Both of these attacks count as attacks of opportunity. This feat grants you an additional attack of opportunity per round which does not stack with additional attacks of opportunity granted by other feats that provide additional attacks of opportunity.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Reflexes for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites.
feat-dual-shield-vanguard-combat:
Shields are helpful in keeping you alive, why not two?

Prerequisite(s): Weapons of the guardian.

Benefit(s): You may use two shields when dual-wielding for weapons of the guardian. This feat does not allow the stacking of shield bonuses.

Normal: Weapons of the guardian does not allow the use of two shields simultaneously.
feat-duck-and-cover-selfless-teamwork:
Your allies assist you in avoiding certain attacks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally and both of you are required to make a Reflex saving throw against a spell or effect, your ally may take the result of your die roll or their own (your modifiers still apply to the roll, regardless of which result they take). If your ally takes your result, they are knocked prone (or staggered on their next turn, if they are already prone or cannot be knocked prone). In addition, your ally receives a +2 cover bonus to their AC against ranged attacks as long as you are wielding a shield.
feat-echoes-of-the-first-world-teamwork:
Your fey heritage is strong, and it grows stronger when you're near another of your kind, strong enough that you can bring out this power in others of your kind, like a conduit to the first world your people came from.

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nature) 2 ranks, gnome subtype.

Benefit(s): While you're adjacent to an ally who has the gnome subtype, you both gain DR 2/cold iron, and count as fey instead of humanoid for the purposes of effects that target creatures by type. You both still count as having the gnome subtype, however.
feat-eclipse-strike-teamwork:
A sudden darkness disorients your foe, leaving it unprotected against your blinding attack.

Prerequisite(s): Tiefling, darkness ancestral spell-like ability.

Benefit(s): You can attack with an eclipse strike as a standard action if you and an ally are both flanking a target. You and your ally must both have at least one use of your darkness ancestral spell-like ability available to make this attack. If your eclipse strike hits, your target is blinded for 1 round. Creatures that have the see in darkness ability are immune to the blindness that is caused by an eclipse strike.
feat-electric-discharge-teamwork:
The fury of lightning storms fuels you and your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Arcane Strike, ability to cast a 1st-level or higher spell with the electricity descriptor.

Benefit(s): If you cast a 1st-level or higher spell with the electricity descriptor in the same round as an ally within 30 feet who casts a 1st-level or higher spell with the electricity descriptor, then both you and that ally gain the ability to have the next weapon attack you augment with the Arcane Strike feat deal an additional 1d6 points of electricity damage on a hit. These attacks must be made before the end of the next round.
feat-elemental-commixture-teamwork:
You can combine your elemental spells with those of your allies to produce entirely new and synergistic magical effects.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st.

Benefit(s): You and an ally within 30 feet can cast your spells together to create a more powerful, hybrid effect. Both spells must have an elemental descriptor (air, earth, fire, or water), or an energy descriptor that corresponds to one of the elements (acid [earth], cold [water], electricity [air], or fire [fire]). Both spells must be at least 1st level, within 1 spell level of each other, and cast during the same initiative turn through the use of readied actions.

When the spells to be commixed are cast, one is designated as the primary spell (typically the higher level spell), while the other is the secondary spell. The primary spell must be an offensive spell that targets an area or one or more creatures. The secondary spell can be any spell with an appropriate descriptor. Neither spell can take more than a standard action to cast. The primary spell behaves as written (with the exception of the synergistic benefits that are described below). The secondary spell does not manifest any of its usual effects; instead, targeted creatures are affected by a secondary effect that is determined by the combination of the two spells' descriptors.

Targeted creatures can attempt a saving throw against the primary spell as normal (assuming that a save is normally allowed), and then attempt a separate save against the secondary effect. The secondary effect's save type is described in its listing, and its save DC is equal to the normal save DC of the primary or secondary spell, whichever is lower (or, if neither spell allows a saving throw, 10 + lowest spell's level + spellcaster's primary spellcasting ability score [Int, Wis, or Cha] modifier).

Commixed spells cannot be counterspelled normally. A creature with Improved Counterspell can counterspell commixed spells if both spells are correctly identified and both belong to the same school. Regardless, the secondary effects of two spells combined through Elemental Commixture cannot be counterspelled. Spell resistance still applies to the secondary effect, unless both of the commixed spells bypass spell resistance.

Synergistic Benefits: The primary spell's save DC (if any) increases by 1. If either spell is normally modified by Spell Focus or Greater Spell Focus, the bonus to save DCs granted by those feats stacks with this increase. The caster of the primary spell also gains a +1 bonus on any caster level check made to overcome spell resistance.

Secondary Effects: While the secondary spell has no direct effect other than bolstering the effects of the primary spell, the combination of spells also creates a unique secondary effect depending on the elemental descriptors of the commixed spells. For the purpose of this secondary effect, the acid, cold, and electricity descriptors count as earth, water, and air descriptors, respectively. Commixed spells with the same elemental descriptors do not produce a secondary effect, though the primary spell still gains the synergistic benefits described above.

• Dust (Air/Earth): Choked by dust, the targets must succeed at a Fortitude save or become staggered for 1 round plus 1 round per 5 caster levels of the secondary spell's caster. Targeted spellcasters must succeed at a concentration check to cast spells (the DC is equal to the save DC). On a successful save, the targets are not staggered but must still attempt concentration checks.

• Lava (Earth/Fire): The targets are splattered with bits of molten rock and take 1d6 points of fire damage. The targets must succeed at a Reflex save or catch fire (see Catching on Fire on page 444 of the Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook).

• Mud (Earth/Water): The targets must succeed at a Reflex save or fall prone and have their movement speeds cut in half (to a minimum speed of 5 feet) for 1 round plus 1 round per 5 caster levels of the secondary spell's caster. On a successful save, the targets' movement speeds are cut in half for 1 round.

• Smoke (Air/Fire): The targets suffer smoke inhalation and must succeed at Fortitude saves or become nauseated for 1 round and blinded for 1d4 rounds. Success negates the nausea effect and reduces the blindness to 1 round. Creatures immune to fire are immune to the nausea effect.

• Snow (Air/Water): The primary spell gains the cold descriptor if it doesn't have that descriptor already, and half the damage dealt (if any) is cold damage. The targets must succeed at a Reflex save or fall prone.

• Steam (Fire/Water): Damage caused by the primary spell (if any) is treated as nonlethal, untyped damage (neither cold nor fire damage) and is not affected by energy resistance or absorbed by protection from energy. The targets become blinded for 1d4 rounds unless they succeed at a Will save.

Special: An inquisitor or any other character with the solo tactics class feature can use this teamwork feat without the aid of an ally. In order to do so, the character must be able to cast two qualifying spells within the same round, such as by using the Quicken Spell metamagic feat to cast one spell as a swift action or by using effects such as the time stop spell.
feat-empathic-link:
You have a deep connection with another creature.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 16

Benefit(s): You gain the ability to know the general state and emotions of a specific creature as long as they are within 100 feet. This cannot be used to convey messages or exact hit points or conditions. The target can be changed with a 1 hour ritual of meditation and close contact. However, you can only have one such connection.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times. Each additional time, you can connect with an additional creature simultaneously.
feat-enfilading-fire-combat-selfish-team:
Your ranged attacks take advantage of the flanking maneuvers of allies.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, one other teamwork feat.

Benefit(s): You receive a +2 bonus on ranged attacks made against a foe flanked by 1 or more allies.
feat-ensemble-selfless-teamwork:
You can create an ensemble of skilled and amateur performers to aid you in your performance.

Prerequisite(s): Perform 5 ranks.

Benefit(s): When your allies are performing and you are within 20 feet, you can aid with your Perform checks (including those made as part of bardic performance) as if you were aiding another as an immediate action. You make your aid another roll before your allies make their check. No more than four allies can grant this bonus with aid another. All allies aiding do not need to use the same category of the Perform skill as the ally they are aiding in order to aid them.

Special: If you possess one or more levels of the bard class, you can choose any one ally within 20 feet to be part of the ensemble. The ally is considered to have the ensemble teamwork feat for the purposes of aiding your performance.
feat-equilibrium-initiate-piety:

However, if you wish to retrain out a defunct and inaccessible piety feat for another piety feat granted by a new patron deity, you must wait at least 30 days and prove your worth (as determined by the GM) to the church of your new patron deity before you can select the piety feat associated with that deity.

You can possess multiple piety feats if they have the same specific patron deity listed in their prerequisites; otherwise, you cannot have more than one piety feat.

Prerequisite(s): 3 class levels in any one divine spellcasting class, spellcasting mental ability score 13+ for that divine spellcasting class and an equal or greater corresponding physical ability score (see the Balanced Education trait for details), and Deific Obedience [this god]; you must have [this god] as your patron deity and your alignment must not be LG (or must be within the alignment restriction of your divine spellcasting class that requires a patron deity).

Benefits: As a free action on your turn, you can use a special divine power granted by this god under certain lighting conditions, becoming difficult to perceive and affect. You also add the spells below at the spell level listed to the spell list of any and all divine spellcasting classes you possess that meet the prerequisites of this piety feat.

0th– root; 1st-martial master; 2nd–certain grip, recentering drone, surefoot boots; 3rd-dream shield; 4th-negative rain; 5th-[this god]'s blessing, covetous aura
feat-escape-route-selfless-teamwork:
You have trained to watch your allies' backs, covering them as they make tactical withdraws.

Benefit(s): An ally provokes no attacks of opportunity for moving through squares adjacent to you or within your space.
feat-essence-backlash:
When you counter an enemy spell, some of the dissipating energy is redirected to your opponent.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Counterspell.

Benefit: Whenever you successfully counter a spell, or dispel an ongoing effect with dispel magic (or greater dispel magic) the caster of the effect takes damage equal to twice the level of the spell that you countered or dispelled. This requires you to have line of effect to the caster of the effect you countered or dispelled.

feat-exceptional-aid-selfless-teamwork:
You're always ready to lend your partner a hand.

Prerequisite(s): Bonded Mind.

Benefit(s): When you successfully use the aid another action to assist an ally whom you can affect with your Bonded Mind feat on a skill check, the bonus is +4 instead of +2.
feat-exceptional-mount:
When you choose an animal to serve as your mount, you know what to look for.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 7 ranks, Mounted Combat, Ride by Attack

Benefit(s): By spending 24 hours with a normal animal that could bear you as a rider, you are able to draw out its potential. Choose an animal that could serve as your mount and spend 24 hours with it bonding and training and you may treat the animal as an animal companion as the druid class feature, using your character level -4 to determine your effective druid level. The animal chosen must be perfectly ordinary prior to the bond formed with this feat. This cannot allow you to have multiple animal companions.
feat-expanded-aura:
The aura of competence, heroism, or woe is felt further.

Prerequisite(s): aura of courage or aura of corruption.

Benefit: All auras created by your class features are expanded by 10 feet.
feat-experienced-flanker-combat:
You have spent countless hours fighting in tandem with others.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls when flanking rather than a +2 and gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls while flanking.
feat-experienced-supporter-combat:
You are adept at helping your allies succeed.

Benefit: Once per round, when you use the aid another action, for every 5 by which you exceed the DC you increase the bonus granted by 1.
feat-expert-rider:
Your time in the saddle has granted you extraordinary control over your mount.

Prerequisites: Mounted Combat

Benefit(s): If a creature you are riding needs to make an Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, Stealth, or Swim check you may make a Ride check in place of that skill.

If the creature has any bonuses to the skill check required, you add them as bonuses to your Ride check.
feat-extend-the-bulwark-combat-selfless-:
You can bolster a trained ally's defenses by interposing your own armored body.

Benefit(s): If you are wearing medium or heavy armor and are adjacent to an ally, as a free action, you may give your ally a circumstance bonus to their AC equal to half the armor bonus provided by your armor. This bonus lasts for 1 round. During this round, you gain no bonus to your AC from your armor.
feat-extra-expertise:
You have squeezed just a little more from your training.

Prerequisite(s): Spelljack expertise class feature.

Benefit: You may select an additional expertise for which you qualify.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times.
feat-extra-followers:
You can amass a veritable army.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership, Cha 13

Benefit(s): You gain double the number of followers indicated for your leadership score.
feat-extra-mettle:
You show much more mettle in battle than your peers.

Prerequisite(s): Mettle class feature or a feat that provides a Mettle pool.

Benefit(s): You gain 2 extra Mettle points per day and your maximum Mettle increases by 2.

Special: If you have the mettle class feature, this feat may be taken multiple times and its effects stack.
feat-extraplanar-conjunction-selfish-tea:
The innate planar energies of your allies empower your magical abilities, allowing you to make your spell-like abilities more difficult to resist.

Prerequisite(s): Any ancestral spell-like ability, outsider.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to an outsider ally, the DC of any ancestral spell-like abilities you or your ally use increase by 2 if your ally has the same ancestral spell-like ability. The proximity of multiple allies can't increase the DC further.
feat-fall-guy-selfless-teamwork:
You play the part of a bumbling fool, making your allies look good in comparison.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank.

Benefit(s): You can spend a standard action bumbling around, uttering gaffes, or otherwise making yourself appear to be socially inept. You take a –2 penalty on future Charisma-based checks against characters who witnessed your behavior, but your allies gain a +2 competence bonus on such checks. The penalty and bonus both end after 24 hours.
feat-familiar-link-coven-selfish-teamwor:
Within your coven, you have formed a bond with your fellow witches' familiars.

Prerequisite(s): Coven hex or Coven-Touched, familiar or spirit animal class feature, witch level 1st.

Benefit(s): You share an empathic link with the familiars of all other witches in your coven, as per the witch's familiar ability. Additionally, you can use the share spells, deliver touch spells, and scry on familiar abilities with a coven member's familiar as the target, as long as your witch level is high enough to grant access to these abilities. You can communicate with the familiar using its speak with master ability. You gain a +5 bonus on Spellcraft checks to help your familiar learn spells from a coven member's familiar.
feat-fancy-footwork-combat:

Prerequisites: Fleet, base attack bonus +3

Benefit(s): You may use a standard action to make a single melee attack against an enemy creature at your highest base attack bonus. If the attack hits, you may move up to 15 feet as a free action as long as you end your movement in a square that would be considered a flanking position in relation to your original square. If the attack was a critical hit, you may then make an attack against the same creature as a swift action from your new square. If you do, the attack gains all the bonuses normally associated with flanking.
feat-feint-partner-combat-selfless-teamw:
A little diversion is all your allies need to slip through your foe's defenses.

Prerequisite(s): Bluff 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Whenever you successfully feint an opponent, that opponent also loses their Dexterity bonus to AC against the next attack your ally makes against them before the end of your next turn.
feat-ferocious-horde-selfish-teamwork:
Seeing a fellow orc bleed makes you fight harder.

Prerequisite(s): Orc, ferocity ancestral trait.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are at or below half of your full hit points and an orc ally within 30 feet is also at or below half of their full hit points, you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls.
feat-ferocious-loyalty-selfish-teamwork:
You have a powerful sense of responsibility for your allies.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls against any foe that currently threatens an ally. Whenever an ally is rendered helpless or killed within 30 feet of you, you gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls for 1 minute or until the foe responsible is rendered helpless or killed, whichever comes first.
feat-fighting-frenzy-combat-teamwork:
You feed off the rage of your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 13, rage or similar class feature (like bloodrage).

Benefit(s): When you and an ally within 60 feet are in a rage, neither of you take the normal –2 penalty to AC for being in a rage. If either of you would take a larger penalty to AC for being in a rage, reduce that penalty by 2.
feat-flow-of-elements-teamwork:
You can spontaneously channel your ally's elemental essence, be it burning fire, freezing ice, crackling lightning, or searing acid.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast spells; ifrit, oread, sylph, or undine.

Benefit(s): Whenever you're adjacent to an ifrit, oread, sylph, or undine ally, or an ally with an elemental bloodline sorcerer power, you can spontaneously replace or split a spell's damage when casting it, as though the spell were affected by Elemental Spell (without using a higher-level spell slot). The type of energy damage depends on your ally's ancestry: acid for oread, electricity for sylph, fire for ifrit, or cold for undine.
feat-focused-defense:
Your dedicated study in one school of magic has made you less susceptible to it.

Prerequisite(s): Spell Focus, Spellcraft 3 ranks.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on saves and armor class against spells from schools you've chosen with Spell Focus.
feat-focusing-blow-teamwork:
You and your allies work together to shake off mental effects.

Prerequisite(s): Hobgoblin Discipline, hobgoblin.

Benefit(s): You can deal damage to allies in order to break an ongoing mind-affecting effect that allows a saving throw. You must cause at least 5 points of damage to your ally with an attack, spell, or other ability. Your ally then rerolls their saving throw, with a +1 bonus for every 5 additional points of damage the attack caused. If their save is successful, the mind-affecting effect ends. Only damage actually dealt counts for purposes of this feat; nonlethal damage and damage reduced or eliminated by damage reduction, resistances, and so on does not qualify.

Benefit(s): You can prepare fortified spells in higher leveled spell slots to gain a bonus on checks to overcome spell resistance. For each spell level above the normal level of the spell you gain a +2 bonus on caster level checks to overcome spell resistance. You cannot choose to fortify a spell which is not normally subject to spell resistance.

If you have legendary cavalier levels instead, your legendary cavalier and marshal class levels stack together for the purposes of determining your total daily rounds of commander's aura. Your cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your effective marshal class levels when calculating how many additional hit points (equal to half your marshal class levels) you heal with vital inspiration to a target of your inspire action. This does not affect calculating your effective class levels for any other aspects of these class abilities.

You also stack your cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal class levels together to determine your effective cavalier (or legendary cavalier) and marshal levels for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of social talents (for legendary cavalier) and feats.
feat-great-commander:
Your orders are law and those that listen have greater guidance.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership.

Benefit: You can use the aid another action to grant the bonus to all allies within 100 feet that can see or hear you, who are performing the same action.
feat-great-diplomat:
You have a voice and ability to move people with your words.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership, Cha 15.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy checks, and your Leadership score is increased by 2.
feat-greater-mage-slayer-combat:
Your disdain for magic grows and your ability to harm those who use magic expands.

Prerequisite(s): Mage Slayer, Improved Critical, base attack bonus +10.

Benefit: Your critical threat range against creatures with spellcasting features or spell-like abilities increases by 1. This improvement is applied after the effects of the Improved Critical feat. For example a character with Improved Critical (greatsword) and this feat would have a threat range of 17-20/x2. Against an enemy wizard their threat range would increase to 16-20/x2.
feat-guard-the-breach-combat:
You have trained on the front line and are ready for enemies that try to rush past you.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Reflexes, (base attack bonus +5 or Fighter level 4th).

Benefit(s): When a charging opponent enters a square you threaten they provoke an attack of opportunity from you and opponents may still provoke an attack of opportunity when exiting a square you threaten providing you have one remaining. This feat allows a single movement from an opponent to provoke up to two attacks of opportunity from you during a target's charge. This feat does not grant additional attacks of opportunity.

Normal: A creature can only provoke an attack of opportunity once from each attacker with a move action.

feat-harrying-stance-combat:
Your shield can be used to disrupt a foe's attack or defense.

feat-helping-hand:
Part of your study included using magic to make simple tasks easier.

Benefit(s): You gain the following spell-like abilities, each usable once per day plus one additional time for every 4 character levels you possess: mage hand, open/close, and floating disk. Your caster level for these abilities is equal to your character level.

feat-hierarchical-training:
You are conditioned to follow through on your orders in combat and resist magical attempts to alter attack plans.

Your decisive blow helps your allies strike true.

feat-improved-dazing-bash-combat:
You have learned to truly bully an opponent with your shield.

feat-improvised-diversion:
You are well practiced at distracting your enemies and making a quick exit.

Benefit(s): You can make a Bluff check to create a diversion to hide and move up to your speed as a move action. In addition you gain a +2 bonus on Bluff checks made to create a diversion. To create a diversion you make a Bluff check DC equal to 10 plus each opponent's modifier to sense motive checks.
feat-innovative-leadership:
You blend your knowledge of performance arts with your leadership experience to keep your skills in the bardic arts and auras competitive.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd level in both bard (or legendary bard) and marshal classes, bardic performance, minor auras, and 4 skill ranks in Diplomacy, Knowledge (arcana), Perform (any), and Sense Motive.

Benefit: Your bard (or legendary bard) and marshal class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your total daily rounds of bardic performance and your total number of readied auras for the day. This does change your effective class levels for any other aspects.

You also stack your bard (or legendary bard) and marshal class levels together to determine your effective bard (or legendary bard) and marshal levels for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of bardic masterpieces (or bardic performances for legendary bard) and feats.
feat-inspirational-performance:
Your bardic performances now include a minor boost that inspires your allies to success on certain actions.

Prerequisite(s): BAB +3, bardic performance, and 3 skill ranks in any Perform skill.

Benefit: Each round in which you spend at least one round of bardic performance to maintain an ongoing bardic performance you created with an audible component that affects at least one creature other than yourself, you may select 1 target creature within range of your bardic performance other than yourself. If you succeed on a Perform check (DC 20), that target creature gains the benefits of the aid another action as if you succeeded on an aid another check.

Special: The effects of this feat do not trigger during any round in which your bardic performance required no rounds of bardic performance to maintain (such as through a tuned bowstring or Lingering Performance).

The effects of this feat also do not trigger during a bardic performance you created through the use of spells or magic items.
feat-inspiring-leader:
Your presence in combat bolsters the morale of your soldiers.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership.

Benefit: Your followers and cohort gained through Leadership gain a +1 morale bonus to attack and damage rolls and a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. This functions as long as they are within 100 feet of you and can see and hear you.
feat-invigorate:
When you heal others you aid their spirit and flesh.

Prerequisite(s): Class feature which restores hit points to other creatures.

Benefit: Whenever you use a class feature that restores hit points to a creature other than yourself, you also gird them against other ailments. For 10 minutes, the affected creature gains a bonus on saves against poison and disease equal to 1/4 your character level. If the creature is currently suffering from the effects of any disease or poison they may make a new save against that effect as a free action when healed by you. A creature can only benefit from this feat once per day.
feat-iron-body-iron-mind:
Training your body to its limit has manifested in a particularly strong determination.

Prerequisite(s): Endurance, base Fortitude save +3

Benefit(s): You use your Constitution modifier in place of your Wisdom modifier on Will saves and no longer automatically fail a fortitude save on a roll of 1.
feat-lead-volley-combat-teamwork:
When you mark a target with a ranged attack, you aid your allies aim.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any ranged weapon)

Benefit(s): You may make a single attack at your highest base attack bonus as a standard action to grant each ally who makes a ranged attack against the target to gain a +1 circumstance bonus on their first ranged attack against the target before your next turn.

Special: If you and an adjacent ally both have this feat and attack the same target the circumstance bonus becomes +2 for each ally attacking thereafter.
feat-leadership-greater:
You are a truly inspiring leader.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership.

Benefit: You increase your leadership score by 4.

Special: This feat can be taken multiple times, but the additional times only grant a +2 bonus.
feat-legendary-personage:
Your presence grows as you continue to straddle the line between being a leader and a reckoning force.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd level in both marshal and vigilante classes, inspire action, renown (or obscurity) social talent, unshakeable, and 4 skill ranks in Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive.

Benefit: Your marshal and vigilante class levels stack together for the purpose of determining your total daily uses of inspire action, the effectiveness of unshakeable, and the distance limit from a community you have gained renown or obscurity in with the renown or obscurity social talent. This does not change your effective class levels for any other aspects.

You also stack your marshal and vigilante class levels together to determine your effective marshal and vigilante levels for the purposes of meeting the prerequisites of any social talent that has renown or obscurity as a prerequisite and feats.
feat-like-water-combat:
You have honed your reflexes to the point of instinct.

Prerequisite(s): Evasion, Improved Unarmed Strike, Acrobatics 9 ranks

Benefit(s): When fighting defensively you gain a +4 dodge bonus to AC and suffer only a -2 penalty to attack rolls. Additionally, when an opponent misses you while you are fighting defensively or taking the total defense action you may make an attack of opportunity with an unarmed strike or light weapon.
feat-mage-slayer-combat:
You have dedicated your skills and tactics to combat spellcasters.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 2 ranks, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit: You gain a +1 bonus in Will saving throws against spells or spell-like abilities.

Spellcasters you threaten may not cast defensively. The spellcaster is aware of this by your demeanor and if they still try the attempt automatically fails. The spellcaster is immune to this feat if they are 4 or more levels higher than you.
feat-melee-wand-wielder:
You have integrated magic wands into your combat style.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (dagger), caster level 3rd

Benefit(s): You may wield a wand in melee as though it were a dagger, and using dagger traits and statistics, and leverage additional benefits from the magic within. You may spend a swift action to expend charges from the wand to grant yourself a bonus to attack and damage rolls with it. For every 2 charges you expend the wand gains a +1 enhancement bonus to a maximum of 1/2 the level of the spell it contains, rounded down. This bonus lasts for a number of rounds equal to the level of the spell in the wand. In addition, you may make an attack with the wand as a standard action, if successful you may expend 2 charges from the wand to activate it as a free action, instead of its normal casting time. If the spell has an area of effect you choose if the point of origin is your square or the square containing the target of your attack.
feat-metamagic-spell-trigger:
You have learned how to manipulate the magic provided by spell-trigger items.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 10 ranks, any metamagic feat

Benefit(s): You can apply one metamagic feat you know to a spell generated by a spell trigger item, like a wand or staff, that you activate. You expend one extra charge for each spell level increase normally required by the metamagic feat. This level increase is not reduced by any class ability or feat for this purpose. You cannot increase the spell's level above 9th with the metamagic applied.
